# M1 Foundation Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Execute tasks in the serial order under Global Constraints → Execution order, not by heading number.** Each out-of-order task names its predecessor in a **Run after:** line under its heading.

**Goal:** Turn the Unity 6000.6.5f1 URP template at `C:\Dev\FishGame` into the FishGame M1 Foundation (spec §17.1): a pinned, asmdef-split project with a CLI pipeline; pure-C# Core logic (RNG, hashing, connection state machine, join rules, payload codec, input routing, movement math, audio recipes); runtime services; solo, dev-direct and online (Sessions/Relay) networking behind one `INetworkSession`; a host-authoritative 4-player roster with a networked first-person player on a generated lake dock; UI Toolkit menus, HUD and settings; deterministic editor builders with validators; EditMode and PlayMode tests; and a manual acceptance checklist for criteria 1–13.

**Architecture:** Thirteen assembly definitions with a one-way dependency chain (Core ← Data ← Runtime ← Networking, Gameplay ← Fishing ← Presentation ← UI ← App; Editor and Tests on top). Core is pure C# (`noEngineReferences`) and holds every rule worth unit-testing. Runtime holds the service seams (`ServiceRegistry` + `ServiceRoots`, `EventBus`, `ISettings`, `IInputService`, `INetworkSession`, `AudioBus`). Networking is the only assembly that touches UGS. `CompositeNetworkSession` routes each attempt to `LocalNetworkSession` (plain UnityTransport on 127.0.0.1) or a lazily created `UgsNetworkSession`, so Solo never touches UGS. The host approves joins through Core `JoinRules` and hands approvals to the replicated `SessionState` roster through `JoinApprovalBridge`. The owner moves its own `PlayerFP` (NetworkTransform, owner authority); the host spawns players and the `DockBell`. `AppBootstrap` on the DontDestroyOnLoad `App` object is the composition root. All scenes, prefabs, materials, the network prefab list and most project settings are generated by `FishGame.EditorTools.ProjectBuilder.BuildAll` and checked by validators.

**Tech Stack:** Unity 6000.6.5f1, URP 17.6.0, Netcode for GameObjects 2.13.3 (UnityTransport), Unity Multiplayer Services 2.3.3 (Sessions: Lobby + Relay), Authentication 3.8.0, Core 1.18.0, Input System 1.20.0, UI Toolkit, Multiplayer Play Mode 3.0.0, Multiplayer Tools 2.2.12 (Network Simulator), Test Framework 1.8.0 (NUnit), C# 9, Windows PowerShell 5.1 (`Tools/unity.ps1`).

**Spec:** C:\Dev\FishGame\docs\superpowers\specs\2026-10-09-fishgame-design.md (section 17.1)

**Interface contract:** C:\Dev\FishGame\docs\superpowers\plans\2026-10-09-m1-interfaces.md

### Encoding and paths (spec 4.1)

> 2. **Encoding.** Every text file (`.cs`, `.json`, `.asmdef`, `.inputactions`, `.uxml`, `.uss`, `.shader`, `.hlsl`, `.md`, `.meta`) is UTF-8 **without a BOM**. Windows PowerShell 5.1 `Set-Content`/`Out-File -Encoding utf8` writes a BOM and UPM then rejects `manifest.json`. Use the Write tool or `[IO.File]::WriteAllText(p, t, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))`.
> 3. **Paths.** Pass absolute paths to Unity `-logFile` and `-testResults`; paths with `..` were rejected empirically.

Also UTF-8 without BOM: `.tss` and `.ps1`. `Tools/unity.ps1` is pure ASCII. Copy every code block in this plan exactly, character for character.

### Editor lock (spec 4.1 #1)

> 1. **Editor lock.** Before any batchmode run, test whether `Temp/UnityLockfile` is held open (`[IO.File]::Open(path, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None')` in PowerShell).
>    - Locked: the editor is open. Ask the user to close it, or use editor-open mode (4.8).
>    - Present but not locked: stale from a crash; proceed.
>    - Never kill Unity processes.

`Tools/unity.ps1` does this check itself. If any run prints `FG RESULT <command> LOCKED ...` (exit 2), stop the task and report that the editor is open. On `FG RESULT <command> TIMEOUT pid=<pid> ...` (exit 3), report the PID and stop. Never kill Unity.

Spec 4.8: "Required `-OutDir` (the session scratchpad) receives `<name>.log` and XML. Logs and results never go in the repo." and "Run the lock-file check first. **Never pass `-quit` with `-runTests`.**"

### Assembly definitions and dependency direction (spec 4.3)

> **Dependency direction:** Core ← Data ← Runtime ← Networking, Gameplay ← Fishing ← Presentation ← UI ← App. Editor and Tests sit on top. References are not transitive.
> - Gameplay never references Fishing, Presentation or UI.
> - Fishing references Gameplay (to set the player's input context) but never Networking.
> - Presentation reads Gameplay and Fishing state (NetworkVariables, read-only properties, C# events) and never writes gameplay state (enforced by code review).
> - UI talks to sessions only through `INetworkSession` (Runtime).
>
> No runtime code in Assembly-CSharp (test asmdefs cannot reference it).

- T1 creates all 13 asmdefs with the exact content in contract §4. **No later task edits an asmdef**, except T15/T16/T17 under the integration-fix rule, and then only to *add* a reference. A missing reference in any other task is a contract bug: stop and report it.
- One namespace per assembly, no sub-namespaces: `FishGame.Core`, `FishGame.Data`, `FishGame.Runtime` (the generated input wrapper alone uses `FishGame.Input`), `FishGame.Networking`, `FishGame.Gameplay`, `FishGame.Fishing`, `FishGame.Presentation`, `FishGame.UI`, `FishGame.App`, `FishGame.EditorTools` (both editor assemblies; never `FishGame.Editor`, CS0118), `FishGame.Tests.EditMode`, `FishGame.Tests.PlayMode`.
- `FishGame.Core` has `noEngineReferences: true`: never `using UnityEngine;`, never `UnityEngine.Random` or `System.Random`.
- Never write a bare `Input.` identifier in a `FishGame.*` namespace. Never name a type or namespace `Input` or `Editor`. Never add `using System.Numerics;` to a file that also uses `UnityEngine`.
- Gameplay, Fishing, Presentation and UI never mention `Unity.Services` or `Unity.Netcode.Transports` (the T15 architecture test enforces it).
- Unity 6 compiles C# 9: no file-scoped namespaces, `global using`, `record`, `init`, collection expressions or primary constructors.

### Naming and file rules (spec 4.5)

> - One MonoBehaviour, NetworkBehaviour or ScriptableObject per file; file name equals class name. Keep other classes one per file too, under ~300 lines.
> - RPC methods end in `Rpc`. NetworkVariable fields are prefixed `Net` (for example `NetPitchQ`).
> - Every networked class opens with a class comment stating its authority (host or owner).
> - Do not reuse Unity type names: no `PlayerInput` (use `PlayerInputFrame`), `BuildPipeline`, `NetworkManager`.
> - **Ids:** stable lowercase snake_case string ids (`lake_dock`, `rod_handmade`) are save and network keys. `ContentRegistry` assigns `ushort` indices by ordinal-sorted id (`StringComparer.Ordinal`) per category, so host and clients agree. Never send ScriptableObject references, asset paths or GUIDs.
> - **Versioning:** `BuildInfo.ProtocolVersion` (int, bumped by hand on any wire, RPC or networked-prefab change) goes **only into the connection payload**. `NetworkConfig.ProtocolVersion` stays at a constant 0.
> - Core RNG: `Pcg32` (PCG-XSH-RR, seed never 0). Streams derive with `Rng.Derive(runSeed, StreamId, index)` = SplitMix64 over FNV-1a of a constant stream id, so extra draws in one system never shift another's rolls. `UnityEngine.Random` and `System.Random` are not used in Core.
> - Test names: `Subject_Condition_Expected`.

A file may hold several public types only where the contract lists them together (for example `JoinRules.cs`, `ConnectPayload.cs`, `ServiceRegistry.cs`, `ContentHash.cs`). A task may add private or internal helpers freely; it must not add, rename or remove anything public that the contract lists. `.meta` files are generated by Unity on the next batchmode run and committed with their assets; the only hand-written `.meta` is `FishGameInput.inputactions.meta` (T4).

## Review Focus

The five input classes or failure modes the spec implies but the original task tests did not exercise. Each now has a pinning test in its owning task (written in that task's red step, so it is red first and green after).

1. **Disconnect reason text that is not exactly one `EndReason` name** (NGO's own `[Disconnect Event] ...` text, a comma list such as `FullLobby, Kicked`, wrong case, digits): it falls through to the `wasConnected` / timing rules; a comma list must not parse as `FullLobby | Kicked` (= `VersionMismatch`). Pin: T3 `DisconnectClassifier_NonExactReasonText_FallsThrough`.
2. **Connect payload with multi-byte UTF-8 or corrupted bytes** (accented ids over 64 bytes, emoji at the name cut, a lone `0xFF` byte, one byte short or long, unknown kind): `Encode` truncates by characters then bytes without splitting a surrogate pair and stays ≤ 255 bytes; `TryDecode` returns false and never throws. Pin: T3 `ConnectPayloadCodec_MultiByteAndInvalidUtf8_HandledSafely` (with `DisplayNameRules_Sanitize_DoesNotSplitSurrogatePair`).
3. **Dev-flag tokens from MPPM tags or command lines in the wrong shape** (missing value, value that is the next flag, port 0 / 65536 / non-numeric, hostname instead of IPv4, upper-case flag names): the flag is ignored and left at its default, the next flag is still read, and flag names are case-insensitive. Pin: T3 `DevFlags_Parse_MalformedJoinDirect_IsIgnoredAndNextFlagKept`.
4. **Session error messages where "full" is part of a longer word** ("successfully", "fully"): they are not `FullLobby`; "Lobby is full", "LOBBY FULL" and "LobbyFull" still are. Pin: T9 `UgsErrorMap_FullInsideLongerWord_IsNotFullLobby`.
5. **Relay failures whose message mentions a join code** (the SDK's "Failed to fetch relay join code"): they map to `ServicesUnavailable` ("Online services are unavailable"), not `InvalidCode` ("code not found"); a `SessionNotFound` code still wins. Pin: T9 `UgsErrorMap_RelayJoinCodeFailure_IsServicesUnavailable`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Manifest pins (spec 4.2 step 3, 4.4)**

**3a. Write the check.** Create `<absolute scratchpad path>\t1\check-manifest.ps1` with the Write tool, using exactly this content:
```powershell
# T1 scratch check for Packages/manifest.json (spec 4.4). Not part of the repo.
param([string]$Path = 'C:\Dev\FishGame\Packages\manifest.json')
$problems = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF) { $problems.Add('BOM present') }
$m = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) | ConvertFrom-Json
$d = $m.dependencies
$names = @($d.PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
$pins = [ordered]@{
    'com.unity.ai.navigation'              = '2.0.15'
    'com.unity.ide.rider'                  = '3.0.38'
    'com.unity.ide.visualstudio'           = '2.0.26'
    'com.unity.inputsystem'                = '1.20.0'
    'com.unity.multiplayer.playmode'       = '3.0.0'
    'com.unity.multiplayer.tools'          = '2.2.12'
    'com.unity.netcode.gameobjects'        = '2.13.3'
    'com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json'      = '3.2.2'
    'com.unity.pipeline'                   = '0.8.0-exp.1'
    'com.unity.render-pipelines.universal' = '17.6.0'
    'com.unity.services.authentication'    = '3.8.0'
    'com.unity.services.core'              = '1.18.0'
    'com.unity.services.multiplayer'       = '2.3.3'
    'com.unity.test-framework'             = '1.8.0'
    'com.unity.timeline'                   = '6.6.0'
    'com.unity.ugui'                       = '2.6.0'
}
foreach ($k in $pins.Keys) {
    if ($names -notcontains $k) { $problems.Add("missing $k") }
    elseif ($d.$k -ne $pins[$k]) { $problems.Add("wrong $k=" + $d.$k) }
}
$forbidden = @('com.unity.visualscripting', 'com.unity.collab-proxy', 'com.unity.services.relay', 'com.unity.services.lobby',
    'com.unity.services.matchmaker', 'com.unity.services.multiplay', 'com.unity.multiplay', 'com.unity.multiplayer.widgets',
    'com.unity.textmeshpro', 'com.unity.cinemachine', 'com.unity.transport')
foreach ($k in $forbidden) { if ($names -contains $k) { $problems.Add("forbidden $k") } }
$moduleCount = @($names | Where-Object { $_ -like 'com.unity.modules.*' }).Count
if ($moduleCount -ne 36) { $problems.Add("modules=$moduleCount (want 36)") }
foreach ($k in $names) {
    if (($k -notlike 'com.unity.modules.*') -and (-not $pins.Contains($k)) -and ($forbidden -notcontains $k)) { $problems.Add("unexpected $k") }
}
if ($problems.Count -eq 0) { 'MANIFEST OK' } else { $problems | ForEach-Object { 'MANIFEST ' + $_ } }
```

```powershell
        'rootNamespace'         = $e.Ns
        'references'            = ($e.Refs -join ',')

        'autoReferenced'        = [string](-not $e.Test)
        'defineConstraints'     = $(if ($e.Test) { 'UNITY_INCLUDE_TESTS' } else { '' })
        'versionDefines'        = ''
        'noEngineReferences'    = [string]$e.NoEngine
    }
    foreach ($key in $want.Keys) {
        $prop = $j.PSObject.Properties[$key]
        if ($null -eq $prop) { $problems.Add($e.File + ' lacks ' + $key); continue }
        $have = (@($prop.Value) | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ }) -join ','
        if ($have -ne $want[$key]) { $problems.Add($e.File + ' ' + $key + '=' + $have + ' (want ' + $want[$key] + ')') }
    }
}
$all = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Root -Recurse -Filter *.asmdef -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
if ($all -ne 13) { $problems.Add("asmdef count=$all (want 13)") }

    'Data\AssemblyInfo.cs'           = 'namespace FishGame.Data { internal static class AssemblyMarker { } }'

    'Fishing\AssemblyInfo.cs'        = 'namespace FishGame.Fishing { internal static class AssemblyMarker { } }'

    'Editor\AssemblyInfo.cs'         = 'namespace FishGame.EditorTools { internal static class EditorAssemblyMarker { } }'
    'Editor\TestMenu\AssemblyInfo.cs' = 'namespace FishGame.EditorTools { internal static class TestMenuAssemblyMarker { } }'
    'Tests\PlayMode\AssemblyInfo.cs' = 'namespace FishGame.Tests.PlayMode { internal static class AssemblyMarker { } }'
}
$header = '// Assembly marker (T1). Keeps this asmdef compiling before its first type exists. Do not delete.'
foreach ($rel in $markers.Keys) {
    $path = Join-Path $Root $rel
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path)) { $problems.Add('missing ' + $rel); continue }
    if (Test-Bom $path) { $problems.Add('BOM ' + $rel) }
    $text = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($path)
    if ($text -ne ($header + "`n" + $markers[$rel] + "`n")) { $problems.Add('content ' + $rel) }
}
$markerCount = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Root -Recurse -Filter AssemblyInfo.cs -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
if ($markerCount -ne 12) { $problems.Add("marker count=$markerCount (want 12)") }
if ($problems.Count -eq 0) { 'ASMDEFS OK' } else { $problems | ForEach-Object { 'ASMDEFS ' + $_ } }
```

```powershell
# Tools/unity.ps1 - FishGame wrapper for Unity batchmode runs (M1 interface contract section 11).
# ASCII only. Windows PowerShell 5.1 compatible.
#
# Usage:
#   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Dev\FishGame\Tools\unity.ps1 <command> [-OutDir <abs dir>] [-Filter <regex>] [-TimeoutMinutes <int>]
#   <command> = compile | build | test-edit | test-play | check
#
# OutDir defaults to $env:FG_OUT. It must be absolute, must not contain '..', and must be outside the repo.
# Exit codes: 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 LOCKED, 3 TIMEOUT, 4 usage error.
# The command is checked by hand instead of with ValidateSet, because a ValidateSet failure exits 1, not 4.
param(
    [Parameter(Position = 0)]
    [string]$Command = '',

    [string]$OutDir = $env:FG_OUT,

    [string]$Filter = '',

    [int]$TimeoutMinutes = 5
)

$ProjectRoot = 'C:\Dev\FishGame'
$UnityExe    = 'C:\Program Files\Unity\Hub\Editor\6000.6.5f1\Editor\Unity.exe'
$LockFile    = Join-Path $ProjectRoot 'Temp\UnityLockfile'
$ErrPattern  = 'error CS|Exception|Scripts have compiler errors|Compilation failed'
$Commands    = @('compile', 'build', 'test-edit', 'test-play', 'check')
$UsageLine   = 'usage: unity.ps1 <compile|build|test-edit|test-play|check> -OutDir <absolute scratch dir outside the repo> (or set FG_OUT)'

function Say([string]$Text) {
    [Console]::Out.WriteLine($Text)
}

function Exit-Usage([string]$Detail) {
    Say $UsageLine
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Detail)) { Say ('usage: ' + $Detail) }
    exit 4
}

function Get-LogText([string]$Log) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Log)) { return '' }
    $raw = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Log -Raw -Encoding UTF8
    if ($null -eq $raw) { return '' }
    return [string]$raw
}

function Test-UnityLocked {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $LockFile)) { return $false }
    try {
        $stream = [IO.File]::Open($LockFile, 'Open', 'ReadWrite', 'None')
        $stream.Close()
        return $false
    }
    catch {
        return $true
    }
}

function Show-LogExcerpt([string]$Log, [string]$Pattern) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Log)) {
        Say ('FG LOG no log file at ' + $Log)
        return
    }
    $shown = 0
    foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $Log -Encoding UTF8)) {
        if ($line -match $Pattern) {
            Say ('FG LOG ' + $line)
            $shown++
            if ($shown -ge 40) { break }
        }
    }
}

function Test-CompileClean([string]$Log) {
    $text = Get-LogText $Log
    return (($text -match 'Exiting batchmode successfully') -and ($text -notmatch 'error CS'))
}

function Invoke-UnityRun([string]$Name, [string]$Extra) {
    $log = Join-Path $OutDir ($Name + '.log')
    if (Test-UnityLocked) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status = 'LOCKED'; ProcId = 0; ExitCode = -1; Log = $log }
    }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $log) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $log -Force }
    $unityArgs = '-batchmode -nographics -projectPath "' + $ProjectRoot + '" -logFile "' + $log + '" ' + $Extra
    try {
        $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $UnityExe -ArgumentList $unityArgs -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ErrorAction Stop
    }
    catch {
        Say ('FG LOG could not start Unity: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status = 'DONE'; ProcId = 0; ExitCode = -1; Log = $log }
    }
    $null = $proc.Handle
    $finished = $proc.WaitForExit($TimeoutMinutes * 60 * 1000)
    if (-not $finished) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status = 'TIMEOUT'; ProcId = $proc.Id; ExitCode = -1; Log = $log }
    }
    return [pscustomobject]@{ Status = 'DONE'; ProcId = $proc.Id; ExitCode = $proc.ExitCode; Log = $log }
}

function Invoke-Compile {
    $run = Invoke-UnityRun 'compile' '-quit'
    switch ($run.Status) {
        'LOCKED'  { Say 'FG RESULT compile LOCKED (close the Unity editor, then rerun)'; return 2 }
        'TIMEOUT' { Say ('FG RESULT compile TIMEOUT pid=' + $run.ProcId + ' log=' + $run.Log); return 3 }
    }
    if (($run.ExitCode -eq 0) -and (Test-CompileClean $run.Log)) {
        Say ('FG RESULT compile PASS log=' + $run.Log)
        return 0
    }
    Show-LogExcerpt $run.Log $ErrPattern
    Say ('FG RESULT compile FAIL log=' + $run.Log)
    return 1
}

function Invoke-Build {
    $run = Invoke-UnityRun 'build' '-quit -executeMethod FishGame.EditorTools.ProjectBuilder.BuildAll'
    switch ($run.Status) {
        'LOCKED'  { Say 'FG RESULT build LOCKED (close the Unity editor, then rerun)'; return 2 }
        'TIMEOUT' { Say ('FG RESULT build TIMEOUT pid=' + $run.ProcId + ' log=' + $run.Log); return 3 }
    }
    $text = Get-LogText $run.Log
    if ($text -match 'FG BUILDALL FAIL') {
        foreach ($line in (Get-Content -LiteralPath $run.Log -Encoding UTF8)) {
            if ($line -match '^FG BUILDALL ERROR ') { Say $line }
        }
        Show-LogExcerpt $run.Log $ErrPattern
        Say ('FG RESULT build FAIL log=' + $run.Log)
        return 1
    }
    if (($run.ExitCode -eq 0) -and (Test-CompileClean $run.Log) -and ($text -match 'FG BUILDALL PASS')) {
        Say ('FG RESULT build PASS log=' + $run.Log)
        return 0
    }
    Show-LogExcerpt $run.Log $ErrPattern
    Say ('FG RESULT build FAIL log=' + $run.Log)
    return 1
}

function Invoke-Tests([string]$Name, [string]$Platform, [string]$XmlName) {
    $xml = Join-Path $OutDir $XmlName
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $xml) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $xml -Force }
    # Never pass -quit with -runTests.
    $extra = '-runTests -testPlatform ' + $Platform + ' -testResults "' + $xml + '" -dev-profile fgtest'
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Filter)) { $extra = $extra + ' -testFilter "' + $Filter + '"' }
    $run = Invoke-UnityRun $Name $extra
    switch ($run.Status) {
        'LOCKED'  { Say ('FG RESULT ' + $Name + ' LOCKED (close the Unity editor, then rerun)'); return 2 }
        'TIMEOUT' { Say ('FG RESULT ' + $Name + ' TIMEOUT pid=' + $run.ProcId + ' log=' + $run.Log); return 3 }
    }

    $total = 0; $passed = 0; $failed = 0; $skipped = 0
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $xml) {
        try {
            [xml]$doc = Get-Content -LiteralPath $xml -Raw -Encoding UTF8
            $runNode = $doc.SelectSingleNode('/test-run')
            if ($null -ne $runNode) {
                $total = [int]$runNode.GetAttribute('total')
                $passed = [int]$runNode.GetAttribute('passed')
                $failed = [int]$runNode.GetAttribute('failed')
                $skipped = [int]$runNode.GetAttribute('skipped')
                foreach ($case in $doc.SelectNodes('//test-case[@result="Failed"]')) {
                    $message = ''
                    $messageNode = $case.SelectSingleNode('failure/message')
                    if ($null -ne $messageNode) { $message = [string]$messageNode.InnerText }
                    $firstLine = ($message.Trim() -split "`r?`n")[0]
                    Say ('FG FAILED ' + $case.GetAttribute('fullname') + ' :: ' + $firstLine)
                }
            }
        }
        catch {
            Say ('FG LOG could not parse ' + $xml)
        }
    }

    $logText = Get-LogText $run.Log
    $completed = $logText -match 'Test run completed\. Exiting with code 0'
    $completedAny = $logText -match 'Test run completed\. Exiting with code'
    if (($total -gt 0) -and ($failed -eq 0) -and $completed) {
        Say ('FG RESULT ' + $Name + ' PASS total=' + $total + ' passed=' + $passed + ' failed=0 skipped=' + $skipped + ' log=' + $run.Log)
        return 0
    }
    if ($total -eq 0) {
        Show-LogExcerpt $run.Log $ErrPattern
        Say ('FG RESULT ' + $Name + ' FAIL total=0 (no tests matched or compile errors) log=' + $run.Log)
        return 1
    }
    $reason = ''
    if (-not $completedAny) { $reason = ' (no completion line in log)' }
    Say ('FG RESULT ' + $Name + ' FAIL total=' + $total + ' passed=' + $passed + ' failed=' + $failed + ' skipped=' + $skipped + ' log=' + $run.Log + $reason)
    return 1
}

# ---- entry point ----
if ($Commands -notcontains $Command) {
    Exit-Usage ("unknown or missing command '" + $Command + "'")
}
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($OutDir)) {
    Exit-Usage 'no -OutDir given and FG_OUT is not set'
}
if ((-not [IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($OutDir)) -or $OutDir.Contains('..')) {
    Exit-Usage ('OutDir must be absolute and must not contain ..: ' + $OutDir)
}
$outFull  = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($OutDir).TrimEnd('\')
$rootFull = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ProjectRoot).TrimEnd('\')
if ($outFull.Equals($rootFull, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or $outFull.StartsWith($rootFull + '\', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
    Exit-Usage ('OutDir must be outside the repo: ' + $OutDir)
}
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $UnityExe)) {
    Exit-Usage ('Unity editor not found at ' + $UnityExe)
}
$OutDir = $outFull
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutDir | Out-Null

$code = 1
switch ($Command) {
    'compile'   { $code = Invoke-Compile }
    'build'     { $code = Invoke-Build }
    'test-edit' { $code = Invoke-Tests 'test-edit' 'EditMode' 'editmode.xml' }
    'test-play' { $code = Invoke-Tests 'test-play' 'PlayMode' 'playmode.xml' }
    'check' {
        $code = Invoke-Build
        if ($code -eq 0) { $code = Invoke-Tests 'test-edit' 'EditMode' 'editmode.xml' }
        if ($code -eq 0) { $code = Invoke-Tests 'test-play' 'PlayMode' 'playmode.xml' }
        switch ($code) {
            0       { Say 'FG RESULT check PASS' }
            2       { Say 'FG RESULT check LOCKED (close the Unity editor, then rerun)' }
            3       { Say 'FG RESULT check TIMEOUT' }
            default { Say 'FG RESULT check FAIL' }
        }
    }
}
exit $code
```

Neither file can be unit-tested in batchmode. A menu click cannot be driven there, and the hook cannot observe the compilation that builds it. Step 8 proves both compile, and step 11 proves the hook writes its file. The menu items are checked by hand in T17's editor-open checklist.

Create `C:\Dev\FishGame\Assets\_Project\Editor\CompileLogHook.cs` with exactly this content:
```csharp
// Editor tooling (T1). After every script compilation, writes Logs/FishGame/compile.txt so an
// editor-open session can read errors and warnings without the Console window. Not used at runtime.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Compilation;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    [InitializeOnLoad]
    public static class CompileLogHook
    {
        public const string RelativeLogPath = "Logs/FishGame/compile.txt";

        private static readonly List<string> Lines = new List<string>();
        private static int errorCount;
        private static int warningCount;

        static CompileLogHook()
        {
            CompilationPipeline.compilationStarted += OnCompilationStarted;
            CompilationPipeline.assemblyCompilationFinished += OnAssemblyCompilationFinished;
            CompilationPipeline.compilationFinished += OnCompilationFinished;
        }

        private static void OnCompilationStarted(object context)
        {
            Lines.Clear();
            errorCount = 0;
            warningCount = 0;
        }

        private static void OnAssemblyCompilationFinished(string assemblyPath, CompilerMessage[] messages)
        {
            if (messages == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            foreach (CompilerMessage message in messages)
            {
                string kind;
                if (message.type == CompilerMessageType.Error)
                {
                    kind = "Error";
                    errorCount++;
                }
                else if (message.type == CompilerMessageType.Warning)
                {
                    kind = "Warning";
                    warningCount++;
                }
                else
                {
                    continue;
                }

                string text = (message.message ?? string.Empty).Replace('\r', ' ').Replace('\n', ' ');
                Lines.Add(kind + " " + message.file + "(" + message.line + "," + message.column + "): " + text);
            }
        }

        private static void OnCompilationFinished(object context)
        {
            string status = errorCount == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL";
            string stamp = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssK", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

            var output = new StringBuilder();
            output.Append("FG COMPILE ").Append(status)
                  .Append(" errors=").Append(errorCount)
                  .Append(" warnings=").Append(warningCount)
                  .Append(" at=").Append(stamp).Append('\n');
            foreach (string line in Lines)
            {
                output.Append(line).Append('\n');
            }

            try
            {
                string fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "..", RelativeLogPath));
                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(fullPath));
                File.WriteAllText(fullPath, output.ToString(), new UTF8Encoding(false));
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("FG COMPILE log not written: " + exception.Message);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Create `C:\Dev\FishGame\Assets\_Project\Editor\TestMenu\TestMenu.cs` with exactly this content. It uses `[InitializeOnLoad]` for a specific reason. The Test Runner keeps registered callbacks in a list that is emptied on every domain reload, and a PlayMode run reloads the domain when it enters Play mode (domain reload is switched on in T15). So the result saver is registered again each time the editor domain loads, and the pending run is kept in `UnityEditor.SessionState`, which survives reloads. `SessionState` is written fully qualified because T10 adds a `FishGame.Gameplay.SessionState`.
```csharp
// Editor tooling (T1). Menu entry points that run the EditMode or PlayMode suites through the
// Test Runner API and save the NUnit XML result under Logs/FishGame. Not used at runtime.
using System.IO;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.TestTools.TestRunner.Api;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    // Registered on every domain load: the Test Runner drops registered callbacks on domain reload,
    // and a PlayMode run reloads the domain. The pending run survives in UnityEditor.SessionState.
    [InitializeOnLoad]
    public static class TestMenu
    {
        public const string EditModeResultPath = "Logs/FishGame/editmode.xml";
        public const string PlayModeResultPath = "Logs/FishGame/playmode.xml";

        private const string PendingPathKey = "FishGame.TestMenu.PendingResultPath";
        private const string PendingModeKey = "FishGame.TestMenu.PendingModeName";

        static TestMenu()
        {
            TestRunnerApi.RegisterTestCallback(new ResultSaver());
        }

        [MenuItem("FishGame/Run EditMode Tests")]
        public static void RunEditMode()
        {
            Run(TestMode.EditMode, "EditMode", EditModeResultPath);
        }

        [MenuItem("FishGame/Run PlayMode Tests")]
        public static void RunPlayMode()
        {
            Run(TestMode.PlayMode, "PlayMode", PlayModeResultPath);
        }

        private static void Run(TestMode mode, string modeName, string relativePath)
        {
            UnityEditor.SessionState.SetString(PendingPathKey, relativePath);
            UnityEditor.SessionState.SetString(PendingModeKey, modeName);
            TestRunnerApi api = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<TestRunnerApi>();
            api.Execute(new ExecutionSettings(new UnityEditor.TestTools.TestRunner.Api.Filter { testMode = mode }));
        }

        private sealed class ResultSaver : ICallbacks
        {
            public void RunStarted(ITestAdaptor testsToRun)
            {
            }

            public void RunFinished(ITestResultAdaptor result)
            {
                string relativePath = UnityEditor.SessionState.GetString(PendingPathKey, string.Empty);
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(relativePath))
                {
                    // This run was not started from this menu (command line or Test Runner window).
                    return;
                }

                string modeName = UnityEditor.SessionState.GetString(PendingModeKey, "Unknown");
                UnityEditor.SessionState.EraseString(PendingPathKey);
                UnityEditor.SessionState.EraseString(PendingModeKey);

                string fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "..", relativePath));
                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(fullPath));
                TestRunnerApi.SaveResultToFile(result, fullPath);
                Debug.Log("FG TESTS " + modeName + " passed=" + result.PassCount + " failed=" + result.FailCount);
            }

            public void TestStarted(ITestAdaptor test)
            {
            }

            public void TestFinished(ITestResultAdaptor result)
            {
            }
        }
    }
}
```

The APIs above were checked against test-framework 1.8.0 source:
- `TestRunnerApi.RegisterTestCallback<T>(T, int priority = 0)` and `SaveResultToFile(ITestResultAdaptor, string)` are both public static.
- `Execute(ExecutionSettings)` is an instance method.
- `ExecutionSettings(params Filter[])` is a constructor, and `Filter.testMode` is a field.
- `ICallbacks` has exactly the four methods shown.
- `ITestResultAdaptor` has `PassCount` and `FailCount`.

```powershell
# T1 scratch check: every reference in the 13 asmdefs names an assembly Unity actually built. Not part of the repo.
param([string]$Root = 'C:\Dev\FishGame')
$sa = Join-Path $Root 'Library\ScriptAssemblies'
$problems = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$asmdefs = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Root 'Assets\_Project') -Recurse -Filter *.asmdef)
foreach ($f in $asmdefs) {
    $j = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName) | ConvertFrom-Json
    foreach ($r in @($j.references)) {

    }
}
$want = @('FishGame.Core', 'FishGame.Data', 'FishGame.Runtime', 'FishGame.Networking', 'FishGame.Gameplay', 'FishGame.Fishing',
```

```csharp
using System;
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class Pcg32Tests
    {
        [Test]
        public void Pcg32_Seed42Stream54_MatchesReferenceVector()
        {
            // Reference output of O'Neill's pcg32-demo: pcg32_srandom_r(&rng, 42u, 54u).
            var rng = new Pcg32(42, 54);
            uint[] expected =
            {
                0xa15c02b7u, 0x7b47f409u, 0xba1d3330u,
                0x83d2f293u, 0xbfa4784bu, 0xcbed606eu
            };
            for (int i = 0; i < expected.Length; i++)
            {
                Assert.That(rng.NextUInt(), Is.EqualTo(expected[i]), "draw " + i);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void Pcg32_ZeroSeed_IsReplaced()
        {
            var zero = new Pcg32(0, 54);
            var replaced = new Pcg32(Pcg32.ZeroSeedReplacement, 54);
            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
            {
                Assert.That(zero.NextUInt(), Is.EqualTo(replaced.NextUInt()), "draw " + i);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void Pcg32_RangeInt_StaysInBounds()
        {
            var rng = new Pcg32(7, 1);
            bool sawMin = false, sawMaxMinusOne = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < 10000; i++)
            {
                int v = rng.Range(-3, 7);
                Assert.That(v, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(-3));
                Assert.That(v, Is.LessThan(7));
                if (v == -3) sawMin = true;
                if (v == 6) sawMaxMinusOne = true;
            }
            Assert.That(sawMin, Is.True, "min value never drawn");
            Assert.That(sawMaxMinusOne, Is.True, "max-1 value never drawn");
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => rng.Range(5, 5));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => rng.Range(5, 4));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Pcg32_FloatDraws_StayInHalfOpenRanges()
        {
            var rng = new Pcg32(123, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < 10000; i++)
            {
                float f = rng.NextFloat();
                Assert.That(f, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0f));
                Assert.That(f, Is.LessThan(1f));

                double d = rng.NextDouble();
                Assert.That(d, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0.0));
                Assert.That(d, Is.LessThan(1.0));

                float r = rng.Range(-2f, 3f);
                Assert.That(r, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(-2f));
                Assert.That(r, Is.LessThan(3f));
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class RngTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void Rng_SplitMix64_ZeroInput_MatchesReferenceVector()
        {
            // First output of Vigna's splitmix64 with state 0.
            Assert.That(Rng.SplitMix64(0UL), Is.EqualTo(0xE220A8397B1DCDAFUL));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Rng_Derive_IsDeterministicAndStreamIndependent()
        {
            ulong a = Rng.Derive(1, "fish", 0);
            Assert.That(Rng.Derive(1, "fish", 0), Is.EqualTo(a));
            Assert.That(Rng.Derive(1, "bait", 0), Is.Not.EqualTo(a));
            Assert.That(Rng.Derive(1, "fish", 1), Is.Not.EqualTo(a));
            Assert.That(Rng.Derive(2, "fish", 0), Is.Not.EqualTo(a));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Rng_Derive_NeverReturnsZero()
        {
            for (ulong i = 0; i < 10000; i++)
            {
                Assert.That(Rng.Derive(0, "", i), Is.Not.EqualTo(0UL), "index " + i);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void Rng_Stream_EqualsPcg32SeededWithDerive()
        {
            var fromStream = Rng.Stream(99, "weather", 3);
            var manual = new Pcg32(Rng.Derive(99, "weather", 3));
            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
            {
                Assert.That(fromStream.NextUInt(), Is.EqualTo(manual.NextUInt()), "draw " + i);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class Fnv1a64Tests
    {
        [Test]
        public void Fnv1a64_KnownVectors_Match()
        {
            Assert.That(Fnv1a64.Hash(""), Is.EqualTo(0xcbf29ce484222325UL));
            Assert.That(Fnv1a64.Hash("a"), Is.EqualTo(0xaf63dc4c8601ec8cUL));
            Assert.That(Fnv1a64.Hash("foobar"), Is.EqualTo(0x85944171f73967e8UL));
            Assert.That(Fnv1a64.Hash((string)null), Is.EqualTo(Fnv1a64.OffsetBasis));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Fnv1a64_IncrementalAppend_EqualsOneShotHash()
        {
            var h = Fnv1a64.Create();
            h.Append("foo");
            h.Append("bar");
            Assert.That(h.Value, Is.EqualTo(Fnv1a64.Hash("foobar")));
            Assert.That(Fnv1a64.Hash(new byte[] { 0x61 }), Is.EqualTo(Fnv1a64.Hash("a")));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Fnv1a64_AppendInt32LE_EqualsLittleEndianBytes()
        {
            var viaInt = Fnv1a64.Create();
            viaInt.AppendInt32LE(0x01020304);
            Assert.That(viaInt.Value, Is.EqualTo(Fnv1a64.Hash(new byte[] { 0x04, 0x03, 0x02, 0x01 })));

            var negative = Fnv1a64.Create();
            negative.AppendInt32LE(-1);
            Assert.That(negative.Value, Is.EqualTo(Fnv1a64.Hash(new byte[] { 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF })));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class ContentHashTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void ContentHash_InputOrder_DoesNotChangeHash()
        {
            var forward = new List<ContentCategoryIds>
            {
                new ContentCategoryIds("spot", new[] { "lake_dock", "pond" }),
                new ContentCategoryIds("rod", new[] { "rod_handmade" })
            };
            var reversed = new List<ContentCategoryIds>
            {
                new ContentCategoryIds("rod", new[] { "rod_handmade" }),
                new ContentCategoryIds("spot", new[] { "pond", "lake_dock" })
            };
            Assert.That(ContentHash.Compute(reversed, 1), Is.EqualTo(ContentHash.Compute(forward, 1)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ContentHash_DataVersionChange_ChangesHash()
        {
            var cats = new List<ContentCategoryIds>
            {
                new ContentCategoryIds("spot", new[] { "lake_dock" })
            };
            Assert.That(ContentHash.Compute(cats, 2), Is.Not.EqualTo(ContentHash.Compute(cats, 1)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ContentHash_IdChange_ChangesHash()
        {
            var a = new List<ContentCategoryIds>
            {
                new ContentCategoryIds("spot", new[] { "pond" })
            };
            var b = new List<ContentCategoryIds>
            {
                new ContentCategoryIds("spot", new[] { "pond2" })
            };
            Assert.That(ContentHash.Compute(b, 1), Is.Not.EqualTo(ContentHash.Compute(a, 1)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ContentHash_IdMovedBetweenCategories_ChangesHash()
        {
            // Moving id "y" from "spot" to "rod" must change the hash (the 0x1F / 0x1E separators mark category boundaries).
            var a = new List<ContentCategoryIds>
            {
                new ContentCategoryIds("rod", new[] { "x" }),
                new ContentCategoryIds("spot", new[] { "y" })
            };
            var b = new List<ContentCategoryIds>
            {
                new ContentCategoryIds("rod", new[] { "x", "y" }),
                new ContentCategoryIds("spot", new string[0])
            };
            Assert.That(ContentHash.Compute(b, 1), Is.Not.EqualTo(ContentHash.Compute(a, 1)));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
    public class PitchQuantTests

        [Test]
        public void PitchQuant_Quantize_ClampsToLimit()
        {
            Assert.That(PitchQuant.Quantize(90f), Is.EqualTo((short)8500));
            Assert.That(PitchQuant.Quantize(-90f), Is.EqualTo((short)-8500));
            Assert.That(PitchQuant.Quantize(85f), Is.EqualTo((short)8500));
            Assert.That(PitchQuant.Quantize(45.678f), Is.EqualTo((short)4568));
            Assert.That(PitchQuant.Quantize(-45.678f), Is.EqualTo((short)-4568));
            Assert.That(PitchQuant.Quantize(float.NaN), Is.EqualTo((short)0));
        }

        [Test]
        public void PitchQuant_RoundTrip_WithinOneHundredthDegree()
        {
            for (int i = -8500; i <= 8500; i += 37)
            {
                float p = i / 100f + 0.0037f;
                if (p > PitchQuant.LimitDeg) p = PitchQuant.LimitDeg;
                float back = PitchQuant.Dequantize(PitchQuant.Quantize(p));
                Assert.That(back, Is.EqualTo(p).Within(0.01f), "pitch " + p);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void PitchQuant_ShouldSend_UsesHalfDegreeThreshold()
        {
            Assert.That(PitchQuant.ShouldSend(0, 49), Is.False);
            Assert.That(PitchQuant.ShouldSend(0, 50), Is.True);
            Assert.That(PitchQuant.ShouldSend(0, -50), Is.True);
            Assert.That(PitchQuant.ShouldSend(-8500, 8500), Is.True);
            Assert.That(PitchQuant.ShouldSend(1234, 1234), Is.False);
        }
    }
```

```csharp
// Core/Random/Pcg32.cs: PCG-XSH-RR 32 (O'Neill), seeded exactly like pcg32_srandom_r.
// Pure C#, no engine references. Mutable struct: keep it in a field or local and never copy it mid-stream.
// Always construct with the constructor; default(Pcg32) is not a valid stream.
using System;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    public struct Pcg32
    {
        public const ulong ZeroSeedReplacement = 0x853C49E6748FEA9BUL;
        private const ulong Multiplier = 6364136223846793005UL;

        private ulong _state;
        private readonly ulong _inc;

        public Pcg32(ulong seed, ulong stream = 0)
        {
            if (seed == 0) seed = ZeroSeedReplacement;
            _inc = unchecked((stream << 1) | 1UL);
            _state = 0;
            Step();
            _state = unchecked(_state + seed);
            Step();
        }

        private void Step()
        {
            _state = unchecked(_state * Multiplier + _inc);
        }

        public uint NextUInt()
        {
            ulong old = _state;
            Step();
            uint xorshifted = unchecked((uint)(((old >> 18) ^ old) >> 27));
            int rot = (int)(old >> 59);
            return (xorshifted >> rot) | (xorshifted << ((-rot) & 31));
        }

        // [0, 1) with 24 bits of precision.
        public float NextFloat()
        {
            return (NextUInt() >> 8) * (1f / 16777216f);
        }

        // [0, 1) with 53 bits of precision (27 high bits + 26 low bits).
        public double NextDouble()
        {
            ulong hi = NextUInt() >> 5;
            ulong lo = NextUInt() >> 6;
            return ((hi << 26) | lo) * (1.0 / 9007199254740992.0);
        }

        public float Range(float minInclusive, float maxExclusive)
        {
            return minInclusive + NextFloat() * (maxExclusive - minInclusive);
        }

        // Unbiased (rejection sampling). Throws ArgumentException when maxExclusive <= minInclusive.
        public int Range(int minInclusive, int maxExclusive)
        {
            if (maxExclusive <= minInclusive)
                throw new ArgumentException("maxExclusive must be greater than minInclusive.");
            uint range = unchecked((uint)(maxExclusive - minInclusive));
            uint threshold = unchecked(0u - range) % range; // 2^32 mod range
            while (true)
            {
                uint r = NextUInt();
                if (r >= threshold)
                    return unchecked(minInclusive + (int)(r % range));
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Core/Random/Rng.cs: derives independent deterministic streams from a run seed (spec 4.5).
// Each system uses its own constant stream id, so extra draws in one system never shift another system's rolls.
namespace FishGame.Core
{
    public static class Rng
    {
        public static ulong SplitMix64(ulong x)
        {
            unchecked
            {
                ulong z = x + 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15UL;
                z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9UL;
                z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBUL;
                return z ^ (z >> 31);
            }
        }

        // Never returns 0 (Pcg32 seeds must be non-zero).
        public static ulong Derive(ulong runSeed, string streamId, ulong index)
        {
            ulong z = SplitMix64(runSeed ^ Fnv1a64.Hash(streamId));
            z = SplitMix64(z ^ index);
            return z == 0 ? 1UL : z;
        }

        public static Pcg32 Stream(ulong runSeed, string streamId, ulong index)
        {
            return new Pcg32(Derive(runSeed, streamId, index));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Core/Hashing/Fnv1a64.cs: FNV-1a 64-bit. Mutable struct; use it as a local variable (var h = Fnv1a64.Create();).
using System;
using System.Text;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    public struct Fnv1a64
    {
        public const ulong OffsetBasis = 14695981039346656037UL;
        public const ulong Prime = 1099511628211UL;

        private ulong _value;

        public static Fnv1a64 Create()
        {
            return new Fnv1a64 { _value = OffsetBasis };
        }

        public ulong Value => _value;

        public void Append(byte b)
        {
            unchecked
            {
                _value ^= b;
                _value *= Prime;
            }
        }

        public void Append(byte[] bytes)
        {
            if (bytes == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(bytes));
            for (int i = 0; i < bytes.Length; i++) Append(bytes[i]);
        }

        // UTF-8 bytes of s; null is treated as "".
        public void Append(string s)
        {
            Append(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(s ?? string.Empty));
        }

        public void AppendInt32LE(int value)
        {
            Append((byte)(value & 0xFF));
            Append((byte)((value >> 8) & 0xFF));
            Append((byte)((value >> 16) & 0xFF));
            Append((byte)((value >> 24) & 0xFF));
        }

        public static ulong Hash(string s)
        {
            var h = Create();
            h.Append(s);
            return h.Value;
        }

        public static ulong Hash(byte[] bytes)
        {
            var h = Create();
            h.Append(bytes);
            return h.Value;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Core/Hashing/ContentHash.cs: order-independent FNV-1a 64 over registry ids plus a manually bumped data version (spec 4.5).
// Host and clients compare it in the connection payload to detect content mismatch. This file also holds ContentCategoryIds.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    public readonly struct ContentCategoryIds
    {
        public readonly string Category;
        public readonly IReadOnlyList<string> Ids;

        public ContentCategoryIds(string category, IReadOnlyList<string> ids)
        {
            Category = category ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(category));
            Ids = ids ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ids));
        }
    }

    public static class ContentHash
    {
        public static ulong Compute(IReadOnlyList<ContentCategoryIds> categories, int dataVersion)
        {
            if (categories == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(categories));

            var sortedCategories = new List<ContentCategoryIds>(categories);
            sortedCategories.Sort((a, b) => StringComparer.Ordinal.Compare(a.Category, b.Category));

            var h = Fnv1a64.Create();
            for (int c = 0; c < sortedCategories.Count; c++)
            {
                ContentCategoryIds category = sortedCategories[c];
                if (category.Ids == null)
                    throw new ArgumentException("ContentCategoryIds at index " + c + " has null Ids (default struct?).", nameof(categories));

                h.Append(category.Category);
                h.Append((byte)0x1F);

                var ids = new List<string>(category.Ids);
                ids.Sort(StringComparer.Ordinal);
                for (int i = 0; i < ids.Count; i++)
                {
                    h.Append(ids[i]);
                    h.Append((byte)0x1E);
                }
            }

            h.Append((byte)0x1D);
            h.AppendInt32LE(dataVersion);
            return h.Value;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// If runtime check V3 shows Sessions codes are case-sensitive, change only Normalize (contract D20).
namespace FishGame.Core
{
    public static class JoinCode
    {
        public const int MaxLength = 16;

        // null -> ""; trims surrounding whitespace; upper-cases with the invariant culture.
        public static string Normalize(string raw)
        {
            if (raw == null) return "";
            return raw.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        }

        // 1..MaxLength characters, each A-Z or 0-9. Expects an already normalised code.
        public static bool IsPlausible(string normalized)
        {
            if (normalized == null || normalized.Length < 1 || normalized.Length > MaxLength) return false;
            for (int i = 0; i < normalized.Length; i++)
            {
                char c = normalized[i];
                bool upper = c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z';
                bool digit = c >= '0' && c <= '9';
                if (!upper && !digit) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Core/Player/PitchQuant.cs: pitch quantisation for NetPitchQ (degrees x 100, clamped to +-85; spec 7.3).
using System;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    public static class PitchQuant
    {
        public const float LimitDeg = 85f;
        public const short SendThreshold = 50; // 0.5 degrees

        public static short Quantize(float pitchDeg)
        {
            if (float.IsNaN(pitchDeg)) return 0;
            float p = Math.Min(Math.Max(pitchDeg, -LimitDeg), LimitDeg);
            return (short)Math.Round(p * 100.0, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
        }

        public static float Dequantize(short q)
        {
            return q / 100f;
        }

        // The owner writes NetPitchQ only when this is true (and at most 15 Hz; the rate cap lives in PlayerNetState, T11).
        public static bool ShouldSend(short lastSent, short current)
        {
            return Math.Abs(current - lastSent) >= SendThreshold;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Core/Player/MovementMath.cs: movement, camera and water numbers as pure functions (spec 7.3, contract 7.2).
// No engine references. The owner's PlayerLocomotion / PlayerCamera (T11) call these each frame. Constants are the M1 values.
using System;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    public static class MovementMath
    {
        public const float WalkSpeed = 4.2f, SprintSpeed = 6.6f, AimSpeedMult = 0.6f, SwimSpeed = 2.2f;
        public const float GroundAccel = 14f, AirAccel = 4f, KnockbackDecayGround = 10f, KnockbackDecayAir = 2f;
        public const float Gravity = -22f, TerminalVelocity = -30f, GroundedStickVelocity = -2f;
        public const float JumpHeight = 1.1f, CoyoteTime = 0.1f, JumpBufferTime = 0.1f;
        public const float SwimGravity = -4f, SwimEnterDepth = 1.2f, SwimEyeAboveSurface = 0.15f, WadeDepth = 0.3f;
        public const float SwimBuoyancyStiffness = 12f, SwimBuoyancyDamping = 5f, SwimMaxVerticalSpeed = 3f;
        public const float ClimbDuration = 0.4f, WaterTimeoutSeconds = 60f, OutOfBoundsY = -20f;
        public const float EyeHeight = 1.62f, CapsuleHeight = 1.8f, CapsuleRadius = 0.35f, CapsuleCenterY = 0.9f;
        public const float StepOffset = 0.35f, SlopeLimit = 45f, SkinWidth = 0.08f;
        public const float PitchLimit = 85f, NearClip = 0.05f, FarClip = 400f;
        public const float DefaultHorizontalFov = 90f, SprintFovKickDeg = 4f, SprintFovKickTime = 0.25f;
        public const float HeadBobStride = 1.4f, HeadBobAmplitude = 0.03f;
        public const float TraumaDecayPerSecond = 1.2f, TraumaMaxAngleDeg = 2.5f, TraumaFrequency = 20f;
        public const float CarryMaxKg = 40f, CarryMinMult = 0.55f, CarryNoSprintKg = 15f;

        // sqrt(2 * |gravity| * jumpHeight); (1.1, -22) is about 6.957 m/s.
        public static float JumpVelocity(float jumpHeight, float gravity)
        {
            return MathF.Sqrt(2f * MathF.Abs(gravity) * jumpHeight);
        }

        // v^2 / (2 |g|)
        public static float JumpPeakHeight(float launchVelocity, float gravity)
        {
            return (launchVelocity * launchVelocity) / (2f * MathF.Abs(gravity));
        }

        // clamp(1 - kg / 40, 0.55, 1)
        public static float CarrySpeedMult(float kg)
        {
            float m = 1f - kg / CarryMaxKg;
            return MathF.Min(MathF.Max(m, CarryMinMult), 1f);
        }

        // Callers pass sprint = sprintHeld && grounded (no sprint in the air).
        public static float WishSpeed(bool sprint, bool aiming, bool swimming, float carryKg)
        {
            if (swimming) return SwimSpeed;
            float baseSpeed = (sprint && !aiming && carryKg <= CarryNoSprintKg) ? SprintSpeed : WalkSpeed;
            return baseSpeed * (aiming ? AimSpeedMult : 1f) * CarrySpeedMult(carryKg);
        }

        // Moves (vx, vz) toward (targetX, targetZ) by at most accel * dt (vector length); arrives exactly when closer.
        public static void Accelerate(ref float vx, ref float vz, float targetX, float targetZ, float accel, float dt)
        {
            float dx = targetX - vx;
            float dz = targetZ - vz;
            float dist = MathF.Sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
            float maxStep = accel * dt;
            if (dist <= maxStep)
            {
                vx = targetX;
                vz = targetZ;
                return;
            }
            float k = maxStep / dist;
            vx += dx * k;
            vz += dz * k;
        }

        // Reduces the length of (kx, kz) by decay * dt, never below 0. Direction is kept.
        public static void DecayKnockback(ref float kx, ref float kz, float decay, float dt)
        {
            float len = MathF.Sqrt(kx * kx + kz * kz);
            if (len <= 0f) return;
            float newLen = MathF.Max(0f, len - decay * dt);
            float scale = newLen / len;
            kx *= scale;
            kz *= scale;
        }

        // Returns dy = vy*dt + 0.5*gravity*dt*dt, then sets vy = max(vy + gravity*dt, terminalVelocity).
        // Exact for constant gravity, so a JumpVelocity launch peaks at JumpHeight regardless of frame rate.
        public static float VerticalStep(ref float vy, float gravity, float terminalVelocity, float dt)
        {
            float dy = vy * dt + 0.5f * gravity * dt * dt;
            vy = MathF.Max(vy + gravity * dt, terminalVelocity);
            return dy;
        }

        // Root height that puts the eyes SwimEyeAboveSurface above the surface.
        public static float SwimTargetRootY(float surfaceY)
        {
            return surfaceY + SwimEyeAboveSurface - EyeHeight;
        }

        // Spring-damper toward SwimTargetRootY; SwimGravity applies only while above the target (contract D26).
        public static float SwimVerticalVelocity(float rootY, float surfaceY, float vy, float dt)
        {
            float target = SwimTargetRootY(surfaceY);
            float a = (target - rootY) * SwimBuoyancyStiffness - vy * SwimBuoyancyDamping
                      + (rootY > target ? SwimGravity : 0f);
            float next = vy + a * dt;
            return MathF.Min(MathF.Max(next, -SwimMaxVerticalSpeed), SwimMaxVerticalSpeed);
        }

        // Swimming when the root is more than SwimEnterDepth below the surface.
        public static bool IsSwimmingDepth(float rootY, float surfaceY)
        {
            return rootY < surfaceY - SwimEnterDepth;
        }

        // Wading or swimming (root more than WadeDepth below the surface); gates WaterExit climbs (contract D36).
        public static bool IsInWater(float rootY, float surfaceY)
        {
            return rootY < surfaceY - WadeDepth;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Core/Player/JumpAssist.cs: coyote time + jump buffer (spec 7.3). Pure struct, ticked by PlayerLocomotion (T11).
// Always create with JumpAssist.Create(); default(JumpAssist) has both timers at 0 and would allow an immediate jump.
// jumpPressed is the pressed-this-frame edge, not "held".
namespace FishGame.Core
{
    public struct JumpAssist
    {
        private float _sinceGrounded;
        private float _sinceJump;

        public static JumpAssist Create()
        {
            return new JumpAssist
            {
                _sinceGrounded = float.PositiveInfinity,
                _sinceJump = float.PositiveInfinity
            };
        }

        public float TimeSinceGrounded => _sinceGrounded;
        public float TimeSinceJumpPressed => _sinceJump;

        // Returns true on the tick the jump should fire, then resets both timers so it fires only once.
        public bool Tick(float dt, bool grounded, bool jumpPressed)
        {
            _sinceGrounded = grounded ? 0f : _sinceGrounded + dt;
            _sinceJump = jumpPressed ? 0f : _sinceJump + dt;
            if (_sinceJump <= MovementMath.JumpBufferTime && _sinceGrounded <= MovementMath.CoyoteTime)
            {
                _sinceGrounded = float.PositiveInfinity;
                _sinceJump = float.PositiveInfinity;
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Core/Game/SlotPalette.cs: player slot body colours and the skin tone (spec 7.4, contract 5.4), as 0..1 RGB floats.
// Core has no engine references, so callers build the engine colour themselves (PrefabBuilder materials, T15).
using System;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    public static class SlotPalette
    {
        public const int Count = 4;

        private static readonly float[] Rgb =
        {
            0.90f, 0.36f, 0.24f, // slot 0 coral
            0.22f, 0.52f, 0.90f, // slot 1 blue
            0.30f, 0.72f, 0.32f, // slot 2 green
            0.95f, 0.78f, 0.20f  // slot 3 yellow
        };

        // Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when slot is outside 0..Count-1.
        public static void GetRgb(int slot, out float r, out float g, out float b)
        {
            if (slot < 0 || slot >= Count)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(slot), slot, "Slot must be in 0.." + (Count - 1) + ".");
            int i = slot * 3;
            r = Rgb[i];
            g = Rgb[i + 1];
            b = Rgb[i + 2];
        }

        public static void GetSkinRgb(out float r, out float g, out float b)
        {
            r = 0.96f;
            g = 0.80f;
            b = 0.66f;
        }
    }
}
```

**Behaviour being implemented (spec 6.4, 6.6, R13/R56, contract §7.3 and D4/D9):**
- **State machine.** Exactly 8 legal transitions, listed below. Every other (state, event) pair of the 5 × 6 grid (22 pairs) is illegal. An illegal pair makes `Next`/`Fire` throw `InvalidTransitionException`, and `TryNext`/`TryFire` return false. An illegal event never changes `State`, never changes `FailureReason`, and never raises `Changed`.
  - Offline --Begin--> Connecting
  - Connecting --Established--> Connected
  - Connecting --Fail--> Failed
  - Connected --UnexpectedStop--> Failed
  - Connected --Leave--> ShuttingDown
  - Failed --Leave--> ShuttingDown
  - Failed --ShutdownComplete--> Offline
  - ShuttingDown --ShutdownComplete--> Offline
- **`JoinRules.Evaluate`.** Rules run in this order, and the first match wins:
  1. `IsServerSelf` → `Approve(ChooseSlot(...))`. This skips rules 2–7, and the host is always approved. NGO 2.13.3 auto-approves a declined host anyway. In M1 the roster is empty at this point, so the host gets slot 0.
  2. `Mode == Solo` → `Reject(JoinsClosed)`.
  3. `ProtocolVersion` differs → `Reject(VersionMismatch)`.
  4. `ContentHash` differs → `Reject(VersionMismatch)`.
  5. `!JoinsOpen` → `Reject(JoinsClosed)`.
  6. `ConnectedCount(Roster) >= MaxPlayers` → `Reject(FullLobby)`.
  7. A **connected** entry has `Key == request.Key` → `Reject(DuplicateIdentity)`.
  8. Otherwise take `slot = ChooseSlot(...)`. If the slot is `NoSlot` → `Reject(FullLobby)`. Else `Approve(slot, reclaimed)`.

  `Evaluate` does **not** check `Key.IsValid`. The caller, `ConnectionApprover` (T8), rejects invalid keys before it calls `Evaluate`. A `null` roster counts as empty.
- **`ChooseSlot`** is how players reclaim slots by persistent id (R13/R56):
  - a) A disconnected entry with the same Key → that entry's Slot, `reclaimed = true`.
  - b) Else the lowest slot in `[0, maxPlayers)` held by no entry, connected or not. This keeps a dropped player's slot free for their rejoin.
  - c) Else the lowest Slot among disconnected entries. This is a takeover, so `reclaimed = false`.
  - d) Else `JoinVerdict.NoSlot`.
- **`DisconnectClassifier.Classify`** (spec 6.9), first match wins:
  1. `userInitiated` → `UserLeft`.
  2. `disconnectReason` is exactly one defined `EndReason` name (non-empty, first char a letter, no comma, case-sensitive `Enum.TryParse` plus `Enum.IsDefined`) → that value. This is how the client learns the approver's rejection reason.
  3. `wasConnected` → `HostLeft`.
  4. `secondsSinceStart < NetworkConstants.VersionMismatchWindowSeconds` (8 s) → `VersionMismatch` (NGO drops a config-hash mismatch with no reason string).
  5. Else `Timeout`.
- **`EndReasonText.ToastKey`** (spec 11.2): UserLeft → null (no toast); HostLeft → `err.host_left`; Kicked and DuplicateIdentity → `err.rejected`; Timeout → `err.timeout`; FullLobby → `err.session_full`; JoinsClosed → `err.joins_closed`; VersionMismatch → `err.version`; InvalidCode → `err.code_not_found`; ServicesUnavailable → `err.services`; TransportFailure → `err.network`; Unknown and any undefined value → `err.generic`.
- **`DevFlags.Parse`**: `-dev-solo`, `-dev-host-direct`, `-dev-join-direct <ip[:port]>` (port defaults to `NetworkConstants.DefaultPort`), `-dev-protocol-offset <int>`, `-dev-long-timeout`. Unknown tokens are ignored; a missing or malformed value leaves the flag at its default. `None` and `Parse(null)` hold the defaults (`JoinDirectAddress` "127.0.0.1", `JoinDirectPort` 7777, offset 0).

```csharp
// Tests for FishGame.Core.ConnectionStateMachine (spec 6.4, contract 7.3 and D9).
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class ConnectionStateMachineTests
    {
        // The exact 8 legal transitions (contract 7.3). Every other pair of the 5 x 6 grid is illegal.
        private static readonly (ConnState From, ConnEvent Event, ConnState To)[] LegalTable =
        {
            (ConnState.Offline, ConnEvent.Begin, ConnState.Connecting),
            (ConnState.Connecting, ConnEvent.Established, ConnState.Connected),
            (ConnState.Connecting, ConnEvent.Fail, ConnState.Failed),
            (ConnState.Connected, ConnEvent.UnexpectedStop, ConnState.Failed),
            (ConnState.Connected, ConnEvent.Leave, ConnState.ShuttingDown),
            (ConnState.Failed, ConnEvent.Leave, ConnState.ShuttingDown),
            (ConnState.Failed, ConnEvent.ShutdownComplete, ConnState.Offline),
            (ConnState.ShuttingDown, ConnEvent.ShutdownComplete, ConnState.Offline),
        };

        private static ConnState[] AllStates()
        {
            return (ConnState[])Enum.GetValues(typeof(ConnState));
        }

        private static ConnEvent[] AllEvents()
        {
            return (ConnEvent[])Enum.GetValues(typeof(ConnEvent));
        }

        private static bool IsLegal(ConnState from, ConnEvent ev)
        {
            foreach (var t in LegalTable)
            {
                if (t.From == from && t.Event == ev) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        public static IEnumerable<TestCaseData> LegalCases()
        {
            foreach (var t in LegalTable)
            {
                yield return new TestCaseData(t.From, t.Event, t.To);
            }
        }

        public static IEnumerable<TestCaseData> IllegalCases()
        {
            foreach (ConnState from in AllStates())
            {
                foreach (ConnEvent ev in AllEvents())
                {
                    if (!IsLegal(from, ev)) yield return new TestCaseData(from, ev);
                }
            }
        }

        // Drives a fresh machine into the target state using only legal events.
        private static ConnectionStateMachine MachineAt(ConnState target)
        {
            var m = new ConnectionStateMachine();
            switch (target)
            {
                case ConnState.Offline:
                    break;
                case ConnState.Connecting:
                    m.Fire(ConnEvent.Begin);
                    break;
                case ConnState.Connected:
                    m.Fire(ConnEvent.Begin);
                    m.Fire(ConnEvent.Established);
                    break;
                case ConnState.Failed:
                    m.Fire(ConnEvent.Begin);
                    m.Fire(ConnEvent.Fail, EndReason.Timeout);
                    break;
                case ConnState.ShuttingDown:
                    m.Fire(ConnEvent.Begin);
                    m.Fire(ConnEvent.Established);
                    m.Fire(ConnEvent.Leave);
                    break;
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(target));
            }
            Assert.AreEqual(target, m.State, "Setup failed to reach the target state.");
            return m;
        }

        [Test]
        public void ConnectionStateMachine_TransitionGrid_Has8LegalPairsOf30()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(5, AllStates().Length, "ConnState must have exactly 5 values.");
            Assert.AreEqual(6, AllEvents().Length, "ConnEvent must have exactly 6 values.");

            int legal = 0;
            foreach (ConnState from in AllStates())
            {
                foreach (ConnEvent ev in AllEvents())
                {
                    if (ConnectionStateMachine.TryNext(from, ev, out _)) legal++;
                }
            }
            Assert.AreEqual(8, legal);
        }

        [TestCaseSource(nameof(LegalCases))]
        public void ConnectionStateMachine_LegalTransitions_ReachExpectedState(ConnState from, ConnEvent ev, ConnState to)
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(ConnectionStateMachine.TryNext(from, ev, out ConnState next));
            Assert.AreEqual(to, next);
            Assert.AreEqual(to, ConnectionStateMachine.Next(from, ev));

            var fired = MachineAt(from);
            fired.Fire(ev);
            Assert.AreEqual(to, fired.State);

            var tried = MachineAt(from);
            Assert.IsTrue(tried.TryFire(ev));
            Assert.AreEqual(to, tried.State);
        }

        [TestCaseSource(nameof(IllegalCases))]
        public void ConnectionStateMachine_IllegalPairs_ThrowInvalidTransition(ConnState from, ConnEvent ev)
        {
            var staticEx = Assert.Throws<InvalidTransitionException>(() => ConnectionStateMachine.Next(from, ev));
            Assert.AreEqual(from, staticEx.From);
            Assert.AreEqual(ev, staticEx.Event);
            Assert.IsFalse(ConnectionStateMachine.TryNext(from, ev, out _));

            var m = MachineAt(from);
            EndReason reasonBefore = m.FailureReason;
            int changedCount = 0;
            m.Changed += (a, b) => changedCount++;

            var ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidTransitionException>(() => m.Fire(ev, EndReason.Kicked));
            Assert.AreEqual(from, ex.From);
            Assert.AreEqual(ev, ex.Event);
            Assert.IsFalse(m.TryFire(ev, EndReason.Kicked));

            Assert.AreEqual(from, m.State, "State must not change on an illegal event.");
            Assert.AreEqual(reasonBefore, m.FailureReason, "FailureReason must not change on an illegal event.");
            Assert.AreEqual(0, changedCount, "Changed must not fire on an illegal event.");
        }

        [Test]
        public void ConnectionStateMachine_InvalidTransition_MessageMatchesFormat()
        {
            var ex = new InvalidTransitionException(ConnState.Offline, ConnEvent.Established);
            Assert.AreEqual("Invalid connection transition: Offline --Established-->", ex.Message);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<InvalidOperationException>(ex);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ConnectionStateMachine_Fail_RecordsReason()
        {
            var m = new ConnectionStateMachine();
            Assert.AreEqual(ConnState.Offline, m.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.Unknown, m.FailureReason);

            m.Fire(ConnEvent.Begin);
            m.Fire(ConnEvent.Fail, EndReason.Timeout);
            Assert.AreEqual(ConnState.Failed, m.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.Timeout, m.FailureReason);

            m.Fire(ConnEvent.Leave);
            m.Fire(ConnEvent.ShutdownComplete);
            Assert.AreEqual(ConnState.Offline, m.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.Timeout, m.FailureReason, "The reason survives until the next Begin, so the menu can show it.");

            m.Fire(ConnEvent.Begin);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.Unknown, m.FailureReason, "Begin resets the failure reason.");
        }

        [Test]
        public void ConnectionStateMachine_UnexpectedStop_RecordsReason()
        {
            var m = MachineAt(ConnState.Connected);
            m.Fire(ConnEvent.UnexpectedStop, EndReason.HostLeft);
            Assert.AreEqual(ConnState.Failed, m.State);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.HostLeft, m.FailureReason);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ConnectionStateMachine_Changed_RaisedAfterStateUpdate()
        {
            var m = new ConnectionStateMachine();
            var raised = new List<(ConnState From, ConnState To, ConnState StateInHandler)>();
            m.Changed += (from, to) => raised.Add((from, to, m.State));

            m.Fire(ConnEvent.Begin);
            Assert.IsFalse(m.TryFire(ConnEvent.Begin));

            Assert.AreEqual(1, raised.Count, "Changed fires once, and not for the rejected event.");
            Assert.AreEqual(ConnState.Offline, raised[0].From);
            Assert.AreEqual(ConnState.Connecting, raised[0].To);
            Assert.AreEqual(ConnState.Connecting, raised[0].StateInHandler);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace FishGame.Core
```

```csharp
    // Thrown by ConnectionStateMachine for any (state, event) pair outside the 8 legal transitions.
    public sealed class InvalidTransitionException : InvalidOperationException
    {
        public ConnState From { get; }
        public ConnEvent Event { get; }

        public InvalidTransitionException(ConnState from, ConnEvent ev)
            : base("Invalid connection transition: " + from + " --" + ev + "-->")
        {
            From = from;
            Event = ev;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Connection state machine (spec 6.4, contract 7.3 and D9). Pure logic: no Unity or NGO references.
    // Exactly 8 legal transitions; every other (state, event) pair throws InvalidTransitionException.
    public sealed class ConnectionStateMachine
    {
        public ConnState State { get; private set; } = ConnState.Offline;

        // Reset to Unknown on Begin; set to the supplied reason on Fail / UnexpectedStop; otherwise unchanged.
        public EndReason FailureReason { get; private set; } = EndReason.Unknown;

        // (from, to), raised after State is updated.
        public event Action<ConnState, ConnState> Changed;

        public void Fire(ConnEvent ev, EndReason reason = EndReason.Unknown)
        {
            ConnState from = State;
            ConnState to = Next(from, ev);
            Apply(from, to, ev, reason);
        }

        public bool TryFire(ConnEvent ev, EndReason reason = EndReason.Unknown)
        {
            ConnState from = State;
            if (!TryNext(from, ev, out ConnState to)) return false;
            Apply(from, to, ev, reason);
            return true;
        }

        public static ConnState Next(ConnState from, ConnEvent ev)
        {
            if (!TryNext(from, ev, out ConnState to)) throw new InvalidTransitionException(from, ev);
            return to;
        }

        public static bool TryNext(ConnState from, ConnEvent ev, out ConnState to)
        {
            to = from;
            switch (from)
            {
                case ConnState.Offline:
                    if (ev == ConnEvent.Begin) { to = ConnState.Connecting; return true; }
                    break;
                case ConnState.Connecting:
                    if (ev == ConnEvent.Established) { to = ConnState.Connected; return true; }
                    if (ev == ConnEvent.Fail) { to = ConnState.Failed; return true; }
                    break;
                case ConnState.Connected:
                    if (ev == ConnEvent.UnexpectedStop) { to = ConnState.Failed; return true; }
                    if (ev == ConnEvent.Leave) { to = ConnState.ShuttingDown; return true; }
                    break;
                case ConnState.Failed:
                    if (ev == ConnEvent.Leave) { to = ConnState.ShuttingDown; return true; }
                    if (ev == ConnEvent.ShutdownComplete) { to = ConnState.Offline; return true; }
                    break;
                case ConnState.ShuttingDown:
                    if (ev == ConnEvent.ShutdownComplete) { to = ConnState.Offline; return true; }
                    break;
            }
            return false;
        }

        private void Apply(ConnState from, ConnState to, ConnEvent ev, EndReason reason)
        {
            if (ev == ConnEvent.Begin)
            {
                FailureReason = EndReason.Unknown;
            }
            else if (ev == ConnEvent.Fail || ev == ConnEvent.UnexpectedStop)
            {
                FailureReason = reason;
            }
            State = to;
            Changed?.Invoke(from, to);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Tests for FishGame.Core.PlayerKey (contract 7.3).
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class PlayerKeyTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void PlayerKey_Equality_UsesKindAndOrdinalId()
        {
            var a = new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "abc");
            var same = new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "abc");
            var otherKind = new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, "abc");
            var otherCase = new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "ABC");

            Assert.IsTrue(a == same);
            Assert.IsFalse(a != same);
            Assert.IsTrue(a.Equals(same));
            Assert.AreEqual(a.GetHashCode(), same.GetHashCode());
            Assert.IsTrue(a != otherKind);
            Assert.IsFalse(a.Equals(otherKind));
            Assert.IsTrue(a != otherCase, "Ids compare ordinally (case-sensitive).");
        }

        [Test]
        public void PlayerKey_EqualsObject_HandlesBoxedAndOtherTypes()
        {
            var a = new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "abc");
            object boxed = new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "abc");

            Assert.IsTrue(a.Equals(boxed));
            Assert.IsFalse(a.Equals("Ugs:abc"));
            Assert.IsFalse(a.Equals(null));
        }

        [Test]
        public void PlayerKey_IsValid_RejectsEmptyNullAndOverlong()
        {
            Assert.IsFalse(new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "").IsValid);
            Assert.IsFalse(new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, null).IsValid);
            Assert.IsFalse(new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, new string('x', PlayerKey.MaxIdLength + 1)).IsValid);
            Assert.IsTrue(new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, new string('x', PlayerKey.MaxIdLength)).IsValid);
            Assert.IsTrue(new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, "a").IsValid);
        }

        [Test]
        public void PlayerKey_ToString_IsKindColonId()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual("Local:abc", new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, "abc").ToString());
            Assert.AreEqual("Ugs:p-1", new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "p-1").ToString());
        }

        [Test]
        public void PlayerKey_Default_IsInvalidLocalWithNullId()
        {
            var d = default(PlayerKey);
            Assert.AreEqual(IdentityKind.Local, d.Kind);
            Assert.IsNull(d.Id);
            Assert.IsFalse(d.IsValid);
            Assert.IsTrue(d == new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, null));
            Assert.DoesNotThrow(() => d.GetHashCode());
            Assert.AreEqual("Local:", d.ToString());
        }
    }
}
```
