```csharp
// Tests for FishGame.Core.JoinRules (spec 6.6, R13/R56 reclaim by persistent id; contract 7.3).
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class JoinRulesTests
    {
        private const int Proto = 1;
        private const ulong LocalHash = 0xABCDUL;

        private static readonly PlayerKey Alice = new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "alice");
        private static readonly PlayerKey Bob = new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "bob");

        private static JoinContext Ctx(SessionMode mode = SessionMode.Online, int proto = Proto,
                                       ulong hash = LocalHash, bool joinsOpen = true,
                                       IReadOnlyList<RosterEntry> roster = null)
        {
            return new JoinContext(mode, proto, hash, joinsOpen, NetworkConstants.MaxPlayers,
                roster ?? new RosterEntry[0]);
        }

        private static JoinRequest Req(PlayerKey key, bool self = false, int proto = Proto, ulong hash = LocalHash)
        {
            return new JoinRequest(clientId: self ? 0UL : 1UL, isServerSelf: self, protocolVersion: proto,
                contentHash: hash, key: key, name: key.Id);
        }

        private static RosterEntry Entry(string id, byte slot, bool connected)
        {
            return new RosterEntry(new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, id), slot, connected);
        }

        private static RosterEntry[] FourConnected(string firstId = "p0")
        {
            return new[]
            {
                Entry(firstId, 0, true), Entry("p1", 1, true), Entry("p2", 2, true), Entry("p3", 3, true)
            };
        }

        // ---- Rule 1: host self ----

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_HostSelf_ApprovedEvenWhenSolo()
        {
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Alice, self: true, proto: Proto + 5, hash: 7UL),
                Ctx(mode: SessionMode.Solo, joinsOpen: false));
            Assert.IsTrue(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual((byte)0, verdict.Slot);
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Reclaimed);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_HostSelf_ReclaimsOwnDisconnectedSlot()
        {
            var roster = new[] { Entry("alice", 2, false) };
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Alice, self: true), Ctx(roster: roster));
            Assert.IsTrue(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual((byte)2, verdict.Slot);
            Assert.IsTrue(verdict.Reclaimed);
        }

        // ---- Rules 2-7: rejections ----

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_SoloRemote_RejectedJoinsClosed()
        {
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Bob), Ctx(mode: SessionMode.Solo));
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.JoinsClosed, verdict.Reason);
            Assert.AreEqual(JoinVerdict.NoSlot, verdict.Slot);
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Reclaimed);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_ProtocolMismatch_RejectedVersionMismatch()
        {
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Bob, proto: Proto + 1), Ctx());
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.VersionMismatch, verdict.Reason);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_ContentHashMismatch_RejectedVersionMismatch()
        {
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Bob, hash: LocalHash + 1UL), Ctx());
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.VersionMismatch, verdict.Reason);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_JoinsClosed_Rejected()
        {
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Bob), Ctx(joinsOpen: false));
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.JoinsClosed, verdict.Reason);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_Full_RejectedFullLobby()
        {
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Alice), Ctx(roster: FourConnected()));
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.FullLobby, verdict.Reason);
            Assert.AreEqual(JoinVerdict.NoSlot, verdict.Slot);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_DuplicateConnectedIdentity_Rejected()
        {
            var roster = new[] { Entry("alice", 0, true) };
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Alice), Ctx(roster: roster));
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.DuplicateIdentity, verdict.Reason);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_SameIdDifferentKind_IsNotDuplicate()
        {
            var roster = new[] { Entry("alice", 0, true) };
            var localAlice = new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, "alice");
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(localAlice), Ctx(roster: roster));
            Assert.IsTrue(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual((byte)1, verdict.Slot);
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Reclaimed);
        }

        // ---- Rule 8: seating and reclaim ----

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_DisconnectedIdentity_ReclaimsSlot()
        {
            var roster = new[] { Entry("alice", 2, false), Entry("bob", 0, true) };
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Alice), Ctx(roster: roster));
            Assert.IsTrue(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual((byte)2, verdict.Slot, "The persistent id is matched before the free slot 1 is taken.");
            Assert.IsTrue(verdict.Reclaimed);

            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Alice), Ctx(roster: roster));
            Assert.IsTrue(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual((byte)1, verdict.Slot);
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Reclaimed);
        }

        {

            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Alice), Ctx(roster: roster));
            Assert.IsTrue(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual((byte)2, verdict.Slot, "A dropped player's slot is kept for their rejoin while a free slot exists.");
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Reclaimed);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_AllSlotsHeldButOneDisconnected_TakesOverDisconnectedSlot()
        {
            var roster = new[]
            {
                Entry("p0", 0, true), Entry("p1", 1, true), Entry("p2", 2, true), Entry("gone", 3, false)
            };
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Alice), Ctx(roster: roster));
            Assert.IsTrue(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual((byte)3, verdict.Slot);
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Reclaimed, "A takeover of another identity's slot is not a reclaim.");
        }

        // ---- Rule order ----

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_RuleOrder_SoloCheckedBeforeVersion()
        {
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Bob, proto: Proto + 1), Ctx(mode: SessionMode.Solo));
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.JoinsClosed, verdict.Reason);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_RuleOrder_VersionCheckedBeforeJoinsOpen()
        {
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Bob, proto: Proto + 1), Ctx(joinsOpen: false));
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.VersionMismatch, verdict.Reason);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_RuleOrder_JoinsClosedCheckedBeforeFull()
        {
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Alice), Ctx(joinsOpen: false, roster: FourConnected()));
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.JoinsClosed, verdict.Reason);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_RuleOrder_FullCheckedBeforeDuplicate()
        {
            var verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(Req(Alice), Ctx(roster: FourConnected(firstId: "alice")));
            Assert.IsFalse(verdict.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.FullLobby, verdict.Reason);
        }

        // ---- Helpers on the public surface ----

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_ChooseSlot_AllConnected_ReturnsNoSlot()
        {
            byte slot = JoinRules.ChooseSlot(Alice, FourConnected(), NetworkConstants.MaxPlayers, out bool reclaimed);
            Assert.AreEqual(JoinVerdict.NoSlot, slot);
            Assert.IsFalse(reclaimed);

            byte first = JoinRules.ChooseSlot(Alice, null, NetworkConstants.MaxPlayers, out bool reclaimedNull);
            Assert.AreEqual((byte)0, first, "A null roster counts as empty.");
            Assert.IsFalse(reclaimedNull);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_ConnectedCount_CountsOnlyConnected()
        {
            var roster = new[] { Entry("a", 0, true), Entry("b", 1, false), Entry("c", 2, true) };
            Assert.AreEqual(2, JoinRules.ConnectedCount(roster));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, JoinRules.ConnectedCount(new RosterEntry[0]));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, JoinRules.ConnectedCount(null));
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinRules_VerdictFactories_SetContractFields()
        {
            var approve = JoinVerdict.Approve(3, true);
            Assert.IsTrue(approve.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual((byte)3, approve.Slot);
            Assert.IsTrue(approve.Reclaimed);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.UserLeft, approve.Reason);

            var reject = JoinVerdict.Reject(EndReason.FullLobby);
            Assert.IsFalse(reject.Approved);
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.FullLobby, reject.Reason);
            Assert.AreEqual(JoinVerdict.NoSlot, reject.Slot);
            Assert.IsFalse(reject.Reclaimed);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Persistent identity of a player (spec 6.6 rule 7/8, R13/R56): used to detect duplicates and to reclaim slots.
    // Equal when Kind matches and Id matches by ordinal (case-sensitive) comparison.
    public readonly struct PlayerKey : IEquatable<PlayerKey>
    {
        public const int MaxIdLength = 64;

        public readonly IdentityKind Kind;
        public readonly string Id;

        public PlayerKey(IdentityKind kind, string id)
        {
            Kind = kind;
            Id = id;
        }

        public bool IsValid => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Id) && Id.Length <= MaxIdLength;

        public bool Equals(PlayerKey other)
        {
            return Kind == other.Kind && string.Equals(Id, other.Id, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }

        public override bool Equals(object obj)
        {
            return obj is PlayerKey other && Equals(other);
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            unchecked
            {
                return ((int)Kind * 397) ^ (Id == null ? 0 : StringComparer.Ordinal.GetHashCode(Id));
            }
        }

        public override string ToString()
        {
            return Kind + ":" + Id;
        }

        public static bool operator ==(PlayerKey a, PlayerKey b) => a.Equals(b);

        public static bool operator !=(PlayerKey a, PlayerKey b) => !a.Equals(b);
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // One connection approval request, decoded from the client's ConnectPayload by ConnectionApprover (T8).
    public readonly struct JoinRequest
    {
        public readonly ulong ClientId;
        public readonly bool IsServerSelf;
        public readonly int ProtocolVersion;
        public readonly ulong ContentHash;
        public readonly PlayerKey Key;
        public readonly string Name;

        public JoinRequest(ulong clientId, bool isServerSelf, int protocolVersion, ulong contentHash, PlayerKey key, string name)
        {
            ClientId = clientId;
            IsServerSelf = isServerSelf;
            ProtocolVersion = protocolVersion;
            ContentHash = contentHash;
            Key = key;
            Name = name;
        }
    }

    // One roster slot as seen by approval: connected players, disconnected (reclaimable) slots, and pending approvals (as connected).
    public readonly struct RosterEntry
    {
        public readonly PlayerKey Key;
        public readonly byte Slot;
        public readonly bool Connected;

        public RosterEntry(PlayerKey key, byte slot, bool connected)
        {
            Key = key;
            Slot = slot;
            Connected = connected;
        }
    }

    // Host-side facts that approval is evaluated against.
    public readonly struct JoinContext
    {
        public readonly SessionMode Mode;
        public readonly int ProtocolVersion;
        public readonly ulong ContentHash;
        public readonly bool JoinsOpen;
        public readonly int MaxPlayers;
        public readonly IReadOnlyList<RosterEntry> Roster;

        public JoinContext(SessionMode mode, int protocolVersion, ulong contentHash, bool joinsOpen, int maxPlayers, IReadOnlyList<RosterEntry> roster)
        {
            Mode = mode;
            ProtocolVersion = protocolVersion;
            ContentHash = contentHash;
            JoinsOpen = joinsOpen;
            MaxPlayers = maxPlayers;
            Roster = roster;
        }
    }

    public readonly struct JoinVerdict
    {
        public const byte NoSlot = 255;

        public readonly bool Approved;
        public readonly EndReason Reason;
        public readonly byte Slot;
        public readonly bool Reclaimed;

        private JoinVerdict(bool approved, EndReason reason, byte slot, bool reclaimed)
        {
            Approved = approved;
            Reason = reason;
            Slot = slot;
            Reclaimed = reclaimed;
        }

        // Reason is UserLeft and unused when approved.
        public static JoinVerdict Approve(byte slot, bool reclaimed) => new JoinVerdict(true, EndReason.UserLeft, slot, reclaimed);

        public static JoinVerdict Reject(EndReason reason) => new JoinVerdict(false, reason, NoSlot, false);
    }

    // Pure connection-approval rules (spec 6.6, contract 7.3). Host-only caller: ConnectionApprover (T8),
    // which rejects undecodable payloads and invalid keys before calling Evaluate.
    public static class JoinRules
    {
        // In order (spec 6.6):
        // 1 IsServerSelf -> Approve(ChooseSlot)               (skips 2-7; NGO auto-approves a declined host anyway)
        // 2 Mode == Solo -> Reject(JoinsClosed)
        // 3 ProtocolVersion differs -> Reject(VersionMismatch)
        // 4 ContentHash differs -> Reject(VersionMismatch)
        // 5 !JoinsOpen -> Reject(JoinsClosed)
        // 6 ConnectedCount(Roster) >= MaxPlayers -> Reject(FullLobby)
        // 7 a Connected entry has Key == request.Key -> Reject(DuplicateIdentity)
        // 8 slot = ChooseSlot; NoSlot -> Reject(FullLobby); else Approve(slot, reclaimed)
        public static JoinVerdict Evaluate(in JoinRequest request, in JoinContext context)
        {
            if (request.IsServerSelf)
            {
                byte hostSlot = ChooseSlot(request.Key, context.Roster, context.MaxPlayers, out bool hostReclaimed);
                return JoinVerdict.Approve(hostSlot, hostReclaimed);
            }
            if (context.Mode == SessionMode.Solo)
            {
                return JoinVerdict.Reject(EndReason.JoinsClosed);
            }
            if (request.ProtocolVersion != context.ProtocolVersion)
            {
                return JoinVerdict.Reject(EndReason.VersionMismatch);
            }
            if (request.ContentHash != context.ContentHash)
            {
                return JoinVerdict.Reject(EndReason.VersionMismatch);
            }
            if (!context.JoinsOpen)
            {
                return JoinVerdict.Reject(EndReason.JoinsClosed);
            }
            if (ConnectedCount(context.Roster) >= context.MaxPlayers)
            {
                return JoinVerdict.Reject(EndReason.FullLobby);
            }
            if (IsConnected(context.Roster, request.Key))
            {
                return JoinVerdict.Reject(EndReason.DuplicateIdentity);
            }

            byte slot = ChooseSlot(request.Key, context.Roster, context.MaxPlayers, out bool reclaimed);
            return slot == JoinVerdict.NoSlot
                ? JoinVerdict.Reject(EndReason.FullLobby)
                : JoinVerdict.Approve(slot, reclaimed);
        }

        public static int ConnectedCount(IReadOnlyList<RosterEntry> roster)
        {
            if (roster == null) return 0;
            int count = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < roster.Count; i++)
            {
                if (roster[i].Connected) count++;
            }
            return count;
        }

        // a) a disconnected entry with the same Key -> its Slot, reclaimed = true
        // b) else the lowest slot in [0, maxPlayers) held by no entry (connected or not)
        // c) else the lowest Slot among disconnected entries (taken over), reclaimed = false
        // d) else JoinVerdict.NoSlot
        public static byte ChooseSlot(PlayerKey key, IReadOnlyList<RosterEntry> roster, int maxPlayers, out bool reclaimed)
        {
            reclaimed = false;
            if (roster == null) roster = new RosterEntry[0];

            for (int i = 0; i < roster.Count; i++)
            {
                RosterEntry e = roster[i];
                if (!e.Connected && e.Key == key)
                {
                    reclaimed = true;
                    return e.Slot;
                }
            }

            for (int s = 0; s < maxPlayers && s < JoinVerdict.NoSlot; s++)
            {
                if (!SlotHeld(roster, (byte)s)) return (byte)s;
            }

            bool found = false;
            byte takeover = JoinVerdict.NoSlot;
            for (int i = 0; i < roster.Count; i++)
            {
                RosterEntry e = roster[i];
                if (e.Connected) continue;
                if (!found || e.Slot < takeover)
                {
                    takeover = e.Slot;
                    found = true;
                }
            }
            return found ? takeover : JoinVerdict.NoSlot;
        }

        private static bool IsConnected(IReadOnlyList<RosterEntry> roster, PlayerKey key)
        {
            if (roster == null) return false;
            for (int i = 0; i < roster.Count; i++)
            {
                if (roster[i].Connected && roster[i].Key == key) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        private static bool SlotHeld(IReadOnlyList<RosterEntry> roster, byte slot)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < roster.Count; i++)
            {
                if (roster[i].Slot == slot) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Tests for FishGame.Core.ConnectPayload / ConnectPayloadCodec (contract 7.3, D3).
using System;
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class ConnectPayloadCodecTests
    {
        private static ConnectPayload Sample()
        {
            return new ConnectPayload(7, 0xDEADBEEFCAFEF00DUL, new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "player-123"), "Captain");
        }

        [Test]
        public void ConnectPayloadCodec_RoundTrip_PreservesFields()
        {
            byte[] data = ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode(Sample());
            Assert.IsTrue(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(data, out ConnectPayload back));
            Assert.AreEqual(7, back.ProtocolVersion);
            Assert.AreEqual(0xDEADBEEFCAFEF00DUL, back.ContentHash);
            Assert.AreEqual(new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "player-123"), back.Key);
            Assert.AreEqual("Captain", back.Name);

            var negative = new ConnectPayload(-3, 0UL, new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Steam, "s"), "");
            Assert.IsTrue(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode(negative), out ConnectPayload negBack));
            Assert.AreEqual(-3, negBack.ProtocolVersion);
            Assert.AreEqual(IdentityKind.Steam, negBack.Key.Kind);
            Assert.AreEqual("", negBack.Name);

            var nulls = new ConnectPayload(1, 2UL, new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, null), null);
            Assert.IsTrue(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode(nulls), out ConnectPayload nullBack));
            Assert.AreEqual("", nullBack.Key.Id);
            Assert.AreEqual("", nullBack.Name);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ConnectPayloadCodec_Encode_IsLittleEndianWithFormatByteFirst()
        {
            byte[] data = ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode(new ConnectPayload(0x01020304, 0x1122334455667788UL, new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, "a"), "b"));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new byte[]
            {
                ConnectPayloadCodec.FormatVersion,
                0x04, 0x03, 0x02, 0x01,
                0x88, 0x77, 0x66, 0x55, 0x44, 0x33, 0x22, 0x11,
                (byte)IdentityKind.Local,
                1, (byte)'a',
                1, (byte)'b'
            }, data);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ConnectPayloadCodec_LongNameAndId_TruncatedUnderMaxBytes()
        {
            var payload = new ConnectPayload(1, 1UL, new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, new string('x', 100)), "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV");
            byte[] data = ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode(payload);
            Assert.LessOrEqual(data.Length, ConnectPayloadCodec.MaxBytes);
            Assert.IsTrue(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(data, out ConnectPayload back));
            Assert.AreEqual(new string('x', PlayerKey.MaxIdLength), back.Key.Id);
            Assert.AreEqual("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP", back.Name);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ConnectPayloadCodec_Garbage_ReturnsFalse()
        {
            byte[] good = ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode(Sample());

            Assert.IsFalse(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(null, out _), "null");
            Assert.IsFalse(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(new byte[0], out _), "empty");
            Assert.IsFalse(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 }, out _), "short");

            byte[] wrongFormat = (byte[])good.Clone();
            wrongFormat[0] = 2;
            Assert.IsFalse(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(wrongFormat, out _), "format version");

            byte[] unknownKind = (byte[])good.Clone();
            unknownKind[13] = 9;
            Assert.IsFalse(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(unknownKind, out _), "unknown kind");

            byte[] trailing = new byte[good.Length + 1];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(good, 0, trailing, 0, good.Length);
            Assert.IsFalse(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(trailing, out _), "trailing byte");

            byte[] truncated = new byte[good.Length - 1];
            Buffer.BlockCopy(good, 0, truncated, 0, truncated.Length);
            Assert.IsFalse(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(truncated, out _), "one byte short");

            byte[] idTooLong = (byte[])good.Clone();
            idTooLong[14] = 200;
            Assert.IsFalse(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(idTooLong, out _), "id length past the end");

            Assert.IsFalse(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(new byte[ConnectPayloadCodec.MaxBytes + 1], out _), "over MaxBytes");
        }

        // Review Focus 2: multi-byte UTF-8 and corrupted text bytes.
        [Test]
        public void ConnectPayloadCodec_MultiByteAndInvalidUtf8_HandledSafely()
        {
            // 64 x U+00E9 is 128 UTF-8 bytes; the id must shrink to 32 chars (64 bytes).
            string accented = new string('é', 64);
            // 15 x 'a' then U+1F600 (a surrogate pair): the 16-char name cut would split the pair, so it drops it.
            string emojiName = new string('a', 15) + "😀" + "b";
            byte[] data = ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode(new ConnectPayload(1, 1UL, new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, accented), emojiName));
            Assert.LessOrEqual(data.Length, ConnectPayloadCodec.MaxBytes);
            Assert.IsTrue(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(data, out ConnectPayload back));
            Assert.AreEqual(new string('é', 32), back.Key.Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(new string('a', 15), back.Name);

            // Four-byte characters: 20 x U+1F600 is 40 chars and 80 bytes; the id keeps 16 whole pairs (64 bytes).
            var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) sb.Append("😀");
            byte[] emojiId = ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode(new ConnectPayload(1, 1UL, new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, sb.ToString()), "n"));
            Assert.IsTrue(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(emojiId, out ConnectPayload emojiBack));
            Assert.AreEqual(32, emojiBack.Key.Id.Length);
            Assert.IsTrue(char.IsLowSurrogate(emojiBack.Key.Id[31]), "the last kept char closes a pair");

            // A name byte that is not valid UTF-8 (lone 0xFF) is rejected, not thrown.
            byte[] bad = ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode(new ConnectPayload(1, 1UL, new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, "id"), "x"));
            bad[bad.Length - 1] = 0xFF;
            Assert.DoesNotThrow(() => ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(bad, out _));
            Assert.IsFalse(ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(bad, out _));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Tests for FishGame.Core.DisplayNameRules (contract 7.3).
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class DisplayNameRulesTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void DisplayNameRules_Sanitize_StripsControlTrimsAndTruncates()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual("Bob", DisplayNameRules.Sanitize("  Bob\u0007 \t", 0));
            Assert.AreEqual("AB", DisplayNameRules.Sanitize("A\nB", 0));
            Assert.AreEqual("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP", DisplayNameRules.Sanitize("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", 0));
            Assert.AreEqual("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNO", DisplayNameRules.Sanitize("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNO  Z", 0), "TrimEnd after the cut");
            Assert.AreEqual("Captain Hook", DisplayNameRules.Sanitize("Captain Hook", 2));
            Assert.AreEqual(16, DisplayNameRules.MaxLength);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DisplayNameRules_Sanitize_Empty_UsesSlotFallback()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual("Fisher 1", DisplayNameRules.Sanitize(null, 0));
            Assert.AreEqual("Fisher 1", DisplayNameRules.Sanitize("", 0));
            Assert.AreEqual("Fisher 4", DisplayNameRules.Sanitize("   ", 3));
            Assert.AreEqual("Fisher 3", DisplayNameRules.Sanitize("\u0001\u0002", 2));
            Assert.AreEqual("Fisher 2", DisplayNameRules.Fallback(1));
        }

        [Test]
        public void DisplayNameRules_Sanitize_DoesNotSplitSurrogatePair()
        {
            // 15 x 'a' + U+1F600 (two UTF-16 units) + 'b' is 18 chars; cutting at 16 would leave a lone high surrogate.
            string result = DisplayNameRules.Sanitize(new string('a', 15) + "😀" + "b", 0);
            Assert.AreEqual(new string('a', 15), result);

            // A pair that ends exactly at char 16 is kept whole.
            string whole = DisplayNameRules.Sanitize(new string('a', 14) + "😀" + "b", 0);
            Assert.AreEqual(new string('a', 14) + "😀", whole);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Tests for FishGame.Core.DisconnectClassifier (spec 6.9, contract 7.3).
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class DisconnectClassifierTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void DisconnectClassifier_ReasonString_ParsesEndReason()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.FullLobby, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, false, "FullLobby", 0.5));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.JoinsClosed, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, true, "JoinsClosed", 100.0));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.VersionMismatch, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, false, "VersionMismatch", 30.0));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.DuplicateIdentity, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, false, EndReason.DuplicateIdentity.ToString(), 1.0));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.Kicked, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, true, "Kicked", 5.0));
        }

        [Test]
        public void DisconnectClassifier_EmptyWhileConnected_IsHostLeft()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.HostLeft, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, true, "", 100.0));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.HostLeft, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, true, null, 1.0));
        }

        [Test]
        public void DisconnectClassifier_EmptyEarlyWhileConnecting_IsVersionMismatch()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.VersionMismatch, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, false, null, 2.0));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.VersionMismatch, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, false, "", 7.99));
        }

        [Test]
        public void DisconnectClassifier_EmptyLateWhileConnecting_IsTimeout()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.Timeout, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, false, "", 9.0));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.Timeout, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, false, null, NetworkConstants.VersionMismatchWindowSeconds));
        }

        [Test]
        public void DisconnectClassifier_UserInitiated_IsUserLeft()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.UserLeft, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(true, true, "FullLobby", 0.0));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.UserLeft, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(true, false, null, 100.0));
        }

        // Review Focus 1: reason text that is not exactly one EndReason name falls through to the timing rules.
        [Test]
        public void DisconnectClassifier_NonExactReasonText_FallsThrough()
        {
            // NGO's own generated text.
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.HostLeft, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, true, "[Disconnect Event] Disconnected by the server.", 50.0));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.Timeout, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, false, "[Disconnect Event] Transport failure", 20.0));
            // A comma list would otherwise parse as FullLobby | Kicked = 6 = VersionMismatch.
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.HostLeft, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, true, "FullLobby, Kicked", 50.0));
            // Wrong case, digits, sentences and out-of-range values are not reasons.
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.HostLeft, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, true, "fulllobby", 50.0));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.HostLeft, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, true, "4", 50.0));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.HostLeft, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, true, "Disconnected due to host shutting down.", 50.0));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.VersionMismatch, DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, false, " FullLobby", 1.0));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Tests for FishGame.Core.EndReasonText (spec 11.2 table, contract 7.3).
using System;
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class EndReasonTextTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void EndReasonText_EveryReason_HasKeyExceptUserLeft()
        {
            foreach (EndReason reason in (EndReason[])Enum.GetValues(typeof(EndReason)))
            {
                string key = EndReasonText.ToastKey(reason);
                if (reason == EndReason.UserLeft)
                {
                    Assert.IsNull(key, "UserLeft shows no toast");
                    continue;
                }
                Assert.IsNotNull(key, reason.ToString());
                StringAssert.StartsWith("err.", key, reason.ToString());
            }

            Assert.AreEqual("err.host_left", EndReasonText.ToastKey(EndReason.HostLeft));
            Assert.AreEqual("err.rejected", EndReasonText.ToastKey(EndReason.Kicked));
            Assert.AreEqual("err.rejected", EndReasonText.ToastKey(EndReason.DuplicateIdentity));
            Assert.AreEqual("err.timeout", EndReasonText.ToastKey(EndReason.Timeout));
            Assert.AreEqual("err.session_full", EndReasonText.ToastKey(EndReason.FullLobby));
            Assert.AreEqual("err.joins_closed", EndReasonText.ToastKey(EndReason.JoinsClosed));
            Assert.AreEqual("err.version", EndReasonText.ToastKey(EndReason.VersionMismatch));
            Assert.AreEqual("err.code_not_found", EndReasonText.ToastKey(EndReason.InvalidCode));
            Assert.AreEqual("err.services", EndReasonText.ToastKey(EndReason.ServicesUnavailable));
            Assert.AreEqual("err.network", EndReasonText.ToastKey(EndReason.TransportFailure));
            Assert.AreEqual("err.generic", EndReasonText.ToastKey(EndReason.Unknown));
            Assert.AreEqual("err.generic", EndReasonText.ToastKey((EndReason)200), "undefined values fall back");
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Tests for FishGame.Core.DevFlags (contract 7.3).
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class DevFlagsTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void DevFlags_Parse_AllFlags()
        {
            DevFlags f = DevFlags.Parse(new[]
            {
                "Unity.exe", "-batchmode", "-dev-solo", "-dev-host-direct", "-dev-join-direct", "192.168.1.20:7800",
                "-dev-protocol-offset", "1", "-dev-long-timeout", "-logFile", "x.log"
            });
            Assert.IsTrue(f.Solo);
            Assert.IsTrue(f.HostDirect);
            Assert.IsTrue(f.HasJoinDirect);
            Assert.AreEqual("192.168.1.20", f.JoinDirectAddress);
            Assert.AreEqual((ushort)7800, f.JoinDirectPort);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, f.ProtocolOffset);
            Assert.IsTrue(f.LongTimeout);

            Assert.AreEqual(-2, DevFlags.Parse(new[] { "-dev-protocol-offset", "-2" }).ProtocolOffset);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DevFlags_Parse_JoinDirectWithoutPort_UsesDefault()
        {
            DevFlags f = DevFlags.Parse(new[] { "-dev-join-direct", "127.0.0.1" });
            Assert.IsTrue(f.HasJoinDirect);
            Assert.AreEqual("127.0.0.1", f.JoinDirectAddress);
            Assert.AreEqual(NetworkConstants.DefaultPort, f.JoinDirectPort);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DevFlags_Parse_MalformedOffset_IsZero()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(0, DevFlags.Parse(new[] { "-dev-protocol-offset", "abc" }).ProtocolOffset);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, DevFlags.Parse(new[] { "-dev-protocol-offset" }).ProtocolOffset);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, DevFlags.Parse(new[] { "-dev-protocol-offset", "1.5" }).ProtocolOffset);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DevFlags_None_AndNullArgs_AreDefaults()
        {
            foreach (DevFlags f in new[] { DevFlags.None, DevFlags.Parse(null), DevFlags.Parse(new string[0]) })
            {
                Assert.IsFalse(f.Solo);
                Assert.IsFalse(f.HostDirect);
                Assert.IsFalse(f.HasJoinDirect);
                Assert.AreEqual(NetworkConstants.LoopbackAddress, f.JoinDirectAddress);
                Assert.AreEqual(NetworkConstants.DefaultPort, f.JoinDirectPort);
                Assert.AreEqual(0, f.ProtocolOffset);
                Assert.IsFalse(f.LongTimeout);
            }
        }

        // Review Focus 3: MPPM tag tokens in the wrong shape.
        [Test]
        public void DevFlags_Parse_MalformedJoinDirect_IsIgnoredAndNextFlagKept()
        {
            // A missing value must not swallow the next flag.
            DevFlags missing = DevFlags.Parse(new[] { "-dev-join-direct", "-dev-solo" });
            Assert.IsFalse(missing.HasJoinDirect);
            Assert.IsTrue(missing.Solo);

            string[] bad = { "not-an-ip", "127.0.0.1:", "127.0.0.1:0", "127.0.0.1:65536", "127.0.0.1:77x", "256.0.0.1", "127.0.0", "localhost:7777" };
            foreach (string value in bad)
            {
                DevFlags f = DevFlags.Parse(new[] { "-dev-join-direct", value });
                Assert.IsFalse(f.HasJoinDirect, value);
                Assert.AreEqual(NetworkConstants.LoopbackAddress, f.JoinDirectAddress, value);
                Assert.AreEqual(NetworkConstants.DefaultPort, f.JoinDirectPort, value);
            }

            // Flag names are case-insensitive; the highest valid port is accepted.
            DevFlags upper = DevFlags.Parse(new[] { "-DEV-JOIN-DIRECT", "10.0.0.2:65535", "-Dev-Long-Timeout" });
            Assert.IsTrue(upper.HasJoinDirect);
            Assert.AreEqual("10.0.0.2", upper.JoinDirectAddress);
            Assert.AreEqual((ushort)65535, upper.JoinDirectPort);
            Assert.IsTrue(upper.LongTimeout);
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8c: Implement ConnectPayload, DisplayNameRules, DisconnectClassifier, EndReasonText and DevFlags**

These files use only `System`, `System.Collections.Generic`, `System.Text` and `System.Globalization` (all available with `noEngineReferences: true`). The behaviour beyond the bare contract signatures is deliberate and pinned by the tests:
- `ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode` never splits a UTF-16 surrogate pair when it truncates, and `TryDecode` returns false (never throws) on invalid UTF-8.
- `DisplayNameRules.Sanitize` never leaves a lone surrogate at the 16-character cut.
- `DisconnectClassifier` rejects reason text containing a comma, because `Enum.TryParse("FullLobby, Kicked")` would return `FullLobby | Kicked`, which equals `VersionMismatch`.
- `DevFlags` compares flag names case-insensitively (like `InstanceProfile`, T5). A missing or malformed value leaves the default and is not consumed, so the next flag is still read. `-dev-join-direct` accepts only a dotted-decimal IPv4 address with an optional port in 1..65535.

```csharp
using System;
using System.Text;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Connection payload sent in NetworkConfig.ConnectionData and decoded by the host's ConnectionApprover (contract 7.3, D3).
    // Pure data; the wire form is produced by ConnectPayloadCodec.
    public readonly struct ConnectPayload
    {
        public readonly int ProtocolVersion;
        public readonly ulong ContentHash;
        public readonly PlayerKey Key;
        public readonly string Name;

        public ConnectPayload(int protocolVersion, ulong contentHash, PlayerKey key, string name)
        {
            ProtocolVersion = protocolVersion;
            ContentHash = contentHash;
            Key = key;
            Name = name;
        }
    }

    // Wire format, little-endian:
    // byte FormatVersion (1) | int32 ProtocolVersion | uint64 ContentHash | byte Kind | byte idLen + idLen UTF-8 bytes | byte nameLen + nameLen UTF-8 bytes
    // Encode truncates Id to PlayerKey.MaxIdLength chars and Name to DisplayNameRules.MaxLength chars, then drops trailing chars
    // until each field is at most 64 UTF-8 bytes. A surrogate pair is never split. TryDecode never throws.
    public static class ConnectPayloadCodec
    {
        public const byte FormatVersion = 1;
        public const int MaxBytes = 255;

        private const int MaxFieldBytes = 64;
        private const int HeaderBytes = 1 + 4 + 8 + 1;    // format, protocol, hash, kind
        private const int MinBytes = HeaderBytes + 1 + 1; // plus two empty length-prefixed fields

        private static readonly UTF8Encoding Lenient = new UTF8Encoding(false, false);
        private static readonly UTF8Encoding Strict = new UTF8Encoding(false, true);

        public static byte[] Encode(in ConnectPayload payload)
        {
            byte[] id = FieldBytes(payload.Key.Id, PlayerKey.MaxIdLength);
            byte[] name = FieldBytes(payload.Name, DisplayNameRules.MaxLength);

            var data = new byte[HeaderBytes + 1 + id.Length + 1 + name.Length];
            int p = 0;
            data[p++] = FormatVersion;
            uint protocol = unchecked((uint)payload.ProtocolVersion);
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) data[p++] = (byte)(protocol >> (8 * i));
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) data[p++] = (byte)(payload.ContentHash >> (8 * i));
            data[p++] = (byte)payload.Key.Kind;
            data[p++] = (byte)id.Length;
            Buffer.BlockCopy(id, 0, data, p, id.Length);
            p += id.Length;
            data[p++] = (byte)name.Length;
            Buffer.BlockCopy(name, 0, data, p, name.Length);
            return data;
        }

        // False on null, too short or too long, wrong FormatVersion, unknown Kind, a length past the end or above 64,
        // trailing bytes, or invalid UTF-8.
        public static bool TryDecode(byte[] data, out ConnectPayload payload)
        {
            payload = default;
            if (data == null || data.Length < MinBytes || data.Length > MaxBytes) return false;

            int p = 0;
            if (data[p++] != FormatVersion) return false;

            uint protocol = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) protocol |= (uint)data[p++] << (8 * i);
            ulong hash = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) hash |= (ulong)data[p++] << (8 * i);

            byte kind = data[p++];
            if (kind > (byte)IdentityKind.Steam) return false;

            if (!TryReadField(data, ref p, out string id)) return false;
            if (!TryReadField(data, ref p, out string name)) return false;
            if (p != data.Length) return false;

            payload = new ConnectPayload(unchecked((int)protocol), hash, new PlayerKey((IdentityKind)kind, id), name);
            return true;
        }

        private static bool TryReadField(byte[] data, ref int p, out string value)
        {
            value = null;
            if (p >= data.Length) return false;
            int length = data[p++];
            if (length > MaxFieldBytes || p + length > data.Length) return false;
            try
            {
                value = Strict.GetString(data, p, length);
            }
            catch (ArgumentException)
            {
                return false; // DecoderFallbackException: invalid UTF-8
            }
            p += length;
            return true;
        }

        private static byte[] FieldBytes(string text, int maxChars)
        {
            string s = text ?? string.Empty;
            if (s.Length > maxChars) s = s.Substring(0, CutIndex(s, maxChars));
            byte[] bytes = Lenient.GetBytes(s);
            while (bytes.Length > MaxFieldBytes)
            {
                s = s.Substring(0, CutIndex(s, s.Length - 1));
                bytes = Lenient.GetBytes(s);
            }
            return bytes;
        }

        // Largest cut point <= length that does not split a surrogate pair.
        private static int CutIndex(string s, int length)
        {
            if (length > 0 && length < s.Length && char.IsHighSurrogate(s[length - 1]) && char.IsLowSurrogate(s[length])) return length - 1;
            return length;
        }
    }
}
```

Create `Assets/_Project/Core/Net/DisplayNameRules.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Display-name rules shared by the settings store (T5), the connection approver (T8) and SubmitNameRpc (T11).
    public static class DisplayNameRules
    {
        public const int MaxLength = 16;

        // Removes char.IsControl characters, trims, truncates to MaxLength chars (never splitting a surrogate pair),
        // trims the end again. An empty result (or null input) becomes Fallback(slot).
        public static string Sanitize(string raw, int slot)
        {
            if (raw == null) return Fallback(slot);

            var sb = new StringBuilder(raw.Length);
            foreach (char c in raw)
            {
                if (!char.IsControl(c)) sb.Append(c);
            }

            string s = sb.ToString().Trim();
            if (s.Length > MaxLength)
            {
                int cut = MaxLength;
                if (char.IsHighSurrogate(s[cut - 1]) && char.IsLowSurrogate(s[cut])) cut--;
                s = s.Substring(0, cut).TrimEnd();
            }

            return s.Length == 0 ? Fallback(slot) : s;
        }

        // "Fisher " + (slot + 1): slot 0 -> "Fisher 1".
        public static string Fallback(int slot)
        {
            return "Fisher " + (slot + 1);
        }
    }
}
```

Create `Assets/_Project/Core/Net/DisconnectClassifier.cs`:

```csharp
using System;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Turns an NGO client stop into an EndReason (spec 6.9, contract 7.3). Called by LocalNetworkSession (T8) and UgsNetworkSession (T9).
    // The host's approver sends EndReason.ToString() as the disconnect reason; NGO's own reason text (for example
    // "[Disconnect Event] ...") is not an EndReason name and falls through to the timing rules.
    public static class DisconnectClassifier
    {
        // 1 userInitiated -> UserLeft
        // 2 disconnectReason is exactly one defined EndReason name (case-sensitive, first char a letter, no comma) -> that value
        // 3 wasConnected -> HostLeft
        // 4 secondsSinceStart < NetworkConstants.VersionMismatchWindowSeconds -> VersionMismatch
        // 5 else Timeout
        public static EndReason Classify(bool userInitiated, bool wasConnected, string disconnectReason, double secondsSinceStart)
        {
            if (userInitiated) return EndReason.UserLeft;
            if (TryParseReason(disconnectReason, out EndReason parsed)) return parsed;
            if (wasConnected) return EndReason.HostLeft;
            if (secondsSinceStart < NetworkConstants.VersionMismatchWindowSeconds) return EndReason.VersionMismatch;
            return EndReason.Timeout;
        }

        private static bool TryParseReason(string text, out EndReason reason)
        {
            reason = EndReason.Unknown;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || !char.IsLetter(text[0])) return false;
            // Enum.TryParse accepts "A, B" and returns the OR of both values, which can collide with a real member.
            if (text.IndexOf(',') >= 0) return false;
            if (!Enum.TryParse(text, false, out EndReason value)) return false;
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(EndReason), value)) return false;
            reason = value;
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Maps an EndReason to its UI string key (spec 11.2 table). T14's UiStrings holds the texts.
    // SceneFlow (T13) publishes a toast only when the key is not null.
    public static class EndReasonText
    {
        public static string ToastKey(EndReason reason)
        {
            switch (reason)
            {
                case EndReason.UserLeft: return null;
                case EndReason.HostLeft: return "err.host_left";
                case EndReason.Kicked: return "err.rejected";
                case EndReason.DuplicateIdentity: return "err.rejected";
                case EndReason.Timeout: return "err.timeout";
                case EndReason.FullLobby: return "err.session_full";
                case EndReason.JoinsClosed: return "err.joins_closed";
                case EndReason.VersionMismatch: return "err.version";
                case EndReason.InvalidCode: return "err.code_not_found";
                case EndReason.ServicesUnavailable: return "err.services";
                case EndReason.TransportFailure: return "err.network";
                default: return "err.generic"; // Unknown and any undefined value
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Create `Assets/_Project/Core/Net/DevFlags.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Dev-only command-line flags (spec 17.1 criteria 3-6; contract 7.3). AppBootstrap (T13) parses
    // DevStartup.CollectArgs() (command line plus MPPM tags split on whitespace) and applies them only in dev builds.
    // Flag names are case-insensitive. Unknown tokens are ignored. A flag whose value is missing or malformed is
    // ignored (left at its default) and its value token is not consumed, so a following flag is still read.
    public sealed class DevFlags
    {
        public static readonly DevFlags None = new DevFlags();

        private DevFlags()
        {
            JoinDirectAddress = NetworkConstants.LoopbackAddress;
            JoinDirectPort = NetworkConstants.DefaultPort;
        }

        public bool Solo { get; private set; }                 // -dev-solo
        public bool HostDirect { get; private set; }           // -dev-host-direct
        public bool HasJoinDirect { get; private set; }        // -dev-join-direct <ip[:port]>
        public string JoinDirectAddress { get; private set; }  // "127.0.0.1" when HasJoinDirect is false
        public ushort JoinDirectPort { get; private set; }     // NetworkConstants.DefaultPort when omitted
        public int ProtocolOffset { get; private set; }        // -dev-protocol-offset <int>, default 0
        public bool LongTimeout { get; private set; }          // -dev-long-timeout

        public static DevFlags Parse(IReadOnlyList<string> args)
        {
            var flags = new DevFlags();
            if (args == null) return flags;

            for (int i = 0; i < args.Count; i++)
            {
                string arg = args[i];
                string next = i + 1 < args.Count ? args[i + 1] : null;

                if (Is(arg, "-dev-solo"))
                {
                    flags.Solo = true;
                }
                else if (Is(arg, "-dev-host-direct"))
                {
                    flags.HostDirect = true;
                }
                else if (Is(arg, "-dev-long-timeout"))
                {
                    flags.LongTimeout = true;
                }
                else if (Is(arg, "-dev-join-direct"))
                {
                    if (TryParseEndpoint(next, out string address, out ushort port))
                    {
                        flags.HasJoinDirect = true;
                        flags.JoinDirectAddress = address;
                        flags.JoinDirectPort = port;
                        i++;
                    }
                }
                else if (Is(arg, "-dev-protocol-offset"))
                {
                    if (next != null && int.TryParse(next, NumberStyles.AllowLeadingSign, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out int offset))
                    {
                        flags.ProtocolOffset = offset;
                        i++;
                    }
                }
            }

            return flags;
        }

        private static bool Is(string arg, string flag)
        {
            return string.Equals(arg, flag, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }

        // "a.b.c.d" or "a.b.c.d:port" with a dotted-decimal IPv4 address and a port in 1..65535.
        private static bool TryParseEndpoint(string text, out string address, out ushort port)
        {
            address = NetworkConstants.LoopbackAddress;
            port = NetworkConstants.DefaultPort;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) return false;

            string host = text;
            int colon = text.IndexOf(':');
            if (colon >= 0)
            {
                host = text.Substring(0, colon);
                string portText = text.Substring(colon + 1);
                if (!ushort.TryParse(portText, NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out ushort parsed) || parsed == 0) return false;
                port = parsed;
            }

            if (!IsIPv4(host)) return false;
            address = host;
            return true;
        }

        private static bool IsIPv4(string text)
        {
            string[] parts = text.Split('.');
            if (parts.Length != 4) return false;
            foreach (string part in parts)
            {
                if (part.Length == 0 || part.Length > 3) return false;
                foreach (char c in part)
                {
                    if (c < '0' || c > '9') return false;
                }
                if (int.Parse(part, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) > 255) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Authority: none (pure EditMode tests). FishGame.Core.LookMath.
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class LookMathTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void LookMath_Mouse_ScalesWithoutDt()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(1.2f, LookMath.MouseToDegrees(10f, 0.12f), 1e-5f);
            Assert.AreEqual(-0.6f, LookMath.MouseToDegrees(-5f, 0.12f), 1e-5f);
            Assert.AreEqual(0f, LookMath.MouseToDegrees(0f, 0.3f), 0f);
        }

        [Test]
        public void LookMath_Stick_IsSquaredAndSigned()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(45f, LookMath.StickToDegrees(0.5f, 1f, 1f), 1e-4f);
            Assert.AreEqual(-45f, LookMath.StickToDegrees(-0.5f, 1f, 1f), 1e-4f);
            Assert.AreEqual(180f, LookMath.StickToDegrees(1f, 2f, 0.5f), 1e-4f);
            Assert.AreEqual(3f, LookMath.StickToDegrees(1f, 1f, 1f / 60f), 1e-4f);
            Assert.AreEqual(0f, LookMath.StickToDegrees(0f, 1f, 1f), 0f);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Authority: none (EditMode tests). Loads the committed FishGameInput.inputactions through InputActionAsset.FromJson
// and checks maps, actions, types, schemes (spec 8.1, 17.1) and the default bindings (spec 8.3).
using System.IO;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class InputActionsAssetTests
    {
        private static InputActionAsset LoadFromJson()
        {
            string projectRoot = Path.GetDirectoryName(Application.dataPath);
            string path = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(projectRoot, InputActionNames.AssetPath));
            Assert.IsTrue(File.Exists(path), "Missing input asset: " + path);
            return InputActionAsset.FromJson(File.ReadAllText(path));
        }

        private static bool HasGroup(InputBinding binding, string group)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(binding.groups)) return false;
            foreach (string g in binding.groups.Split(';'))
                if (g == group) return true;
            return false;
        }

        // A plain (non-composite) binding, or a composite part, with this exact path and group.
        private static bool HasBinding(InputAction action, string path, string group)
        {
            foreach (InputBinding b in action.bindings)
                if (!b.isComposite && b.path == path && HasGroup(b, group)) return true;
            return false;
        }

        // A composite part with this part name (e.g. "negative"), path and group.
        private static bool HasCompositePart(InputAction action, string partName, string path, string group)
        {
            foreach (InputBinding b in action.bindings)
                if (b.isPartOfComposite && b.name == partName && b.path == path && HasGroup(b, group)) return true;
            return false;
        }

        [Test]
        public void InputActions_FromJson_HasMapsActionsAndTypes()
        {
            InputActionAsset asset = LoadFromJson();
            try
            {
                Assert.AreEqual(3, asset.actionMaps.Count, "Exactly Player, Fishing, UI in M1 (no Boat map)");
                InputActionMap player = asset.FindActionMap(InputActionNames.PlayerMap);
                InputActionMap fishing = asset.FindActionMap(InputActionNames.FishingMap);
                InputActionMap ui = asset.FindActionMap(InputActionNames.UiMap);
                Assert.IsNotNull(player, "Player map");
                Assert.IsNotNull(fishing, "Fishing map");
                Assert.IsNotNull(ui, "UI map");
                Assert.IsNull(asset.FindActionMap("FishGameInput"), "No map may be named FishGameInput");

                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionNames.PlayerActions.Length, player.actions.Count, "Player action count");
                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionNames.FishingActions.Length, fishing.actions.Count, "Fishing action count");
                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionNames.UiActions.Length, ui.actions.Count, "UI action count");

                foreach (string name in InputActionNames.PlayerActions)
                    Assert.IsNotNull(asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.PlayerMap + "/" + name), "Missing Player/" + name);
                foreach (string name in InputActionNames.FishingActions)
                    Assert.IsNotNull(asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.FishingMap + "/" + name), "Missing Fishing/" + name);
                foreach (string name in InputActionNames.UiActions)
                    Assert.IsNotNull(asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.UiMap + "/" + name), "Missing UI/" + name);

                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionType.Value, asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Move).type, "Move type");
                Assert.AreEqual("Vector2", asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Move).expectedControlType, "Move control");
                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionType.Value, asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Look).type, "Look type");
                Assert.AreEqual("Vector2", asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Look).expectedControlType, "Look control");

                foreach (string name in InputActionNames.PlayerActions)
                {
                    if (name == "Move" || name == "Look") continue;
                    InputAction a = asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.PlayerMap + "/" + name);
                    Assert.AreEqual(InputActionType.Button, a.type, "Player/" + name + " type");
                }

                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionType.Button, asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Reel).type, "Reel type");
                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionType.Value, asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Steer).type, "Steer type");
                Assert.AreEqual("Axis", asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Steer).expectedControlType, "Steer control");

                // UI (contract D17: names are the requirement; types follow the Unity UI defaults).
                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionType.PassThrough, asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Navigate).type, "Navigate type");
                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionType.Button, asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Submit).type, "Submit type");
                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionType.Button, asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Cancel).type, "Cancel type");
                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionType.PassThrough, asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Point).type, "Point type");
                Assert.AreEqual(InputActionType.PassThrough, asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Click).type, "Click type");

                Assert.AreEqual(2, asset.controlSchemes.Count, "Exactly two control schemes");
                Assert.GreaterOrEqual(asset.FindControlSchemeIndex(InputActionNames.KeyboardMouseScheme), 0, "Keyboard&Mouse scheme");
                Assert.GreaterOrEqual(asset.FindControlSchemeIndex(InputActionNames.GamepadScheme), 0, "Gamepad scheme");
            }
            finally
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(asset);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void InputActions_FromJson_DefaultBindingsMatchSpec()
        {
            const string KM = InputActionNames.KeyboardMouseScheme;
            const string GP = InputActionNames.GamepadScheme;
            // { action path, binding path, group } for every plain binding required by spec 8.3.
            string[][] expected =
            {
                new[] { InputActionNames.Move, "<Gamepad>/leftStick", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Look, "<Mouse>/delta", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Look, "<Gamepad>/rightStick", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Jump, "<Keyboard>/space", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Jump, "<Gamepad>/buttonSouth", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Sprint, "<Keyboard>/leftShift", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Sprint, "<Gamepad>/leftStickPress", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Primary, "<Mouse>/leftButton", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Primary, "<Gamepad>/rightTrigger", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Secondary, "<Mouse>/rightButton", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Secondary, "<Gamepad>/leftTrigger", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Interact, "<Keyboard>/e", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Interact, "<Gamepad>/buttonWest", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Shove, "<Keyboard>/f", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Shove, "<Gamepad>/rightStickPress", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Drop, "<Keyboard>/g", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Drop, "<Gamepad>/buttonEast", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Equip, "<Keyboard>/1", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Equip, "<Mouse>/scroll/up", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Equip, "<Mouse>/scroll/down", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Equip, "<Gamepad>/buttonNorth", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Journal, "<Keyboard>/j", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Journal, "<Gamepad>/select", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Pause, "<Keyboard>/escape", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Pause, "<Gamepad>/start", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Reel, "<Keyboard>/s", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Steer, "<Gamepad>/leftStick/x", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Submit, "<Keyboard>/enter", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Submit, "<Gamepad>/buttonSouth", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Cancel, "<Keyboard>/escape", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Cancel, "<Gamepad>/buttonEast", GP },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Point, "<Mouse>/position", KM },
                new[] { InputActionNames.Click, "<Mouse>/leftButton", KM },
            };

            InputActionAsset asset = LoadFromJson();
            try
            {
                foreach (string[] row in expected)
                {
                    InputAction action = asset.FindAction(row[0]);
                    Assert.IsNotNull(action, row[0]);
                    Assert.IsTrue(HasBinding(action, row[1], row[2]), row[0] + " needs " + row[1] + " in group " + row[2]);
                }

                InputAction move = asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Move);
                Assert.IsTrue(HasCompositePart(move, "up", "<Keyboard>/w", KM), "Move up = W");
                Assert.IsTrue(HasCompositePart(move, "down", "<Keyboard>/s", KM), "Move down = S");
                Assert.IsTrue(HasCompositePart(move, "left", "<Keyboard>/a", KM), "Move left = A");
                Assert.IsTrue(HasCompositePart(move, "right", "<Keyboard>/d", KM), "Move right = D");

                InputAction steer = asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.Steer);
                Assert.IsTrue(HasCompositePart(steer, "negative", "<Keyboard>/a", KM), "Steer A = -1");
                Assert.IsTrue(HasCompositePart(steer, "positive", "<Keyboard>/d", KM), "Steer D = +1");
                bool hasAxisComposite = false;
                foreach (InputBinding b in steer.bindings)
                    if (b.isComposite && b.path == "1DAxis") hasAxisComposite = true;
                Assert.IsTrue(hasAxisComposite, "Steer has a 1DAxis composite");
            }
            finally
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(asset);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **2.6** Write `Assets/_Project/Core/Input/InputContextRouter.cs`:

```csharp
// Core, no engine references, unit-tested. Decides which raw frame fields count in each context (spec 8.2).
// M1 rows: Free, Swimming, Climbing, Menu. Every other context routes exactly like Free until its milestone (contract D18).
namespace FishGame.Core
{
    public static class InputContextRouter
    {
        public static PlayerIntent Route(InputContext context, in PlayerInputFrame frame)
        {
            switch (context)
            {
                case InputContext.Swimming: return RouteSwimming(in frame);
                case InputContext.Climbing: return RouteClimbing(in frame);
                case InputContext.Menu: return RouteMenu(in frame);
                default: return RouteFree(in frame);
            }
        }

        // RodFighting / Staggered: (Steer, Reel || PrimaryHeld). Every other context: no fight input.
        public static FightInput RouteFight(InputContext context, in PlayerInputFrame frame)
        {
            if (context == InputContext.RodFighting || context == InputContext.Staggered)
                return new FightInput(frame.Steer, frame.Reel || frame.PrimaryHeld);
            return default;
        }

        // Menu -> UI only; Seated -> Player | Boat; everything else -> Player | Fishing.
        public static InputMaps EnabledMaps(InputContext context)
        {
            switch (context)
            {
                case InputContext.Menu: return InputMaps.UI;
                case InputContext.Seated: return InputMaps.Player | InputMaps.Boat;
                default: return InputMaps.Player | InputMaps.Fishing;
            }
        }

        private static PlayerIntent CopyAll(in PlayerInputFrame f)
        {
            return new PlayerIntent
            {
                MoveX = f.MoveX,
                MoveY = f.MoveY,
                LookYawDeg = f.LookYawDeg,
                LookPitchDeg = f.LookPitchDeg,
                JumpPressed = f.JumpPressed,
                SprintHeld = f.SprintHeld,
                PrimaryHeld = f.PrimaryHeld,
                PrimaryPressed = f.PrimaryPressed,
                PrimaryReleased = f.PrimaryReleased,
                SecondaryHeld = f.SecondaryHeld,
                SecondaryPressed = f.SecondaryPressed,
                SecondaryReleased = f.SecondaryReleased,
                InteractPressed = f.InteractPressed,
                ShovePressed = f.ShovePressed,
                DropPressed = f.DropPressed,
                EquipPressed = f.EquipPressed,
                PausePressed = f.PausePressed,
            };
        }

        // Free: Move, Look, Jump, Sprint, Interact, Shove, Equip, Pause pass. Primary*, Secondary*, Drop zeroed.
        private static PlayerIntent RouteFree(in PlayerInputFrame f)
        {
            PlayerIntent i = CopyAll(in f);
            i.PrimaryHeld = false;
            i.PrimaryPressed = false;
            i.PrimaryReleased = false;
            i.SecondaryHeld = false;
            i.SecondaryPressed = false;
            i.SecondaryReleased = false;
            i.DropPressed = false;
            return i;
        }

        // Swimming: Move, Look, Jump, Interact (climb at exits), Pause pass. Sprint, Primary*, Secondary*, Shove, Drop, Equip zeroed.
        private static PlayerIntent RouteSwimming(in PlayerInputFrame f)
        {
            PlayerIntent i = CopyAll(in f);
            i.SprintHeld = false;
            i.PrimaryHeld = false;
            i.PrimaryPressed = false;
            i.PrimaryReleased = false;
            i.SecondaryHeld = false;
            i.SecondaryPressed = false;
            i.SecondaryReleased = false;
            i.ShovePressed = false;
            i.DropPressed = false;
            i.EquipPressed = false;
            return i;
        }

        // Climbing: Look, Pause pass. Everything else zeroed.
        private static PlayerIntent RouteClimbing(in PlayerInputFrame f)
        {
            return new PlayerIntent
            {
                LookYawDeg = f.LookYawDeg,
                LookPitchDeg = f.LookPitchDeg,
                PausePressed = f.PausePressed,
            };
        }

        // Menu: Pause passes. Everything else zeroed (look included).
        private static PlayerIntent RouteMenu(in PlayerInputFrame f)
        {
            return new PlayerIntent { PausePressed = f.PausePressed };
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Core, no engine references, unit-tested. Converts raw look input to degrees (spec 11.6: mouse deg/count, stick x 180 deg/s).
namespace FishGame.Core
{
    public static class LookMath
    {
        public const float StickDegPerSecond = 180f;

        // Mouse deltas are already per-frame counts, so no dt.
        public static float MouseToDegrees(float countsDelta, float sensitivityDegPerCount)
        {
            return countsDelta * sensitivityDegPerCount;
        }

        // sign(v) * v^2 * 180 * speedMult * dt. The squared response keeps small stick deflections precise.
        public static float StickToDegrees(float stickValue, float speedMult, float dt)
        {
            float magnitude = stickValue < 0f ? -stickValue : stickValue;
            return stickValue * magnitude * StickDegPerSecond * speedMult * dt;
        }
    }
}
```
