- [ ] **3.4** Write `Assets/_Project/Runtime/Input/PlayerInputAdapter.cs`. Behaviour notes (the code already implements all of these):
  - It reads actions only from its own runtime `Instantiate` copy.
  - Look scaling comes from the active control: stick → `LookMath.StickToDegrees`, mouse → `LookMath.MouseToDegrees`.
  - `LastDevice` follows whichever action performed this frame. It never polls `Gamepad.current.wasUpdatedThisFrame`, because HID pads report constantly.
  - The context setters return early when the value is unchanged, so writing them every frame is free.
  - `GetBindingDisplayString` masks bindings by the `LastDevice` scheme: "E" on keyboard, "Button West" on a pad.

```csharp
// Authority: local client only. Reads hardware input once per frame; nothing here is networked.
// The only reader of InputActions (spec 8.1). Single owner of the cursor lock policy (contract D28) and of binding overrides.
// Works on a runtime Instantiate copy of the serialized asset, so rebinding never dirties the asset (contract D15).
// Journal is bound in the asset but not routed in M1 (no PlayerInputFrame field and no journal UI yet).
using System;
using FishGame.Core;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-1000)]
    public sealed class PlayerInputAdapter : MonoBehaviour, IInputService, IInputBindings
    {
        private InputActionAsset _actions;
        private ISettings _settings;

        private InputActionMap _playerMap, _fishingMap, _uiMap;
        private InputAction _move, _look, _jump, _sprint, _primary, _secondary, _interact, _shove, _drop, _equip, _pause;
        private InputAction _reel, _steer, _uiCancel;
        private InputAction[] _deviceProbe = Array.Empty<InputAction>();

        private InputContext _gameplayContext = InputContext.Free;
        private bool _menuOpen;
        private InputContext _appliedContext = InputContext.Free;

        private PlayerInputFrame _frame;
        private PlayerIntent _intent;
        private FightInput _fight;

        private bool _hasFocus = true;
        private InputDeviceKind _lastDevice = InputDeviceKind.KeyboardMouse;
        private bool _sprintLatched;
        private bool _aimLatched;
        private int _skipLookFrames;

        public InputContext Context => _menuOpen ? InputContext.Menu : _gameplayContext;

        public InputContext GameplayContext
        {
            get => _gameplayContext;
            set
            {
                if (_gameplayContext == value) return;
                _gameplayContext = value;
                ApplyContextIfChanged();
            }
        }

        public bool MenuOpen
        {
            get => _menuOpen;
            set
            {
                if (_menuOpen == value) return;
                _menuOpen = value;
                ApplyContextIfChanged();
            }
        }

        public PlayerIntent Intent => _intent;
        public FightInput Fight => _fight;
        public bool HasFocus => _hasFocus;
        public InputDeviceKind LastDevice => _lastDevice;
        public InputActionAsset Actions => _actions;

        public event Action<InputContext> ContextChanged;

        public void Initialize(InputActionAsset asset, ISettings settings)
        {
            if (asset == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(asset));
            if (settings == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(settings));

            ReleaseActions();
            if (_settings != null) _settings.Changed -= OnSettingsChanged;
            _settings = settings;
            _settings.Changed += OnSettingsChanged;

            _actions = Instantiate(asset);
            _actions.name = asset.name;

            string json = _settings.Current.bindingOverridesJson;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(json))
            {
                try { _actions.LoadBindingOverridesFromJson(json); }
                catch (Exception e) { Debug.LogWarning("[Input] Ignoring invalid binding overrides: " + e.Message); }
            }

            CacheActions();
            _appliedContext = Context;
            ApplyMaps(_appliedContext);
            ApplyCursor(_appliedContext);
        }

        private void Awake()
        {
            _hasFocus = Application.isFocused;
        }

        private void CacheActions()
        {
            _playerMap = _actions.FindActionMap(InputActionNames.PlayerMap, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _fishingMap = _actions.FindActionMap(InputActionNames.FishingMap, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _uiMap = _actions.FindActionMap(InputActionNames.UiMap, throwIfNotFound: true);

            _move = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Move, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _look = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Look, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _jump = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Jump, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _sprint = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Sprint, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _primary = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Primary, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _secondary = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Secondary, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _interact = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Interact, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _shove = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Shove, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _drop = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Drop, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _equip = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Equip, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _pause = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Pause, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _reel = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Reel, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _steer = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Steer, throwIfNotFound: true);
            _uiCancel = _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Cancel, throwIfNotFound: true);

            _deviceProbe = new[]
            {
                _move, _look, _jump, _sprint, _primary, _secondary, _interact, _shove, _drop, _equip, _pause, _reel, _steer,
                _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Navigate, throwIfNotFound: true),
                _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Submit, throwIfNotFound: true),
                _uiCancel,
                _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Point, throwIfNotFound: true),
                _actions.FindAction(InputActionNames.Click, throwIfNotFound: true),
            };
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (_actions == null || !_hasFocus)
            {
                ClearOutputs(); // spec 8.1: unfocused window -> neutral input
                return;
            }

            UpdateLastDevice();
            _frame = ReadFrame();
            InputContext ctx = Context;
            _intent = InputContextRouter.Route(ctx, in _frame);
            _fight = InputContextRouter.RouteFight(ctx, in _frame);
        }

        private PlayerInputFrame ReadFrame()
        {
            SettingsData s = _settings.Current;
            var f = new PlayerInputFrame();

            Vector2 move = _move.ReadValue<Vector2>();
            f.MoveX = move.x;
            f.MoveY = move.y;

            Vector2 look = _look.ReadValue<Vector2>();
            if (_skipLookFrames > 0)
            {
                _skipLookFrames--; // drop the first look delta after focus regain
            }
            else if (look.x != 0f || look.y != 0f)
            {
                float yaw, pitch;
                InputControl source = _look.activeControl;
                if (source != null && source.device is Gamepad)
                {
                    float dt = Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
                    yaw = LookMath.StickToDegrees(look.x, s.gamepadLookSpeed, dt);
                    pitch = LookMath.StickToDegrees(look.y, s.gamepadLookSpeed, dt);
                }
                else
                {
                    // Input System mouse delta: +x = right, +y = up, in counts per frame.
                    yaw = LookMath.MouseToDegrees(look.x, s.mouseSensitivity);
                    pitch = LookMath.MouseToDegrees(look.y, s.mouseSensitivity);
                }
                f.LookYawDeg = yaw;
                f.LookPitchDeg = s.invertY ? -pitch : pitch;
            }

            f.JumpPressed = _jump.WasPressedThisFrame();
            f.SprintHeld = Held(_sprint, s.sprintToggle, ref _sprintLatched);
            f.PrimaryHeld = _primary.IsPressed();
            f.PrimaryPressed = _primary.WasPressedThisFrame();
            f.PrimaryReleased = _primary.WasReleasedThisFrame();
            f.SecondaryHeld = Held(_secondary, s.aimToggle, ref _aimLatched);
            f.SecondaryPressed = _secondary.WasPressedThisFrame();
            f.SecondaryReleased = _secondary.WasReleasedThisFrame();
            f.InteractPressed = _interact.WasPressedThisFrame();
            f.ShovePressed = _shove.WasPressedThisFrame();
            f.DropPressed = _drop.WasPressedThisFrame();
            f.EquipPressed = _equip.WasPressedThisFrame();
            f.PausePressed = Context == InputContext.Menu ? _uiCancel.WasPressedThisFrame() : _pause.WasPressedThisFrame();
            f.Steer = _steer.ReadValue<float>();
            f.Reel = _reel.IsPressed();
            return f;
        }

        // Hold, or a latched toggle when the setting is on (sprint toggle, aim toggle).
        private static bool Held(InputAction action, bool toggle, ref bool latch)
        {
            if (!toggle)
            {
                latch = false;
                return action.IsPressed();
            }
            if (action.WasPressedThisFrame()) latch = !latch;
            return latch;
        }

        // The device of whichever action performed this frame wins. Never polls Gamepad.current.wasUpdatedThisFrame,
        // because HID pads stream reports every frame even when idle.
        private void UpdateLastDevice()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _deviceProbe.Length; i++)
            {
                InputAction action = _deviceProbe[i];
                if (!action.WasPerformedThisFrame()) continue;
                InputControl control = action.activeControl;
                if (control == null) continue;
                InputDevice device = control.device;
                if (device is Gamepad)
                {
                    _lastDevice = InputDeviceKind.Gamepad;
                    return;
                }
                if (device is Keyboard || device is Pointer)
                {
                    _lastDevice = InputDeviceKind.KeyboardMouse;
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        private void ClearOutputs()
        {
            _frame = default;
            _intent = PlayerIntent.None;
            _fight = default;
        }

        private void OnApplicationFocus(bool hasFocus)
        {
            _hasFocus = hasFocus;
            if (hasFocus)
            {
                _skipLookFrames = 1;
                ApplyCursor(Context);
            }
            else
            {
                SetRumble(0f, 0f);
                ClearOutputs();
            }
        }

        private void OnSettingsChanged(SettingsData data)
        {
            if (data == null) return;
            if (!data.sprintToggle) _sprintLatched = false;
            if (!data.aimToggle) _aimLatched = false;
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            SetRumble(0f, 0f);
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            SetRumble(0f, 0f);
            if (_settings != null) _settings.Changed -= OnSettingsChanged;
            ReleaseActions();
        }

        private void ReleaseActions()
        {
            if (_actions == null) return;
            _actions.Disable();
            if (Application.isPlaying) Destroy(_actions);
            else DestroyImmediate(_actions);
            _actions = null;
            _deviceProbe = Array.Empty<InputAction>();
        }

        private void ApplyContextIfChanged()
        {
            InputContext ctx = Context;
            if (ctx == _appliedContext) return;
            _appliedContext = ctx;
            if (_actions != null) ApplyMaps(ctx);
            ApplyCursor(ctx);
            ContextChanged?.Invoke(ctx);
        }

        private void ApplyMaps(InputContext ctx)
        {
            InputMaps maps = InputContextRouter.EnabledMaps(ctx);
            SetMapEnabled(_playerMap, (maps & InputMaps.Player) != 0);
            SetMapEnabled(_fishingMap, (maps & InputMaps.Fishing) != 0);
            SetMapEnabled(_uiMap, (maps & InputMaps.UI) != 0);
        }

        private static void SetMapEnabled(InputActionMap map, bool enabled)
        {
            if (map == null) return;
            if (enabled) map.Enable();
            else map.Disable();
        }

        // Cursor policy (single owner): Menu -> unlocked + visible; every other context -> locked + hidden.
        private static void ApplyCursor(InputContext ctx)
        {
            bool menu = ctx == InputContext.Menu;
            Cursor.lockState = menu ? CursorLockMode.None : CursorLockMode.Locked;
            Cursor.visible = menu;
        }

        public void SetRumble(float low, float high)
        {
            Gamepad pad = Gamepad.current;
            if (pad == null) return;
            pad.SetMotorSpeeds(Mathf.Clamp01(low), Mathf.Clamp01(high));
        }

        public string GetBindingDisplayString(string actionPath)
        {
            if (_actions == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(actionPath)) return "";
            InputAction action = _actions.FindAction(actionPath);
            if (action == null) return "";
            string group = _lastDevice == InputDeviceKind.Gamepad
                ? InputActionNames.GamepadScheme
                : InputActionNames.KeyboardMouseScheme;
            return action.GetBindingDisplayString(InputBinding.MaskByGroup(group));
        }

        public void SaveBindingOverrides()
        {
            if (_actions == null || _settings == null) return;
            _settings.Current.bindingOverridesJson = _actions.SaveBindingOverridesAsJson();
            _settings.Save();
        }

        public void ResetAllBindingOverrides()
        {
            if (_actions == null) return;
            _actions.RemoveAllBindingOverrides();
            SaveBindingOverrides();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Authority: test only (local). Stands in for PlayerInputAdapter so PlayMode tests drive the player without devices.
// Tests set Frame; Intent and Fight are routed through the real Core InputContextRouter on every read.
using System;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;

namespace FishGame.Tests.PlayMode
{
    public sealed class FakeInputService : IInputService
    {
        private InputContext _gameplayContext = InputContext.Free;
        private bool _menuOpen;

        public PlayerInputFrame Frame;

        public float LastRumbleLow { get; private set; }
        public float LastRumbleHigh { get; private set; }

        public InputContext Context => _menuOpen ? InputContext.Menu : _gameplayContext;

        public InputContext GameplayContext
        {
            get => _gameplayContext;
            set
            {
                InputContext before = Context;
                _gameplayContext = value;
                RaiseIfChanged(before);
            }
        }

        public bool MenuOpen
        {
            get => _menuOpen;
            set
            {
                InputContext before = Context;
                _menuOpen = value;
                RaiseIfChanged(before);
            }
        }

        public PlayerIntent Intent => InputContextRouter.Route(Context, in Frame);
        public FightInput Fight => InputContextRouter.RouteFight(Context, in Frame);
        public bool HasFocus => true;
        public InputDeviceKind LastDevice => InputDeviceKind.KeyboardMouse;

        public event Action<InputContext> ContextChanged;

        public void SetRumble(float low, float high)
        {
            LastRumbleLow = low;
            LastRumbleHigh = high;
        }

        public string GetBindingDisplayString(string actionPath) => actionPath ?? "";

        private void RaiseIfChanged(InputContext before)
        {
            InputContext after = Context;
            if (after != before) ContextChanged?.Invoke(after);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class ServiceRegistryTests
    {
        private interface IGreeter { string Greet(); }
        private sealed class EnglishGreeter : IGreeter { public string Greet() => "hi"; }
        private sealed class FrenchGreeter : IGreeter { public string Greet() => "salut"; }

        private class RecordingDisposable : IDisposable
        {
            private readonly string _name;
            private readonly List<string> _log;
            public RecordingDisposable(string name, List<string> log) { _name = name; _log = log; }
            public void Dispose() { _log.Add(_name); }
        }

        private sealed class DisposableA : RecordingDisposable
        {
            public DisposableA(string name, List<string> log) : base(name, log) { }
        }

        private sealed class DisposableB : RecordingDisposable
        {
            public DisposableB(string name, List<string> log) : base(name, log) { }
        }

        [Test]
        public void ServiceRegistry_MissingService_Throws()
        {
            var registry = new ServiceRegistry();
            var ex = Assert.Throws<MissingServiceException>(() => registry.Get<IGreeter>());
            Assert.AreEqual(typeof(IGreeter), ex.ServiceType);
            StringAssert.StartsWith("Service not registered: ", ex.Message);
            Assert.IsInstanceOf<InvalidOperationException>(ex);
            Assert.IsFalse(registry.Contains<IGreeter>());
            Assert.IsFalse(registry.TryGet<IGreeter>(out IGreeter none));
            Assert.IsNull(none);
            registry.Dispose();
        }

        [Test]
        public void ServiceRegistry_DuplicateRegister_Throws()
        {
            var registry = new ServiceRegistry();
            registry.Register<IGreeter>(new EnglishGreeter());
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => registry.Register<IGreeter>(new FrenchGreeter()));
            Assert.AreEqual("hi", registry.Get<IGreeter>().Greet());
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => registry.Register<FrenchGreeter>(null));
            registry.Dispose();
        }

        [Test]
        public void ServiceRegistry_Replace_Overwrites()
        {
            var registry = new ServiceRegistry();
            registry.Replace<IGreeter>(new EnglishGreeter()); // Replace on an empty key registers
            Assert.IsTrue(registry.Contains<IGreeter>());
            registry.Replace<IGreeter>(new FrenchGreeter());
            Assert.AreEqual("salut", registry.Get<IGreeter>().Greet());
            Assert.IsTrue(registry.TryGet<IGreeter>(out IGreeter found));
            Assert.AreEqual("salut", found.Greet());
            registry.Dispose();
        }

        [Test]
        public void ServiceRegistry_Dispose_DisposesInReverseOrderOnce()
        {
            var log = new List<string>();
            var registry = new ServiceRegistry();
            var a = new DisposableA("a", log);
            var b = new DisposableB("b", log);
            registry.Register<DisposableA>(a);  // order 0
            registry.Register<DisposableB>(b);  // order 1
            registry.Register<IDisposable>(b);  // order 2: same instance under a second key, disposed once

            registry.Dispose();
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "b", "a" }, log);
            Assert.IsFalse(registry.Contains<DisposableA>());
            Assert.IsFalse(registry.Contains<IDisposable>());

            registry.Dispose(); // idempotent
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "b", "a" }, log);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class EventBusTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void EventBus_DisposedSubscription_StopsReceiving()
        {
            var bus = new EventBus();
            int count = 0;
            IDisposable subscription = bus.Subscribe<int>(_ => count++);

            bus.Publish(1);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, count);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, bus.SubscriberCount<int>());

            subscription.Dispose();
            subscription.Dispose(); // idempotent
            bus.Publish(2);

            Assert.AreEqual(1, count);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, bus.SubscriberCount<int>());
        }

        [Test]
        public void EventBus_ThrowingHandler_DoesNotBlockOthers()
        {
            var bus = new EventBus();
            int secondCalls = 0;
            bus.Subscribe<int>(_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("boom"));
            bus.Subscribe<int>(_ => secondCalls++);

            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Exception, new Regex("boom"));
            bus.Publish(7);

            Assert.AreEqual(1, secondCalls);
        }

        [Test]
        public void EventBus_Publish_DeliversOnlyToMatchingType()
        {
            var bus = new EventBus();
            int intCalls = 0;
            int toastCalls = 0;
            ToastRequested received = default;
            bus.Subscribe<int>(_ => intCalls++);
            bus.Subscribe<ToastRequested>(t => { toastCalls++; received = t; });

            bus.Publish(new ToastRequested("toast.join_code", "ABC123"));

            Assert.AreEqual(0, intCalls);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, toastCalls);
            Assert.AreEqual("toast.join_code", received.Key);
            Assert.AreEqual("ABC123", received.Arg);
            Assert.AreEqual(4f, received.Seconds, 1e-6f);

            Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => bus.Subscribe<int>(null));

            bus.Clear();
            Assert.AreEqual(0, bus.SubscriberCount<int>());
            Assert.AreEqual(0, bus.SubscriberCount<ToastRequested>());
            bus.Publish(3);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, intCalls);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    public sealed class MissingServiceException : InvalidOperationException
    {
        public Type ServiceType { get; }

        public MissingServiceException(Type serviceType)
            : base("Service not registered: " + (serviceType == null ? "null" : serviceType.FullName))
        {
            ServiceType = serviceType;
        }
    }

    // Instance registry (not static). The key is the type argument T, so register under the interface consumers ask for.
    public sealed class ServiceRegistry : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<Type, object> _byType = new Dictionary<Type, object>();
        private readonly List<Type> _order = new List<Type>();

        public void Register<T>(T instance) where T : class
        {
            if (instance == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(instance));
            Type key = typeof(T);
            if (_byType.ContainsKey(key))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Service already registered: " + key.FullName);
            _byType.Add(key, instance);
            _order.Add(key);
        }

        // Registers or overwrites. A replaced instance is not disposed by the registry; its creator still owns it.
        public void Replace<T>(T instance) where T : class
        {
            if (instance == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(instance));
            Type key = typeof(T);
            if (!_byType.ContainsKey(key)) _order.Add(key);
            _byType[key] = instance;
        }

        public T Get<T>() where T : class
        {
            if (_byType.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out object found)) return (T)found;
            throw new MissingServiceException(typeof(T));
        }

        public bool TryGet<T>(out T instance) where T : class
        {
            if (_byType.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out object found))
            {
                instance = (T)found;
                return true;
            }
            instance = null;
            return false;
        }

        public bool Contains<T>() where T : class
        {
            return _byType.ContainsKey(typeof(T));
        }

        // Disposes each distinct registered IDisposable once, in reverse registration order, then clears. Idempotent.
        public void Dispose()
        {
            var disposed = new List<object>();
            for (int i = _order.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                var disposable = _byType[_order[i]] as IDisposable;
                if (disposable == null || ContainsReference(disposed, disposable)) continue;
                disposed.Add(disposable);
                try { disposable.Dispose(); }
                catch (Exception ex) { Debug.LogException(ex); }
            }
            _byType.Clear();
            _order.Clear();
        }

        private static bool ContainsReference(List<object> items, object target)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(items[i], target)) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // The only static service access point. App is set by AppBootstrap; Game is set by GameScope in gameplay scenes.
    // Both are null in EditMode tests. Reset on SubsystemRegistration so disabled domain reload cannot leak a stale registry.
    public static class ServiceRoots
    {
        private static ServiceRegistry _app;
        private static ServiceRegistry _game;

        public static ServiceRegistry App => _app;
        public static ServiceRegistry Game => _game;

        public static void SetApp(ServiceRegistry registry) { _app = registry; }
        public static void SetGame(ServiceRegistry registry) { _game = registry; }

        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        private static void ResetStatics()
        {
            _app = null;
            _game = null;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // Process-local, main thread only. Typed: Subscribe<T> receives Publish<T> with exactly the same T.
    public sealed class EventBus
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<Type, List<object>> _subscribers = new Dictionary<Type, List<object>>();

        public IDisposable Subscribe<T>(Action<T> handler)
        {
            if (handler == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(handler));
            Type key = typeof(T);
            if (!_subscribers.TryGetValue(key, out List<object> list))
            {
                list = new List<object>();
                _subscribers.Add(key, list);
            }
            var subscription = new Subscription<T>(this, handler);
            list.Add(subscription);
            return subscription;
        }

        // Iterates a snapshot, so handlers may subscribe/unsubscribe during delivery.
        // A throwing handler is logged with Debug.LogException and the remaining handlers still run.
        public void Publish<T>(T message)
        {
            if (!_subscribers.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out List<object> list)) return;
            object[] snapshot = list.ToArray();
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.Length; i++)
            {
                var subscription = (Subscription<T>)snapshot[i];
                if (!subscription.Active) continue;
                try { subscription.Handler(message); }
                catch (Exception ex) { Debug.LogException(ex); }
            }
        }

        public int SubscriberCount<T>()
        {
            return _subscribers.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out List<object> list) ? list.Count : 0;
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            foreach (List<object> list in _subscribers.Values)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++) ((ISubscription)list[i]).Deactivate();
            }
            _subscribers.Clear();
        }

        private void Remove(Type key, object subscription)
        {
            if (!_subscribers.TryGetValue(key, out List<object> list)) return;
            list.Remove(subscription);
            if (list.Count == 0) _subscribers.Remove(key);
        }

        private interface ISubscription
        {
            void Deactivate();
        }

        private sealed class Subscription<T> : IDisposable, ISubscription
        {
            private readonly EventBus _bus;

            public Subscription(EventBus bus, Action<T> handler)
            {
                _bus = bus;
                Handler = handler;
            }

            public Action<T> Handler { get; }
            public bool Active { get; private set; } = true;

            public void Deactivate() { Active = false; }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (!Active) return;
                Active = false;
                _bus.Remove(typeof(T), this);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // Raises Changed only on a real change. Never touches Time.timeScale.
    public sealed class PauseState : IPauseState
    {
        public bool Paused { get; private set; }

        public event Action<bool> Changed;

        public void SetPaused(bool paused)
        {
            if (Paused == paused) return;
            Paused = paused;
            Action<bool> handler = Changed;
            if (handler != null) handler(paused);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.IO;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class AtomicFileTests
    {
        private string _dir;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            _dir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "fgtests-atomic-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(_dir);
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown()
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(_dir)) Directory.Delete(_dir, true);
        }

        [Test]
        public void AtomicFile_Write_LeavesNoTempFile()
        {
            string path = Path.Combine(_dir, "a.json");
            AtomicFile.WriteAllText(path, "{}");
            Assert.IsTrue(File.Exists(path));
            Assert.AreEqual("{}", File.ReadAllText(path));
            Assert.IsFalse(File.Exists(path + AtomicFile.TempSuffix));
            Assert.IsFalse(File.Exists(path + AtomicFile.BackupSuffix)); // first write has nothing to back up
        }

        [Test]
        public void AtomicFile_SecondWrite_KeepsBackupOfPrevious()
        {
            string path = Path.Combine(_dir, "a.json");
            AtomicFile.WriteAllText(path, "first");
            AtomicFile.WriteAllText(path, "second");
            Assert.AreEqual("second", File.ReadAllText(path));
            Assert.AreEqual("first", File.ReadAllText(path + AtomicFile.BackupSuffix));
            Assert.IsFalse(File.Exists(path + AtomicFile.TempSuffix));

            AtomicFile.WriteAllText(path, "third"); // an existing .bak is overwritten
            Assert.AreEqual("third", File.ReadAllText(path));
            Assert.AreEqual("second", File.ReadAllText(path + AtomicFile.BackupSuffix));
        }

        [Test]
        public void AtomicFile_Write_HasNoBom()
        {
            string path = Path.Combine(_dir, "b.json");
            AtomicFile.WriteAllText(path, "caf\u00e9");
            byte[] bytes = File.ReadAllBytes(path);
            Assert.AreEqual(5, bytes.Length); // "caf" = 3 bytes, U+00E9 = 2 bytes in UTF-8, no 3-byte BOM
            Assert.IsFalse(bytes[0] == 0xEF && bytes[1] == 0xBB && bytes[2] == 0xBF);
            Assert.AreEqual("caf\u00e9", AtomicFile.ReadAllTextOrNull(path));
        }

        [Test]
        public void AtomicFile_Write_CreatesDirectory()
        {
            string path = Path.Combine(_dir, "nested", "c.json");
            AtomicFile.WriteAllText(path, "{}");
            Assert.IsTrue(File.Exists(path));
        }

        [Test]
        public void AtomicFile_ReadAllTextOrNull_MissingFile_ReturnsNull()
        {
            Assert.IsNull(AtomicFile.ReadAllTextOrNull(Path.Combine(_dir, "missing.json")));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        {
```

```csharp
            store.Current.displayName = "  Bob\u0007 ";

            Assert.AreEqual(Path.Combine(_dir, "settings_player2.json"), clonePath);

            var clone = new SettingsStore(clonePath);
            clone.Load();

            for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++)
            {
                main.Current.displayName = "Main" + i;
                main.Current.masterVolume = i;
                main.Save();
                clone.Current.displayName = "Clone" + i;
                clone.Current.masterVolume = 100 - i;
                clone.Save();
            }

            var mainReload = new SettingsStore(mainPath);
            mainReload.Load();
            var cloneReload = new SettingsStore(clonePath);
            cloneReload.Load();

            Assert.IsFalse(mainReload.LoadedFromBackup);
            Assert.IsFalse(cloneReload.LoadedFromBackup);
            Assert.AreEqual("Main19", mainReload.Current.displayName);
            Assert.AreEqual(19, mainReload.Current.masterVolume);
            Assert.AreEqual("Clone19", cloneReload.Current.displayName);
            Assert.AreEqual(81, cloneReload.Current.masterVolume);
            StringAssert.Contains("Main18", File.ReadAllText(mainPath + AtomicFile.BackupSuffix));
            StringAssert.Contains("Clone18", File.ReadAllText(clonePath + AtomicFile.BackupSuffix));
            Assert.IsFalse(File.Exists(mainPath + AtomicFile.TempSuffix));
            Assert.IsFalse(File.Exists(clonePath + AtomicFile.TempSuffix));
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Text;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // M1 settings (spec 11.6). Serialized with JsonUtility: public fields only, unknown/missing fields keep defaults.
    // Clamp() runs on every Load, NotifyChanged and Save.
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class SettingsData
    {
        private const string DefaultName = "Fisher";

        public int version = 1;
        public int masterVolume = 80, sfxVolume = 80, ambienceVolume = 70, musicVolume = 60, uiVolume = 80, voiceVolume = 80; // 0..100
        public string displayName = DefaultName;   // 1..16 chars after Clamp (empty/whitespace -> "Fisher")
        public float mouseSensitivity = 0.12f;     // 0.04..0.30 deg/count
        public float gamepadLookSpeed = 1.0f;      // 0.2..3.0 (x 180 deg/s)
        public bool invertY = false;
        public float fieldOfView = 90f;            // horizontal, 80..110
        public float cameraMotion = 1f;            // 0..1
        public bool sprintToggle = false, aimToggle = false, streamerMode = false;
        public int uiScalePercent = 100;           // 80..150
        public string bindingOverridesJson = "";   // InputActionAsset.SaveBindingOverridesAsJson output
        public string localPlayerId = "";          // GUID "N" format, created once per instance file

        public void Clamp()
        {
            masterVolume = ClampInt(masterVolume, 0, 100);
            sfxVolume = ClampInt(sfxVolume, 0, 100);
            ambienceVolume = ClampInt(ambienceVolume, 0, 100);
            musicVolume = ClampInt(musicVolume, 0, 100);
            uiVolume = ClampInt(uiVolume, 0, 100);
            voiceVolume = ClampInt(voiceVolume, 0, 100);
            displayName = NormalizeName(displayName);
            mouseSensitivity = ClampFloat(mouseSensitivity, 0.04f, 0.30f, 0.12f);
            gamepadLookSpeed = ClampFloat(gamepadLookSpeed, 0.2f, 3.0f, 1.0f);
            fieldOfView = ClampFloat(fieldOfView, 80f, 110f, 90f);
            cameraMotion = ClampFloat(cameraMotion, 0f, 1f, 1f);
            uiScalePercent = ClampInt(uiScalePercent, 80, 150);
            if (bindingOverridesJson == null) bindingOverridesJson = "";
            if (localPlayerId == null) localPlayerId = "";
        }

        public SettingsData Clone()
        {
            return JsonUtility.FromJson<SettingsData>(JsonUtility.ToJson(this));
        }

        // Removes control chars, trims, truncates to DisplayNameRules.MaxLength, trims the end again; empty -> "Fisher".
        private static string NormalizeName(string raw)
        {
            if (raw == null) return DefaultName;
            var sb = new StringBuilder(raw.Length);
            foreach (char c in raw)
            {
                if (!char.IsControl(c)) sb.Append(c);
            }
            string trimmed = sb.ToString().Trim();
            int max = FishGame.Core.DisplayNameRules.MaxLength;
            if (trimmed.Length > max) trimmed = trimmed.Substring(0, max).TrimEnd();
            return trimmed.Length == 0 ? DefaultName : trimmed;
        }

        private static int ClampInt(int value, int min, int max)
        {
            return value < min ? min : (value > max ? max : value);
        }

        private static float ClampFloat(float value, float min, float max, float fallback)
        {
            if (float.IsNaN(value)) return fallback;
            return value < min ? min : (value > max ? max : value);
        }
    }
}
```

Create `Assets/_Project/Runtime/Settings/AtomicFile.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // Atomic text write: path + ".tmp" (UTF-8 without BOM, flushed to disk), then
    // File.Replace(tmp, path, path + ".bak") when path exists, else File.Move(tmp, path).
    // The previous good file therefore survives as path + ".bak".
    public static class AtomicFile
    {
        public const string TempSuffix = ".tmp";
        public const string BackupSuffix = ".bak";

        private static readonly UTF8Encoding Utf8NoBom = new UTF8Encoding(false);

        public static void WriteAllText(string path, string contents)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) throw new ArgumentException("path is required", nameof(path));
            string directory = Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetFullPath(path));
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory)) Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);

            string temp = path + TempSuffix;
            byte[] bytes = Utf8NoBom.GetBytes(contents ?? "");
            using (var stream = new FileStream(temp, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None))
            {
                stream.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
                stream.Flush(true); // flush OS buffers to disk before the swap
            }

            try
            {
                if (File.Exists(path)) File.Replace(temp, path, path + BackupSuffix);
                else File.Move(temp, path);
            }
            catch
            {
                TryDelete(temp);
                throw;
            }
        }

        // Null when the file is missing or cannot be read.
        public static string ReadAllTextOrNull(string path)
        {
            try
            {
                return File.Exists(path) ? File.ReadAllText(path, Utf8NoBom) : null;
            }
            catch (IOException)
            {
                return null;
            }
            catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private static void TryDelete(string path)
        {
            try
            {
                if (File.Exists(path)) File.Delete(path);
            }
            catch (IOException) { }
            catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // Per-instance profile name: picks the settings file suffix (and the UGS auth profile in T9), so MPPM clones and
    // several standalone builds on one machine never share settings.json.
    // Rules (flag names compared case-insensitively):
    //   1. "-dev-profile <x>" wins: Name = Sanitize(x), IsMppmClone = false.
    //   2. else "-editor-mode" plus "-name <x>" (MPPM clone; same rule Authentication 3.8.0 uses) with Sanitize(x) non-empty:
    //      Name = Sanitize(x), IsMppmClone = true.
    //   3. else main instance: Name = "", Suffix = "".
    public sealed class InstanceProfile
    {
        private const int MaxNameLength = 30;

        private static InstanceProfile _current;

        private InstanceProfile(string name, bool isMppmClone)
        {
            Name = name;
            Suffix = name.Length == 0 ? "" : "_" + name;
            IsMppmClone = isMppmClone;
        }

        public string Name { get; }
        public string Suffix { get; }
        public bool IsMppmClone { get; }

        // Command-line args never change within a process, so caching survives disabled domain reload safely.
        public static InstanceProfile Current
        {
            get
            {
                if (_current == null) _current = FromArgs(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs());
                return _current;
            }
        }

        public static InstanceProfile FromArgs(IReadOnlyList<string> args)
        {
            if (args == null) return new InstanceProfile("", false);

            bool editorMode = false;
            string cloneName = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < args.Count; i++)
            {
                string arg = args[i];
                if (IsFlag(arg, "-dev-profile") && i + 1 < args.Count)
                    return new InstanceProfile(Sanitize(args[i + 1]), false);
                if (IsFlag(arg, "-editor-mode")) editorMode = true;
                else if (IsFlag(arg, "-name") && i + 1 < args.Count && cloneName == null) cloneName = args[i + 1];
            }

            if (editorMode && cloneName != null)
            {
                string name = Sanitize(cloneName);
                if (name.Length > 0) return new InstanceProfile(name, true);
            }
            return new InstanceProfile("", false);
        }

        // Lowercase; keep [a-z0-9_-]; max 30 chars. Null/empty -> "".
        public static string Sanitize(string raw)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(raw)) return "";
            var sb = new StringBuilder(raw.Length);
            foreach (char c in raw.ToLowerInvariant())
            {
                bool keep = (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '_' || c == '-';
                if (!keep) continue;
                sb.Append(c);
                if (sb.Length == MaxNameLength) break;
            }
            return sb.ToString();
        }

        private static bool IsFlag(string arg, string flag)
        {
            return string.Equals(arg, flag, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.IO;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // Load order: main file -> FilePath + ".bak" -> defaults (warning logged when the backup or defaults were used
    // because the main file was bad). Writes go through AtomicFile. Never logs at error level (EditMode/PlayMode safe).
    public sealed class SettingsStore : ISettings
    {
        private SettingsData _current = new SettingsData();

        public SettingsStore(string filePath)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath)) throw new ArgumentException("filePath is required", nameof(filePath));
            FilePath = filePath;
        }

        public string FilePath { get; }
        public SettingsData Current => _current;
        public bool LoadedFromBackup { get; private set; }

        public event Action<SettingsData> Changed;

        public void Load()
        {
            LoadedFromBackup = false;
            string mainText = AtomicFile.ReadAllTextOrNull(FilePath);
            SettingsData loaded = TryParse(mainText);
            if (loaded == null)
            {
                string backupPath = FilePath + AtomicFile.BackupSuffix;
                loaded = TryParse(AtomicFile.ReadAllTextOrNull(backupPath));
                if (loaded != null)
                {
                    LoadedFromBackup = true;
                    Debug.LogWarning("Settings: main file missing or unreadable, loaded backup " + backupPath);
                }
                else if (mainText != null)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("Settings: " + FilePath + " is corrupt and no backup is readable, using defaults");
                }
                // else: first run (no file yet) -> defaults, nothing logged.
            }
            _current = loaded ?? new SettingsData();
            _current.Clamp();
        }

        public void NotifyChanged()
        {
            _current.Clamp();
            Action<SettingsData> handler = Changed;
            if (handler != null) handler(_current);
        }

        public void Save()
        {
            _current.Clamp();
            try
            {
                AtomicFile.WriteAllText(FilePath, JsonUtility.ToJson(_current, true));
            }
            catch (IOException ex)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("Settings: save failed for " + FilePath + ": " + ex.Message);
            }
            catch (UnauthorizedAccessException ex)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("Settings: save failed for " + FilePath + ": " + ex.Message);
            }
        }

        public string EnsureLocalPlayerId()
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_current.localPlayerId))
            {
                _current.localPlayerId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
                Save();
            }
            return _current.localPlayerId;
        }

        // persistentDataPath is shared by MPPM clones, so the per-instance suffix keeps their files apart.
        public static SettingsStore CreateForThisInstance()
        {
            var store = new SettingsStore(
                SettingsPaths.SettingsFile(Application.persistentDataPath, InstanceProfile.Current.Suffix));
            store.Load();
            return store;
        }

        private static SettingsData TryParse(string json)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(json)) return null;
            try
            {
                var data = new SettingsData();
                JsonUtility.FromJsonOverwrite(json, data);
                return data;
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                return null; // JsonUtility throws ArgumentException on malformed JSON
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class SfxRecipesTests
    {
        private const ulong Seed = 1234UL;

        private static float Peak(float[] samples)
        {
            float peak = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < samples.Length; i++)
            {
                float a = Math.Abs(samples[i]);
                if (a > peak) peak = a;
            }
            return peak;
        }

        [Test]
        public void SfxRecipes_M1Table_MatchesContract()
        {
            string[] ids =
            {
                SfxIds.UiClick, SfxIds.UiConfirm, SfxIds.UiError,
                SfxIds.WindAmbient, SfxIds.WaterLap, SfxIds.BellRing,
            };
            Assert.AreEqual(ids.Length, SfxRecipes.M1.Count);
            for (int i = 0; i < ids.Length; i++)
            {
                Assert.AreEqual(ids[i], SfxRecipes.M1[i].Id, "order at index " + i);
            }

            Assert.IsTrue(SfxRecipes.TryGet(SfxIds.UiClick, out SfxRecipe click));
            Assert.AreEqual(0.08f, click.LengthSeconds, 1e-6f);
            Assert.IsFalse(click.Loop);
            Assert.AreEqual(AudioCategory.Ui, click.Category);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.6f, click.BaseVolume, 1e-6f);
            Assert.IsFalse(click.Spatial);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.03f, click.MinInterval, 1e-6f);

            Assert.IsTrue(SfxRecipes.TryGet(SfxIds.WindAmbient, out SfxRecipe wind));
            Assert.AreEqual(6.0f, wind.LengthSeconds, 1e-6f);
            Assert.IsTrue(wind.Loop);
            Assert.AreEqual(AudioCategory.Ambience, wind.Category);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.5f, wind.BaseVolume, 1e-6f);
            Assert.IsFalse(wind.Spatial);

            Assert.IsTrue(SfxRecipes.TryGet(SfxIds.WaterLap, out SfxRecipe lap));
            Assert.AreEqual(0.4f, lap.LengthSeconds, 1e-6f);
            Assert.IsFalse(lap.Loop);
            Assert.AreEqual(AudioCategory.Ambience, lap.Category);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.3f, lap.MinInterval, 1e-6f);

            Assert.IsTrue(SfxRecipes.TryGet(SfxIds.BellRing, out SfxRecipe bell));
            Assert.AreEqual(1.0f, bell.LengthSeconds, 1e-6f);
            Assert.AreEqual(AudioCategory.Sfx, bell.Category);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.9f, bell.BaseVolume, 1e-6f);
            Assert.IsTrue(bell.Spatial);
            Assert.AreEqual(30f, bell.MaxDistance, 1e-6f);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.25f, bell.MinInterval, 1e-6f);

            Assert.IsFalse(SfxRecipes.TryGet("Not_A_Cue", out _));
        }

        [Test]
        public void SfxRecipes_EveryM1Recipe_HasCorrectSampleCount()
        {
            foreach (SfxRecipe recipe in SfxRecipes.M1)
            {
                float[] samples = SfxRecipes.Generate(recipe.Id, SfxRecipes.SampleRate, Seed);
                int expected = (int)Math.Round(recipe.LengthSeconds * SfxRecipes.SampleRate);
                Assert.AreEqual(expected, SfxRecipes.SampleCount(recipe, SfxRecipes.SampleRate), recipe.Id);
                Assert.AreEqual(expected, samples.Length, recipe.Id);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void SfxRecipes_EveryM1Recipe_PeakBelowOne()
        {
            foreach (SfxRecipe recipe in SfxRecipes.M1)
            {
                float peak = Peak(SfxRecipes.Generate(recipe.Id, SfxRecipes.SampleRate, Seed));
                Assert.Less(peak, 1.0f, recipe.Id);
                Assert.Greater(peak, 0.5f, recipe.Id + " is almost silent");
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void SfxRecipes_EveryM1Recipe_HasNoNaNOrInf()
        {
            foreach (SfxRecipe recipe in SfxRecipes.M1)
            {
                float[] samples = SfxRecipes.Generate(recipe.Id, SfxRecipes.SampleRate, Seed);
                int bad = -1;
                for (int i = 0; i < samples.Length; i++)
                {
                    if (float.IsNaN(samples[i]) || float.IsInfinity(samples[i]))
                    {
                        bad = i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Assert.AreEqual(-1, bad, recipe.Id + " has NaN or Inf at sample " + bad);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void SfxRecipes_Loops_HaveSmoothSeam()
        {
            int loops = 0;
            foreach (SfxRecipe recipe in SfxRecipes.M1)
            {
                if (!recipe.Loop) continue;
                loops++;
                float[] samples = SfxRecipes.Generate(recipe.Id, SfxRecipes.SampleRate, Seed);
                float seam = Math.Abs(samples[samples.Length - 1] - samples[0]);
                Assert.Less(seam, 0.05f, recipe.Id);
            }
            Assert.Greater(loops, 0, "at least one M1 recipe must be a loop");
        }

        [Test]
        public void SfxRecipes_SameSeed_IsDeterministic()
        {
            foreach (SfxRecipe recipe in SfxRecipes.M1)
            {
                float[] a = SfxRecipes.Generate(recipe.Id, SfxRecipes.SampleRate, Seed);
                float[] b = SfxRecipes.Generate(recipe.Id, SfxRecipes.SampleRate, Seed);
                Assert.AreEqual(a.Length, b.Length, recipe.Id);
                int firstDiff = -1;
                for (int i = 0; i < a.Length; i++)
                {
                    if (a[i] != b[i])
                    {
                        firstDiff = i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                Assert.AreEqual(-1, firstDiff, recipe.Id + " differs at sample " + firstDiff);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void SfxRecipes_UnknownId_ThrowsArgumentException()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => SfxRecipes.Generate("Not_A_Cue", SfxRecipes.SampleRate, Seed));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Spec 11.7: effective volume = cueBase * category^2 * master^2, settings are 0..100.
    public static class AudioMath
    {
        public const float PitchJitter = 0.07f, VolumeJitterDb = 1.5f;

        public static float EffectiveVolume(float cueBase, int categoryPercent, int masterPercent)
        {
            float c = Math.Clamp(categoryPercent, 0, 100) / 100f;
            float m = Math.Clamp(masterPercent, 0, 100) / 100f;
            return cueBase * c * c * m * m;
        }

        public static float DbToLinear(float db)
        {
            return (float)Math.Pow(10.0, db / 20.0);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Pure procedural audio (spec 11.7). No UnityEngine. Deterministic for a given (id, sampleRate, seed).
    // Loops are a whole number of base periods: the wind gain LFO completes exactly one cycle per loop.
    // Noise loops get a 20 ms crossfade, then a tiny linear seam correction so s[last] == s[0].
    // Every recipe is peak-normalized to 0.9.
    public static class SfxRecipes
    {
        public const int SampleRate = 44100;

        private const float TwoPi = 2f * MathF.PI;
        private const float PeakTarget = 0.9f;
        private const float CrossfadeSeconds = 0.02f;
        private const float ToneAttackSeconds = 0.003f;
        private const float ToneReleaseSeconds = 0.005f;
        private const float BellAttackSeconds = 0.002f;
        private const float BellReleaseSeconds = 0.02f;
        private const int NoiseWarmupSamples = 4096;
        private const float WindLowPass = 0.12f;   // one-pole coefficient, about 850 Hz at 44.1 kHz
        private const float WindLfoDepth = 0.225f; // gain swings between 0.55 and 1.0
        private const float LapLowPass = 0.06f;    // two cascaded one-pole stages
        private const float BellFundamentalHz = 660f;

        private static readonly float[] BellRatio = { 1f, 2.01f, 2.76f, 5.4f };
        private static readonly float[] BellAmp = { 1f, 0.5f, 0.3f, 0.15f };
        private static readonly float[] BellDecay = { 2.5f, 4f, 6f, 9f };

        private static readonly SfxRecipe[] M1Table =
        {
            new SfxRecipe(SfxIds.UiClick, 0.08f, false, AudioCategory.Ui, 0.6f, false, 0f, 0.03f),
            new SfxRecipe(SfxIds.UiConfirm, 0.08f, false, AudioCategory.Ui, 0.6f, false, 0f, 0.03f),
            new SfxRecipe(SfxIds.UiError, 0.08f, false, AudioCategory.Ui, 0.6f, false, 0f, 0.03f),
            new SfxRecipe(SfxIds.WindAmbient, 6.0f, true, AudioCategory.Ambience, 0.5f, false, 0f, 0f),
            new SfxRecipe(SfxIds.WaterLap, 0.4f, false, AudioCategory.Ambience, 0.5f, false, 0f, 0.3f),
            new SfxRecipe(SfxIds.BellRing, 1.0f, false, AudioCategory.Sfx, 0.9f, true, 30f, 0.25f),
        };

        private static readonly IReadOnlyList<SfxRecipe> M1ReadOnly = Array.AsReadOnly(M1Table);

        public static IReadOnlyList<SfxRecipe> M1 => M1ReadOnly;

        public static bool TryGet(string id, out SfxRecipe recipe)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < M1Table.Length; i++)
            {
                if (string.Equals(M1Table[i].Id, id, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    recipe = M1Table[i];
                    return true;
                }
            }
            recipe = default;
            return false;
        }

        public static int SampleCount(in SfxRecipe recipe, int sampleRate)
        {
            return (int)Math.Round(recipe.LengthSeconds * sampleRate);
        }

        public static float[] Generate(string id, int sampleRate, ulong seed)
        {
            if (!TryGet(id, out SfxRecipe recipe))
                throw new ArgumentException("Unknown SFX id: " + (id ?? "<null>"), nameof(id));
            if (sampleRate <= 0)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(sampleRate), sampleRate, "Sample rate must be positive.");

            int n = SampleCount(recipe, sampleRate);
            if (n < 2)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(sampleRate), sampleRate, "Sample rate too low for recipe " + id + ".");

            Pcg32 rng = Rng.Stream(seed, "sfx." + id, 0UL);
            float[] samples;
            switch (id)
            {
                case SfxIds.UiClick: samples = Tone(n, sampleRate, 1400f, 2100f, 60f); break;
                case SfxIds.UiConfirm: samples = Tone(n, sampleRate, 880f, 1320f, 30f); break;
                case SfxIds.UiError: samples = Tone(n, sampleRate, 220f, 233f, 20f); break;
                case SfxIds.WindAmbient: samples = WindLoop(n, sampleRate, ref rng); break;
                case SfxIds.WaterLap: samples = LapBurst(n, ref rng); break;
                case SfxIds.BellRing: samples = Bell(n, sampleRate); break;
                default: throw new ArgumentException("No generator for SFX id: " + id, nameof(id));
            }

            NormalizePeak(samples, PeakTarget);
            return samples;
        }

        // Sine pair with a 3 ms attack, exponential decay and a 5 ms release to zero (no click at the end).
        private static float[] Tone(int n, int sampleRate, float f1, float f2, float decayPerSecond)
        {
            var o = new float[n];
            float releaseSamples = MathF.Max(1f, ToneReleaseSeconds * sampleRate);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                float t = i / (float)sampleRate;
                float attack = MathF.Min(1f, t / ToneAttackSeconds);
                float release = MathF.Min(1f, (n - 1 - i) / releaseSamples);
                float env = attack * release * MathF.Exp(-decayPerSecond * t);
                o[i] = (MathF.Sin(TwoPi * f1 * t) + 0.6f * MathF.Sin(TwoPi * f2 * t)) * env;
            }
            return o;
        }

        // Pink noise (Paul Kellet's economy filter), one-pole low-passed, with a gain LFO of exactly one cycle per loop.
        // The tail (n .. n+xf) is crossfaded into the head, so o[n-1] -> o[0] continues the same noise stream.
        private static float[] WindLoop(int n, int sampleRate, ref Pcg32 rng)
        {
            int xf = Math.Min(n / 2, Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Round(CrossfadeSeconds * sampleRate)));
            int total = n + xf;
            var noise = new float[total];
            float b0 = 0f, b1 = 0f, b2 = 0f, lp = 0f;
            for (int k = -NoiseWarmupSamples; k < total; k++)
            {
                float white = rng.NextFloat() * 2f - 1f;
                b0 = 0.99765f * b0 + white * 0.0990460f;
                b1 = 0.96300f * b1 + white * 0.2965164f;
                b2 = 0.57000f * b2 + white * 1.0526913f;
                float pink = b0 + b1 + b2 + white * 0.1848f;
                lp += WindLowPass * (pink - lp);
                if (k >= 0) noise[k] = lp;
            }

            for (int k = 0; k < total; k++)
            {
                float lfo = 1f - WindLfoDepth + WindLfoDepth * MathF.Sin(TwoPi * k / n);
                noise[k] *= lfo;
            }

            var o = new float[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                if (i < xf)
                {
                    float w = i / (float)xf;
                    o[i] = noise[i] * w + noise[n + i] * (1f - w);
                }
                else
                {
                    o[i] = noise[i];
                }
            }

            float d = o[n - 1] - o[0];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                o[i] -= d * (i / (float)(n - 1));
            }
            return o;
        }

        // Two-pole low-passed white noise with a sin^2 envelope (zero at both ends).
        private static float[] LapBurst(int n, ref Pcg32 rng)
        {
            var o = new float[n];
            float lp1 = 0f, lp2 = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                float white = rng.NextFloat() * 2f - 1f;
                lp1 += LapLowPass * (white - lp1);
                lp2 += LapLowPass * (lp1 - lp2);
                float env = MathF.Sin(MathF.PI * i / (n - 1));
                o[i] = lp2 * env * env;
            }
            return o;
        }

        // Struck-bell sine partials with per-partial exponential decay, 2 ms attack, 20 ms release to zero.
        private static float[] Bell(int n, int sampleRate)
        {
            var o = new float[n];
            float releaseSamples = MathF.Max(1f, BellReleaseSeconds * sampleRate);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                float t = i / (float)sampleRate;
                float attack = MathF.Min(1f, t / BellAttackSeconds);
                float release = MathF.Min(1f, (n - 1 - i) / releaseSamples);
                float sum = 0f;
                for (int k = 0; k < BellRatio.Length; k++)
                {
                    sum += BellAmp[k] * MathF.Sin(TwoPi * BellFundamentalHz * BellRatio[k] * t) * MathF.Exp(-BellDecay[k] * t);
                }
                o[i] = sum * attack * release;
            }
            return o;
        }

        private static void NormalizePeak(float[] s, float target)
        {
            float peak = 0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < s.Length; i++)
            {
                float a = MathF.Abs(s[i]);
                if (a > peak) peak = a;
            }
            if (peak <= 1e-9f) return;
            float g = target / peak;
            for (int i = 0; i < s.Length; i++)
            {
                s[i] *= g;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // Authority: none. Client-side presentation audio, generated locally at Bootstrap (AppBootstrap calls GenerateAll once) and cached.
    // Never networked. A recipe that fails to generate is skipped with a warning; its cue then stays silent (spec 11.7).
    public sealed class SfxGenerator
    {
        private readonly int _sampleRate;
        private readonly Dictionary<string, AudioClip> _clips = new Dictionary<string, AudioClip>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

        public SfxGenerator(int sampleRate = SfxRecipes.SampleRate)
        {
            if (sampleRate <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(sampleRate), sampleRate, "Sample rate must be positive.");
            _sampleRate = sampleRate;
        }

        public void GenerateAll(ulong seed)
        {
            IReadOnlyList<SfxRecipe> recipes = SfxRecipes.M1;
            for (int i = 0; i < recipes.Count; i++)
            {
                SfxRecipe recipe = recipes[i];
                try
                {
                    int n = SfxRecipes.SampleCount(recipe, _sampleRate);
                    float[] data = SfxRecipes.Generate(recipe.Id, _sampleRate, seed);
                    if (data.Length != n)
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"SFX '{recipe.Id}' produced {data.Length} samples, expected {n}; staying silent.");
                        continue;
                    }

                    AudioClip clip = AudioClip.Create(recipe.Id, n, 1, _sampleRate, false);
                    if (!clip.SetData(data, 0))
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning($"SFX '{recipe.Id}' SetData failed; staying silent.");
                        continue;
                    }
                    _clips[recipe.Id] = clip;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"SFX '{recipe.Id}' failed to generate; staying silent. {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
                }
            }
        }

        public bool TryGetClip(string id, out AudioClip clip)
        {
            if (id != null && _clips.TryGetValue(id, out clip) && clip != null) return true;
            clip = null;
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // Authority: none. Client-side presentation audio only; never networked. Lives on the App root (Bootstrap, DontDestroyOnLoad).
    // Volume = cueBase * category^2 * master^2 (AudioMath.EffectiveVolume, settings 0..100); re-applied on ISettings.Changed.
    // Per play: pitch +/-7 %, volume +/-1.5 dB (Pcg32); rate limit per id by the recipe MinInterval; missing clip -> warning, silent.
    // Ducking and SfxCueTableDef (spec 11.7) are later milestones; M1 cue data comes from SfxRecipes.M1.
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    public sealed class AudioBus : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private const int PoolSize = 8;
        private const float DefaultMaxDistance = 30f;

        private struct Entry
        {
            public AudioCategory Category;
            public float CueBase;
        }

        private readonly Dictionary<AudioSource, Entry> _entries = new Dictionary<AudioSource, Entry>();
        private readonly List<AudioSource> _dead = new List<AudioSource>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, float> _lastPlayed = new Dictionary<string, float>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        private SfxGenerator _generator;
        private ISettings _settings;
        private AudioSource[] _pool;
        private int _poolCursor;
        private Pcg32 _jitter;

        internal bool IsReady => _generator != null && _pool != null;

        public void Initialize(SfxGenerator generator, ISettings settings)
        {
            if (generator == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(generator));
            if (settings == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(settings));
            if (_settings != null) _settings.Changed -= OnSettingsChanged;
            _generator = generator;
            _settings = settings;
            _settings.Changed += OnSettingsChanged;
            _jitter = Rng.Stream(0UL, "audio.jitter", 0UL);
            BuildPool();
            ApplyVolumes();
        }

        public void Register(AudioSource source, AudioCategory category, float cueBase)
        {
            if (source == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(source));
            _entries[source] = new Entry { Category = category, CueBase = cueBase };
            source.volume = AudioMath.EffectiveVolume(cueBase, CategoryPercent(category), MasterPercent());
        }

        public void Unregister(AudioSource source)
        {
            if ((object)source != null) _entries.Remove(source);
        }

        public void PlayUi(string sfxId)
        {
            Play2D(sfxId, AudioCategory.Ui);
        }

        public void Play2D(string sfxId, AudioCategory category)
        {
            if (!TryPrepare(sfxId, out SfxRecipe recipe, out AudioClip clip)) return;
            Play(clip, recipe, category, false, Vector3.zero);
        }

        public void PlayAt(string sfxId, Vector3 position)
        {
            if (!TryPrepare(sfxId, out SfxRecipe recipe, out AudioClip clip)) return;
            Play(clip, recipe, recipe.Category, true, position);
        }

        public void ApplyVolumes()
        {
            int master = MasterPercent();
            _dead.Clear();
            foreach (KeyValuePair<AudioSource, Entry> pair in _entries)
            {
                if (pair.Key == null)
                {
                    _dead.Add(pair.Key);
                    continue;
                }
                pair.Key.volume = AudioMath.EffectiveVolume(pair.Value.CueBase, CategoryPercent(pair.Value.Category), master);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < _dead.Count; i++)
            {
                _entries.Remove(_dead[i]);
            }
            _dead.Clear();
        }

        internal bool TryGetClip(string sfxId, out AudioClip clip)
        {
            clip = null;
            return _generator != null && _generator.TryGetClip(sfxId, out clip);
        }

        private void OnSettingsChanged(SettingsData _)
        {
            ApplyVolumes();
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            if (_settings != null) _settings.Changed -= OnSettingsChanged;
        }

        private void BuildPool()
        {
            if (_pool != null) return;
            _pool = new AudioSource[PoolSize];
            for (int i = 0; i < PoolSize; i++)
            {
                var go = new GameObject("SfxSource" + i);
                go.transform.SetParent(transform, false);
                AudioSource src = go.AddComponent<AudioSource>();
                src.playOnAwake = false;
                src.loop = false;
                src.rolloffMode = AudioRolloffMode.Logarithmic;
                src.minDistance = 1f;
                src.maxDistance = DefaultMaxDistance;
                src.dopplerLevel = 0f;
                src.spatialBlend = 0f;
                _pool[i] = src;
            }
        }

        // Round-robin; prefers an idle source. When all 8 are busy the oldest-in-order one is cut.
        private AudioSource AcquireSource()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _pool.Length; i++)
            {
                int idx = (_poolCursor + i) % _pool.Length;
                if (!_pool[idx].isPlaying)
                {
                    _poolCursor = (idx + 1) % _pool.Length;
                    return _pool[idx];
                }
            }
            AudioSource reuse = _pool[_poolCursor];
            _poolCursor = (_poolCursor + 1) % _pool.Length;
            return reuse;
        }

        private bool TryPrepare(string sfxId, out SfxRecipe recipe, out AudioClip clip)
        {
            recipe = default;
            clip = null;
            if (!IsReady)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"AudioBus not initialized; '{sfxId}' stays silent.");
                return false;
            }
            if (!SfxRecipes.TryGet(sfxId, out recipe))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"Unknown SFX id '{sfxId}'; staying silent.");
                return false;
            }
            if (!TryGetClip(sfxId, out clip))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"SFX clip '{sfxId}' is missing; staying silent.");
                return false;
            }
            return AllowPlay(recipe);
        }

        private bool AllowPlay(SfxRecipe recipe)
        {
            float now = Time.unscaledTime;
            if (_lastPlayed.TryGetValue(recipe.Id, out float last) && now - last < recipe.MinInterval) return false;
            _lastPlayed[recipe.Id] = now;
            return true;
        }

        private void Play(AudioClip clip, SfxRecipe recipe, AudioCategory category, bool spatial, Vector3 position)
        {
            AudioSource src = AcquireSource();
            src.Stop();
            src.clip = clip;
            src.loop = false;
            src.spatialBlend = spatial ? 1f : 0f;
            src.maxDistance = recipe.MaxDistance > 0f ? recipe.MaxDistance : DefaultMaxDistance;
            src.transform.position = position;
            src.pitch = 1f + SignedUnit() * AudioMath.PitchJitter;
            float jitterGain = AudioMath.DbToLinear(SignedUnit() * AudioMath.VolumeJitterDb);
            Register(src, category, recipe.BaseVolume * jitterGain);
            src.Play();
        }

        private float SignedUnit()
        {
            return _jitter.NextFloat() * 2f - 1f;
        }

        private int CategoryPercent(AudioCategory category)
        {
            if (_settings == null) return 100;
            SettingsData d = _settings.Current;
            switch (category)
            {
                case AudioCategory.Sfx: return d.sfxVolume;
                case AudioCategory.Ambience: return d.ambienceVolume;
                case AudioCategory.Music: return d.musicVolume;
                case AudioCategory.Ui: return d.uiVolume;
                case AudioCategory.Voice: return d.voiceVolume;
                default: return 100;
            }
        }

        private int MasterPercent()
        {
            return _settings == null ? 100 : _settings.Current.masterVolume;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using FishGame.Core;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // Authority: none. Client-side scene ambience on the Spot_LakeDock root "Ambience"; every peer runs its own copy. Never networked.
    // Wind_Ambient loop plus a Water_Lap every 0.6-1.4 s, both through AudioBus (category Ambience).
    // Disables itself (with a warning) if ServiceRoots.App or an initialized AudioBus is missing, e.g. when the scene is opened alone.
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    public sealed class AmbienceBed : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private const float MinLapInterval = 0.6f;
        private const float MaxLapInterval = 1.4f;

        private AudioBus _bus;
        private AudioSource _wind;
        private Pcg32 _rng;
        private float _nextLapIn;

        private void Start()
        {
            ServiceRegistry app = ServiceRoots.App;
            if (app == null)
            {
                Disable("ServiceRoots.App is null");
                return;
            }
            if (!app.TryGet<AudioBus>(out AudioBus bus) || bus == null || !bus.IsReady)
            {
                Disable("AudioBus is missing or not initialized");
                return;
            }

            _bus = bus;
            _rng = Rng.Stream(0UL, "ambience.bed", 0UL);
            _nextLapIn = NextLapDelay();

            if (SfxRecipes.TryGet(SfxIds.WindAmbient, out SfxRecipe windRecipe)
                && _bus.TryGetClip(SfxIds.WindAmbient, out AudioClip windClip))
            {
                var windGo = new GameObject("Wind");
                windGo.transform.SetParent(transform, false);
                _wind = windGo.AddComponent<AudioSource>();
                _wind.playOnAwake = false;
                _wind.loop = true;
                _wind.spatialBlend = 0f;
                _wind.dopplerLevel = 0f;
                _wind.clip = windClip;
                _bus.Register(_wind, AudioCategory.Ambience, windRecipe.BaseVolume);
                _wind.Play();
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("AmbienceBed: Wind_Ambient clip missing; wind stays silent.");
            }
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            if (_wind != null) _wind.UnPause();
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            if (_wind != null) _wind.Pause();
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (_bus == null) return;
            _nextLapIn -= Time.deltaTime;
            if (_nextLapIn > 0f) return;
            _bus.Play2D(SfxIds.WaterLap, AudioCategory.Ambience);
            _nextLapIn = NextLapDelay();
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            if (_bus != null && (object)_wind != null) _bus.Unregister(_wind);
        }

        private float NextLapDelay()
        {
            return _rng.Range(MinLapInterval, MaxLapInterval);
        }

        private void Disable(string reason)
        {
            Debug.LogWarning($"AmbienceBed disabled: {reason}.");
            enabled = false;
        }
    }
}
```

#### Notes for the implementer

- **Why the wind seam passes:** the crossfade makes `o[0]` the sample that follows `o[n-1]` in the same noise stream, and the linear correction then removes the remaining one-sample step, so `|s[last] − s[0]|` is about 1e-7. The correction offset `d` (one sample-to-sample step of the filtered noise) can be a noticeable fraction of the signal; it is inaudible because it is spread as a linear ramp over 264,600 samples, not because it is small. A large-looking `d` while debugging is normal. Peak normalization is applied last and keeps the seam at zero.
- **Determinism:** only `Wind_Ambient` and `Water_Lap` use the seed (via `Rng.Stream(seed, "sfx." + id, 0)`). The tones and the bell are seed-independent. Equality in `SfxRecipes_SameSeed_IsDeterministic` is exact, on purpose.
- **AudioBus jitter seed:** fixed (`Rng.Stream(0, "audio.jitter", 0)`). Jitter is presentation only, so identical sequences on different peers do not matter.
- **Pooled volume:** the ±1.5 dB jitter is folded into the registered `cueBase`, so `ApplyVolumes` (on a settings change) keeps it.
- **`PlayAt` with a 2D recipe:** it still plays 3D with `maxDistance` 30 m (spec default), because `MaxDistance` is 0 for 2D recipes.
- **Ambience lookup:** `AmbienceBed` finds the bus through `ServiceRoots.App.TryGet<AudioBus>` (AppBootstrap registers it, contract §7.14), not through `FindObjectOfType`-style scene searches.
- **Spec wording:** spec 11.7 writes `Generate(RecipeParams, sampleRate, seed)`. The contract (binding) uses `Generate(string id, int sampleRate, ulong seed)`; follow the contract.

### Task 7: Data: ContentRegistry with ordinal-sorted ushort indices + ContentHash over registry

**Goal:** Stable lowercase snake_case content ids get `ushort` indices from an ordinal sort (`StringComparer.Ordinal`), per category, so host and clients agree (spec 4.5). `ContentRegistry` builds those indices and computes the `ContentHash` that is sent in the connect payload.
