**Behaviour rules.** The contract leaves these open, so this task decides them:
- **`RegistryIndex`**
  - An empty collection is allowed (Count 0).
  - These throw exactly `ArgumentException`, never a subclass: a null collection, a null or empty id, a duplicate id (compared ordinally), or more than 65535 ids.
  - Exactly 65535 ids is allowed, giving indices 0..65534.
  - Ids are sorted with `StringComparer.Ordinal`. Index = position in that sort.
  - `SortedIds` is a `ReadOnlyCollection<string>`, so callers cannot change the order.
  - `IndexOf` on an unknown or null id throws `KeyNotFoundException`.
  - `TryGetIndex` on an unknown or null id returns false with `index = 0`.
  - `IdAt` out of range throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`.
- **`ContentIds.IsValidId`** matches `^[a-z0-9]+(_[a-z0-9]+)*$`. Null and empty return false. It is a hand-written character scan, with no `Regex` and no allocation.
- **`ContentRegistry.Configure`**
  - Throws `ArgumentNullException` for a null `spots`.
  - Otherwise copies the enumerable into a new list, so later changes to the caller's collection do not leak in, and clears the cached index and lookup.
- **`ContentRegistry.Validate`** returns one message per problem, in list order. Exact formats, where `i` is the list index:
  - `spots[i] is null.`
  - `spots[i] has invalid id '<id>'.` If an entry has an invalid id, it is not also checked for duplicates.
  - `spots[i] duplicate id '<id>'.` This is reported on the second and every later occurrence.
- **`ContentRegistry.Build`**
  - Always rebuilds.
  - Calls `Validate()` first and throws `InvalidOperationException("ContentRegistry is invalid: " + string.Join("; ", errors))` if there are any errors.
  - Only then does it construct `RegistryIndex`, so a bad registry never surfaces as `ArgumentException`.
- **Lazy build.** `SpotIndex`, `SpotAt`, `TryGetSpot` and `ComputeContentHash` call `Build()` when the cache is null. So they throw `InvalidOperationException` on invalid data.
  - `SpotIndex` on an unknown id throws `KeyNotFoundException`.
  - `SpotAt` out of range throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`.
  - `TryGetSpot(null, ...)` returns false.
- **`ComputeContentHash`** = `ContentHash.Compute(new[] { new ContentCategoryIds(CategorySpots, spotsIndex.SortedIds) }, dataVersion)`.
- **Cache fields** are private and marked `[NonSerialized]`. Do not add `OnValidate` or any other cache-invalidation hook. Changing a `SpotDef` id after `Build()` is not tracked. Callers call `Configure` or `Build` again.
- **C# compatibility.** Unity 6 compiles C# 9. Use no collection expressions (`[...]`), no primary constructors, and no `required` members.
- **Tests: no bare `Object`.** With both `using System;` and `using UnityEngine;`, a bare `Object` is ambiguous (CS0104). Always write `UnityEngine.Object`.

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class RegistryIndexTests
    {
        // Ordinal order compares UTF-16 code units: 'Z' = 90 < '_' = 95 < 'a' = 97 < 'l' = 108.
        // So the expected order is "Zeta", "a_b", "alpha", "lake", "lake_dock".
        // A culture-aware sort orders "alpha" before "Zeta" (case-insensitive first pass), so this fails if the sort is culture-based.
        [Test]
        public void Registry_Index_IsOrdinalSortedAndStable()
        {
            var expected = new[] { "Zeta", "a_b", "alpha", "lake", "lake_dock" };
            var forward = new RegistryIndex(new[] { "lake_dock", "alpha", "Zeta", "a_b", "lake" });
            var reversed = new RegistryIndex(new[] { "lake", "a_b", "Zeta", "alpha", "lake_dock" });

            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(expected, forward.SortedIds);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(expected, reversed.SortedIds);
            Assert.AreEqual(5, forward.Count);
            for (int i = 0; i < expected.Length; i++)
            {
                Assert.AreEqual((ushort)i, forward.IndexOf(expected[i]));
                Assert.AreEqual((ushort)i, reversed.IndexOf(expected[i]));
                Assert.AreEqual(expected[i], forward.IdAt((ushort)i));
                Assert.IsTrue(reversed.TryGetIndex(expected[i], out ushort tryIndex));
                Assert.AreEqual((ushort)i, tryIndex);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void RegistryIndex_Duplicate_Throws()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new RegistryIndex(new[] { "lake_dock", "lake_dock" }));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new RegistryIndex(new[] { "b", "a", "b" }));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RegistryIndex_NullOrEmpty_Throws()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new RegistryIndex(new[] { "ok", "" }));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new RegistryIndex(new string[] { null }));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new RegistryIndex(null));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RegistryIndex_UnknownId_Throws_AndTryGetFalse()
        {
            var index = new RegistryIndex(new[] { "lake_dock" });
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => index.IndexOf("missing"));
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => index.IndexOf(null));
            Assert.IsFalse(index.TryGetIndex("missing", out _));
            Assert.IsFalse(index.TryGetIndex(null, out _));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => index.IdAt((ushort)1));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RegistryIndex_EmptyCollection_HasZeroCount()
        {
            var index = new RegistryIndex(new string[0]);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, index.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, index.SortedIds.Count);
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => index.IdAt((ushort)0));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RegistryIndex_CountLimit_Is65535()
        {
            var max = new List<string>(65535);
            for (int i = 0; i < 65535; i++)
            {
                max.Add("id" + i.ToString("D5"));
            }

            var index = new RegistryIndex(max);
            Assert.AreEqual(65535, index.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual("id65534", index.IdAt((ushort)65534));

            max.Add("id65535");
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new RegistryIndex(max));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    public class ContentRegistryTests

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown()
        {

            {
                if (o != null)

                }
            }
            created.Clear();
        }

        private SpotDef MakeSpot(string id, string displayName = "Name")

            created.Add(spot);
            spot.Configure(id, displayName, "Spot_" + id);
            return spot;
        }

        private ContentRegistry MakeRegistry(int dataVersion, params SpotDef[] spots)
        {
            ContentRegistry reg = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<ContentRegistry>();
            created.Add(reg);
            reg.Configure(dataVersion, spots);
            return reg;
        }

        [Test]
        public void ContentRegistry_Hash_StableAcrossInstances()
        {
            SpotDef lake = MakeSpot(ContentIds.LakeDock, "Lake Dock");
            SpotDef pond = MakeSpot("pond_north", "Pond North");
            ContentRegistry a = MakeRegistry(1, lake, pond);
            ContentRegistry b = MakeRegistry(1, pond, lake);

            ulong hashA = a.ComputeContentHash();
            ulong hashB = b.ComputeContentHash();
            Assert.AreEqual(hashA, hashB);
            Assert.AreEqual(hashA, a.ComputeContentHash());

            // Independent expected value. Sorted ids: "lake_dock" < "pond_north" ('l' < 'p').
            ulong expected = ContentHash.Compute(
                new[] { new ContentCategoryIds(ContentRegistry.CategorySpots, new[] { "lake_dock", "pond_north" }) },
                1);
            Assert.AreEqual(expected, hashA);
            Assert.AreNotEqual(expected, MakeRegistry(2, lake, pond).ComputeContentHash());
        }

        [Test]
        public void ContentRegistry_Validate_FlagsBadIds()
        {
            SpotDef bad = MakeSpot("Bad Id");
            SpotDef good = MakeSpot("ok_spot");
            SpotDef dup = MakeSpot("ok_spot");
            ContentRegistry reg = MakeRegistry(1, bad, good, dup, null);

            IReadOnlyList<string> errors = reg.Validate();

            Assert.AreEqual(3, errors.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual("spots[0] has invalid id 'Bad Id'.", errors[0]);
            Assert.AreEqual("spots[2] duplicate id 'ok_spot'.", errors[1]);
            Assert.AreEqual("spots[3] is null.", errors[2]);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, MakeRegistry(1, good).Validate().Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ContentRegistry_Build_InvalidData_Throws()
        {
            ContentRegistry reg = MakeRegistry(1, MakeSpot("Bad Id"));
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => reg.Build());
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => reg.ComputeContentHash());

            ContentRegistry dupReg = MakeRegistry(1, MakeSpot("same_id"), MakeSpot("same_id"));
            InvalidOperationException ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => dupReg.Build());
            StringAssert.Contains("duplicate id 'same_id'", ex.Message);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ContentRegistry_SpotAt_RoundTripsSpotIndex()
        {
            SpotDef lake = MakeSpot(ContentIds.LakeDock, "Lake Dock");
            SpotDef pond = MakeSpot("pond_north", "Pond North");
            ContentRegistry reg = MakeRegistry(1, pond, lake);

            // Sorted order: "lake_dock" (index 0), "pond_north" (index 1).
            Assert.AreEqual((ushort)0, reg.SpotIndex("lake_dock"));
            Assert.AreEqual((ushort)1, reg.SpotIndex("pond_north"));
            Assert.AreSame(lake, reg.SpotAt((ushort)0));
            Assert.AreSame(pond, reg.SpotAt((ushort)1));
            Assert.IsTrue(reg.TryGetSpot("lake_dock", out SpotDef found));
            Assert.AreSame(lake, found);
            Assert.IsFalse(reg.TryGetSpot("missing", out _));
            Assert.IsFalse(reg.TryGetSpot(null, out _));
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => reg.SpotIndex("missing"));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => reg.SpotAt((ushort)2));
            Assert.AreEqual(2, reg.Spots.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, reg.DataVersion);
            Assert.AreEqual("Lake Dock", lake.DisplayName);
            Assert.AreEqual("Spot_lake_dock", lake.SceneName);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ContentRegistry_Configure_ResetsCachedIndex()
        {
            SpotDef pond = MakeSpot("pond_north");
            ContentRegistry reg = MakeRegistry(1, pond);
            Assert.AreEqual((ushort)0, reg.SpotIndex("pond_north"));
            ulong before = reg.ComputeContentHash();

            reg.Configure(1, new[] { pond, lake });

            Assert.AreEqual((ushort)0, reg.SpotIndex("lake_dock"));
            Assert.AreEqual((ushort)1, reg.SpotIndex("pond_north"));
            Assert.AreNotEqual(before, reg.ComputeContentHash());
        }
    }
}
```

Create `Assets/_Project/Core/Content/ContentIds.cs` with exactly this content:

```csharp
namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Stable lowercase snake_case content ids. They are save and network keys (spec 4.5).
    public static class ContentIds
    {
        public const string LakeDock = "lake_dock";

        // Matches ^[a-z0-9]+(_[a-z0-9]+)*$ with an allocation-free character scan.
        public static bool IsValidId(string id)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
            {
                return false;
            }

            bool previousUnderscore = true; // true at the start, so a leading '_' is rejected
            for (int i = 0; i < id.Length; i++)
            {
                char c = id[i];
                if (c == '_')
                {
                    if (previousUnderscore)
                    {
                        return false; // leading or doubled underscore
                    }
                    previousUnderscore = true;
                }
                else if ((c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9'))
                {
                    previousUnderscore = false;
                }
                else
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            return !previousUnderscore; // rejects a trailing underscore
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Maps stable string ids to ushort indices for one content category.
    // Indices follow the ordinal sort (StringComparer.Ordinal), so host and clients agree (spec 4.5). Pure C#.
    public sealed class RegistryIndex
    {
        private const int MaxCount = 65535;

        private readonly string[] sortedIds;
        private readonly ReadOnlyCollection<string> sortedIdsView;
        private readonly Dictionary<string, ushort> indexById;

        public RegistryIndex(IEnumerable<string> ids)
        {
            if (ids == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("ids must not be null.", nameof(ids));
            }

            var list = new List<string>(ids);
            if (list.Count > MaxCount)
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("Too many ids: " + list.Count + " (max " + MaxCount + ").", nameof(ids));
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(list[i]))
                {
                    throw new ArgumentException("Ids must be non-null and non-empty (position " + i + ").", nameof(ids));
                }
            }

            list.Sort(StringComparer.Ordinal);

            indexById = new Dictionary<string, ushort>(list.Count, StringComparer.Ordinal);
            for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
            {
                if (i > 0 && string.Equals(list[i], list[i - 1], StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    throw new ArgumentException("Duplicate id: " + list[i], nameof(ids));
                }
                indexById.Add(list[i], (ushort)i);
            }

            sortedIds = list.ToArray();
            sortedIdsView = new ReadOnlyCollection<string>(sortedIds);
        }

        public int Count => sortedIds.Length;

        public IReadOnlyList<string> SortedIds => sortedIdsView;

        public ushort IndexOf(string id)
        {
            if (!TryGetIndex(id, out ushort index))
            {
                throw new KeyNotFoundException("Unknown id: " + (id ?? "<null>"));
            }
            return index;
        }

        public bool TryGetIndex(string id, out ushort index)
        {
            if (id == null)
            {
                index = 0;
                return false;
            }
            return indexById.TryGetValue(id, out index);
        }

        public string IdAt(ushort index)
        {
            if (index >= sortedIds.Length)
            {
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(index), index,
                    "Index " + index + " is outside the registry (count " + sortedIds.Length + ").");
            }
            return sortedIds[index];
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Data
{
    // Content data only (not networked). Host and clients build the same ordinal indices from the same ids,
    // and the ContentHash over those ids goes in the connect payload.
    // M1 holds one category (spots). Later milestones add categories.
    // Changing a SpotDef's id after Build() is not tracked; call Configure or Build again.
    public sealed class ContentRegistry : ScriptableObject
    {
        public const string CategorySpots = "spots";

        [SerializeField] private int dataVersion = 1;
        [SerializeField] private List<SpotDef> spots = new List<SpotDef>();

        // Cache: never serialized. Build() rebuilds it; Configure() clears it.
        [NonSerialized] private RegistryIndex spotsIndex;
        [NonSerialized] private Dictionary<string, SpotDef> spotsById;

        public int DataVersion => dataVersion;

        public IReadOnlyList<SpotDef> Spots => spots;

        // Used by the T15 ContentBuilder and by tests.
        public void Configure(int dataVersion, IEnumerable<SpotDef> spots)
        {
            if (spots == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(spots));
            }

            this.dataVersion = dataVersion;
            this.spots = new List<SpotDef>(spots);
            spotsIndex = null;
            spotsById = null;
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<string> Validate()
        {
            var errors = new List<string>();
            var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            for (int i = 0; i < spots.Count; i++)
            {
                SpotDef def = spots[i];
                if (def == null)
                {
                    errors.Add("spots[" + i + "] is null.");
                    continue;
                }

                if (!ContentIds.IsValidId(def.Id))
                {
                    errors.Add("spots[" + i + "] has invalid id '" + def.Id + "'.");
                    continue;
                }

                if (!seen.Add(def.Id))
                {
                    errors.Add("spots[" + i + "] duplicate id '" + def.Id + "'.");
                }
            }
            return errors;
        }

        public void Build()
        {
            IReadOnlyList<string> errors = Validate();
            if (errors.Count > 0)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("ContentRegistry is invalid: " + string.Join("; ", errors));
            }

            var ids = new List<string>(spots.Count);
            var byId = new Dictionary<string, SpotDef>(spots.Count, StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (SpotDef def in spots)
            {
                ids.Add(def.Id);
                byId.Add(def.Id, def);
            }

            spotsIndex = new RegistryIndex(ids);
            spotsById = byId;
        }

        public ushort SpotIndex(string id)
        {
            EnsureBuilt();
            return spotsIndex.IndexOf(id);
        }

        public SpotDef SpotAt(ushort index)
        {
            EnsureBuilt();
            return spotsById[spotsIndex.IdAt(index)];
        }

        public bool TryGetSpot(string id, out SpotDef def)
        {
            EnsureBuilt();
            if (id == null)
            {
                def = null;
                return false;
            }
            return spotsById.TryGetValue(id, out def);
        }

        public ulong ComputeContentHash()
        {
            EnsureBuilt();
            return ContentHash.Compute(
                new[] { new ContentCategoryIds(CategorySpots, spotsIndex.SortedIds) },
                dataVersion);
        }

        private void EnsureBuilt()
        {
            if (spotsIndex == null)
            {
                Build();
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 8: Networking: INetworkSession (Runtime), LocalNetworkSession (solo + dev-direct), ConnectionApprover

**Goal:** Build the one network seam the UI and App use (`INetworkSession`) and the approval-to-roster handoff (`JoinApprovalBridge` + `IJoinContextProvider`). Add the NGO approval callback (`ConnectionApprover`, which delegates every decision to Core `JoinRules`), the local session (`LocalNetworkSession`: Solo on 127.0.0.1 with plain UnityTransport, plus the dev-direct host and join methods), and the router (`CompositeNetworkSession`). Solo and dev-direct never touch UGS. The online backend is T9's. This task only takes a factory for it.

**Owner area:** `net`. Spec 6.1–6.6, 6.9, 6.10, and contract §7.8 / §9 / §13 (D3, D4, D7, D8, D22, D23, D37, D38).

    - Starting: `StartHost()` and `StartClient()` return bool. On a transport start failure, NGO resets roles and runs its internal shutdown synchronously, so neither stop callback fires. `Shutdown()` only sets `ShutdownInProgress`; the real shutdown runs in a later frame. `IsListening`, `IsServer`, `IsClient`, `LocalClientId`, `const ulong ServerClientId = 0`.
    - `DisconnectReason`: this is the server's reason string if one was sent. Otherwise it is generated text that starts with `[Disconnect Event]`. It is still readable inside `OnClientStopped`.
    - Events: `event Action<NetworkManager, ConnectionEventData> OnConnectionEvent`, `event Action<bool> OnClientStopped`, `event Action<bool> OnServerStopped`, `event Action OnServerStarted` (raised synchronously inside `StartHost`, after host self-approval).
    - Approval: `Action<ConnectionApprovalRequest, ConnectionApprovalResponse> ConnectionApprovalCallback`. Assign it and set it to null freely; a multicast delegate throws. The callback runs on the server for every remote client, and for the host's own client inside `StartHost` (where the host cannot be refused).
    - Config: `NetworkConfig` (field). `NetworkConfig.ProtocolVersion` (ushort), `ConnectionApproval` (bool, part of NGO's config hash, so the client must set it too), `ConnectionData` (byte[]), `NetworkTransport`.
  - Nested approval types: `NetworkManager.ConnectionApprovalRequest` (struct: `byte[] Payload`, `ulong ClientNetworkId`) and `NetworkManager.ConnectionApprovalResponse` (class: `Approved`, `CreatePlayerObject`, `Pending`, `Reason`, …). A rejected client is sent `Reason` as a `DisconnectReasonMessage` before it is dropped.
  - Connection events: `ConnectionEventData { ConnectionEvent EventType; ulong ClientId; … }` and `ConnectionEvent { ClientConnected, PeerConnected, ClientDisconnected, PeerDisconnected }`, both in namespace `Unity.Netcode`.
  - `Unity.Netcode.Transports.UTP.UnityTransport`:
    - `SetConnectionData(bool forceOverrideCommandLineArgs, string ipv4Address, ushort port, string listenAddress = null)` resets `Protocol` to `ProtocolType.UnityTransport`. A null `listenAddress` falls back to `ipv4Address`.
    - Settable int properties: `ConnectTimeoutMS`, `MaxConnectAttempts`, `DisconnectTimeoutMS`, `HeartbeatTimeoutMS`.
  - NGO's own `NetworkConstants` is `internal`, so `NetworkConstants` resolves to `FishGame.Core.NetworkConstants` without CS0104.

```csharp
// FishGame.Runtime
public interface INetworkSession : IDisposable { ConnState State {get;} SessionMode Mode {get;} bool IsHost {get;}
  event Action<ConnState, ConnState> StateChanged; event Action<EndReason> Ended; string JoinCode {get;}
  Task<string> HostOnlineAsync(CancellationToken ct); Task JoinOnlineAsync(string code, CancellationToken ct);
  Task StartLocalAsync(bool allowRemote, CancellationToken ct); Task JoinDirectAsync(string ip, ushort port, CancellationToken ct);
  Task SetJoinableAsync(bool open); Task LeaveAsync(); }
public sealed class NetworkSessionException : Exception { public EndReason Reason {get;} public NetworkSessionException(EndReason reason, string message = null, Exception inner = null); }
public interface IJoinContextProvider { bool JoinsOpen {get;} void GetRoster(List<RosterEntry> into); bool TryGetKey(ulong clientId, out PlayerKey key); }
public readonly struct ApprovedJoin { public readonly ulong ClientId; public readonly PlayerKey Key; public readonly string Name; public readonly byte Slot; public readonly bool Reclaimed; public ApprovedJoin(ulong clientId, PlayerKey key, string name, byte slot, bool reclaimed); }
public sealed class JoinApprovalBridge { public IJoinContextProvider Provider {get;set;} public void AddApproved(in ApprovedJoin join); public bool TryTakeApproved(ulong clientId, out ApprovedJoin join); public void GetPending(List<ApprovedJoin> into); public void RemovePending(ulong clientId); public void Clear(); }

// FishGame.Networking
public sealed class NetworkSessionConfig { public NetworkSessionConfig(NetworkManager networkManager, JoinApprovalBridge bridge, ISettings settings, int protocolVersion, ulong contentHash, bool longTimeout);
  public NetworkManager NetworkManager {get;} public JoinApprovalBridge Bridge {get;} public ISettings Settings {get;} public int ProtocolVersion {get;} public ulong ContentHash {get;} public bool LongTimeout {get;} }
public sealed class ConnectionApprover { public ConnectionApprover(NetworkSessionConfig config, SessionMode mode); public void Install(); public void Uninstall(); public void Handle(NetworkManager.ConnectionApprovalRequest request, NetworkManager.ConnectionApprovalResponse response); }
public static class TransportSetup { public static UnityTransport Get(NetworkManager nm); public static void ApplyTimeouts(UnityTransport utp, bool longTimeout); public static void ConfigureDirect(UnityTransport utp, string address, ushort port, string listenAddress); }
public static class NetworkManagerAwait { public static Task WaitForShutdownAsync(NetworkManager nm, CancellationToken ct); public static Task ShutdownAsync(NetworkManager nm); }
public sealed class LocalNetworkSession : INetworkSession { public LocalNetworkSession(NetworkSessionConfig config); public ushort Port {get;set;} public ushort ActivePort {get;} }
public sealed class CompositeNetworkSession : INetworkSession { public CompositeNetworkSession(LocalNetworkSession local, Func<INetworkSession> onlineFactory); public LocalNetworkSession Local {get;} public INetworkSession Active {get;} }
```

**Scope decisions (the contract wins over the spec, per §13)**
- **Protocol version and the `-dev-protocol-offset` flag.** The connection payload carries `NetworkSessionConfig.ProtocolVersion`, `ContentHash`, `PlayerKey(Local, settings.EnsureLocalPlayerId())` and `settings.Current.displayName`. T13 builds `ProtocolVersion` as `BuildInfo.EffectiveProtocolVersion(devBuild ? DevFlags.ProtocolOffset : 0)`, and T3 `DevFlags` parses `-dev-protocol-offset`. **T8 reads no command-line arguments.** `ConfigureDirect` passes `forceOverrideCommandLineArgs: true`, so `-ip`/`-port` are ignored as well.
- `NetworkConfig.ProtocolVersion` is always set to `NetworkConstants.NgoProtocolVersion` (0). Our own version check runs in `JoinRules` (rules 3 and 4), so a mismatch reaches the client as the reason `VersionMismatch`.
- The wire payload is the Core codec bytes (D3), not an `INetworkSerializable`.
- Dev-direct UI buttons belong to T14. T8 supplies only `StartLocalAsync(true)` and `JoinDirectAsync(ip, port)`. Both fault with `NetworkSessionException(EndReason.Unknown)` unless `UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD`.
- The dev-direct host listens on `127.0.0.1` at exactly `Port`, with no retry (D22, D23). Spec 6.3's `0.0.0.0` is overridden.
- Solo listens and connects on `127.0.0.1` and tries ports `Port .. Port+SoloPortRetryCount-1` (7777..7786 by default; T16 sets `Port = 7790`). If every port fails, or `StartClient` returns false, the attempt fails with `TransportFailure`.
- `Established` fires on the host right after `StartHost()` returns true. On the client it fires from `OnConnectionEvent` `ClientConnected` where `ClientId == LocalClientId` (D37). Never fire it inside `OnServerStarted`.
- **Watchdog:** after `AsyncTimeoutSeconds` (15 s), an attempt that is still Connecting fails with `Timeout`. A `ct` cancel while Connecting fails it with `UserLeft`.
- **Ended:** it is raised exactly once per attempt (Begin .. Offline), after the state reaches Offline.
- **Start tasks:** they complete when the state reaches Connected. On failure they fault with `NetworkSessionException(reason)`. A cancel, or a leave while Connecting, faults it with `NetworkSessionException(UserLeft)` (contract §7.8 and D8; T9 uses the same convention, so callers handle one shape).
- `Dispose()` detaches the NGO callbacks and uninstalls the approver. It does not shut NGO down; callers run `LeaveAsync()` first.

**Global constraints for this task (in addition to contract §2)**
- **Language:** Unity 6 compiles C# 9. Do not use C# 10+ features: no file-scoped namespaces, no `global using`, no `record struct`. Do not use `record` or `init` either. Use block-scoped `namespace X { }`.
- **Namespaces:** exactly `FishGame.Runtime`, `FishGame.Networking` and `FishGame.Tests.EditMode`, with no sub-namespaces. Never write a bare `Input.` identifier.
- **Files:** each file holds exactly one public type, and the file name equals the type name. Write UTF-8 without BOM using the Write tool, and copy the code below exactly.
- **Comments:** every class opens with a `// Authority: ...` comment.
- **Threading:** all session code runs on the Unity main thread, with UnitySynchronizationContext continuations. Do not add `ConfigureAwait(false)` anywhere.
- **Name clashes:** if a CS0104 ambiguity ever appears, fully qualify the `FishGame.Core` type. Never rename a contract type.
- **Unity commands:** every Unity command uses `$env:FG_OUT = '<absolute scratchpad path>\fg'`, where you substitute your own session scratchpad path (contract §2.3). Call the PowerShell tool with `timeout: 600000`. If any run prints `FG RESULT <command> LOCKED` (exit 2), stop and report that the editor is open. Never kill Unity.

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FishGame.Tests.EditMode
{
    // Authority: none (EditMode tests). Covers the approver -> SessionState handoff (contract §7.8, D4).
    public sealed class JoinApprovalBridgeTests
    {
        private static ApprovedJoin MakeJoin(ulong clientId, string id, byte slot)
        {
            return new ApprovedJoin(clientId, new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, id), "Fisher " + (slot + 1), slot, false);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinApprovalBridge_TryTakeApproved_ReturnsThenRemovesEntry()
        {
            var bridge = new JoinApprovalBridge();
            bridge.AddApproved(MakeJoin(5UL, "alpha", 1));

            bool first = bridge.TryTakeApproved(5UL, out ApprovedJoin taken);
            bool second = bridge.TryTakeApproved(5UL, out _);

            Assert.IsTrue(first);
            Assert.AreEqual(5UL, taken.ClientId);
            Assert.AreEqual(new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, "alpha"), taken.Key);
            Assert.AreEqual((byte)1, taken.Slot);
            Assert.IsFalse(second);
        }

        [Test]
        public void JoinApprovalBridge_AddApproved_SameClientReplacesEntry()
        {
            var bridge = new JoinApprovalBridge();
            bridge.AddApproved(MakeJoin(7UL, "alpha", 1));
            bridge.AddApproved(MakeJoin(7UL, "beta", 2));

            var pending = new List<ApprovedJoin>();
            bridge.GetPending(pending);

            Assert.AreEqual(1, pending.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, "beta"), pending[0].Key);
            Assert.AreEqual((byte)2, pending[0].Slot);
        }

        {
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.Core;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // Authority: none (interface). Menus and App talk only to this seam. Start tasks complete when State reaches Connected.
    // On failure they fault with NetworkSessionException(reason) and Ended(reason) fires once. A cancel ends with UserLeft.
    public interface INetworkSession : IDisposable
    {
        ConnState State { get; }
        SessionMode Mode { get; }                 // None while Offline
        bool IsHost { get; }
        event Action<ConnState, ConnState> StateChanged;
        event Action<EndReason> Ended;            // exactly once per attempt (Begin .. Offline); UserLeft for a normal leave or a cancel
        string JoinCode { get; }                  // null for solo and dev-direct
        Task<string> HostOnlineAsync(CancellationToken ct);
        Task JoinOnlineAsync(string code, CancellationToken ct);
        Task StartLocalAsync(bool allowRemote, CancellationToken ct); // false = Solo; true = DevDirect host (dev builds only)
        Task JoinDirectAsync(string ip, ushort port, CancellationToken ct);
        Task SetJoinableAsync(bool open);
        Task LeaveAsync();                        // idempotent; completes when Offline
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FishGame.Runtime
{
    // Authority: host. App-scope handoff from the approver (Networking) to SessionState (Gameplay). Main thread only.
    // Pending entries count as connected for the approver's capacity and duplicate checks (D4).
    public sealed class JoinApprovalBridge
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<ulong, ApprovedJoin> _pending = new Dictionary<ulong, ApprovedJoin>();

        // SessionState sets this on server spawn and clears it on despawn.
        public IJoinContextProvider Provider { get; set; }

        // Replaces any pending entry for the same ClientId.
        public void AddApproved(in ApprovedJoin join)
        {
            _pending[join.ClientId] = join;
        }

        // Removes the entry when found.
        public bool TryTakeApproved(ulong clientId, out ApprovedJoin join)
        {
            if (_pending.TryGetValue(clientId, out join))
            {
                _pending.Remove(clientId);
                return true;
            }
            join = default;
            return false;
        }

        // Clears `into` first.
        public void GetPending(List<ApprovedJoin> into)
        {
            into.Clear();
            foreach (KeyValuePair<ulong, ApprovedJoin> entry in _pending)
            {
                into.Add(entry.Value);
            }
        }

        public void RemovePending(ulong clientId)
        {
            _pending.Remove(clientId);
        }

        // Pending only. Provider is untouched.
        public void Clear()
        {
            _pending.Clear();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using FishGame.Core;
using Unity.Netcode;
using Unity.Netcode.Transports.UTP;

namespace FishGame.Networking
{
    // Authority: none (helper). Configures the plain UnityTransport protocol and timeouts. Never sets Relay data.
    public static class TransportSetup
    {
        public static UnityTransport Get(NetworkManager nm)
        {
            if (nm == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(nm));
            }
            UnityTransport utp = nm.NetworkConfig.NetworkTransport as UnityTransport;
            if (utp == null)
            {
                utp = nm.GetComponent<UnityTransport>();
                if (utp != null)
                {
                    // NGO starts from NetworkConfig.NetworkTransport; a null field would make StartHost fail with a misleading transport error.
                    nm.NetworkConfig.NetworkTransport = utp;
                }
            }
            if (utp == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("No UnityTransport found on the NetworkManager.");
            }
            return utp;
        }

        public static void ApplyTimeouts(UnityTransport utp, bool longTimeout)
        {
            utp.ConnectTimeoutMS = NetworkConstants.ConnectTimeoutMS;
            utp.MaxConnectAttempts = NetworkConstants.MaxConnectAttempts;
            utp.DisconnectTimeoutMS = longTimeout ? NetworkConstants.LongDisconnectTimeoutMS : NetworkConstants.DisconnectTimeoutMS;
            utp.HeartbeatTimeoutMS = NetworkConstants.HeartbeatTimeoutMS;
        }

        // Resets Protocol to ProtocolType.UnityTransport (so Relay data never leaks into Solo) and ignores -ip/-port args.
        public static void ConfigureDirect(UnityTransport utp, string address, ushort port, string listenAddress)
        {
            utp.SetConnectionData(true, address, port, listenAddress);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Unity.Netcode;

namespace FishGame.Networking
{
    // Authority: none (helper). Awaits NGO shutdown, one frame per Task.Yield on the Unity main thread.
    public static class NetworkManagerAwait
    {
        public static async Task WaitForShutdownAsync(NetworkManager nm, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            while (nm != null && nm.ShutdownInProgress)
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                await Task.Yield();
            }
        }

        public static async Task ShutdownAsync(NetworkManager nm)
        {
            if (nm == null)
            {
                return;
            }
            if (!nm.ShutdownInProgress && (nm.IsListening || nm.IsServer || nm.IsClient))
            {
                nm.Shutdown();
            }
            await WaitForShutdownAsync(nm, CancellationToken.None);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Networking
{
    // Authority: host. NGO calls Handle on the server only (each remote join, and the host's own client inside StartHost).
    // Every decision goes through Core JoinRules. Approved joins are parked in the JoinApprovalBridge for SessionState.
    public sealed class ConnectionApprover
    {
        private readonly NetworkSessionConfig _config;
        private readonly SessionMode _mode;
        private readonly Action<NetworkManager.ConnectionApprovalRequest, NetworkManager.ConnectionApprovalResponse> _callback;
        private readonly List<RosterEntry> _roster = new List<RosterEntry>();
        private readonly List<ApprovedJoin> _pending = new List<ApprovedJoin>();

        public ConnectionApprover(NetworkSessionConfig config, SessionMode mode)
        {
            _config = config ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(config));
            _mode = mode;
            _callback = Handle;
        }

        // Assignment, never +=. NGO throws on a multicast approval callback.
        // ConnectionApproval is part of NGO's config hash, so clients set it too.
        public void Install()
        {
            NetworkManager nm = _config.NetworkManager;
            nm.NetworkConfig.ConnectionApproval = true;
            nm.ConnectionApprovalCallback = _callback;
        }

        // Clears the callback only while it is still ours, so a stale approver never removes a newer one.
        public void Uninstall()
        {
            NetworkManager nm = _config.NetworkManager;
            if (ReferenceEquals(nm, null))
            {
                return;
            }
            if (nm.ConnectionApprovalCallback == _callback)
            {
                nm.ConnectionApprovalCallback = null;
            }
        }

        public void Handle(NetworkManager.ConnectionApprovalRequest request, NetworkManager.ConnectionApprovalResponse response)
        {
            response.CreatePlayerObject = false;
            response.Pending = false;
            try
            {
                Evaluate(request, response);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e);
                Reject(response, EndReason.Unknown);
            }
        }

        private void Evaluate(NetworkManager.ConnectionApprovalRequest request, NetworkManager.ConnectionApprovalResponse response)
        {
            if (!ConnectPayloadCodec.TryDecode(request.Payload, out ConnectPayload payload) || !payload.Key.IsValid)
            {
                Reject(response, EndReason.VersionMismatch);
                return;
            }

            ulong clientId = request.ClientNetworkId;
            JoinApprovalBridge bridge = _config.Bridge;
            IJoinContextProvider provider = bridge.Provider;

            // Roster = provider slots (empty if none) + pending approvals counted as connected (D4).
            _roster.Clear();
            if (provider != null)
            {
                provider.GetRoster(_roster);
            }
            bridge.GetPending(_pending);
            for (int i = 0; i < _pending.Count; i++)
            {
                _roster.Add(new RosterEntry(_pending[i].Key, _pending[i].Slot, true));
            }
            bool joinsOpen = provider == null || provider.JoinsOpen;

            var joinRequest = new JoinRequest(
                clientId,
                clientId == NetworkManager.ServerClientId,
                payload.ProtocolVersion,
                payload.ContentHash,
                payload.Key,
                payload.Name);
            var context = new JoinContext(
                _mode,
                _config.ProtocolVersion,
                _config.ContentHash,
                joinsOpen,
                NetworkConstants.MaxPlayers,
                _roster);

            JoinVerdict verdict = JoinRules.Evaluate(joinRequest, context);
            if (!verdict.Approved)
            {
                Reject(response, verdict.Reason);
                return;
            }

            string name = DisplayNameRules.Sanitize(payload.Name, verdict.Slot);
            bridge.AddApproved(new ApprovedJoin(clientId, payload.Key, name, verdict.Slot, verdict.Reclaimed));
            response.Approved = true;
            response.CreatePlayerObject = false;
            response.Pending = false;
        }

        // NGO sends Reason to the pending client before dropping it; the client parses it with DisconnectClassifier.
        private static void Reject(NetworkManager.ConnectionApprovalResponse response, EndReason reason)
        {
            response.Approved = false;
            response.CreatePlayerObject = false;
            response.Pending = false;
            response.Reason = reason.ToString();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using Unity.Netcode;
using Unity.Netcode.Transports.UTP;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Networking
{
    // Authority: host. In Solo and in dev-direct host mode this process is the host: it owns join approval
    // (ConnectionApprover -> Core JoinRules) and the approval -> roster handoff (JoinApprovalBridge).
    // A dev-direct client only follows NGO. Plain UnityTransport on loopback; never touches UGS.
    // Main thread only. Dev-direct (host or join) is refused unless UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD.
    public sealed class LocalNetworkSession : INetworkSession
    {
        private const string DevOnlyMessage = "Dev-direct is only available in the editor or in a development build.";

        private readonly NetworkSessionConfig _config;
        private readonly ConnectionStateMachine _sm = new ConnectionStateMachine();
        private ConnectionApprover _approver;
        private SessionMode _mode = SessionMode.None;
        private bool _isHost;
        private EndReason _endReason = EndReason.UserLeft;
        private bool _endedRaised = true;
        private bool _suppressStopCallbacks;
        private bool _disposed;
        private int _attemptId;
        private double _beginTime;
        private TaskCompletionSource<bool> _startTcs;
        private CancellationTokenSource _attemptCts;
        private Task _teardown;

        public LocalNetworkSession(NetworkSessionConfig config)
        {
            _config = config ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(config));
            _sm.Changed += OnStateMachineChanged;
        }

        // First port tried. PlayMode tests set NetworkConstants.TestPort.
        public ushort Port { get; set; } = NetworkConstants.DefaultPort;

        // The port actually bound (host) or joined (client) by the current or last attempt; 0 before the first.
        public ushort ActivePort { get; private set; }

        public ConnState State => _sm.State;
        public SessionMode Mode => _sm.State == ConnState.Offline ? SessionMode.None : _mode;
        public bool IsHost => _sm.State != ConnState.Offline && _isHost;
        public string JoinCode => null;

        public event Action<ConnState, ConnState> StateChanged;
        public event Action<EndReason> Ended;

        private NetworkManager Nm => _config.NetworkManager;
        private bool IsLive => _sm.State == ConnState.Connecting || _sm.State == ConnState.Connected;

        private static bool DevAllowed
        {
            get
            {
#if UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD
                return true;
#else
                return false;
#endif
            }
        }

        public Task<string> HostOnlineAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            throw new NotSupportedException("LocalNetworkSession cannot host online sessions.");
        }

        public Task JoinOnlineAsync(string code, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            throw new NotSupportedException("LocalNetworkSession cannot join online sessions.");
        }

        public async Task StartLocalAsync(bool allowRemote, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            if (allowRemote)
            {
                if (!DevAllowed)
                {
                    throw new NetworkSessionException(EndReason.Unknown, DevOnlyMessage);
                }
                // Dev-direct host: 127.0.0.1, exactly Port, no retry (D22, D23).
                await AttemptAsync(SessionMode.DevDirect, true, NetworkConstants.LoopbackAddress, Port, 1, ct);
                return;
            }
            // Solo: 127.0.0.1, Port .. Port + SoloPortRetryCount - 1.
            await AttemptAsync(SessionMode.Solo, true, NetworkConstants.LoopbackAddress, Port, NetworkConstants.SoloPortRetryCount, ct);
        }

        public async Task JoinDirectAsync(string ip, ushort port, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            if (!DevAllowed)
            {
                throw new NetworkSessionException(EndReason.Unknown, DevOnlyMessage);
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ip))
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("An IPv4 address is required.", nameof(ip));
            }
            await AttemptAsync(SessionMode.DevDirect, false, ip.Trim(), port, 1, ct);
        }

        // Local sessions have no Lobby lock; approval (rule 5) is the guarantee.
        public Task SetJoinableAsync(bool open)
        {
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        public async Task LeaveAsync()
        {
            if (_sm.State == ConnState.Connecting)
            {
                Fail(EndReason.UserLeft);
            }
            RequestShutdown();
            Task pending = _teardown;
            if (pending != null)
            {
                await pending;
            }
        }

        // Does not shut NGO down. Callers use LeaveAsync first.
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_disposed)
            {
                return;
            }
            _disposed = true;
            UnsubscribeNetwork();
            UninstallApprover();
            DisposeAttemptToken();
        }

        private async Task AttemptAsync(SessionMode mode, bool asHost, string address, ushort firstPort, int portAttempts, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            if (_disposed)
            {
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(LocalNetworkSession));
            }
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            if (_sm.State != ConnState.Offline)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot start a session while " + _sm.State + ".");
            }
            if (Nm == null)
            {
                throw new NetworkSessionException(EndReason.TransportFailure, "NetworkManager is missing.");
            }

            _attemptId++;
            int attempt = _attemptId;
            _mode = mode;
            _isHost = asHost;
            _endReason = EndReason.UserLeft;
            _endedRaised = false;
            _suppressStopCallbacks = false;
            _beginTime = Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble;
            ActivePort = 0;
            _startTcs = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            _attemptCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
            Task startTask = _startTcs.Task;
            CancellationToken attemptToken = _attemptCts.Token;

            SubscribeNetwork();
            _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.Begin);

            SynchronizationContext context = SynchronizationContext.Current;
            using (ct.Register(() => PostCancel(context, attempt)))
            {
                _ = WatchTimeoutAsync(attempt);
                _ = SetupAndStartAsync(attempt, address, firstPort, portAttempts, attemptToken);
                await startTask;
            }
        }

        // Cancel callbacks can run on any thread (e.g. CancelAfter); hop back to the main thread first.
        private void PostCancel(SynchronizationContext context, int attempt)
        {
            if (context != null)
            {
                context.Post(_ => CancelAttempt(attempt), null);
            }
            else
            {
                CancelAttempt(attempt);
            }
        }

        private void CancelAttempt(int attempt)
        {
            if (attempt == _attemptId && _sm.State == ConnState.Connecting)
            {
                Fail(EndReason.UserLeft);
            }
        }

        private async Task SetupAndStartAsync(int attempt, string address, ushort firstPort, int portAttempts, CancellationToken token)
        {
            try
            {
                NetworkManager nm = Nm;
                await NetworkManagerAwait.WaitForShutdownAsync(nm, token);
                if (!IsCurrent(attempt))
                {
                    return;
                }
                if (nm.IsListening)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("[LocalNetworkSession] NetworkManager was still running; shutting it down before starting.");
                    await ShutdownNgoAsync();
                    if (!IsCurrent(attempt))
                    {
                        return;
                    }
                }

                UnityTransport utp = TransportSetup.Get(nm);
                TransportSetup.ApplyTimeouts(utp, _config.LongTimeout);
                nm.NetworkConfig.ProtocolVersion = NetworkConstants.NgoProtocolVersion;
                nm.NetworkConfig.ConnectionData = ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode(new ConnectPayload(
                    _config.ProtocolVersion,
                    _config.ContentHash,
                    new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Local, _config.Settings.EnsureLocalPlayerId()),
                    _config.Settings.Current.displayName));

                UninstallApprover();
                _approver = new ConnectionApprover(_config, _mode);
                _approver.Install();

                bool started = false;
                int attempts = _isHost ? Math.Max(1, portAttempts) : 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < attempts; i++)
                {
                    int candidate = firstPort + i;
                    if (candidate > ushort.MaxValue)
                    {
                        break;
                    }
                    ushort port = (ushort)candidate;
                    ActivePort = port;
                    TransportSetup.ConfigureDirect(utp, address, port, _isHost ? NetworkConstants.LoopbackAddress : null);

                    started = StartNgo(nm);
                    if (started)
                    {
                        break;
                    }
                    if (_isHost && i < attempts - 1)
                    {
                        Debug.LogWarning("[LocalNetworkSession] StartHost failed on port " + port + "; retrying on the next port.");
                    }
                    await ShutdownNgoAsync();
                    if (!IsCurrent(attempt))
                    {
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (!IsCurrent(attempt))
                {
                    return;
                }
                if (!started)
                {
                    Fail(EndReason.TransportFailure);
                    return;
                }
                if (_isHost)
                {
                    // D37: after StartHost returned, never from inside OnServerStarted.
                    Established();
                }
                // Client: Established comes from OnConnectionEvent ClientConnected for the local id.
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                // The attempt ended (timeout, cancel or leave) while waiting for the previous shutdown.
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e);
                if (IsCurrent(attempt))
                {
                    Fail(EndReason.TransportFailure);
                }
            }
        }

        // An exception inside NGO's Initialize runs its internal shutdown with roles still set, which raises the stop
        // callbacks while StartHost/StartClient is on the stack. Those are part of a failed start, not an unexpected stop.
        private bool StartNgo(NetworkManager nm)
        {
            _suppressStopCallbacks = true;
            try
            {
                return _isHost ? nm.StartHost() : nm.StartClient();
            }
            finally
            {
                _suppressStopCallbacks = false;
            }
        }

        private async Task ShutdownNgoAsync()
        {
            _suppressStopCallbacks = true;
            try
            {
                await NetworkManagerAwait.ShutdownAsync(Nm);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e);
            }
            finally
            {
                _suppressStopCallbacks = false;
            }
        }

        private async Task WatchTimeoutAsync(int attempt)
        {
            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(NetworkConstants.AsyncTimeoutSeconds));
            if (attempt == _attemptId && _sm.State == ConnState.Connecting)
            {
                Fail(EndReason.Timeout);
            }
        }

        private bool IsCurrent(int attempt)
        {
            return attempt == _attemptId && _sm.State == ConnState.Connecting;
        }

        private void Established()
        {
            if (_sm.State != ConnState.Connecting)
            {
                return;
            }
            _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.Established);
            TaskCompletionSource<bool> tcs = _startTcs;
            if (tcs != null)
            {
                tcs.TrySetResult(true);
            }
        }

        // Connecting -> Fail; Connected -> UnexpectedStop. Start task: faulted with NetworkSessionException(reason) (UserLeft for a cancel). Then shut down.
        private void Fail(EndReason reason)
        {
            if (!IsLive)
            {
                return;
            }

            _endReason = reason;
            CancelAttemptToken();
            if (_sm.State == ConnState.Connecting)
            {
                _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.Fail, reason);
            }
            else
            {
                _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.UnexpectedStop, reason);
            }

            TaskCompletionSource<bool> tcs = _startTcs;
            if (tcs != null)
            {
                tcs.TrySetException(new NetworkSessionException(reason));
            }
            RequestShutdown();
        }

        private void RequestShutdown()
        {
            if (_teardown != null || _sm.State == ConnState.Offline)
            {
                return;
            }
            _teardown = TeardownAsync();
        }

        // Leave -> NGO shutdown -> cleanup -> ShutdownComplete (Offline) -> Ended(reason), exactly once.
        private async Task TeardownAsync()
        {
            await Task.Yield(); // never shut NGO down from inside one of its own callbacks
            try
            {
                if (_sm.State == ConnState.Connecting)
                {
                    Fail(EndReason.UserLeft);
                }
                if (_sm.State == ConnState.Connected || _sm.State == ConnState.Failed)
                {
                    _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.Leave, _endReason);
                }
                CancelAttemptToken();
                await ShutdownNgoAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e);
            }
            finally
            {
                UnsubscribeNetwork();
                UninstallApprover();
                _config.Bridge.Clear();
                DisposeAttemptToken();

                // Capture and reset first: an Offline/Ended subscriber may start a new attempt synchronously.
                EndReason reason = _endReason;
                bool raise = !_endedRaised;
                _endedRaised = true;
                _teardown = null;

                if (_sm.State == ConnState.ShuttingDown || _sm.State == ConnState.Failed)
                {
                    _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.ShutdownComplete);
                }
                if (raise)
                {
                    RaiseEnded(reason);
                }
            }
        }

        private void OnStateMachineChanged(ConnState from, ConnState to)
        {
            try
            {
                StateChanged?.Invoke(from, to);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e);
            }
        }

        private void RaiseEnded(EndReason reason)
        {
            try
            {
                Ended?.Invoke(reason);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e);
            }
        }

        private void UninstallApprover()
        {
            if (_approver != null)
            {
                _approver.Uninstall();
                _approver = null;
            }
        }

        private void CancelAttemptToken()
        {
            CancellationTokenSource cts = _attemptCts;
            if (cts == null)
            {
                return;
            }
            try
            {
                cts.Cancel();
            }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException)
            {
            }
        }

        private void DisposeAttemptToken()
        {
            CancellationTokenSource cts = _attemptCts;
            _attemptCts = null;
            if (cts != null)
            {
                cts.Dispose();
            }
        }

        private void SubscribeNetwork()
        {
            UnsubscribeNetwork();
            NetworkManager nm = Nm;
            nm.OnConnectionEvent += OnConnectionEvent;
            nm.OnClientStopped += OnClientStopped;
            nm.OnServerStopped += OnServerStopped;
        }

        // Managed-only unsubscribe; safe even after the NetworkManager GameObject is destroyed.
        private void UnsubscribeNetwork()
        {
            NetworkManager nm = Nm;
            if (ReferenceEquals(nm, null))
            {
                return;
            }
            nm.OnConnectionEvent -= OnConnectionEvent;
            nm.OnClientStopped -= OnClientStopped;
            nm.OnServerStopped -= OnServerStopped;
        }

        private void OnConnectionEvent(NetworkManager nm, ConnectionEventData data)
        {
            if (data.EventType == ConnectionEvent.ClientConnected)
            {
                if (!_isHost && _sm.State == ConnState.Connecting && data.ClientId == nm.LocalClientId)
                {
                    Established();
                }
            }
            else if (data.EventType == ConnectionEvent.ClientDisconnected)
            {
                if (_isHost)
                {
                    _config.Bridge.RemovePending(data.ClientId);
                }
            }
        }

        // Client path. The host's own client also reports here, so the host is skipped (it uses OnServerStopped).
        private void OnClientStopped(bool wasHostClient)
        {
            if (_isHost || _suppressStopCallbacks || !IsLive)
            {
                return;
            }
            bool wasConnected = _sm.State == ConnState.Connected;
            NetworkManager nm = Nm;
            string disconnectReason = ReferenceEquals(nm, null) ? null : nm.DisconnectReason;
            Fail(DisconnectClassifier.Classify(false, wasConnected, disconnectReason, SecondsSinceBegin()));
        }

        private void OnServerStopped(bool wasHost)
        {
            if (!_isHost || _suppressStopCallbacks || !IsLive)
            {
                return;
            }
            Fail(EndReason.TransportFailure);
        }

        private double SecondsSinceBegin()
        {
            return Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble - _beginTime;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;

namespace FishGame.Networking
{
    // Authority: none (router). The single INetworkSession the UI and App see (D7). Each attempt routes to Local or to a
    // lazily created online backend. Solo and dev-direct never construct or touch the online backend (no UGS).
    public sealed class CompositeNetworkSession : INetworkSession
    {
        private readonly Func<INetworkSession> _onlineFactory;
        private INetworkSession _online;
        private INetworkSession _active;
        private bool _disposed;

        public CompositeNetworkSession(LocalNetworkSession local, Func<INetworkSession> onlineFactory)
        {
            Local = local ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(local));
            _onlineFactory = onlineFactory ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(onlineFactory));
            Local.StateChanged += OnBackendStateChanged;
            Local.Ended += OnBackendEnded;
        }

        public LocalNetworkSession Local { get; }

        // Backend of the current or last attempt; null before the first.
        public INetworkSession Active => _active;

        private INetworkSession Current => _active ?? Local;

        public ConnState State => Current.State;
        public SessionMode Mode => Current.Mode;
        public bool IsHost => Current.IsHost;
        public string JoinCode => Current.JoinCode;

        public event Action<ConnState, ConnState> StateChanged;
        public event Action<EndReason> Ended;

        public Task<string> HostOnlineAsync(CancellationToken ct) => Begin(true).HostOnlineAsync(ct);

        public Task JoinOnlineAsync(string code, CancellationToken ct) => Begin(true).JoinOnlineAsync(code, ct);

        public Task StartLocalAsync(bool allowRemote, CancellationToken ct) => Begin(false).StartLocalAsync(allowRemote, ct);

        public Task JoinDirectAsync(string ip, ushort port, CancellationToken ct) => Begin(false).JoinDirectAsync(ip, port, ct);

        public Task SetJoinableAsync(bool open) => Current.SetJoinableAsync(open);

        public Task LeaveAsync() => Current.LeaveAsync();

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_disposed)
            {
                return;
            }
            _disposed = true;
            Local.StateChanged -= OnBackendStateChanged;
            Local.Ended -= OnBackendEnded;
            Local.Dispose();
            if (_online != null)
            {
                _online.StateChanged -= OnBackendStateChanged;
                _online.Ended -= OnBackendEnded;
                _online.Dispose();
            }
        }

        // Starting while any backend is not Offline throws InvalidOperationException (synchronously).
        private INetworkSession Begin(bool online)
        {
            if (_disposed)
            {
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(CompositeNetworkSession));
            }
            if (Local.State != ConnState.Offline || (_online != null && _online.State != ConnState.Offline))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("A session is already active (" + Current.State + ").");
            }
            INetworkSession target = online ? GetOrCreateOnline() : Local;
            _active = target;
            return target;
        }

        private INetworkSession GetOrCreateOnline()
        {
            if (_online != null)
            {
                return _online;
            }
            INetworkSession created = _onlineFactory();
            if (created == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("The online session factory returned null.");
            }
            _online = created;
            created.StateChanged += OnBackendStateChanged;
            created.Ended += OnBackendEnded;
            return created;
        }

        // Only one backend can be outside Offline at a time (Begin enforces it), so forwarding from either backend
        // is the same as forwarding from the active one, and an Ended raised just after a backend switch is never lost.
        private void OnBackendStateChanged(ConnState from, ConnState to)
        {
            StateChanged?.Invoke(from, to);
        }

        private void OnBackendEnded(EndReason reason)
        {
            Ended?.Invoke(reason);
        }
    }
}
```

**Behaviour notes (do not "simplify" these away)**
- **Approver on the client.** `ConnectionApprover.Install()` also runs on client attempts. `NetworkConfig.ConnectionApproval` is part of NGO's config hash, and a mismatch drops the client before approval.
- **Host self-approval happens inside `StartHost()`.** Its `ApprovedJoin` (slot 0) is in the bridge before `OnServerStarted`, where T13 spawns SessionState, which absorbs it. `Established` comes only after `StartHost()` returns.
- **Failed `StartHost()`.** When the transport fails, NGO resets roles and shuts down synchronously, so the solo retry's `ShutdownNgoAsync()` is a no-op. UTP and NGO each log one error per busy port. That is expected.
- **Teardown order.** Teardown captures the end reason and clears `_teardown`/`_endedRaised` *before* firing `ShutdownComplete`, because subscribers to Offline may start the next attempt synchronously.

- Leave then restart in one process works: `ShutdownInProgress == false` before each start, `UnityTransport.Protocol == ProtocolType.UnityTransport` and `ConnectionData.Address == "127.0.0.1"`.
- A dev-direct client launched with `-dev-protocol-offset 1` is refused with `VersionMismatch`. It sees Failed, then Offline, then `Ended(VersionMismatch)` exactly once.

- Every network-facing await is bounded by `NetworkConstants.AsyncTimeoutSeconds` (15 s) through `UgsAsync`. Start calls also honour the caller's `CancellationToken`.
- `FishGame.Core` is `noEngineReferences: true`, so `UgsErrorMap` uses only `System`. Its comments must not contain the literal text `Unity.Services.`, because Step 11 searches for it.

**What the code does.** The code below is complete. This section is for review only.
- **Host.**
  - Runs `PrepareAsync`, then calls `CreateSessionAsync(new SessionOptions { MaxPlayers = 4, IsPrivate = true }.WithRelayNetwork())`.
  - `JoinCode` is `host.Code`, exactly as returned.
  - `Established` fires after that call returns, once `IsServer && IsListening` is true. It never fires inside an NGO callback (D37).
- **Join.**
  - Normalizes the code. If the result is not plausible, the attempt fails locally with `InvalidCode` and makes no UGS call.
  - Otherwise runs `PrepareAsync`, then calls `JoinSessionByCodeAsync(normalized)`.
  - `Established` fires from the local `ClientConnected` event.
- **PrepareAsync.**
  - Awaits `WaitForShutdownAsync`, then signs in (bounded).
  - Sets only `ProtocolVersion`, `ConnectionData` (a payload with `PlayerKey(Ugs, PlayerId)`), the timeouts and the approver.
  - Never calls `SetConnectionData`, `StartHost` or `StartClient` (F1).
- **Errors.**
  - A `SessionException` maps through `UgsErrorMap.Map((int)e.Error, e.Message)`. Any other exception maps to `ServicesUnavailable`.
  - The raw exception goes to `Debug.LogWarning` only. The player never sees it.
  - On a client, a reason recorded when NGO stopped wins over the SDK's generic follow-up error. Examples are approval rejections such as `FullLobby`, `JoinsClosed` and `VersionMismatch`.
  - A failed start task faults with `NetworkSessionException(reason)`. That reason is the same one `Ended` reports.
- **Cancel or timeout while Connecting.**
  - The attempt ends with `Fail(UserLeft)` or `Fail(Timeout)`, and the task faults with `NetworkSessionException(UserLeft)` or `NetworkSessionException(Timeout)`.
  - The SDK call cannot be aborted. Teardown waits up to 15 s for it, then leaves the session.
  - If the call finishes even later, its session is left as soon as it finishes.
- **Ending.**
  - `End` runs once per attempt. The state moves Connecting → Failed (or Connected → Failed or ShuttingDown), then → ShuttingDown → Offline.
  - On the way it awaits `session.LeaveAsync()` (bounded, errors ignored), then `NetworkManagerAwait.ShutdownAsync`, `approver.Uninstall()` and `bridge.Clear()`.
  - `Ended(reason)` is raised exactly once.
  - `LeaveAsync` does nothing while Offline. While an end is running, it returns that same end task.
- **NGO stopping on its own.**
  - The host ignores `OnClientStopped` and ends with `TransportFailure` from `OnServerStopped`. So the host never reports `HostLeft` about itself.
  - A client classifies the stop with `DisconnectClassifier`, timing it from `OnClientStarted`.
  - While Connected, the end runs one frame later, outside NGO's shutdown callback.
- **Host receives a remote `ClientDisconnected`.**
  - Calls `bridge.RemovePending(clientId)`, then `RemovePlayerAsync(ugsPlayerId)` (bounded, errors logged).
  - The UGS id is cached at `ClientConnected`, from `Provider.TryGetKey` or from the bridge's pending approvals. So the lobby seat is freed even if SessionState forgets the client first.
- **`SetJoinableAsync(open)`.**
  - Runs `host.IsLocked = !open; await host.SavePropertiesAsync();` (bounded).
  - Failures are only logged, because approval is the real guarantee.
  - Does nothing unless this instance is a Connected host.
- **`StartLocalAsync` and `JoinDirectAsync`** throw `NotSupportedException`.
- **`UgsBootstrap`.**
  - Caches one `UnityServices.InitializeAsync` task per process. The cache resets on SubsystemRegistration.
  - Calls `SetProfile(InstanceProfile.Current.Name)` only when `Name != ""` and `!IsMppmClone`.
  - Then signs in anonymously if `!IsSignedIn`.
  - If initialization faults, the cache is cleared so the next online action retries.

```csharp
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.InvalidCode, UgsErrorMap.Map(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorInvalidParameter, "Bad request"));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.InvalidCode, UgsErrorMap.Map(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorInvalidParameter, null));
        }

        // Review Focus 4: "full" inside a longer word is not a full lobby.
        [Test]
        public void UgsErrorMap_FullInsideLongerWord_IsNotFullLobby()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.ServicesUnavailable, UgsErrorMap.Map(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorUnknown, "Session created successfully but the network start failed"));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.ServicesUnavailable, UgsErrorMap.Map(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorUnknown, "Lobby is not fully initialized"));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.FullLobby, UgsErrorMap.Map(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorUnknown, "LobbyFull"));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.FullLobby, UgsErrorMap.Map(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorUnknown, "Lobby is full."));
        }

        // Review Focus 5: a Relay failure is a service outage, not a bad join code.
        [Test]
        public void UgsErrorMap_RelayJoinCodeFailure_IsServicesUnavailable()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.ServicesUnavailable, UgsErrorMap.Map(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorUnknown, "Failed to fetch relay join code"));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.ServicesUnavailable, UgsErrorMap.Map(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorInvalidParameter, "Relay allocation not found"));
            Assert.AreEqual(EndReason.InvalidCode, UgsErrorMap.Map(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorSessionNotFound, "Relay join code not found"));
        }
    }
}
```

Create `Assets/_Project/Core/Net/UgsErrorMap.cs`:

```csharp
using System;

namespace FishGame.Core
{
    // Maps a Multiplayer Services session error (numeric SessionError + message) to an EndReason.
    // Pure logic, EditMode-tested (T9). The SDK turns Lobby "full" (16004) and "invalid join code" (16010) into
    // SessionError.Unknown and keeps only the message text (F3), so those cases are decided from the message.
    public static class UgsErrorMap
    {
        // Mirror the Multiplayer Services 2.3.3 SessionError enum (read from its source: Unknown = 1,
        // SessionNotFound = 6, InvalidParameter = 12). UgsNetworkSession has a compile-time guard against drift.
        public const int SessionErrorUnknown = 1;
        public const int SessionErrorSessionNotFound = 6;
        public const int SessionErrorInvalidParameter = 12;

        // Rule order, first match wins (all text checks are ordinal, ignore case):
        // 1 message contains "full" not followed by a letter ("Lobby is full", "LobbyFull"; not "fully", "successfully") -> FullLobby
        // 2 code == SessionNotFound -> InvalidCode
        // 3 message contains "relay" -> ServicesUnavailable (the SDK's "Failed to fetch relay join code" is a Relay outage, not a bad code)
        // 4 message contains "not found", "join code" or "invalid code" -> InvalidCode
        // 5 code == InvalidParameter -> InvalidCode
        // 6 else -> ServicesUnavailable
        public static EndReason Map(int sessionErrorCode, string message)
        {
            var text = message ?? string.Empty;

            if (ContainsFullWord(text))
            {
                return EndReason.FullLobby;
            }

            if (sessionErrorCode == SessionErrorSessionNotFound)
            {
                return EndReason.InvalidCode;
            }

            if (Contains(text, "relay"))
            {
                return EndReason.ServicesUnavailable;
            }

            if (Contains(text, "not found") || Contains(text, "join code") || Contains(text, "invalid code"))
            {
                return EndReason.InvalidCode;
            }

            if (sessionErrorCode == SessionErrorInvalidParameter)
            {
                return EndReason.InvalidCode;
            }

            return EndReason.ServicesUnavailable;
        }

        private static bool Contains(string text, string part)
        {
            return text.IndexOf(part, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
        }

        // "full" (any case) whose next character is not a letter. A letter before it is allowed, so "LobbyFull" matches.
        private static bool ContainsFullWord(string text)
        {
            int index = text.IndexOf("full", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            while (index >= 0)
            {
                int after = index + 4;
                if (after >= text.Length || !char.IsLetter(text[after]))
                {
                    return true;
                }

                index = text.IndexOf("full", after, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            }

            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

Create `Assets/_Project/Networking/UgsAsync.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;

namespace FishGame.Networking
{
    // Authority: none (local async helpers for the UGS path). The SDK calls cannot be aborted, so these helpers stop
    // waiting but never stop the work itself.
    internal static class UgsAsync
    {
        // Completes when `work` completes and rethrows its exception. Throws OperationCanceledException when `ct` is
        // cancelled first, and NetworkSessionException(Timeout) after NetworkConstants.AsyncTimeoutSeconds.
        internal static async Task WithTimeoutAsync(Task work, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            if (!work.IsCompleted)
            {
                using (var cts = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct))
                {
                    var delay = Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(NetworkConstants.AsyncTimeoutSeconds), cts.Token);
                    var first = await Task.WhenAny(work, delay);
                    cts.Cancel(); // stops the timer when the work won
                    if (first != work)
                    {
                        Observe(work);
                        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                        throw new NetworkSessionException(EndReason.Timeout, "Timed out waiting for Multiplayer Services.");
                    }
                }
            }

            await work;
        }

        internal static async Task<T> WithTimeoutAsync<T>(Task<T> work, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            await WithTimeoutAsync((Task)work, ct);
            return await work;
        }

        // True when `work` finished within `seconds`. Never throws (the work's own exception is not rethrown).
        internal static async Task<bool> WaitAtMostAsync(Task work, double seconds)
        {
            if (work.IsCompleted)
            {
                return true;
            }

            using (var cts = new CancellationTokenSource())
            {
                var first = await Task.WhenAny(work, Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(seconds), cts.Token));
                cts.Cancel();
                if (first != work)
                {
                    Observe(work);
                    return false;
                }

                return true;
            }
        }

        // Marks a fault as observed, so an abandoned task never raises UnobservedTaskException.
        private static void Observe(Task work)
        {
            work.ContinueWith(
                t => { _ = t.Exception; },
                CancellationToken.None,
                TaskContinuationOptions.OnlyOnFaulted | TaskContinuationOptions.ExecuteSynchronously,
                TaskScheduler.Default);
        }
    }
}
```
