Create `Assets/_Project/Networking/UgsBootstrap.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using Unity.Services.Authentication;
using Unity.Services.Core;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Networking
{
    // Authority: none (client-side service setup). Process-wide and lazy: only UgsNetworkSession calls it, on the first
    // online action, so Solo and dev-direct never reach UGS (spec 6.3).
    internal static class UgsBootstrap
    {
        private static Task s_initTask;

        // Enter Play Mode without a domain reload keeps statics; start each play session clean.
        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        private static void ResetStatics()
        {
            s_initTask = null;
        }

        // Initializes Unity Services once per process (cached task), then signs in anonymously if needed.
        // A faulted initialization clears the cache, so the next online action retries.
        internal static async Task EnsureSignedInAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            if (s_initTask == null)
            {
                s_initTask = InitializeAsync();
            }

            var init = s_initTask;
            try
            {
                await init;
            }
            catch
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(s_initTask, init))
                {
                    s_initTask = null;
                }

                throw;
            }

            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            if (!AuthenticationService.Instance.IsSignedIn)
            {
                await AuthenticationService.Instance.SignInAnonymouslyAsync();
            }
        }

        private static Task InitializeAsync()
        {
            if (UnityServices.State == ServicesInitializationState.Initialized)
            {
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }

            var options = new InitializationOptions();
            var profile = InstanceProfile.Current;

            // MPPM clones already get a per-clone profile from "-editor-mode -name <x>" (F4). Only -dev-profile
            // instances (several standalone builds on one machine) set it explicitly. Name is sanitized to
            // [a-z0-9_-], max 30 chars, which SetProfile accepts.
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.Name) && !profile.IsMppmClone)
            {
                options.SetProfile(profile.Name);
            }

            return UnityServices.InitializeAsync(options);
        }
    }
}
```

The `SessionErrorMirrorGuard` constant is never read, and that is intentional. If `UgsErrorMap`'s constants ever stop matching `SessionError`, the build fails with CS0221. Keep the constant.

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using Unity.Netcode;
using Unity.Services.Authentication;
using Unity.Services.Multiplayer;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Networking
{
    // Authority: host owns the Sessions lobby (lock state, player removal). The SDK owns NGO start and stop on this path.
    //
    // Recorded findings (M1 criterion 13). Read from multiplayer 2.3.3 / authentication 3.8.0 source on 2026-10-09.
    // T16/T17 replace each [pending] with the runtime result.
    //  - The Sessions NGO handler calls StartHost/StartClient/Shutdown itself and calls UnityTransport.SetRelayServerData
    //    itself (F1). This class never calls StartHost, StartClient or SetConnectionData.
    //  - NetworkManager.Singleton must exist before CreateSessionAsync/JoinSessionByCodeAsync, else
    //    SessionException(NetworkManagerNotInitialized) (F1).
    //  - The inspector Protocol Type does not matter on the Sessions path: SetRelayServerData switches to Relay, and every
    //    local start calls SetConnectionData, which switches back to plain UnityTransport.
    //  - CreateSessionAsync returns only after NGO is listening. JoinSessionByCodeAsync returns only after the client is
    //    connected (IsConnectedClient, polled every 1 s). The SDK trims the code but does not change its case.
    //  - The SDK handler keeps its NGO session until ISession.LeaveAsync, and calling NetworkManager.Shutdown directly
    //    logs "Use ISession.LeaveAsync instead". Teardown therefore always leaves the session first, even after NGO
    //    stopped on its own; otherwise the next online start would skip starting NGO ("Session already started").
    //  - LobbyFull (16004), LobbyLocked (16005) and InvalidJoinCode (16010) arrive as SessionError.Unknown with message
    //    text only, and non-session exceptions are wrapped as Unknown with their message (F3). UgsErrorMap decides
    //    FullLobby and InvalidCode from the message.
    //  - If the network start fails inside a join (e.g. approval rejected), the SDK leaves the lobby itself.
    //  - MPPM clones get their auth profile from "-editor-mode -name <x>" (F4), so UgsBootstrap sets a profile only for
    //    -dev-profile instances. Distinct clone PlayerIds: [pending]. If not distinct: SwitchProfile while signed out.
    //  - Still to confirm at runtime: real code format/length/case (V3): [pending]; exact LobbyFull message: [pending];
    //    Solo after a Sessions run in one process: [pending]; perf baseline (10.7): [pending].
    public sealed partial class UgsNetworkSession : INetworkSession
    {
        // Compile-time guard: error CS0221 on this line means UgsErrorMap's mirrored SessionError values are wrong.
        private const uint SessionErrorMirrorGuard =
            (uint)((int)SessionError.Unknown - UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorUnknown)
            + (uint)(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorUnknown - (int)SessionError.Unknown)
            + (uint)((int)SessionError.SessionNotFound - UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorSessionNotFound)
            + (uint)(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorSessionNotFound - (int)SessionError.SessionNotFound)
            + (uint)((int)SessionError.InvalidParameter - UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorInvalidParameter)
            + (uint)(UgsErrorMap.SessionErrorInvalidParameter - (int)SessionError.InvalidParameter);

        private readonly NetworkSessionConfig _config;
        private readonly ConnectionStateMachine _sm = new ConnectionStateMachine();
        private readonly Dictionary<ulong, string> _ugsIdByClient = new Dictionary<ulong, string>();
        private readonly List<ApprovedJoin> _pendingScratch = new List<ApprovedJoin>();

        private int _attemptId;
        private bool _isHost;
        private bool _subscribed;
        private bool _sessionReleased;
        private bool _disposed;
        private ConnectionApprover _approver;
        private ISession _session;
        private IHostSession _host;
        private string _joinCode;
        private Task _inFlight;
        private TaskCompletionSource<EndReason> _endTcs;
        private EndReason _endReason = EndReason.Unknown;
        private EndReason? _ngoStopReason;
        private System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch _clock;

        public event Action<ConnState, ConnState> StateChanged;
        public event Action<EndReason> Ended;

        // Must not touch UGS: Solo never constructs this class, and constructing it does nothing online.
        public UgsNetworkSession(NetworkSessionConfig config)
        {
            _config = config ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(config));
            _sm.Changed += (prev, next) => StateChanged?.Invoke(prev, next);
        }

        public ConnState State => _sm.State;
        public SessionMode Mode => _sm.State == ConnState.Offline ? SessionMode.None : SessionMode.Online;
        public bool IsHost => _isHost && _sm.State != ConnState.Offline;
        public string JoinCode => _joinCode;

        public Task<string> HostOnlineAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            return RunAttemptAsync<string>(true, ct, HostBodyAsync);
        }

        public Task JoinOnlineAsync(string code, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            return RunAttemptAsync<bool>(false, ct, c => JoinBodyAsync(code, c));
        }

        public Task StartLocalAsync(bool allowRemote, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            throw new NotSupportedException("UgsNetworkSession does not run Solo or dev-direct sessions.");
        }

        public Task JoinDirectAsync(string ip, ushort port, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            throw new NotSupportedException("UgsNetworkSession does not run Solo or dev-direct sessions.");
        }

        // Mirrors joins-open into the Lobby lock (D35). Nice-to-have: approval is the guarantee, so failures are logged only.
        public async Task SetJoinableAsync(bool open)
        {
            var host = _host;
            if (host == null || _sm.State != ConnState.Connected)
            {
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                host.IsLocked = !open;
                await UgsAsync.WithTimeoutAsync(host.SavePropertiesAsync(), CancellationToken.None);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[UGS] SetJoinableAsync({open}) failed (ignored): {e}");
            }
        }

        // Idempotent: a no-op while Offline; while ending it returns the same in-flight end task.
        public Task LeaveAsync()
        {
            if (_sm.State == ConnState.Offline)
            {
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }

            return End(EndReason.UserLeft, false);
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_disposed)
            {
                return;
            }

            _disposed = true;
            _ = LeaveAsync();
        }

        // ---- Attempts ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        private async Task<T> RunAttemptAsync<T>(bool host, CancellationToken ct, Func<CancellationToken, Task<T>> body)
        {
            StartAttempt(host);
            try
            {
                return await body(ct);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException oce) when (ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                var reason = await End(EndReason.UserLeft, false);
                throw new NetworkSessionException(reason, "The online attempt was cancelled.", oce);
            }
            catch (NetworkSessionException ex)
            {
                var reason = await End(ClientStopReasonOr(ex.Reason), true);
                if (ex.Reason == reason)
                {
                    throw;
                }

                throw new NetworkSessionException(reason, ex.Message, ex);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[UGS] Online {(host ? "host" : "join")} failed (raw error, never shown to the player): {ex}");
                var mapped = ex is SessionException se
                    ? UgsErrorMap.Map((int)se.Error, se.Message)
                    : EndReason.ServicesUnavailable;
                var reason = await End(ClientStopReasonOr(mapped), true);
                throw new NetworkSessionException(reason, "The online session failed.", ex);
            }
        }

        private void StartAttempt(bool host)
        {
            if (_disposed)
            {
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(UgsNetworkSession));
            }

            if (_sm.State != ConnState.Offline)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("A session attempt is already in progress.");
            }

            _attemptId++;
            _endTcs = null;
            _endReason = EndReason.Unknown;
            _ngoStopReason = null;
            _sessionReleased = false;
            _isHost = host;
            _joinCode = null;
            _session = null;
            _host = null;
            _inFlight = null;
            _ugsIdByClient.Clear();
            _clock = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
            _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.Begin);
        }

        private async Task<string> HostBodyAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var nm = _config.NetworkManager;
            await PrepareAsync(ct);

            var options = new SessionOptions { MaxPlayers = NetworkConstants.MaxPlayers, IsPrivate = true }.WithRelayNetwork();
            var call = MultiplayerService.Instance.CreateSessionAsync(options);
            _inFlight = TrackSessionAsync(call, _attemptId);
            var host = await UgsAsync.WithTimeoutAsync(call, ct);
            ThrowIfEnding();

            _host = host;
            _joinCode = host.Code; // exactly as given (V3)
            await WaitUntilAsync(() => nm.IsServer && nm.IsListening, ct);
            _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.Established); // after the SDK call returned, never inside an NGO callback (D37)
            return _joinCode;
        }

        private async Task<bool> JoinBodyAsync(string code, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var normalized = FishGame.Core.JoinCode.Normalize(code);
            if (!FishGame.Core.JoinCode.IsPlausible(normalized))
            {
                throw new NetworkSessionException(EndReason.InvalidCode, "The join code is not valid."); // no UGS call
            }

            await PrepareAsync(ct);
            var call = MultiplayerService.Instance.JoinSessionByCodeAsync(normalized);
            _inFlight = TrackSessionAsync(call, _attemptId);
            var session = await UgsAsync.WithTimeoutAsync(call, ct);
            ThrowIfEnding();

            _joinCode = string.IsNullOrEmpty(session.Code) ? normalized : session.Code;
            await WaitUntilAsync(() => _sm.State == ConnState.Connected, ct); // Established fires in OnConnectionEvent
            return true;
        }

        // Shared setup: wait for NGO to be fully down, sign in, then set the payload, timeouts and approver before the SDK
        // starts NGO. Never calls SetConnectionData (the SDK sets relay data, F1).
        private async Task PrepareAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var nm = _config.NetworkManager;
            if (nm == null)
            {
                throw new NetworkSessionException(EndReason.Unknown, "NetworkManager is missing.");
            }

            await NetworkManagerAwait.WaitForShutdownAsync(nm, ct);
            await UgsAsync.WithTimeoutAsync(UgsBootstrap.EnsureSignedInAsync(ct), ct);
            ThrowIfEnding();

            var playerId = AuthenticationService.Instance.PlayerId;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(playerId))
            {
                throw new NetworkSessionException(EndReason.ServicesUnavailable, "Signed in without a PlayerId.");
            }

            TransportSetup.ApplyTimeouts(TransportSetup.Get(nm), _config.LongTimeout);
            nm.NetworkConfig.ProtocolVersion = NetworkConstants.NgoProtocolVersion;
            nm.NetworkConfig.ConnectionData = ConnectPayloadCodec.Encode(new ConnectPayload(
                _config.ProtocolVersion, _config.ContentHash, new PlayerKey(IdentityKind.Ugs, playerId),
                _config.Settings.Current.displayName));

            _approver = new ConnectionApprover(_config, SessionMode.Online);
            _approver.Install();

            nm.OnConnectionEvent += OnConnectionEvent;
            nm.OnClientStarted += OnClientStarted;
            nm.OnServerStopped += OnServerStopped;
            nm.OnClientStopped += OnClientStopped;
            _subscribed = true;
        }

        private void ThrowIfEnding()
        {
            if (_endTcs != null)
            {
                throw new NetworkSessionException(_endReason, "The session ended while starting.");
            }
        }

        private async Task WaitUntilAsync(Func<bool> ready, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var clock = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
            while (!ready())
            {
                ThrowIfEnding();
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                if (_ngoStopReason.HasValue)
                {
                    throw new NetworkSessionException(_ngoStopReason.Value, "NGO stopped while starting.");
                }

                if (clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds > NetworkConstants.AsyncTimeoutSeconds)
                {
                    throw new NetworkSessionException(EndReason.Timeout, "Timed out while starting the session.");
                }

                await Task.Yield(); // one frame on Unity's synchronization context
            }

            ThrowIfEnding();
        }

        private EndReason ClientStopReasonOr(EndReason fallback)
        {
            // A client rejected by approval stops NGO first; the SDK then fails with a generic error. Keep the real reason.
            return !_isHost && _ngoStopReason.HasValue ? _ngoStopReason.Value : fallback;
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Implement `UgsNetworkSession` part 2 (full file)**

Create `Assets/_Project/Networking/UgsNetworkSession.Teardown.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.Core;
using Unity.Netcode;
using Unity.Services.Multiplayer;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Networking
{
    // Part of UgsNetworkSession (see UgsNetworkSession.cs for the authority comment and recorded findings):
    // ending, teardown and session-handle tracking. Split only to keep each file under ~300 lines.
    public sealed partial class UgsNetworkSession
    {
        // ---- Ending --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        // Starts the end of the current attempt exactly once; later calls get the same task. Never faults.
        // The result is the reason Ended was (or will be) raised with.
        private Task<EndReason> End(EndReason reason, bool failed)
        {
            if (_endTcs != null)
            {
                return _endTcs.Task;
            }

            if (_sm.State == ConnState.Offline)
            {
                return Task.FromResult(_endReason);
            }

            var tcs = new TaskCompletionSource<EndReason>(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            _endTcs = tcs;
            _endReason = reason;
            _ = EndCoreAsync(tcs, reason, failed);
            return tcs.Task;
        }

        private async Task EndCoreAsync(TaskCompletionSource<EndReason> tcs, EndReason reason, bool failed)
        {
            try
            {
                if (_sm.State == ConnState.Connecting)
                {
                    _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.Fail, reason);
                }
                else if (_sm.State == ConnState.Connected)
                {
                    _sm.Fire(failed ? ConnEvent.UnexpectedStop : ConnEvent.Leave, reason);
                }

                if (_sm.State == ConnState.Failed)
                {
                    _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.Leave, reason);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e); // a throwing StateChanged handler must not skip teardown
            }

            try
            {
                await TeardownAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e);
            }

            try
            {
                if (_sm.State == ConnState.ShuttingDown || _sm.State == ConnState.Failed)
                {
                    _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.ShutdownComplete, reason);
                }

                Ended?.Invoke(reason); // exactly once per attempt; SceneFlow turns it into a toast (D8)
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e);
            }

            tcs.TrySetResult(reason);
        }

        // Order: let the SDK call finish (bounded), leave the session (bounded, errors ignored), then shut NGO down.
        private async Task TeardownAsync()
        {
            var nm = _config.NetworkManager;

            var inFlight = _inFlight;
            _inFlight = null;
            if (inFlight != null
                && !await UgsAsync.WaitAtMostAsync(inFlight, NetworkConstants.AsyncTimeoutSeconds))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("[UGS] The SDK call is still running; its session will be left when it finishes.");
            }

            _sessionReleased = true;
            var session = _session;
            _session = null;
            _host = null;
            _joinCode = null;
            if (session != null)
            {
                await LeaveQuietlyAsync(session);
            }

            if (nm != null)
            {
                if (_subscribed)
                {
                    nm.OnConnectionEvent -= OnConnectionEvent;
                    nm.OnClientStarted -= OnClientStarted;
                    nm.OnServerStopped -= OnServerStopped;
                    nm.OnClientStopped -= OnClientStopped;
                    _subscribed = false;
                }

                await NetworkManagerAwait.ShutdownAsync(nm);
            }

            _approver?.Uninstall();
            _approver = null;
            _config.Bridge.Clear();
            _ugsIdByClient.Clear();
        }

        private static async Task LeaveQuietlyAsync(ISession session)
        {
            try
            {
                await UgsAsync.WithTimeoutAsync(session.LeaveAsync(), CancellationToken.None);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[UGS] ISession.LeaveAsync failed (ignored): {e}");
            }
        }

        // Keeps the session handle even when the caller timed out or cancelled, so teardown can leave it.
        // A call that finishes after its attempt was torn down is left at once.
        private async Task TrackSessionAsync<T>(Task<T> call, int attempt) where T : ISession
        {
            ISession session;
            try
            {
                session = await call;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                if (attempt != _attemptId || _sessionReleased)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"[UGS] Late session call failed after its attempt ended (ignored): {e}");
                }

                return; // the attempt itself logs and maps the error
            }

            if (session == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (attempt == _attemptId && !_sessionReleased)
            {
                _session = session;
                return;
            }

            Debug.LogWarning("[UGS] A session call finished after its attempt ended. Leaving that session.");
            await LeaveQuietlyAsync(session);
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Implement `UgsNetworkSession` part 3 (full file)**

Create `Assets/_Project/Networking/UgsNetworkSession.NgoEvents.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.Core;
using Unity.Netcode;
using Unity.Services.Multiplayer;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Networking
{
    // Part of UgsNetworkSession (see UgsNetworkSession.cs for the authority comment and recorded findings):
    // NGO callbacks. They run on the main thread. Split only to keep each file under ~300 lines.
    public sealed partial class UgsNetworkSession
    {
        private void OnConnectionEvent(NetworkManager nm, ConnectionEventData data)
        {
            if (_endTcs != null)
            {
                return; // ending: teardown clears the bridge and the seat cache
            }

            if (!_isHost)
            {
                if (_sm.State == ConnState.Connecting
                    && data.EventType == ConnectionEvent.ClientConnected
                    && data.ClientId == nm.LocalClientId)
                {
                    _sm.Fire(ConnEvent.Established);
                }

                return;
            }

            if (data.ClientId == NetworkManager.ServerClientId)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (data.EventType == ConnectionEvent.ClientConnected)
            {
                // Cache the UGS PlayerId now, so the seat can be freed even if SessionState forgets the client first.
                if (TryResolveKey(data.ClientId, out var key) && key.Kind == IdentityKind.Ugs)
                {
                    _ugsIdByClient[data.ClientId] = key.Id;
                }
            }
            else if (data.EventType == ConnectionEvent.ClientDisconnected)
            {
                if (!_ugsIdByClient.TryGetValue(data.ClientId, out var playerId))
                {
                    playerId = TryResolveKey(data.ClientId, out var key) && key.Kind == IdentityKind.Ugs ? key.Id : null;
                }

                _ugsIdByClient.Remove(data.ClientId);
                _config.Bridge.RemovePending(data.ClientId);

                // Free the Lobby seat, or a rejoin would fail as "full" (spec 6.3).
                var host = _host;
                if (host != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(playerId))
                {
                    _ = RemoveSeatAsync(host, playerId);
                }
            }
        }

        private bool TryResolveKey(ulong clientId, out PlayerKey key)
        {
            var bridge = _config.Bridge;
            var provider = bridge.Provider;
            if (provider != null && provider.TryGetKey(clientId, out key))
            {
                return true;
            }

            bridge.GetPending(_pendingScratch); // clears the list first
            foreach (var pending in _pendingScratch)
            {
                if (pending.ClientId == clientId)
                {
                    key = pending.Key;
                    return true;
                }
            }

            key = default;
            return false;
        }

        private static async Task RemoveSeatAsync(IHostSession host, string playerId)
        {
            try
            {
                await UgsAsync.WithTimeoutAsync(host.RemovePlayerAsync(playerId), CancellationToken.None);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[UGS] RemovePlayerAsync({playerId}) failed (ignored): {e}");
            }
        }

        // DisconnectClassifier's timing window counts from the NGO client start, not from sign-in.
        private void OnClientStarted()
        {
            if (!_isHost)
            {
                _clock = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
            }
        }

        private void OnServerStopped(bool wasClient)
        {
            OnNgoStopped(EndReason.TransportFailure);
        }

        // NGO 2.13.3 raises OnClientStopped before OnServerStopped, and a host is also a client.
        // The host ignores this one so it ends with TransportFailure from OnServerStopped, never HostLeft.
        private void OnClientStopped(bool wasHost)
        {
            if (wasHost || _isHost)
            {
                return;
            }

            var reason = DisconnectClassifier.Classify(
                false,
                _sm.State == ConnState.Connected,
                _config.NetworkManager.DisconnectReason,
                _clock == null ? 0.0 : _clock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds);
            OnNgoStopped(reason);
        }

        // NGO stopped on its own. Our own teardown is ignored (the end has started by then).
        // While Connecting only the reason is recorded: the running attempt fails with it.
        // While Connected the end runs one frame later, outside NGO's shutdown callback.
        private void OnNgoStopped(EndReason reason)
        {
            if (_endTcs != null)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (!_ngoStopReason.HasValue)
            {
                _ngoStopReason = reason;
            }

            if (_sm.State == ConnState.Connected)
            {
                _ = EndNextFrameAsync(_attemptId);
            }
        }

        private async Task EndNextFrameAsync(int attempt)
        {
            await Task.Yield();
            if (attempt == _attemptId && _ngoStopReason.HasValue)
            {
                await End(_ngoStopReason.Value, true);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Internal additions, assembly-private, so no contract change:
- `internal static class SessionText`.
- `internal bool SessionState.ServerAbsorbApproved(ulong clientId)`.

`Current` is written as `public static X Current => current;` over a private static field. That has the `{ get; }` shape the contract lists.

**Why `ServerAbsorbApproved` exists.** Do not remove it.
- A late joiner (every MPPM clone in dev-direct) reaches the server's `OnSynchronizeComplete` **before** `ClientConnected`.
- If the roster upsert happened only on `ClientConnected`, PlayerSpawner would find no slot for the joiner and disconnect it.
- So PlayerSpawner calls `ServerAbsorbApproved(clientId)` before it reads the slot. That moves the pending `ApprovedJoin` from the bridge into the roster.
- When `ClientConnected` arrives later, it calls the same method, which finds nothing pending and does nothing.

**Scope mapping (what T10 contributes):**
- **Spec 6.5:**
  - Host-only player spawns at the slot's dock point with `destroyWithScene: true, isPlayerObject: true`.
  - Everyone spawns on `OnLoadEventCompleted`. Late joiners spawn on `OnSynchronizeComplete`.
  - Clients in `clientsTimedOut` are disconnected with reason `Timeout`.
  - "Close joins before LoadScene" is **not** done in M1. Dev-direct clients join after the host is in Spot_LakeDock. Joins open/closed is only the dev toggle (`ServerSetJoinsOpen`, called by T14).
- **Spec 6.6 reclaim:**
  - `JoinRules` (T3) and `ConnectionApprover` (T8) choose the slot.
  - T10 applies the verdict: `Upsert` replaces the entry that holds that slot.
  - T10 keeps disconnected entries (`Connected = false`) so they can be reclaimed, and spawns the player at its slot.
- **Spec 6.8 M1 authority rows:**
  - Roster and slots (H): `Roster`, written only by the host.
  - Joins open (H): `NetJoinsOpen`, written only by the host.
  - Display name and slot (H): `ServerRenameClient`, plus `IServerPlayerInit.ServerInit`, which T11's `PlayerNetState` implements by writing `NetSlot` and `NetDisplayName`.
- **Spec 7.4 slot colours and nameplates:**
  - T10 owns only the slot number (0..3) and the roster name.
  - `PlayerBody` (T11) applies the colour from `NetSlot` using the `M_Body_Slot0..3` materials (T15).
  - `NameplateOverlay` (T14) draws the nameplate.
  - **Do not add colour or UI code in T10.**
- **Spec 4.6 NetSpawnAnchor rule:** the host spawns each `NetSpawnAnchor.All` prefab in this scene once per gameplay scene load, with `destroyWithScene: true`, at the anchor's pose.
- **Acceptance criteria this code enables** (proven in T16/T17):
  - 3: a roster of 4 with slots, which drive the colours.
  - 6: `JoinsOpen` is read by the approver through `IJoinContextProvider`.
  - 7: `ClientDisconnected` marks the entry disconnected on every peer through the replicated roster, and NGO despawns the player object because `isPlayerObject` is set.
  - 8: the disconnected slot is kept, the same identity reclaims it, and the player spawns at that slot.

**Known behaviour (no action needed):**
- `ServerInit` runs right after `InstantiateAndSpawn`, so `NetSlot` and `NetDisplayName` reach remote peers as a delta shortly after the spawn. T11 handles this through `SlotChanged` and `DisplayNameChanged`.
- `PlayerSlot.Name` holds at most 29 UTF-8 bytes, and `NetPlayerId.Id` at most 61. `SessionText` truncates by bytes so the FixedString constructors never throw. Real ids (UGS ids, GUID "N" strings) are short ASCII.

#### Step 2: Write `SessionText.cs`

```csharp
// Session-internal text helpers. Fixed-string capacities are UTF-8 bytes (FixedString32Bytes = 29, FixedString64Bytes = 61),
// and the string constructors throw in the editor when the text is too long, so text is truncated by bytes first.
using System.Text;
using Unity.Collections;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    internal static class SessionText
    {
        public const int NameCapacityBytes = 29; // FixedString32Bytes
        public const int IdCapacityBytes = 61;   // FixedString64Bytes

        public static string FitBytes(string text, int maxBytes)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) return string.Empty;
            var s = text;
            while (s.Length > 0 && Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(s) > maxBytes)
            {
                int cut = s.Length - 1;
                // Never split a surrogate pair.
                if (cut > 0 && char.IsLowSurrogate(s[cut]) && char.IsHighSurrogate(s[cut - 1])) cut--;
                s = s.Substring(0, cut);
            }
            return s;
        }

        public static FixedString32Bytes Name(string text)
        {
            return new FixedString32Bytes(FitBytes(text, NameCapacityBytes));
        }

        public static FixedString64Bytes Id(string text)
        {
            return new FixedString64Bytes(FitBytes(text, IdCapacityBytes));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Authority: host writes (through SessionState); every peer reads. Unmanaged wire form of FishGame.Core.PlayerKey.
using System;
using FishGame.Core;
using Unity.Collections;
using Unity.Netcode;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    public struct NetPlayerId : INetworkSerializable, IEquatable<NetPlayerId>
    {
        public byte Kind;
        public FixedString64Bytes Id;

        public static NetPlayerId From(PlayerKey key)
        {
            return new NetPlayerId
            {
                Kind = (byte)key.Kind,
                Id = SessionText.Id(key.Id),
            };
        }

        public PlayerKey ToKey()
        {
            return new PlayerKey((IdentityKind)Kind, Id.ToString());
        }

        public void NetworkSerialize<T>(BufferSerializer<T> serializer) where T : IReaderWriter
        {
            serializer.SerializeValue(ref Kind);
            serializer.SerializeValue(ref Id);
        }

        public bool Equals(NetPlayerId other)
        {
            return Kind == other.Kind && Id.Equals(other.Id);
        }

        public override bool Equals(object obj)
        {
            return obj is NetPlayerId other && Equals(other);
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            return (Kind * 397) ^ Id.GetHashCode();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Authority: host writes (through SessionState); every peer reads. One roster row; unmanaged so it can live in a NetworkList.
using System;
using Unity.Collections;
using Unity.Netcode;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    public struct PlayerSlot : INetworkSerializable, IEquatable<PlayerSlot>
    {
        public ulong ClientId;
        public NetPlayerId Id;
        public FixedString32Bytes Name;
        public byte Slot;
        public bool Connected;
        public bool Ready;

        public void NetworkSerialize<T>(BufferSerializer<T> serializer) where T : IReaderWriter
        {
            serializer.SerializeValue(ref ClientId);
            serializer.SerializeValue(ref Id);
            serializer.SerializeValue(ref Name);
            serializer.SerializeValue(ref Slot);
            serializer.SerializeValue(ref Connected);
            serializer.SerializeValue(ref Ready);
        }

        public bool Equals(PlayerSlot other)
        {
            return ClientId == other.ClientId
                && Id.Equals(other.Id)
                && Name.Equals(other.Name)
                && Slot == other.Slot
                && Connected == other.Connected
                && Ready == other.Ready;
        }

        public override bool Equals(object obj)
        {
            return obj is PlayerSlot other && Equals(other);
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            return HashCode.Combine(ClientId, Id.GetHashCode(), Slot, Connected, Ready);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Authority: host writes Roster and NetJoinsOpen; every peer reads. Spawned by AppBootstrap on OnServerStarted with destroyWithScene: false.
// Roster entries are never removed in M1: a disconnected entry keeps its slot (Connected = false) so the same identity can reclaim it.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    public sealed class SessionState : NetworkBehaviour, IJoinContextProvider
    {
        private static SessionState current;

        private JoinApprovalBridge bridge;
        private NetworkManager subscribedManager;

        public static SessionState Current => current;
        public static event Action<SessionState> CurrentChanged;

        public NetworkList<PlayerSlot> Roster;
        public readonly NetworkVariable<bool> NetJoinsOpen = new NetworkVariable<bool>(
            true, NetworkVariableReadPermission.Everyone, NetworkVariableWritePermission.Server);

        public event Action RosterChanged;

        public bool JoinsOpen => NetJoinsOpen.Value;

        public int ConnectedCount
        {
            get
            {
                int n = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < Roster.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (Roster[i].Connected) n++;
                }
                return n;
            }
        }

        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        private static void ResetStatics()
        {
            current = null;
            CurrentChanged = null;
        }

        private void Awake()
        {
            // Constructed here, not in a field initializer (contract F21).
            Roster = new NetworkList<PlayerSlot>(null,
                NetworkVariableReadPermission.Everyone, NetworkVariableWritePermission.Server);
        }

        public override void OnNetworkSpawn()
        {
            current = this;
            Roster.OnListChanged += OnRosterListChanged;
            NetJoinsOpen.OnValueChanged += OnJoinsOpenChanged;

            if (IsServer)
            {
                var app = ServiceRoots.App;
                if (app != null && app.TryGet<JoinApprovalBridge>(out var found))
                {
                    bridge = found;
                    bridge.Provider = this;
                }
                else
                {
                    Debug.LogError("SessionState: JoinApprovalBridge is not registered in ServiceRoots.App; the roster will stay empty.");
                }

                subscribedManager = NetworkManager;
                subscribedManager.OnConnectionEvent += OnConnectionEvent;

                // Clients approved before this object spawned. Host self-approval runs inside StartHost, before OnServerStarted.
                var ids = new List<ulong>(subscribedManager.ConnectedClientsIds);
                for (int i = 0; i < ids.Count; i++)
                {
                    ServerAbsorbApproved(ids[i]);
                }
            }

            CurrentChanged?.Invoke(this);
            RosterChanged?.Invoke();
        }

        public override void OnNetworkDespawn()
        {
            if (subscribedManager != null)
            {
                subscribedManager.OnConnectionEvent -= OnConnectionEvent;
                subscribedManager = null;
            }

            if (bridge != null)
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(bridge.Provider, this)) bridge.Provider = null;
                bridge = null;
            }

            Roster.OnListChanged -= OnRosterListChanged;
            NetJoinsOpen.OnValueChanged -= OnJoinsOpenChanged;

            if (ReferenceEquals(current, this))
            {
                current = null;
                CurrentChanged?.Invoke(null);
            }
        }

        // Clears `into`, then adds every entry (connected or not).
        public void GetRoster(List<RosterEntry> into)
        {
            into.Clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < Roster.Count; i++)
            {
                var e = Roster[i];
                into.Add(new RosterEntry(e.Id.ToKey(), e.Slot, e.Connected));
            }
        }

        // Connected or disconnected entries.
        public bool TryGetKey(ulong clientId, out PlayerKey key)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < Roster.Count; i++)
            {
                var e = Roster[i];
                if (e.ClientId == clientId)
                {
                    key = e.Id.ToKey();
                    return true;
                }
            }
            key = default;
            return false;
        }

        // Connected entries only.
        public bool TryGetByClient(ulong clientId, out PlayerSlot slot)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < Roster.Count; i++)
            {
                var e = Roster[i];
                if (e.Connected && e.ClientId == clientId)
                {
                    slot = e;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            slot = default;
            return false;
        }

        // Connected or disconnected entries (a disconnected slot is kept for reclaim).
        public bool TryGetBySlot(byte slot, out PlayerSlot entry)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < Roster.Count; i++)
            {
                var e = Roster[i];
                if (e.Slot == slot)
                {
                    entry = e;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            entry = default;
            return false;
        }

        // Dev toggle (T14 pause menu). Read by ConnectionApprover through IJoinContextProvider.JoinsOpen.
        public void ServerSetJoinsOpen(bool open)
        {
            if (!IsSpawned || !IsServer) throw new InvalidOperationException("ServerSetJoinsOpen is host-only.");
            NetJoinsOpen.Value = open;
        }

        // Called by PlayerActions.SubmitNameRpc (T11) with an already sanitized name.
        public void ServerRenameClient(ulong clientId, string sanitizedName)
        {
            if (!IsSpawned || !IsServer) throw new InvalidOperationException("ServerRenameClient is host-only.");
            for (int i = 0; i < Roster.Count; i++)
            {
                var e = Roster[i];
                if (!e.Connected || e.ClientId != clientId) continue;
                e.Name = SessionText.Name(sanitizedName);
                Roster[i] = e;
                return;
            }
        }

        // Host only. Moves this client's pending ApprovedJoin (if any) from the bridge into the roster.
        // NGO raises OnSynchronizeComplete BEFORE ClientConnected for a joining client, so PlayerSpawner calls this
        // before reading the slot; the later ClientConnected call then finds nothing pending and does nothing.
        internal bool ServerAbsorbApproved(ulong clientId)
        {
            if (!IsSpawned || !IsServer || bridge == null) return false;
            if (!bridge.TryTakeApproved(clientId, out var join)) return false;
            Upsert(join);
            return true;
        }

        private void OnConnectionEvent(NetworkManager manager, ConnectionEventData data)
        {
            if (!IsSpawned || !IsServer) return;

            if (data.EventType == ConnectionEvent.ClientConnected)
            {
                ServerAbsorbApproved(data.ClientId);
            }
            else if (data.EventType == ConnectionEvent.ClientDisconnected)
            {
                MarkDisconnected(data.ClientId);
            }
        }

        // Host only. The entry holding join.Slot is replaced in place (reclaim, or taking over a disconnected slot); otherwise append.
        private void Upsert(ApprovedJoin join)
        {
            var entry = new PlayerSlot
            {
                ClientId = join.ClientId,
                Id = NetPlayerId.From(join.Key),
                Name = SessionText.Name(DisplayNameRules.Sanitize(join.Name, join.Slot)),
                Slot = join.Slot,
                Connected = true,
                Ready = false,
            };

            for (int i = 0; i < Roster.Count; i++)
            {
                if (Roster[i].Slot == join.Slot)
                {
                    Roster[i] = entry;
                    return;
                }
            }

            Roster.Add(entry);
        }

        // Host only. Keeps the slot for reclaim; clears Connected and Ready.
        private void MarkDisconnected(ulong clientId)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < Roster.Count; i++)
            {
                var e = Roster[i];
                if (!e.Connected || e.ClientId != clientId) continue;
                e.Connected = false;
                e.Ready = false;
                Roster[i] = e;
                return;
            }
        }

        private void OnRosterListChanged(NetworkListEvent<PlayerSlot> change)
        {
            RosterChanged?.Invoke();
        }

        private void OnJoinsOpenChanged(bool previous, bool next)
        {
            RosterChanged?.Invoke();
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] Write `Assets/_Project/Gameplay/Spawning/PlayerSpawner.cs` with exactly this content:
```csharp
// Authority: host only. Spawns players and NetSpawnAnchor prefabs; every peer can query spawn poses.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    public sealed class PlayerSpawner : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private NetworkObject playerPrefab;
        [SerializeField] private Transform[] spawnPoints; // index = slot; 4 entries (Spawn0..Spawn3), set by SceneBuilder (T15)

        private static PlayerSpawner current;

        private NetworkManager subscribedManager;
        private NetworkSceneManager subscribedScenes;
        private bool anchorsSpawned;

        public static PlayerSpawner Current => current;

        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        private static void ResetStatics()
        {
            current = null;
        }

        // Builder (T15).
        public void Configure(NetworkObject playerPrefab, Transform[] spawnPoints)
        {
            this.playerPrefab = playerPrefab;
            this.spawnPoints = spawnPoints;
        }

        public bool TryGetSpawnPose(byte slot, out Vector3 position, out Quaternion rotation)
        {
            if (spawnPoints != null && slot < spawnPoints.Length && spawnPoints[slot] != null)
            {
                var point = spawnPoints[slot];
                position = point.position;
                rotation = point.rotation;
                return true;
            }

            position = Vector3.zero;
            rotation = Quaternion.identity;
            return false;
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            current = this;

            var manager = NetworkManager.Singleton;
            if (manager == null || manager.SceneManager == null) return;

            subscribedManager = manager;
            subscribedScenes = manager.SceneManager;
            subscribedScenes.OnLoadEventCompleted += OnLoadEventCompleted;
            subscribedScenes.OnSynchronizeComplete += OnSynchronizeComplete;
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            if (subscribedScenes != null)
            {
                subscribedScenes.OnLoadEventCompleted -= OnLoadEventCompleted;
                subscribedScenes.OnSynchronizeComplete -= OnSynchronizeComplete;
            }
            subscribedScenes = null;
            subscribedManager = null;

            if (ReferenceEquals(current, this)) current = null;
        }

        private void OnLoadEventCompleted(string sceneName, LoadSceneMode loadSceneMode,
            List<ulong> clientsCompleted, List<ulong> clientsTimedOut)
        {
            var manager = subscribedManager;
            if (manager == null || !manager.IsServer) return;
            if (sceneName != gameObject.scene.name) return;

            // Spec 6.5: disconnect clients that timed out loading. The list can contain the host (load not done)
            // and clients that already left, so skip both.
            var timedOut = new List<ulong>(clientsTimedOut);
            for (int i = 0; i < timedOut.Count; i++)
            {
                var id = timedOut[i];
                if (id == NetworkManager.ServerClientId) continue;
                if (!manager.ConnectedClients.ContainsKey(id)) continue;
                manager.DisconnectClient(id, EndReason.Timeout.ToString());
            }

            // Spec 4.6: once per scene load, spawn every anchor's prefab in this scene.
            if (!anchorsSpawned)
            {
                anchorsSpawned = true;
                SpawnAnchors(manager);
            }

            // clientsCompleted contains the host once its own load is done; spawning the host explicitly is idempotent.
            if (manager.IsHost) SpawnPlayerIfMissing(manager, NetworkManager.ServerClientId);

            var completed = new List<ulong>(clientsCompleted);
            for (int i = 0; i < completed.Count; i++)
            {
                var id = completed[i];
                if (id == NetworkManager.ServerClientId) continue;
                if (!manager.ConnectedClients.ContainsKey(id)) continue;
                SpawnPlayerIfMissing(manager, id);
            }
        }

        // Late joiners: the server raises this when a joining client finishes its initial scene sync
        // (before the ClientConnected connection event for that client).
        private void OnSynchronizeComplete(ulong clientId)
        {
            var manager = subscribedManager;
            if (manager == null || !manager.IsServer) return;
            if (clientId == NetworkManager.ServerClientId) return;
            if (!gameObject.scene.isLoaded) return;

            SpawnPlayerIfMissing(manager, clientId);
        }

        private void SpawnAnchors(NetworkManager manager)
        {
            var anchors = new List<NetSpawnAnchor>(NetSpawnAnchor.All);
            for (int i = 0; i < anchors.Count; i++)
            {
                var anchor = anchors[i];
                if (anchor == null) continue;
                if (anchor.gameObject.scene != gameObject.scene) continue;
                if (anchor.Prefab == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"PlayerSpawner: NetSpawnAnchor '{anchor.name}' has no prefab.", anchor);
                    continue;
                }

                var t = anchor.transform;
                var spawned = manager.SpawnManager.InstantiateAndSpawn(
                    anchor.Prefab,
                    ownerClientId: NetworkManager.ServerClientId,
                    destroyWithScene: true,
                    position: t.position,
                    rotation: t.rotation);
                if (spawned == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"PlayerSpawner: failed to spawn '{anchor.Prefab.name}' at anchor '{anchor.name}'.", anchor);
                }
            }
        }

        // Idempotent: a client that already has a player object is skipped.
        private void SpawnPlayerIfMissing(NetworkManager manager, ulong clientId)
        {
            if (manager.SpawnManager.GetPlayerNetworkObject(clientId) != null) return;

            if (playerPrefab == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("PlayerSpawner: playerPrefab is not configured.", this);
                return;
            }

            var session = SessionState.Current;
            if (session == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"PlayerSpawner: no SessionState is spawned; cannot spawn client {clientId}.", this);
                return;
            }

            // Pull the pending approval into the roster first (OnSynchronizeComplete runs before ClientConnected).
            session.ServerAbsorbApproved(clientId);

            if (!session.TryGetByClient(clientId, out var entry))
            {
                if (clientId == NetworkManager.ServerClientId)
                {
                    Debug.LogError("PlayerSpawner: the host has no connected roster slot.", this);
                    return;
                }

                Debug.LogWarning($"PlayerSpawner: client {clientId} has no connected roster slot. Disconnecting.", this);
                if (manager.ConnectedClients.ContainsKey(clientId))
                {
                    manager.DisconnectClient(clientId, EndReason.Unknown.ToString());
                }
                return;
            }

            if (!TryGetSpawnPose(entry.Slot, out var position, out var rotation))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"PlayerSpawner: no spawn point for slot {entry.Slot}.", this);
                return;
            }

            var playerObject = manager.SpawnManager.InstantiateAndSpawn(
                playerPrefab,
                ownerClientId: clientId,
                destroyWithScene: true,
                isPlayerObject: true,
                position: position,
                rotation: rotation);
            if (playerObject == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"PlayerSpawner: InstantiateAndSpawn returned null for client {clientId}.", this);
                return;
            }

            var init = playerObject.GetComponent<IServerPlayerInit>();
            if (init == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"PlayerSpawner: '{playerPrefab.name}' has no IServerPlayerInit component.", this);
                return;
            }

            init.ServerInit(entry.Slot, entry.Name.ToString());
        }
    }
}
```

**Why this task has no unit test (read before starting).**
- The EditMode test asmdef does not reference `FishGame.Gameplay` (contract §4), and asmdefs are frozen to T1 (§2.6).
- Every type here is a MonoBehaviour or NetworkBehaviour that needs a scene, a prefab or a running NGO.
- PlayMode tests belong to T16 and need T15's prefabs and scenes.
- Contract §2.4 therefore gates this task by `compile`, not by red/green tests. Do not add test files, do not add asmdef references, and do not try to write a test here.
- The pure math is already tested by T2 (`MovementMathTests`, `JumpAssistTests`, `PitchQuantTests`). The behaviour here is proven later by T16 (`Solo_Start_SpawnsOneOwnedPlayerWithCamera`, `FakeInput_MoveForward_MovesPlayerMoreThanOneMeterInOneSecond`, `TeleportRpc_OnDeck_LandsWithinFiveCentimetersWithZeroVelocity`) and by the T17 manual checklist.

**Verified against the NGO 2.13.3 and Collections 6.6.0 sources. These are facts; do not second-guess them:**
- `NetworkVariableUpdateTraits` is a **struct** with the public field `MinSecondsBetweenUpdates`.
  - `NetworkVariableBase.SetUpdateTraits(NetworkVariableUpdateTraits)` is public.
  - `Initialize` does not reset the traits, so calling `SetUpdateTraits` in `Awake` is correct.
- `NetworkBehaviourReference(NetworkBehaviour)` is a constructor. It has `TryGet<T>(out T, NetworkManager = null) where T : NetworkBehaviour`. `target.TryGet(out NetworkInteractable i)` binds to the generic overload.
- `NetworkTransform.CanCommitToTransform` is a public getter.
  - `Teleport(Vector3, Quaternion, Vector3)` throws when `CanCommitToTransform` is false.
  - When it is true, `Teleport` writes `transform` immediately.
- On `NetworkBehaviour`:
  - `OnNetworkSpawn()` and `OnNetworkDespawn()` are `public virtual`. `OnDestroy()` is `public virtual` too: override it and call `base.OnDestroy()`.
  - `NetworkBehaviour` declares no `Awake`, `OnEnable` or `Update`, so `private void Awake()` is fine.
  - `IsOwner`, `IsServer`, `IsSpawned` and `OwnerClientId` are public getters.
- NGO sets `IsSpawned` on **every** NetworkBehaviour of an object before it calls any `OnNetworkSpawn`. So `PlayerNetState.OnNetworkSpawn` may call `PlayerActions.SubmitNameRpc`.
- An RPC throws `RpcException` if it is sent while not spawned, or sent without the required ownership or server role. The receiver enforces `InvokePermission`.
- `NetworkVariable<T>.OnValueChanged` is a public field of type `OnValueChangedDelegate(T previousValue, T newValue)`. It fires on the writer too, so the host's own `ServerInit` write fires it.
- `new FixedString32Bytes(string)` and the implicit `string → FixedString32Bytes` conversion **throw `ArgumentException` on truncation**. The capacity is 29 UTF-8 bytes. `FixedStringMethods.CopyFromTruncated(ref this T, string)` (namespace `Unity.Collections`) truncates at a code-point boundary and never throws. Always go through `NameWire.ToFixed`.

**Lifecycle and authority rules (apply everywhere):**
- **Awake and OnEnable.** `Awake` caches component references. Unity calls `Awake` even on a disabled component while its GameObject is active. Services (`ServiceRoots.*`) are resolved in `OnEnable`, `OnNetworkSpawn` or `Update`, never in field initializers.
  - `PlayerLocomotion`, `PlayerCamera` and `PlayerInteractor` re-resolve `IInputService` from `ServiceRoots.App` every frame. A test that calls `Replace<IInputService>` at any time is then picked up.
- **Host ordering.** On the host, `OnNetworkSpawn` runs inside `InstantiateAndSpawn`, before `PlayerSpawner` calls `ServerInit`. The host-local `SubmitNameRpc` also runs then. `PlayerBody` therefore follows `SlotChanged` and does not rely only on the value it reads at bind time.
- **Owner-only components** are enabled in code by `PlayerNetState`. The prefab (T15, contract §6.3) ships them disabled: `CharacterController`, `PlayerLocomotion`, `PlayerCamera`, `PlayerInteractor`, and the `Camera` and `AudioListener` on `HeadPivot/Shake/Camera`. Remotes enable only the `CapsuleCollider`. On despawn the owner disables all of them before raising `LocalPlayerChanged(null)`, so there are never two live AudioListeners.
- **One writer for `HeadPivot` per peer:** `PlayerCamera` on the owner, `PlayerBody` (smoothed `NetPitchQ`) on remotes.
- **Movement authority.** Only the owner moves its own root. The host never moves players. `TeleportRpc` asks the owner to move.
- **Statics.** Static lists, static events and statics are reset with `[RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]`. PlayMode tests share one domain.
- **No stale state after a leave.**
  - `PlayerInteractor.OnDisable` publishes `InteractPromptChanged(null, false)`.
  - `PlayerLocomotion.OnDisable` writes `GameplayContext = Free`, so no Swimming or Climbing context survives a leave.
- **Null checks on Unity objects.** Guard every `PlayerSpawner.Current`, `SessionState.Current` and `TryGet` result with an explicit `!= null`. Never use `?.` on Unity objects.
- **Banned identifiers and references.**
  - Never write a bare `Input.` identifier. `_input.` is fine. Never name anything `Input` or `Editor`.
  - Never use `System.Numerics`.
  - Never reference `Unity.Services.*`, `Unity.Netcode.Transports`, `InputAction` or URP types from this assembly. `UnityEngine.Rendering.ShadowCastingMode` is core Unity, not URP, so it is allowed.
- **Type names that clash with members.**
  - Inside `PlayerCamera`, the property `Camera` shadows the type. Always write `UnityEngine.Camera` for the type and its statics.
  - Write `UnityEngine.Random` explicitly.
- **Prompt text.** `GetPrompt` is published raw, without the key glyph. T14 composes the key.

`Assets/_Project/Gameplay/Player/NameWire.cs`:
```csharp
using System.Text;
using Unity.Collections;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    // Authority: none (pure helper). Converts a display name to FixedString32Bytes without ever throwing.
    // DisplayNameRules.Sanitize caps at 16 chars, which can exceed the 29 usable UTF-8 bytes for non-ASCII text, and
    // new FixedString32Bytes(string) throws on truncation. Lone UTF-16 surrogates are dropped; the rest is copied with
    // CopyFromTruncated, which cuts at a code-point boundary.
    internal static class NameWire
    {
        public static FixedString32Bytes ToFixed(string text)
        {
            FixedString32Bytes result = default;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
            {
                return result;
            }

            var clean = new StringBuilder(text.Length);
            for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
            {
                char c = text[i];
                if (char.IsHighSurrogate(c))
                {
                    if (i + 1 < text.Length && char.IsLowSurrogate(text[i + 1]))
                    {
                        clean.Append(c);
                        clean.Append(text[i + 1]);
                        i++;
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                if (char.IsLowSurrogate(c))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                clean.Append(c);
            }

            result.CopyFromTruncated(clean.ToString());
            return result;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    // Authority: none (static world geometry, identical on every peer). Registry of water trigger boxes.
    // PlayerLocomotion uses FindContaining for swim and wade detection (contract D25: collider bounds, not OnTrigger).
    // Needs exactly one trigger BoxCollider on the same GameObject (added by SceneBuilder; no RequireComponent on purpose,
    // so a builder that adds this script first can never end up with a second, solid box collider).
    public sealed class WaterVolume : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private static readonly List<WaterVolume> s_all = new List<WaterVolume>();
        private BoxCollider _box;

        public static IReadOnlyList<WaterVolume> All => s_all;

        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        private static void ResetStatics()
        {
            s_all.Clear();
        }

        private void Awake()
        {
            _box = GetComponent<BoxCollider>();
            if (_box == null)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"WaterVolume '{name}' has no BoxCollider.", this);
            }
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            if (!s_all.Contains(this))
            {
                s_all.Add(this);
            }
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            s_all.Remove(this);
        }

        // World-space AABB of the BoxCollider.
        public bool Contains(Vector3 point)
        {
            if (_box == null)
            {
                _box = GetComponent<BoxCollider>();
            }

            return _box != null && _box.bounds.Contains(point);
        }

        public static WaterVolume FindContaining(Vector3 point)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < s_all.Count; i++)
            {
                WaterVolume volume = s_all[i];
                if (volume != null && volume.Contains(point))
                {
                    return volume;
                }
            }

            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace FishGame.Gameplay
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    // Authority: none (local presentation). The scene camera and its AudioListener are enabled only while this peer has no
    // local player (PlayerNetState.Local == null). Attached to the SceneCamera object of each gameplay scene (contract 6.5).
    // Reads PlayerNetState.Local in OnEnable, then follows LocalPlayerChanged, so it never depends on having seen the event.
    public sealed class SceneCameraSwitch : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private UnityEngine.Camera _camera;
        private AudioListener _listener;

        private void Awake()
        {
            _camera = GetComponent<UnityEngine.Camera>();
            _listener = GetComponent<AudioListener>();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            PlayerNetState.LocalPlayerChanged += Apply;
            Apply(PlayerNetState.Local);
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            PlayerNetState.LocalPlayerChanged -= Apply;
        }

        private void Apply(PlayerNetState local)
        {
            bool sceneActive = local == null;
            if (_camera != null)
            {
                _camera.enabled = sceneActive;
            }

            if (_listener != null)
            {
                _listener.enabled = sceneActive;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using Unity.Collections;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    // Authority: owner writes NetPitchQ and NetSwimming; host writes NetSlot and NetDisplayName. Every peer reads all four.
    // Owner-only components (CharacterController, PlayerLocomotion, PlayerCamera, PlayerInteractor, and the Camera and
    // AudioListener on HeadPivot/Shake/Camera) are enabled here on the owner, never by the prefab. Remotes enable only the
    // CapsuleCollider (layer RemotePlayer) so local players bump remote bodies. Spec 7.2, 7.5; contract 7.12.
    public sealed class PlayerNetState : NetworkBehaviour, IServerPlayerInit
    {
        private const float PitchSendIntervalSeconds = 1f / 15f;
        private const string OfflineDefaultName = "Fisher";

        public readonly NetworkVariable<short> NetPitchQ = new NetworkVariable<short>(0, NetworkVariableReadPermission.Everyone, NetworkVariableWritePermission.Owner);
        public readonly NetworkVariable<byte> NetSlot = new NetworkVariable<byte>(0, NetworkVariableReadPermission.Everyone, NetworkVariableWritePermission.Server);
        public readonly NetworkVariable<FixedString32Bytes> NetDisplayName = new NetworkVariable<FixedString32Bytes>(default, NetworkVariableReadPermission.Everyone, NetworkVariableWritePermission.Server);
        public readonly NetworkVariable<bool> NetSwimming = new NetworkVariable<bool>(false, NetworkVariableReadPermission.Everyone, NetworkVariableWritePermission.Owner);

        private static readonly List<PlayerNetState> s_active = new List<PlayerNetState>();
        private static PlayerNetState s_local;

        public static IReadOnlyList<PlayerNetState> Active => s_active;
        public static PlayerNetState Local => s_local;
        public static event Action<PlayerNetState> LocalPlayerChanged;
        public static event Action<PlayerNetState> Spawned;
        public static event Action<PlayerNetState> Despawned;

        public byte Slot => NetSlot.Value;
        public string DisplayName => NetDisplayName.Value.ToString();
        public bool IsSwimming => NetSwimming.Value;

        public event Action<byte> SlotChanged;
        public event Action<string> DisplayNameChanged;

        private PlayerBody _body;
        private PlayerActions _actions;
        private PlayerLocomotion _locomotion;
        private PlayerCamera _playerCamera;
        private PlayerInteractor _interactor;
        private CharacterController _characterController;
        private CapsuleCollider _capsule;
        private UnityEngine.Camera _povCamera;
        private AudioListener _listener;
        private bool _ownerRigActive;
        private bool _subscribed;
        private short _lastSentPitch;

        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        private static void ResetStatics()
        {
            s_active.Clear();
            s_local = null;
            LocalPlayerChanged = null;
            Spawned = null;
            Despawned = null;
        }

        private void Awake()
        {
            NetPitchQ.SetUpdateTraits(new NetworkVariableUpdateTraits { MinSecondsBetweenUpdates = PitchSendIntervalSeconds });
            _body = GetComponent<PlayerBody>();
            _actions = GetComponent<PlayerActions>();
            _locomotion = GetComponent<PlayerLocomotion>();
            _playerCamera = GetComponent<PlayerCamera>();
            _interactor = GetComponent<PlayerInteractor>();
            _characterController = GetComponent<CharacterController>();
            _capsule = GetComponent<CapsuleCollider>();
            Transform cameraTransform = transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.Camera);
            if (cameraTransform != null)
            {
                _povCamera = cameraTransform.GetComponent<UnityEngine.Camera>();
                _listener = cameraTransform.GetComponent<AudioListener>();
            }
        }

        public override void OnNetworkSpawn()
        {
            base.OnNetworkSpawn();
            gameObject.layer = IsOwner ? Layers.Player : Layers.RemotePlayer;
            if (!s_active.Contains(this))
            {
                s_active.Add(this);
            }

            NetSlot.OnValueChanged += HandleSlotChanged;
            NetDisplayName.OnValueChanged += HandleNameChanged;
            _subscribed = true;

            if (_body != null)
            {
                _body.Bind(this, IsOwner);
            }

            if (IsOwner)
            {
                EnableOwnerRig();
                s_local = this;
                LocalPlayerChanged?.Invoke(this);
                SubmitLocalName();
            }
            else
            {
                SetEnabled(_capsule, true);
            }

            Spawned?.Invoke(this);
        }

        public override void OnNetworkDespawn()
        {
            Unsubscribe();
            if (_body != null)
            {
                _body.Unbind();
            }

            if (_ownerRigActive)
            {
                DisableOwnerRig();
            }

            SetEnabled(_capsule, false);
            s_active.Remove(this);
            if (s_local == this)
            {
                s_local = null;
                LocalPlayerChanged?.Invoke(null);
            }

            Despawned?.Invoke(this);
            base.OnNetworkDespawn();
        }

        public override void OnDestroy()
        {
            // Safety net when an object is destroyed without a despawn callback (domain teardown in tests).
            Unsubscribe();
            s_active.Remove(this);
            if (s_local == this)
            {
                s_local = null;
                LocalPlayerChanged?.Invoke(null);
            }

            base.OnDestroy();
        }

        // Host only. Called by PlayerSpawner right after InstantiateAndSpawn.
        public void ServerInit(byte slot, string displayName)
        {
            if (!IsServer)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("PlayerNetState.ServerInit is host-only.");
            }

            NetSlot.Value = slot;
            NetDisplayName.Value = NameWire.ToFixed(DisplayNameRules.Sanitize(displayName, slot));
        }

        // Host only. Called by PlayerActions.SubmitNameRpc with an already sanitised name.
        public void ServerSetDisplayName(string sanitizedName)
        {
            if (!IsServer)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("PlayerNetState.ServerSetDisplayName is host-only.");
            }

            NetDisplayName.Value = NameWire.ToFixed(sanitizedName);
        }

        // Owner only. Sends only on a change of at least 0.5 degrees (PitchQuant); the update traits cap the rate at 15 Hz.
        public void OwnerSetPitch(float pitchDeg)
        {
            if (!IsSpawned || !IsOwner)
            {
                return;
            }

            short q = PitchQuant.Quantize(pitchDeg);
            if (!PitchQuant.ShouldSend(_lastSentPitch, q))
            {
                return;
            }

            _lastSentPitch = q;
            NetPitchQ.Value = q;
        }

        // Owner only.
        public void OwnerSetSwimming(bool swimming)
        {
            if (!IsSpawned || !IsOwner)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (NetSwimming.Value != swimming)
            {
                NetSwimming.Value = swimming;
            }
        }

        private void EnableOwnerRig()
        {
            _ownerRigActive = true;
            _lastSentPitch = NetPitchQ.Value;
            SetEnabled(_capsule, false);
            SetEnabled(_characterController, true);
            SetEnabled(_locomotion, true);
            SetEnabled(_playerCamera, true);
            SetEnabled(_interactor, true);
            SetEnabled(_povCamera, true);
            SetEnabled(_listener, true);
        }

        private void DisableOwnerRig()
        {
            _ownerRigActive = false;
            SetEnabled(_interactor, false);
            SetEnabled(_locomotion, false);
            SetEnabled(_playerCamera, false);
            SetEnabled(_characterController, false);
            SetEnabled(_listener, false);
            SetEnabled(_povCamera, false);
        }

        private void SubmitLocalName()
        {
            string displayName = OfflineDefaultName;
            ServiceRegistry app = ServiceRoots.App;
            if (app != null && app.TryGet(out ISettings settings) && settings.Current != null)
            {
                displayName = settings.Current.displayName;
            }

            if (_actions != null)
            {
                _actions.SubmitNameRpc(NameWire.ToFixed(DisplayNameRules.Sanitize(displayName, Slot)));
            }
        }

        private void Unsubscribe()
        {
            if (!_subscribed)
            {
                return;
            }

            NetSlot.OnValueChanged -= HandleSlotChanged;
            NetDisplayName.OnValueChanged -= HandleNameChanged;
            _subscribed = false;
        }

        private void HandleSlotChanged(byte previous, byte current)
        {
            SlotChanged?.Invoke(current);
        }

        private void HandleNameChanged(FixedString32Bytes previous, FixedString32Bytes current)
        {
            DisplayNameChanged?.Invoke(current.ToString());
        }

        private static void SetEnabled(Behaviour behaviour, bool on)
        {
            if (behaviour != null)
            {
                behaviour.enabled = on;
            }
        }

        private static void SetEnabled(Collider collider, bool on)
        {
            if (collider != null)
            {
                collider.enabled = on;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using FishGame.Core;
using Unity.Collections;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    // Authority: owner sends intents (SendTo.Server, InvokePermission Owner); host sends replies (SendTo.Owner,
    // InvokePermission Server). Every non-fishing player RPC lives here and each one sets InvokePermission explicitly
    // (spec 6.7, 7.6). The host validates every intent; the owner only asks. NGO enforces InvokePermission on receive.
    public sealed class PlayerActions : NetworkBehaviour
    {
        public const float InteractRangeSlack = 1.0f;

        private PlayerNetState _state;
        private PlayerLocomotion _locomotion;

        private void Awake()
        {
            _state = GetComponent<PlayerNetState>();
            _locomotion = GetComponent<PlayerLocomotion>();
        }

        // Runs on the host. The owner submits its display name from OnNetworkSpawn.
        [Rpc(SendTo.Server, InvokePermission = RpcInvokePermission.Owner)]
        public void SubmitNameRpc(FixedString32Bytes name, RpcParams rpcParams = default)
        {
            if (_state == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            // Round-trip through NameWire so the roster copy (FixedString32Bytes in PlayerSlot) can never overflow.
            string sanitized = NameWire.ToFixed(DisplayNameRules.Sanitize(name.ToString(), _state.Slot)).ToString();
            _state.ServerSetDisplayName(sanitized);
            SessionState session = SessionState.Current;
            if (session != null)
            {
                session.ServerRenameClient(OwnerClientId, sanitized);
            }
        }

        // Runs on the host when the owner presses Interact. The host decides; no line-of-sight check (spec 7.6).
        [Rpc(SendTo.Server, InvokePermission = RpcInvokePermission.Owner)]
        public void InteractRpc(NetworkBehaviourReference target, RpcParams rpcParams = default)
        {
            if (!target.TryGet(out NetworkInteractable interactable) || interactable == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            ulong sender = rpcParams.Receive.SenderClientId;
            if (!interactable.CanInteract(sender))
            {
                return;
            }

            // The host's (interpolated) copy of the sender's head.
            Vector3 eye = transform.position + Vector3.up * MovementMath.EyeHeight;
            if (Vector3.Distance(eye, interactable.InteractPoint) > interactable.Range + InteractRangeSlack)
            {
                return;
            }

            interactable.ServerInteract(sender);
        }

        // Runs on the owner when the host teleports this player. Only the owner may move its own root.
        [Rpc(SendTo.Owner, InvokePermission = RpcInvokePermission.Server)]
        public void TeleportRpc(Vector3 position, float yaw)
        {
            if (_locomotion != null)
            {
                _locomotion.ApplyTeleport(position, yaw);
            }
        }
    }
}
```
