```csharp
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using Unity.Netcode.Components;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    // Authority: owner only. PlayerNetState enables this component (after the CharacterController) on the owning peer.
    // Moves the owner's CharacterController from the routed PlayerIntent; NetworkTransform (AuthorityMode Owner) replicates
    // the result to everyone. The host never moves players. Rules: spec 7.3; contract 7.12, D25, D26, D36.
    // No RequireComponent on purpose: PrefabBuilder (T15) adds the CharacterController itself (contract 6.3).
    public sealed class PlayerLocomotion : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public Vector3 Velocity { get; private set; }
        public bool IsGrounded { get; private set; }
        public bool IsSwimming { get; private set; }
        public bool IsClimbing { get; private set; }
        public float SecondsInWater { get; private set; }

        // Internal: PlayerCamera reads this for the sprint FOV kick.
        internal bool IsSprinting { get; private set; }

        private CharacterController _cc;
        private NetworkTransform _nt;
        private PlayerNetState _net;
        private IInputService _input;
        private JumpAssist _jump;
        private float _vx, _vz;   // horizontal velocity, accelerated toward the wish velocity
        private float _kx, _kz;   // knockback (decays)
        private float _vy;        // vertical velocity
        private float _climbT;
        private Vector3 _climbFrom;
        private Vector3 _climbTo;
        private bool _warnedNoSpawn;

        private void Awake()
        {
            _cc = GetComponent<CharacterController>();
            _nt = GetComponent<NetworkTransform>();
            _net = GetComponent<PlayerNetState>();
            _jump = JumpAssist.Create();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            _input = ResolveInput();
            if (_input == null || _cc == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("PlayerLocomotion: IInputService (ServiceRoots.App) or CharacterController is missing.", this);
                enabled = false;
                return;
            }

            ResetMotion();
            IsGrounded = false;
            IsSwimming = false;
            IsClimbing = false;
            IsSprinting = false;
            SecondsInWater = 0f;
            _warnedNoSpawn = false;
            SetContext();
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            if (IsClimbing && _cc != null)
            {
                _cc.enabled = true;
            }

            IsClimbing = false;
            IsSwimming = false;
            IsSprinting = false;
            SecondsInWater = 0f;
            Velocity = Vector3.zero;

            IInputService input = _input;
            _input = null;
            if (input == null || (input is UnityEngine.Object unityObject && unityObject == null))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (input.GameplayContext != InputContext.Free)
            {
                input.GameplayContext = InputContext.Free;
            }
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            _input = ResolveInput();
            if (_input == null || _cc == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (IsPaused())
            {
                Velocity = Vector3.zero;
                IsSprinting = false;
                return;
            }

            float dt = Time.deltaTime;
            if (dt <= 0f)
            {
                return;
            }

            PlayerIntent intent = _input.Intent;
            transform.Rotate(0f, intent.LookYawDeg, 0f);

            if (IsClimbing)
            {
                UpdateClimb(dt);
                SetContext();
                return;
            }

            if (!_cc.enabled)
            {
                return;
            }

            Vector3 pos = transform.position;
            float surfaceY = WaterSurface.HeightAt(pos.x, pos.z);
            bool inVolume = WaterVolume.FindContaining(pos) != null;
            bool inWater = inVolume && MovementMath.IsInWater(pos.y, surfaceY);
            bool swimming = inVolume && MovementMath.IsSwimmingDepth(pos.y, surfaceY);

            if (inWater && TryBeginClimb(pos, intent))
            {
                SetContext();
                return;
            }

            if (swimming != IsSwimming)
            {
                IsSwimming = swimming;
                if (_net != null)
                {
                    _net.OwnerSetSwimming(swimming);
                }
            }

            bool grounded = _cc.isGrounded;
            IsGrounded = grounded;

            // No sprint in the air or in water (spec 7.3 step 2). Aiming (M2) and carry (M5) are not in M1: false and 0 kg.
            bool sprint = !swimming && grounded && intent.SprintHeld;
            float wish = MovementMath.WishSpeed(sprint, false, swimming, 0f);
            IsSprinting = sprint && (intent.MoveX != 0f || intent.MoveY != 0f);

            Vector3 dir = transform.right * intent.MoveX + transform.forward * intent.MoveY;
            dir.y = 0f;
            if (dir.sqrMagnitude > 1f)
            {
                dir.Normalize();
            }

            bool firmFooting = grounded || swimming;
            MovementMath.Accelerate(ref _vx, ref _vz, dir.x * wish, dir.z * wish,
                firmFooting ? MovementMath.GroundAccel : MovementMath.AirAccel, dt);
            MovementMath.DecayKnockback(ref _kx, ref _kz,
                firmFooting ? MovementMath.KnockbackDecayGround : MovementMath.KnockbackDecayAir, dt);

            float dy;
            if (swimming)
            {
                _jump = JumpAssist.Create();
                _vy = MovementMath.SwimVerticalVelocity(pos.y, surfaceY, _vy, dt);
                dy = _vy * dt;
            }
            else
            {
                if (grounded && _vy < 0f)
                {
                    _vy = MovementMath.GroundedStickVelocity;
                }

                if (_jump.Tick(dt, grounded, intent.JumpPressed))
                {
                    _vy = MovementMath.JumpVelocity(MovementMath.JumpHeight, MovementMath.Gravity);
                }

                dy = MovementMath.VerticalStep(ref _vy, MovementMath.Gravity, MovementMath.TerminalVelocity, dt);
            }

            CollisionFlags flags = _cc.Move(new Vector3((_vx + _kx) * dt, dy, (_vz + _kz) * dt));
            if ((flags & CollisionFlags.Above) != 0 && _vy > 0f)
            {
                _vy = 0f;
            }

            // Applied (post-collision) velocity: about zero while standing, so no phantom -2 m/s from the grounded stick.
            Velocity = _cc.velocity;

            SecondsInWater = swimming ? SecondsInWater + dt : 0f;
            if (transform.position.y < MovementMath.OutOfBoundsY || SecondsInWater > MovementMath.WaterTimeoutSeconds)
            {
                TeleportToSpawn();
            }

            SetContext();
        }

        // Owner only (TeleportRpc, out-of-bounds and water-timeout recovery). The position is applied immediately.
        // Velocity, knockback and the jump assist are cleared.
        public void ApplyTeleport(Vector3 position, float yaw)
        {
            if (_cc == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            bool restoreController = _cc.enabled || IsClimbing;
            _cc.enabled = false;
            Quaternion rotation = Quaternion.Euler(0f, yaw, 0f);
            if (_nt != null && _nt.IsSpawned && _nt.CanCommitToTransform)
            {
                _nt.Teleport(position, rotation, Vector3.one);
            }
            else
            {
                transform.SetPositionAndRotation(position, rotation);
            }

            ResetMotion();
            IsClimbing = false;
            IsGrounded = false;
            SecondsInWater = 0f;
            _cc.enabled = restoreController;
        }

        // M5 hook. Horizontal only in M1.
        public void AddKnockback(Vector3 velocity)
        {
            _kx += velocity.x;
            _kz += velocity.z;
        }

        // Inside a WaterExit: Jump or Interact always climbs; holding forward climbs only when facing the exit's Top,
        // so walking down the ramp into the lake (inside the ramp volume) does not yank the player back out.
        private bool TryBeginClimb(Vector3 pos, PlayerIntent intent)
        {
            WaterExit exit = WaterExit.FindContaining(pos);
            if (exit == null)
            {
                return false;
            }

            Vector3 top = exit.TopPoint;
            bool pressed = intent.JumpPressed || intent.InteractPressed;
            bool pushingToward = false;
            if (intent.MoveY > 0.5f)
            {
                Vector3 toTop = top - pos;
                toTop.y = 0f;
                pushingToward = toTop.sqrMagnitude < 0.0001f || Vector3.Dot(transform.forward, toTop) > 0f;
            }

            if (!pressed && !pushingToward)
            {
                return false;
            }

            BeginClimb(top);
            return true;
        }

        private void BeginClimb(Vector3 target)
        {
            _climbFrom = transform.position;
            _climbTo = target;
            _climbT = 0f;
            ResetMotion();
            IsClimbing = true;
            IsSprinting = false;
            IsGrounded = false;
            _cc.enabled = false;
        }

        private void UpdateClimb(float dt)
        {
            Vector3 before = transform.position;
            _climbT = Mathf.Min(1f, _climbT + dt / MovementMath.ClimbDuration);
            transform.position = Vector3.Lerp(_climbFrom, _climbTo, Mathf.SmoothStep(0f, 1f, _climbT));
            Velocity = (transform.position - before) / dt;
            if (_climbT < 1f)
            {
                return;
            }

            IsClimbing = false;
            IsSwimming = false;
            if (_net != null)
            {
                _net.OwnerSetSwimming(false);
            }

            ResetMotion();
            SecondsInWater = 0f;
            _cc.enabled = true;
        }

        private void TeleportToSpawn()
        {
            PlayerSpawner spawner = PlayerSpawner.Current;
            byte slot = _net != null ? _net.Slot : (byte)0;
            if (spawner != null && spawner.TryGetSpawnPose(slot, out Vector3 position, out Quaternion rotation))
            {
                ApplyTeleport(position, rotation.eulerAngles.y);
                return;
            }

            SecondsInWater = 0f;
            if (!_warnedNoSpawn)
            {
                _warnedNoSpawn = true;
                Debug.LogWarning("PlayerLocomotion: no spawn pose available for out-of-bounds or water-timeout recovery.", this);
            }
        }

        private void ResetMotion()
        {
            _vx = _vz = _kx = _kz = _vy = 0f;
            _jump = JumpAssist.Create();
            Velocity = Vector3.zero;
        }

        private void SetContext()
        {
            if (_input == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            InputContext target = IsClimbing ? InputContext.Climbing
                : IsSwimming ? InputContext.Swimming
                : InputContext.Free;
            if (_input.GameplayContext != target)
            {
                _input.GameplayContext = target;
            }
        }

        private static IInputService ResolveInput()
        {
            ServiceRegistry app = ServiceRoots.App;
            return app != null && app.TryGet(out IInputService input) ? input : null;
        }

        private static bool IsPaused()
        {
            ServiceRegistry game = ServiceRoots.Game;
            return game != null && game.TryGet(out IPauseState pause) && pause.Paused;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    // Authority: owner only (enabled by PlayerNetState on the owning peer, which also enables the Camera and AudioListener).
    // Look pitch is owner-local and replicated through PlayerNetState.OwnerSetPitch (NetPitchQ). FOV, the sprint kick,
    // trauma shake (HeadPivot/Shake, LateUpdate) and head bob are local presentation, all scaled by settings.cameraMotion
    // (spec 7.3). Cursor lock is owned by PlayerInputAdapter (contract D28), not here.
    public sealed class PlayerCamera : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private const float FallbackAspect = 16f / 9f;
        private const float BobMinSpeed = 0.1f;
        private const float BobFadePerSecond = 6f;

        public UnityEngine.Camera Camera { get; private set; }
        public float PitchDeg { get; private set; }

        private Transform _headPivot;
        private Transform _shake;
        private PlayerNetState _net;
        private PlayerLocomotion _locomotion;
        private float _trauma;
        private float _traumaSeed;
        private float _kick;
        private float _bobDistance;
        private float _bobWeight;
        private float _bobY;
        private float _motion = 1f;

        private void Awake()
        {
            _headPivot = transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.HeadPivot);
            _shake = transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.Shake);
            Transform cameraTransform = transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.Camera);
            Camera = cameraTransform != null ? cameraTransform.GetComponent<UnityEngine.Camera>() : null;
            _net = GetComponent<PlayerNetState>();
            _locomotion = GetComponent<PlayerLocomotion>();
            _traumaSeed = UnityEngine.Random.value * 100f;
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            if (_headPivot == null || _shake == null || Camera == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("PlayerCamera: rig is missing HeadPivot, HeadPivot/Shake or the Camera on HeadPivot/Shake/Camera.", this);
                enabled = false;
                return;
            }

            if (ResolveInput() == null || ResolveSettings() == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("PlayerCamera: IInputService or ISettings is not registered in ServiceRoots.App.", this);
                enabled = false;
                return;
            }

            Camera.nearClipPlane = MovementMath.NearClip;
            Camera.farClipPlane = MovementMath.FarClip;
            PitchDeg = 0f;
            _headPivot.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
            _trauma = 0f;
            _kick = 0f;
            _bobWeight = 0f;
            _bobY = 0f;
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            _trauma = 0f;
            _kick = 0f;
            _bobWeight = 0f;
            _bobY = 0f;
            if (_shake != null)
            {
                _shake.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
                _shake.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
            }
        }

        public void AddTrauma(float amount)
        {
            _trauma = Mathf.Clamp01(_trauma + amount);
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            IInputService input = ResolveInput();
            ISettings settings = ResolveSettings();
            if (input == null || settings == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            float dt = Time.deltaTime;
            SettingsData data = settings.Current;
            _motion = data != null ? Mathf.Clamp01(data.cameraMotion) : 1f;
            float horizontalFov = data != null ? Mathf.Clamp(data.fieldOfView, 80f, 110f) : MovementMath.DefaultHorizontalFov;

            // Pitch: positive = look up. HeadPivot rotates about local X (negative X angle tilts up).
            PlayerIntent intent = input.Intent;
            PitchDeg = Mathf.Clamp(PitchDeg + intent.LookPitchDeg, -MovementMath.PitchLimit, MovementMath.PitchLimit);
            _headPivot.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(-PitchDeg, 0f, 0f);
            if (_net != null)
            {
                _net.OwnerSetPitch(PitchDeg);
            }

            // FOV from the horizontal setting, recomputed every frame so an aspect change is picked up.
            float aspect = Camera.aspect;
            if (float.IsNaN(aspect) || float.IsInfinity(aspect) || aspect <= 0f)
            {
                aspect = FallbackAspect;
            }

            float verticalFov = UnityEngine.Camera.HorizontalToVerticalFieldOfView(horizontalFov, aspect);
            bool sprinting = _locomotion != null && _locomotion.isActiveAndEnabled && _locomotion.IsSprinting;
            _kick = Mathf.MoveTowards(_kick, sprinting ? 1f : 0f, dt / MovementMath.SprintFovKickTime);
            Camera.fieldOfView = verticalFov + MovementMath.SprintFovKickDeg * _kick * _motion;

            _trauma = Mathf.MoveTowards(_trauma, 0f, MovementMath.TraumaDecayPerSecond * dt);

            // Head bob: vertical sine at horizontalSpeed / stride, faded in and out so it never snaps.
            Vector3 velocity = _locomotion != null ? _locomotion.Velocity : Vector3.zero;
            float horizontalSpeed = new Vector2(velocity.x, velocity.z).magnitude;
            bool bobbing = _locomotion != null && _locomotion.IsGrounded && horizontalSpeed > BobMinSpeed;
            if (bobbing)
            {
                _bobDistance = Mathf.Repeat(_bobDistance + horizontalSpeed * dt, MovementMath.HeadBobStride);
            }

            _bobWeight = Mathf.MoveTowards(_bobWeight, bobbing ? 1f : 0f, BobFadePerSecond * dt);
            _bobY = Mathf.Sin(_bobDistance / MovementMath.HeadBobStride * Mathf.PI * 2f)
                * MovementMath.HeadBobAmplitude * _bobWeight * _motion;
        }

        private void LateUpdate()
        {
            if (_shake == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            float t = Time.time * MovementMath.TraumaFrequency;
            float amplitude = MovementMath.TraumaMaxAngleDeg * _trauma * _trauma * _motion;
            float pitch = (Mathf.PerlinNoise(_traumaSeed, t) - 0.5f) * 2f * amplitude;
            float yaw = (Mathf.PerlinNoise(_traumaSeed + 31.7f, t) - 0.5f) * 2f * amplitude;
            float roll = (Mathf.PerlinNoise(_traumaSeed + 63.1f, t) - 0.5f) * 2f * amplitude;
            _shake.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(pitch, yaw, roll);
            _shake.localPosition = new Vector3(0f, _bobY, 0f);
        }

        private static IInputService ResolveInput()
        {
            ServiceRegistry app = ServiceRoots.App;
            return app != null && app.TryGet(out IInputService input) ? input : null;
        }

        private static ISettings ResolveSettings()
        {
            ServiceRegistry app = ServiceRoots.App;
            return app != null && app.TryGet(out ISettings settings) ? settings : null;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using FishGame.Core;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Rendering;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    // Authority: none (local presentation, runs on every peer). The slot material follows PlayerNetState.SlotChanged,
    // including the host's own ServerInit write (OnValueChanged fires on the writer). Owner: head, nose, torso, legs and
    // left arm render ShadowsOnly; the right arm stays visible, posed in camera space (lower right, follows pitch).
    // Remotes: NetPitchQ is smoothed onto HeadPivot and the right arm. Every peer runs the procedural walk cycle from the
    // root's frame-to-frame motion (spec 7.3, 7.4). HeadPivot has one writer per peer: PlayerCamera on the owner, this on
    // remotes. Execution order 200: LateUpdate runs after PlayerCamera's, so the owner's arm follows the shaken camera.
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(200)]
    public sealed class PlayerBody : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private const float LegSwingDeg = 30f;
        private const float ArmSwingDeg = 20f;
        private const float PitchSmoothing = 15f;
        private const float RemoteRightArmRaiseDeg = 70f;
        private const float OwnerRightArmPitchDeg = -90f;
        private const float SwingMinSpeed = 0.2f;
        private const float SwingMaxSpeed = 10f;
        private const float SwingFadePerSecond = 5f;
        private static readonly Vector3 OwnerRightArmCameraOffset = new Vector3(0.22f, -0.28f, 0.42f);

        [SerializeField] private Material[] slotMaterials;
        [SerializeField] private Material skinMaterial;

        private Transform _headPivot;
        private Transform _armL;
        private Transform _armR;
        private Transform _legL;
        private Transform _legR;
        private Transform _cameraTransform;
        private Renderer _headMesh;
        private Renderer _noseMesh;
        private Renderer _torsoMesh;
        private Renderer _armLMesh;
        private Renderer _armRMesh;
        private Renderer _legLMesh;
        private Renderer _legRMesh;
        private bool _rigReady;

        private PlayerNetState _state;
        private bool _isOwner;
        private float _smoothedPitch;
        private float _walkPhase;
        private float _swingWeight;
        private Vector3 _lastPosition;
        private bool _hasLast;

        public Transform NameplateAnchor { get; private set; }

        // Builder entry point (edit mode, before Awake). At runtime it also re-applies the materials.
        public void Configure(Material[] slotMaterials, Material skinMaterial)
        {
            this.slotMaterials = slotMaterials;
            this.skinMaterial = skinMaterial;
            if (_rigReady)
            {
                ApplySkin();
                ApplySlot(_state != null ? _state.Slot : (byte)0);
            }
        }

        private void Awake()
        {
            _headPivot = transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.HeadPivot);
            _armL = transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.ArmL);
            _armR = transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.ArmR);
            _legL = transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.LegL);
            _legR = transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.LegR);
            _cameraTransform = transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.Camera);
            _headMesh = FindRenderer(PlayerRigPaths.Head);
            _noseMesh = FindRenderer(PlayerRigPaths.Nose);
            _torsoMesh = FindRenderer(PlayerRigPaths.Torso);
            _armLMesh = FindRenderer(PlayerRigPaths.ArmLMesh);
            _armRMesh = FindRenderer(PlayerRigPaths.ArmRMesh);
            _legLMesh = FindRenderer(PlayerRigPaths.LegLMesh);
            _legRMesh = FindRenderer(PlayerRigPaths.LegRMesh);
            NameplateAnchor = transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.NameplateAnchor);

            _rigReady = _headPivot != null && _armL != null && _armR != null && _legL != null && _legR != null
                && _headMesh != null && _noseMesh != null && _torsoMesh != null && _armLMesh != null
                && _armRMesh != null && _legLMesh != null && _legRMesh != null;
            if (!_rigReady)
            {
                Debug.LogError("PlayerBody: the PlayerFP rig is incomplete (see PlayerRigPaths and contract 6.3).", this);
                return;
            }

            ApplySkin();
        }

        // Applies the current slot now and follows SlotChanged afterwards. Called from PlayerNetState.OnNetworkSpawn.
        public void Bind(PlayerNetState state, bool isOwner)
        {
            Unbind();
            if (state == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            _state = state;
            _isOwner = isOwner;
            _hasLast = false;
            _smoothedPitch = PitchQuant.Dequantize(state.NetPitchQ.Value);
            state.SlotChanged += ApplySlot;
            if (!_rigReady)
            {
                return;
            }

            ApplySlot(state.Slot);
            ApplyVisibility(isOwner);
        }

        public void Unbind()
        {
            if (_state != null)
            {
                _state.SlotChanged -= ApplySlot;
            }

            _state = null;
            _isOwner = false;
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (!_rigReady)
            {
                return;
            }

            float dt = Time.deltaTime;
            if (dt <= 0f)
            {
                return;
            }

            Vector3 position = transform.position;
            float speed = 0f;
            if (_hasLast)
            {
                Vector3 delta = position - _lastPosition;
                speed = Mathf.Min(new Vector2(delta.x, delta.z).magnitude / dt, SwingMaxSpeed);
            }

            _lastPosition = position;
            _hasLast = true;

            // Walk cycle on every peer: legs +-30 deg, left arm counter-swings +-20 deg at speed / stride frequency.
            _swingWeight = Mathf.MoveTowards(_swingWeight, speed > SwingMinSpeed ? 1f : 0f, SwingFadePerSecond * dt);
            _walkPhase = Mathf.Repeat(_walkPhase + speed * dt / MovementMath.HeadBobStride * Mathf.PI * 2f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
            float swing = Mathf.Sin(_walkPhase) * _swingWeight;
            _legL.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(LegSwingDeg * swing, 0f, 0f);
            _legR.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(-LegSwingDeg * swing, 0f, 0f);
            _armL.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(-ArmSwingDeg * swing, 0f, 0f);

            if (_state == null || _isOwner)
            {
                return;
            }

            // Remotes only: pitch = lerp(pitch, NetPitchQ / 100, 1 - exp(-15 dt)) on the head and the right arm.
            float target = PitchQuant.Dequantize(_state.NetPitchQ.Value);
            _smoothedPitch = Mathf.Lerp(_smoothedPitch, target, 1f - Mathf.Exp(-PitchSmoothing * dt));
            _headPivot.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(-_smoothedPitch, 0f, 0f);
            _armR.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(-RemoteRightArmRaiseDeg - _smoothedPitch, 0f, 0f);
        }

        private void LateUpdate()
        {
            if (!_rigReady || !_isOwner || _cameraTransform == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            // Owner only: right arm in camera space, lower right, pointing along the view (follows pitch and shake).
            _armR.SetPositionAndRotation(
                _cameraTransform.TransformPoint(OwnerRightArmCameraOffset),
                _cameraTransform.rotation * Quaternion.Euler(OwnerRightArmPitchDeg, 0f, 0f));
        }

        private void ApplySlot(byte slot)
        {
            if (!_rigReady || slotMaterials == null || slotMaterials.Length == 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            Material material = slotMaterials[Mathf.Clamp(slot, 0, slotMaterials.Length - 1)];
            if (material == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            // sharedMaterial swap only: no runtime material instances, no MaterialPropertyBlock (spec 7.4).
            _torsoMesh.sharedMaterial = material;
            _armLMesh.sharedMaterial = material;
            _armRMesh.sharedMaterial = material;
            _legLMesh.sharedMaterial = material;
            _legRMesh.sharedMaterial = material;
        }

        private void ApplySkin()
        {
            if (!_rigReady || skinMaterial == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            _headMesh.sharedMaterial = skinMaterial;
            _noseMesh.sharedMaterial = skinMaterial;
        }

        private void ApplyVisibility(bool owner)
        {
            ShadowCastingMode hidden = owner ? ShadowCastingMode.ShadowsOnly : ShadowCastingMode.On;
            _headMesh.shadowCastingMode = hidden;
            _noseMesh.shadowCastingMode = hidden;
            _torsoMesh.shadowCastingMode = hidden;
            _armLMesh.shadowCastingMode = hidden;
            _legLMesh.shadowCastingMode = hidden;
            _legRMesh.shadowCastingMode = hidden;
            _armRMesh.shadowCastingMode = ShadowCastingMode.On;
        }

        private Renderer FindRenderer(string path)
        {
            Transform child = transform.Find(path);
            return child != null ? child.GetComponent<Renderer>() : null;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.Gameplay
{
    // Authority: owner only (enabled by PlayerNetState). The prompt is local display; a press is only a request sent to the
    // host through PlayerActions.InteractRpc, and the host decides (CanInteract, range, ServerInteract). Spec 7.7.
    // InteractPromptChanged.Prompt is the raw GetPrompt text without the key glyph (T14 composes the key).
    public sealed class PlayerInteractor : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public const float CastRange = 3.0f, CastRadius = 0.15f;

        public NetworkInteractable Current { get; private set; }

        private PlayerNetState _net;
        private PlayerActions _actions;
        private PlayerCamera _playerCamera;
        private EventBus _publishedTo;
        private string _lastPrompt;
        private bool _lastCanInteract;
        private bool _hasPublished;

        private void Awake()
        {
            _net = GetComponent<PlayerNetState>();
            _actions = GetComponent<PlayerActions>();
            _playerCamera = GetComponent<PlayerCamera>();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            Current = null;
            _hasPublished = false;
            _lastPrompt = null;
            _lastCanInteract = false;
            _publishedTo = null;
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            IInputService input = ResolveInput();
            UnityEngine.Camera view = _playerCamera != null ? _playerCamera.Camera : null;

            // Interactables are live only in Free with no menu open (contract 7.12).
            bool eligible = input != null && _net != null && view != null
                && input.GameplayContext == InputContext.Free && !input.MenuOpen;

            NetworkInteractable found = null;
            if (eligible)
            {
                Transform origin = view.transform;
                if (Physics.SphereCast(origin.position, CastRadius, origin.forward, out RaycastHit hit,
                        CastRange, Layers.Mask(Layers.Interactable), QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore))
                {
                    found = hit.collider.GetComponentInParent<NetworkInteractable>();
                    if (found != null && !found.IsSpawned)
                    {
                        found = null;
                    }
                }
            }

            Current = found;
            ulong localId = _net != null ? _net.OwnerClientId : 0UL;
            string prompt = found != null ? found.GetPrompt(localId) : null;
            bool canInteract = found != null && found.CanInteract(localId);
            Publish(prompt, canInteract);

            // One request per press; no hold-to-interact.
            if (eligible && found != null && canInteract && input.Intent.InteractPressed
                && _actions != null && _actions.IsSpawned)
            {
                _actions.InteractRpc(new NetworkBehaviourReference(found));
            }
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            Current = null;
            if (_hasPublished && _publishedTo != null)
            {
                _publishedTo.Publish(new InteractPromptChanged(null, false));
            }

            _hasPublished = false;
            _lastPrompt = null;
            _lastCanInteract = false;
            _publishedTo = null;
        }

        private void Publish(string prompt, bool canInteract)
        {
            if (_hasPublished && prompt == _lastPrompt && canInteract == _lastCanInteract)
            {
                return;
            }

            EventBus bus = ResolveBus();
            if (bus == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            _lastPrompt = prompt;
            _lastCanInteract = canInteract;
            _hasPublished = true;
            _publishedTo = bus;
            bus.Publish(new InteractPromptChanged(prompt, canInteract));
        }

        private static IInputService ResolveInput()
        {
            ServiceRegistry app = ServiceRoots.App;
            return app != null && app.TryGet(out IInputService input) ? input : null;
        }

        private static EventBus ResolveBus()
        {
            ServiceRegistry app = ServiceRoots.App;
            return app != null && app.TryGet(out EventBus bus) ? bus : null;
        }
    }
}
```

  ```csharp
  // Authority: scene marker only (not networked). The host's PlayerSpawner reads All and spawns Prefab at each anchor
  // with destroyWithScene: true. Clients never spawn from anchors. The list is process-local and is reset on
  // SubsystemRegistration so it stays correct with domain reload disabled.
  using System.Collections.Generic;
  using Unity.Netcode;
  using UnityEngine;

  namespace FishGame.Gameplay
  {
      public sealed class NetSpawnAnchor : MonoBehaviour
      {
          private static readonly List<NetSpawnAnchor> s_all = new List<NetSpawnAnchor>();

          [SerializeField] private NetworkObject prefab;

          public NetworkObject Prefab => prefab;

          public static IReadOnlyList<NetSpawnAnchor> All => s_all;

          // Builder use (editor). The builder persists the field with SerializedObject + ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo
          // (or marks the object dirty) before saving the scene.
          public void Configure(NetworkObject prefab)
          {
              this.prefab = prefab;
          }

          [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
          private static void ResetStatics()
          {
              s_all.Clear();
          }

          private void OnEnable()
          {
              if (!s_all.Contains(this))
              {
                  s_all.Add(this);
              }
          }

          private void OnDisable()
          {
              s_all.Remove(this);
          }
      }
  }
  ```

  ```csharp
  // Authority: host decides (ServerInteract). Clients only display GetPrompt and evaluate CanInteract to grey the prompt.
  using Unity.Netcode;
  using UnityEngine;

  namespace FishGame.Gameplay
  {
      public abstract class NetworkInteractable : NetworkBehaviour
      {
          // Owner sphere-cast range in metres (spec 7.7). The server allows Range + 1.0 m from the sender's head.
          public virtual float Range => 3.0f;

          // Server range-check target. PlayerActions.InteractRpc (T11) measures distance to this point.
          public virtual Vector3 InteractPoint => transform.position;

          // Local display only, without the key glyph, for example "Ring bell".
          public abstract string GetPrompt(ulong clientId);

          // Server truth. Also evaluated locally to grey the prompt.
          public virtual bool CanInteract(ulong clientId) => true;

          // Server only. Implementations must ignore calls when !IsServer.
          public abstract void ServerInteract(ulong clientId);
      }
  }
  ```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `Assets/_Project/Gameplay/Interaction/DockBell.cs`**

  Full content:

  ```csharp
  // Authority: host validates and rings (ServerInteract). The ring cue is broadcast to ClientsAndHost by RingRpc,
  // which only the server may invoke. Cooldown uses NetworkManager.ServerTime.Time: the server records it in
  // ServerInteract (authoritative), and RingRpc records it on every peer so clients can grey the prompt locally.
  // A client records the ring about RTT/2 late, so its prompt greys slightly longer than the server's cooldown (cosmetic only).
  using System;
  using FishGame.Core;
  using FishGame.Runtime;
  using Unity.Netcode;
  using UnityEngine;

  namespace FishGame.Gameplay
  {
      public sealed class DockBell : NetworkInteractable
      {
          public const float CooldownSeconds = 1.0f;

          private const string BellChildName = "Bell";
          private const float SwingSeconds = 0.5f;
          private const float SwingDegrees = 18f;

          private double m_lastRingTime = double.NegativeInfinity;
          private float m_swingRemaining;
          private Transform m_bell;
          private Quaternion m_bellRest = Quaternion.identity;

          // Increments on every peer (host and clients) each time RingRpc runs.
          public int LocalRingCount { get; private set; }

          // Local, raised on every peer including the host.
          public event Action Rang;

          private void Awake()
          {
              m_bell = transform.Find(BellChildName);
              if (m_bell != null)
              {
                  m_bellRest = m_bell.localRotation;
              }
          }

          private void Update()
          {
              if (m_bell == null || m_swingRemaining <= 0f)
              {
                  return;
              }

              m_swingRemaining -= Time.deltaTime;
              if (m_swingRemaining <= 0f)
              {
                  m_swingRemaining = 0f;
                  m_bell.localRotation = m_bellRest;
                  return;
              }

              float t = 1f - (m_swingRemaining / SwingSeconds);
              float angle = Mathf.Sin(t * Mathf.PI * 3f) * SwingDegrees * (1f - t);
              m_bell.localRotation = m_bellRest * Quaternion.Euler(angle, 0f, 0f);
          }

          public override string GetPrompt(ulong clientId)
          {
              return "Ring bell";
          }

          public override bool CanInteract(ulong clientId)
          {
              return NowServerTime() - m_lastRingTime >= CooldownSeconds;
          }

          public override void ServerInteract(ulong clientId)
          {
              if (!IsServer)
              {
                  return;
              }

              if (!CanInteract(clientId))
              {
                  return;
              }

              m_lastRingTime = NowServerTime();
              RingRpc();
          }

          [Rpc(SendTo.ClientsAndHost, InvokePermission = RpcInvokePermission.Server)]
          private void RingRpc()
          {
              m_lastRingTime = NowServerTime();

              var app = ServiceRoots.App;
              if (app != null && app.TryGet<AudioBus>(out var audioBus) && audioBus != null)
              {
                  audioBus.PlayAt(SfxIds.BellRing, transform.position);
              }

              m_swingRemaining = SwingSeconds;
              LocalRingCount++;
  #if UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD
              Debug.Log($"[DockBell] rang (local count {LocalRingCount})");
  #endif
              Rang?.Invoke();
          }

          private double NowServerTime()
          {
              var manager = NetworkManager;
              return manager != null ? manager.ServerTime.Time : 0.0;
          }
      }
  }
  ```

**Global constraints for this task** (in addition to the project's):
- UTF-8 without BOM. Write every file with the Write tool.
- One public type per file. The file name equals the type name.
- Every file opens with a class comment. A networked class states its authority with `// Authority: ...`. The T13 types are not networked, and their comments say who runs them.
- Never write the NGO static singleton accessor (the `Singleton` property of `NetworkManager`) anywhere in these files, comments included. `AppBootstrap.Awake` runs at order -2000, before NGO's own `Awake`/`OnEnable`.
- Never write a bare `Input.` identifier. Never use `System.Numerics`.
- Call `InstantiateAndSpawn` with named arguments only.
- Add no public surface beyond the list above. Private helpers and attributes are fine.
- `$env:FG_OUT` convention: an absolute directory inside your own session scratchpad (never inside the repo, no `..`). Every Unity command sets it first in the same PowerShell call, because PowerShell state does not persist. Plans write the literal text `<absolute scratchpad path>`, and you substitute your own scratchpad path. Run every Unity command with the PowerShell tool and `timeout: 600000`.

**Behaviour this task must make true.** T16 and T17 prove it later.

Boot:
1. `AppBootstrap.Awake` validates its configuration and composes app services.
2. `Start` calls `UiFlowController.Initialize` and plain-loads Menu.
3. Once Menu is the active scene, and one frame later, it runs `DevStartup.TryAutoStart`, unless `SuppressDevAutoStart` is set.

Sessions and scene changes:
- **SessionState spawn.** Whenever a server starts (Solo, dev-direct host, or the SDK-started UGS host), `SessionState` is spawned exactly once with `destroyWithScene: false`.
- **Connected.** When the session reaches `Connected` on the server, `SceneFlow` loads `Spot_LakeDock` through `NetworkSceneManager` (Single). Clients follow through NGO scene sync.
- **Joins stay open.** Joins are not closed before that load. In M1 the dock is the in-world lobby (spec 11.2), and closing joins there would break criterion 3.
- **Offline.** When the session goes `Offline` and the active scene is not Menu, `SceneFlow` plain-loads Menu. Criteria 7 (clean leave) and 9 (host leaves, clients go to Menu) rely on this.
- **Ended.** `Ended(reason)` publishes `ToastRequested(key)` only when `EndReasonText.ToastKey(reason)` is not null.
  - `UserLeft` gives no toast. `HostLeft` gives `err.host_left`.
  - Criterion 9's "Host ended the session." text comes from T14's `UiStrings`. Invent no strings here.
- **Mode switch.** Criterion 10 (Solo, Leave, Solo in one process) depends on `AppBootstrap` staying alive across Leave: `DontDestroyOnLoad`, and no teardown on Offline.

Quit, duplicates and dev flags:
- **Quit.** `Application.quitting` makes a best-effort `LeaveAsync()` call.
- **Duplicates.** A second Bootstrap load deactivates and destroys the duplicate App before its `NetworkManager`, input or UI wake up.
- **Dev flags.** They apply only under `UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD`. In a release build the protocol offset is 0 and long timeout is off.

```csharp
// Not networked; runs locally on every peer. Session-scope services for one gameplay scene.
// Lives on the root object "GameScope" in each Spot_* scene. Registers IPauseState and publishes itself as ServiceRoots.Game.
// Execution order -1500 so it is awake before any other scene object (PlayerSpawner, SceneCameraSwitch, players) looks it up.
using FishGame.Runtime;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.App
{
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-1500)]
    public sealed class GameScope : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public ServiceRegistry Services { get; private set; }

        private void Awake()
        {
            Services = new ServiceRegistry();
            Services.Register<IPauseState>(new PauseState());
            ServiceRoots.SetGame(Services);
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            if (Services == null) return;
            var mine = Services;
            Services = null;
            if (ServiceRoots.Game == mine) ServiceRoots.SetGame(null);
            mine.Dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Not networked itself. The host decides when gameplay scenes load (NetworkSceneManager); clients follow NGO scene sync.
// Every peer reacts to INetworkSession events. Error toasts come only from Ended, never from start-task exceptions (contract D8).
// M1: joins are NOT closed before the Spot load. The dock is the in-world lobby (spec 11.2) and SessionState.NetJoinsOpen stays true.
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;

namespace FishGame.App
{
    public sealed class SceneFlow : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly INetworkSession session;
        private readonly NetworkManager networkManager;
        private readonly EventBus bus;
        private bool disposed;

        public SceneFlow(INetworkSession session, NetworkManager networkManager, EventBus bus)
        {
            this.session = session ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(session));
            this.networkManager = networkManager ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(networkManager));
            this.bus = bus ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(bus));
            session.StateChanged += HandleStateChanged;
            session.Ended += HandleEnded;
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (disposed) return;
            disposed = true;
            session.StateChanged -= HandleStateChanged;
            session.Ended -= HandleEnded;
        }

        private void HandleStateChanged(ConnState previous, ConnState current)
        {
            if (disposed) return;

            if (current == ConnState.Connected)
            {
                if (networkManager.IsServer) LoadFirstGameplayScene();
                return;
            }

            if (current == ConnState.Offline && SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name != SceneNames.Menu)
            {
                SceneManager.LoadScene(SceneNames.Menu, LoadSceneMode.Single);
            }
        }

        private void LoadFirstGameplayScene()
        {
            var sceneManager = networkManager.SceneManager;
            if (sceneManager == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("SceneFlow: NetworkManager.SceneManager is null (scene management disabled?); leaving the session.");
                ObserveLeave(session.LeaveAsync());
                return;
            }

            SceneEventProgressStatus status = sceneManager.LoadScene(SceneNames.SpotLakeDock, LoadSceneMode.Single);
            if (status != SceneEventProgressStatus.Started)
            {
                Debug.LogError("SceneFlow: LoadScene(" + SceneNames.SpotLakeDock + ") returned " + status + "; leaving the session.");
                ObserveLeave(session.LeaveAsync());
            }
        }

        private void HandleEnded(EndReason reason)
        {
            if (disposed) return;
            string key = EndReasonText.ToastKey(reason);
            if (key != null) bus.Publish(new ToastRequested(key));
        }

        private static async void ObserveLeave(Task leave)
        {
            try
            {
                await leave;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Not networked; runs once at boot on every peer. Dev-only auto-start from command-line tokens,
// MPPM player tags (CurrentPlayer.ReadOnlyTags) and the editor "Auto Solo" pref.
// TryAutoStart does nothing unless UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD. Auto Solo applies only in the main editor (MPPM clones share EditorPrefs).
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using UnityEngine;
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using Unity.Multiplayer.PlayMode;
using UnityEditor;
#endif

namespace FishGame.App
{
    public static class DevStartup
    {
        public static IReadOnlyList<string> CollectArgs()
        {
            var args = new List<string>(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs());
#if UNITY_EDITOR
            try
            {
                var tags = CurrentPlayer.ReadOnlyTags();
                if (tags != null)
                {
                    foreach (var tag in tags)
                    {
                        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(tag)) continue;
                        args.AddRange(tag.Split((char[])null, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries));
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("DevStartup: could not read MPPM player tags: " + e.Message);
            }
#endif
            return args;
        }

        public static void TryAutoStart(INetworkSession session, DevFlags flags)
        {
#if UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD
            if (session == null || flags == null) return;

            if (flags.Solo)
            {
                Observe("-dev-solo", () => session.StartLocalAsync(false, CancellationToken.None));
                return;
            }
            if (flags.HostDirect)
            {
                Observe("-dev-host-direct", () => session.StartLocalAsync(true, CancellationToken.None));
                return;
            }
            if (flags.HasJoinDirect)
            {
                string address = flags.JoinDirectAddress;
                ushort port = flags.JoinDirectPort;
                Observe("-dev-join-direct", () => session.JoinDirectAsync(address, port, CancellationToken.None));
                return;
            }
#if UNITY_EDITOR
            if (EditorPrefs.GetBool(DevPrefKeys.AutoSolo, false) && IsMainEditor())
            {
                Observe("Auto Solo", () => session.StartLocalAsync(false, CancellationToken.None));
            }
#endif
#endif
        }

#if UNITY_EDITOR
        private static bool IsMainEditor()
        {
            try
            {
                return CurrentPlayer.IsMainEditor;
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                return false; // unknown -> never auto-solo (a clone must not start a second solo host)
            }
        }
#endif

        // Start tasks fault with NetworkSessionException; the UI already learns of failures from Ended (toast via SceneFlow), so only log here.
        private static async void Observe(string label, Func<Task> start)
        {
            try
            {
                await start();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("DevStartup: " + label + " did not connect (" + e.GetType().Name + "): " + e.Message);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Not networked. Composition root on the root "App" object in Bootstrap; runs on every peer.
// Server only: spawns SessionState (destroyWithScene: false) from NetworkManager.OnServerStarted. This is the only place SessionState is created (contract D5).
// Uses GetComponent<NetworkManager>() only, never the NGO static accessor: this Awake runs at order -2000, before NetworkManager's own Awake/OnEnable.
using System;
using System.Collections;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Data;
using FishGame.Networking;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using FishGame.UI;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;

namespace FishGame.App
{
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-2000)]
    public sealed class AppBootstrap : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private const ulong SfxSeed = 1UL; // private choice (not in the contract); fixed so generated SFX are reproducible

#if UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD
        private static readonly bool IsDevBuild = true;
#else
        private static readonly bool IsDevBuild = false;
#endif

        [SerializeField] private NetworkObject sessionStatePrefab;
        [SerializeField] private InputActionAsset inputActions;
        [SerializeField] private ContentRegistry contentRegistry;

        private ServiceRegistry services;
        private INetworkSession session;
        private SceneFlow sceneFlow;
        private UiFlowController ui;
        private NetworkObject spawnedSessionState;
        private bool composed;

        public static AppBootstrap Current { get; private set; }
        public static bool SuppressDevAutoStart { get; set; }
        public ServiceRegistry Services => services;
        public NetworkManager NetworkManager { get; private set; }
        public ulong ContentHashValue { get; private set; }
        public DevFlags DevFlags { get; private set; }

        public void Configure(NetworkObject sessionStatePrefab, InputActionAsset inputActions, ContentRegistry contentRegistry)
        {
            this.sessionStatePrefab = sessionStatePrefab;
            this.inputActions = inputActions;
            this.contentRegistry = contentRegistry;
        }

        [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(RuntimeInitializeLoadType.SubsystemRegistration)]
        private static void ResetStatics()
        {
            Current = null;
        }

        private void Awake()
        {
            if (Current != null && Current != this)
            {
                // A second Bootstrap load. Deactivate first so this copy's NetworkManager, input and UI never wake up.
                gameObject.SetActive(false);
                Destroy(gameObject);
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                Compose();
                composed = true;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e, this);
                Debug.LogError("AppBootstrap: composition failed; the app cannot start. Run FishGame > Build All and fix the error above.", this);
                enabled = false; // Start (and the Menu load) will not run
            }
        }

        private void Compose()
        {
            if (sessionStatePrefab == null || inputActions == null || contentRegistry == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("AppBootstrap is not configured (sessionStatePrefab, inputActions or contentRegistry is missing). SceneBuilder must call Configure(...) before saving Bootstrap.");
            }
            if (transform.parent != null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("AppBootstrap: the App object must be a root object (DontDestroyOnLoad and NGO both require it).");
            }
            var networkManager = Require<NetworkManager>();
            var input = Require<PlayerInputAdapter>();
            var audio = Require<AudioBus>();
            ui = GetComponentInChildren<UiFlowController>(true);
            if (ui == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("AppBootstrap: no UiFlowController under App/UI.");

            DontDestroyOnLoad(gameObject);
            Current = this;
            Application.runInBackground = true; // spec 6.2: MPPM clones and alt-tabbed hosts must keep ticking

            NetworkManager = networkManager;
            var config = NetworkManager.NetworkConfig;
            if (config.NetworkTransport == null) config.NetworkTransport = GetComponent<NetworkTransport>();
            if (config.NetworkTransport == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("AppBootstrap: no NetworkTransport (UnityTransport) on the App object.");
            config.TickRate = NetworkConstants.TickRate;
            config.ConnectionApproval = true;
            config.EnableSceneManagement = true;
            config.ProtocolVersion = NetworkConstants.NgoProtocolVersion;
            config.PlayerPrefab = null;

            DevFlags = DevFlags.Parse(DevStartup.CollectArgs());

            services = new ServiceRegistry();
            var bus = new EventBus();
            services.Register(bus);

            var settings = SettingsStore.CreateForThisInstance();
            settings.EnsureLocalPlayerId();
            services.Register<ISettings>(settings);

            input.Initialize(inputActions, settings);
            services.Register<IInputService>(input);
            services.Register<IInputBindings>(input);

            var sfx = new SfxGenerator();
            sfx.GenerateAll(SfxSeed);
            services.Register(sfx);
            audio.Initialize(sfx, settings);
            services.Register(audio);

            contentRegistry.Build();
            ContentHashValue = contentRegistry.ComputeContentHash();
            services.Register(contentRegistry);

            var bridge = new JoinApprovalBridge();
            services.Register(bridge);
            services.Register(this.DevFlags);

            int protocolVersion = BuildInfo.EffectiveProtocolVersion(IsDevBuild ? this.DevFlags.ProtocolOffset : 0);
            bool longTimeout = IsDevBuild && this.DevFlags.LongTimeout;
            var sessionConfig = new NetworkSessionConfig(NetworkManager, bridge, settings, protocolVersion, ContentHashValue, longTimeout);
            var local = new LocalNetworkSession(sessionConfig);
            services.Register(local);
            session = new CompositeNetworkSession(local, () => new UgsNetworkSession(sessionConfig));
            services.Register<INetworkSession>(session);

            ServiceRoots.SetApp(services);
            NetworkManager.OnServerStarted += HandleServerStarted;
            Application.quitting += HandleQuitting;
            sceneFlow = new SceneFlow(session, NetworkManager, bus);
        }

        // UiFlowController.Initialize runs here, not in Awake: by Start every OnEnable has run, so the child UIDocument
        // has built its rootVisualElement. It runs before the Menu load so its activeSceneChanged hook sees Menu.
        private IEnumerator Start()
        {
            if (!composed) yield break;

            ui.Initialize(services);
            SceneManager.LoadScene(SceneNames.Menu, LoadSceneMode.Single);

            // Wait until the plain Menu load has finished, then one more frame (UI shows MainMenu first), so a dev
            // auto-start can never race the pending Menu load with an NGO scene load.
            while (SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name != SceneNames.Menu) yield return null;
            yield return null;

            if (!SuppressDevAutoStart) DevStartup.TryAutoStart(session, this.DevFlags);
        }

        // Raised synchronously inside StartHost after host self-approval; SpawnManager is ready. If this throws, NGO
        // catches it, shuts down and StartHost returns false, so keep it exception-free and log instead.
        // The IsSpawned guard skips a second spawn while the previous instance is live; a destroyed one compares null.
        private void HandleServerStarted()
        {
            if (spawnedSessionState != null && spawnedSessionState.IsSpawned) return;
            spawnedSessionState = NetworkManager.SpawnManager.InstantiateAndSpawn(
                networkPrefab: sessionStatePrefab,
                destroyWithScene: false);
            if (spawnedSessionState == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("AppBootstrap: SessionState spawn failed (is SessionState.prefab in FishGameNetworkPrefabs?).", this);
            }
        }

        private void HandleQuitting()
        {
            if (session == null) return;
            try
            {
                _ = session.LeaveAsync(); // best effort (spec 6.3)
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e);
            }
        }

        private T Require<T>() where T : Component
        {
            var component = GetComponent<T>();
            if (component == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("AppBootstrap: the App object has no " + typeof(T).Name + " component.");
            return component;
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            if (Current != this) return;

            Application.quitting -= HandleQuitting;
            if (NetworkManager != null) NetworkManager.OnServerStarted -= HandleServerStarted;

            sceneFlow?.Dispose();
            sceneFlow = null;
            if (services != null)
            {
                if (ServiceRoots.App == services) ServiceRoots.SetApp(null);
                services.Dispose();
                services = null;
            }
            session = null;
            Current = null;
        }

        public void DestroyForTests()
        {
            if (NetworkManager != null && !NetworkManager.ShutdownInProgress &&
                (NetworkManager.IsListening || NetworkManager.IsServer || NetworkManager.IsClient))
            {
                NetworkManager.Shutdown();
            }
            Destroy(gameObject);
        }
    }
}
```

#### Notes for the implementer (read before Step 6)

1. **Name collisions.** The property and its type share a name for `DevFlags` and for `NetworkManager`. C#'s "Color Color" rule makes `DevFlags.Parse(...)` bind to the static method and `this.DevFlags.ProtocolOffset` to the instance. Keep the code exactly as written, including `this.DevFlags`.
2. **Awake ordering.** `PlayerInputAdapter.Initialize` and `AudioBus.Initialize` are called from `AppBootstrap.Awake` (-2000), before those components' own `Awake`/`OnEnable` run. That order is intentional, because their `OnEnable` then sees initialized state. `UiFlowController.Initialize` is deliberately in `Start`.
3. **Private values.** `SfxSeed = 1UL` is a private choice. Do not promote it to a public constant.
4. **Exceptions.** Do not wrap `HandleServerStarted` in a catch-all that hides a null spawn. It already logs, and NGO turns a thrown exception into a failed `StartHost`.
5. **Composition failures.** Configuration and composition failures are logged with `Debug.LogException` and disable the component, so Start and the Menu load never run. They show as console errors, which criterion 1 counts.

**Gate (contract §2.4).** T14 has no EditMode-testable logic. `FishGame.Tests.EditMode` does not reference `FishGame.UI`, and asmdefs are frozen. The gate has three parts:
1. A static-check script that is run red before the files exist and green after. It checks:
   - every file is present and has no BOM;
   - every UI string key used in code (and every `EndReasonText` key) exists in `UiStrings`;
   - every element name the code looks up is declared in `AppRoot.uxml`;
   - the UXML is well-formed and has no duplicate names;
   - no `Unity.Services` or `Unity.Netcode.Transports` text appears (the T15 architecture test).
2. `compile`, plus a check of the compile log for UXML/USS/TSS import warnings.
3. The full `test-edit` run, as a regression check.

Behaviour is proven by T16 (PlayMode) and the T17 manual checklist (criterion 11).

**Design notes (read before writing code):**
1. **One UIDocument holds every screen (D29).** `UiFlowController` toggles each screen's inline `style.display`. In UXML every screen starts with the class `hidden`. The inline style set by `Show` overrides the class.
2. **Escape / Back has one source.** In gameplay, `IInputService.Intent.PausePressed` is Player/Pause. In Menu context it is UI/Cancel (D27). `UiFlowController.Update` maps it per screen: Hud → Pause, Pause → Hud, Settings → back to the screen it was opened from (ignored while rebinding), Busy → Cancel, MainMenu → nothing. No `NavigationCancelEvent` handlers are registered, so nothing is handled twice. A press is ignored in the frame a screen changed.
3. **No separate EnterCode screen.** `UiScreen` has no EnterCode value, so spec 11.2's EnterCode is the join field on the main menu. Its text is kept on failure. An invalid code shows `err.code_not_found` and focuses the field.
4. **Error toasts come only from `INetworkSession.Ended` (contract D8, published by T13 SceneFlow).** `UiFlowController` only publishes:
   - `toast.join_code` after a successful host;
   - `err.code_not_found` for an implausible code before any call;
   - `err.generic` for an unexpected non-session exception;
   - `pause.copied`.

   Error toasts play `Ui_Error`, the join-code toast plays `Ui_Confirm`, and every button press plays `Ui_Click`. Button presses are wired through `clicked`, so keyboard and gamepad submit play the click sound too.
5. **Streamer mode masks the join code everywhere.** It applies to the Pause text and to the 10 s host toast (the toast argument is masked in `ToastPresenter`). Hold-to-reveal works with the pointer (TrickleDown, because `Button`'s Clickable captures the pointer). A keyboard or gamepad submit on the Reveal button reveals the code for 5 s, because UI Toolkit has no release event for submit.
6. **Rebinds (M1):**
   - Covered actions: Jump, Sprint and Interact. Each gets one button per control scheme (Keyboard&Mouse and Gamepad), and the binding index comes from `GetBindingIndex(group: scheme)`.
   - Every rebind is filtered by device path. It can be cancelled with Escape and times out after 6 s. It starts 150 ms after the button press, so the press that opened it is not captured as the new binding.
   - `WithAction` throws while the action is enabled. The Player map is disabled in Menu context anyway. As a guard, the action is disabled if needed and its previous state is restored afterwards.
   - Move and Look (composites) and Pause are not rebindable in M1. A "Reset controls" button is provided.
7. **Settings apply live through `NotifyChanged`.** They are saved (`ISettings.Save`) whenever the Settings screen is left, by any route, and in `OnApplicationQuit`. They are never saved per slider tick. The display name is committed and saved at the start of every Host/Join/Solo attempt, because the connect payload reads `Current.displayName`.
8. **UI scale.** The `PanelSettings` asset is copied at bind time (D29), and `copy.scale = clamp(uiScalePercent, 80, 150) / 100f`. Layout budget at 150% on 1280×720: with Scale With Screen Size (reference 1920×1080, match 0.5) the panel resolves to about 1280×720 logical px. The main menu is about 470 px tall, the pause menu about 420 px, and the settings list sits in a `ScrollView` whose panel has a fixed `height: 92%`.
9. **Gamepad and keyboard focus.** Every `Show` focuses the screen's default control on the next panel update. A focus change inside the settings `ScrollView` scrolls the newly focused control into view. If a menu screen is open, the last device is a gamepad, and nothing has focus, the default control is focused again.

```powershell
  $cs = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $ui -Filter '*.cs' -File | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName })
  $keySources = $cs + @(Join-Path $base 'Core\Net\EndReasonText.cs')
  $keys = @(Select-String -LiteralPath $keySources -Pattern '"((?:menu|busy|pause|settings|hud|err|toast)\.[a-z_]+)"' -AllMatches |
    ForEach-Object { $_.Matches } | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value } | Sort-Object -Unique)
  $table = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $ui 'UiStrings.cs'))
  foreach ($k in $keys) {
    if ($table -notmatch ('\["' + [regex]::Escape($k) + '"\]\s*=')) { $problems.Add("missing UiStrings key $k") }
  }
  [xml]$doc = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $ui 'Uxml\AppRoot.uxml'))
  $declared = @($doc.SelectNodes('//*[@name]') | ForEach-Object { $_.GetAttribute('name') })
  foreach ($d in @($declared | Group-Object | Where-Object { $_.Count -gt 1 })) { $problems.Add("duplicate UXML name $($d.Name)") }
  $looked = @(Select-String -LiteralPath $cs -Pattern '\(\s*_?\w+\s*,\s*"([A-Z]\w*)"' -AllMatches |
    ForEach-Object { $_.Matches } | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value } | Sort-Object -Unique)
  foreach ($n in $looked) { if ($declared -notcontains $n) { $problems.Add("missing UXML element name $n") } }
  foreach ($f in @(Select-String -LiteralPath $cs -Pattern 'Unity\.Services|Unity\.Netcode\.Transports')) {
    $problems.Add("forbidden reference $($f.Filename):$($f.LineNumber)")
  }
}
foreach ($p in $problems) { "FG T14 PROBLEM $p" }
if ($problems.Count -eq 0) { "FG T14 STATIC PASS keys=$($keys.Count) names=$($looked.Count)"; exit 0 }
"FG T14 STATIC FAIL problems=$($problems.Count)"
exit 1
```


```csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.UI
{
    // T14-private helpers: required element lookup (fails loudly), show/hide, dev-build flag.
    internal static class UiQuery
    {
#if UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD
        public const bool IsDevBuild = true;
#else
        public const bool IsDevBuild = false;
#endif

        public static T Req<T>(VisualElement root, string name) where T : VisualElement
        {
            var element = root.Q<T>(name);
            if (element == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("UI element missing in AppRoot.uxml: " + name + " (" + typeof(T).Name + ")");
            return element;
        }

        public static void Show(VisualElement element, bool visible) =>
            element.style.display = visible ? DisplayStyle.Flex : DisplayStyle.None;
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.UI
{
    // Client-only view logic for the main menu (spec 11.3). Raises intents; UiFlowController runs the session calls.
    internal sealed class MainMenuPresenter
    {
        private readonly ISettings _settings;
        private readonly Button _host;
        private readonly Button _join;
        private readonly Button _solo;
        private readonly Button _devHost;
        private readonly Button _devJoin;
        private readonly TextField _codeField;
        private readonly TextField _nameField;
        private bool _actionsEnabled = true;

        public event Action HostRequested;
        public event Action<string> JoinRequested;
        public event Action SoloRequested;
        public event Action SettingsRequested;
        public event Action QuitRequested;
        public event Action DevHostRequested;
        public event Action DevJoinRequested;

        public MainMenuPresenter(VisualElement root, ISettings settings)
        {
            _settings = settings;
            UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "MenuTitle").text = UiStrings.Get("menu.title");
            UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "JoinCodeLabel").text = UiStrings.Get("menu.join_code");
            _host = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "HostButton");
            _join = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "JoinButton");
            _solo = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "SoloButton");
            var settingsButton = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "SettingsButton");
            var quit = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "QuitButton");
            _devHost = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "DevHostButton");
            _devJoin = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "DevJoinButton");
            _codeField = UiQuery.Req<TextField>(root, "JoinCodeField");
            _nameField = UiQuery.Req<TextField>(root, "NameField");
            var devRow = UiQuery.Req<VisualElement>(root, "DevRow");

            _host.text = UiStrings.Get("menu.host");
            _join.text = UiStrings.Get("menu.join");
            _solo.text = UiStrings.Get("menu.solo");
            settingsButton.text = UiStrings.Get("menu.settings");
            quit.text = UiStrings.Get("menu.quit");
            _devHost.text = UiStrings.Get("menu.dev_host");
            _devJoin.text = UiStrings.Get("menu.dev_join");

            _codeField.maxLength = JoinCode.MaxLength;
            _nameField.label = UiStrings.Get("menu.name");
            _nameField.maxLength = DisplayNameRules.MaxLength;
            _nameField.isDelayed = true;

            _host.clicked += () => HostRequested?.Invoke();
            _join.clicked += () => JoinRequested?.Invoke(JoinCode.Normalize(_codeField.text));
            _solo.clicked += () => SoloRequested?.Invoke();
            settingsButton.clicked += () => SettingsRequested?.Invoke();
            quit.clicked += () => QuitRequested?.Invoke();
            _devHost.clicked += () => DevHostRequested?.Invoke();
            _devJoin.clicked += () => DevJoinRequested?.Invoke();

            _codeField.RegisterValueChangedCallback(_ => UpdateButtons());
            _nameField.RegisterValueChangedCallback(_ => CommitName());

            UiQuery.Show(devRow, UiQuery.IsDevBuild);
            Refresh();
        }

        public void Refresh()
        {
            _nameField.SetValueWithoutNotify(_settings.Current.displayName);
            UpdateButtons();
        }

        // Host, Join and Solo (and the dev buttons) are disabled while an operation is pending (spec 11.3).
        public void SetActionsEnabled(bool enabled)
        {
            _actionsEnabled = enabled;
            UpdateButtons();
        }

        public void FocusDefault() => _host.Focus();
        public void FocusSolo() => _solo.Focus();
        public void FocusJoinCode() => _codeField.Focus();

        // Commits the typed name (isDelayed fields only commit on Enter or focus loss) and saves it (spec 11.3).
        public void CommitName()
        {
            var typed = _nameField.text ?? string.Empty;
            if (!string.Equals(typed, _settings.Current.displayName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                _settings.Current.displayName = typed;
                _settings.NotifyChanged();
                _settings.Save();
            }
            _nameField.SetValueWithoutNotify(_settings.Current.displayName);
        }

        private void UpdateButtons()
        {
            _host.SetEnabled(_actionsEnabled);
            _solo.SetEnabled(_actionsEnabled);
            _devHost.SetEnabled(_actionsEnabled);
            _devJoin.SetEnabled(_actionsEnabled);
            _join.SetEnabled(_actionsEnabled && JoinCode.Normalize(_codeField.text).Length > 0);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.UI
{
    // Client-only view logic for the Creating / Joining / Loading screen: text spinner plus Cancel (spec 11.2).
    internal sealed class BusyPresenter
    {
        private static readonly string[] Frames = { "|", "/", "-", "\\" };
        private readonly Label _message;
        private readonly Label _spinner;
        private readonly Button _cancel;
        private readonly IVisualElementScheduledItem _tick;
        private int _frame;

        public event Action CancelRequested;

        public BusyPresenter(VisualElement root)
        {
            _message = UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "BusyLabel");
            _spinner = UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "BusySpinner");
            _cancel = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "CancelButton");
            _cancel.text = UiStrings.Get("busy.cancel");
            _cancel.clicked += () => CancelRequested?.Invoke();
            _tick = root.schedule.Execute(() =>
            {
                _frame = (_frame + 1) % Frames.Length;
                _spinner.text = Frames[_frame];
            }).Every(150);
            _tick.Pause();
        }

        public void Show(string message)
        {
            SetMessage(message);
            _spinner.text = Frames[_frame];
            _tick.Resume();
        }

        public void SetMessage(string message) => _message.text = message ?? string.Empty;

        public void Hide() => _tick.Pause();

        public void FocusDefault() => _cancel.Focus();
    }
}
```
