```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.UI
{
    // Client-only view logic for the M1 settings (spec 11.6). Controls edit ISettings.Current and call NotifyChanged
    // (values apply live). UiFlowController saves when the screen is left; nothing here saves per tick.
    internal sealed class SettingsPresenter
    {
        private readonly ISettings _settings;
        private readonly List<Action> _refreshers = new List<Action>();
        private readonly ScrollView _scroll;
        private readonly TextField _name;
        private VisualElement _firstControl;

        public event Action BackRequested;

        public SettingsPresenter(VisualElement root, ISettings settings)
        {
            _settings = settings;
            UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "SettingsTitle").text = UiStrings.Get("settings.title");
            UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "SectionAudio").text = UiStrings.Get("settings.section_audio");
            UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "SectionGameplay").text = UiStrings.Get("settings.section_gameplay");
            UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "SectionControls").text = UiStrings.Get("settings.section_controls");
            UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "RebindHint").text = UiStrings.Get("settings.rebind_hint");

            _scroll = UiQuery.Req<ScrollView>(root, "SettingsScroll");
            _scroll.RegisterCallback<FocusInEvent>(OnFocusIn, TrickleDown.TrickleDown);

            BindInt(root, "MasterVolume", "settings.master", 0, 100, d => d.masterVolume, (d, v) => d.masterVolume = v);
            BindInt(root, "EffectsVolume", "settings.sfx", 0, 100, d => d.sfxVolume, (d, v) => d.sfxVolume = v);
            BindInt(root, "AmbienceVolume", "settings.ambience", 0, 100, d => d.ambienceVolume, (d, v) => d.ambienceVolume = v);
            BindInt(root, "InterfaceVolume", "settings.ui", 0, 100, d => d.uiVolume, (d, v) => d.uiVolume = v);

            _name = UiQuery.Req<TextField>(root, "SettingsName");
            _name.label = UiStrings.Get("settings.name");
            _name.maxLength = DisplayNameRules.MaxLength;
            _name.isDelayed = true;
            _name.RegisterValueChangedCallback(_ => Commit());
            _refreshers.Add(() => _name.SetValueWithoutNotify(_settings.Current.displayName));

            BindFloat(root, "MouseSensitivity", "settings.mouse", 0.04f, 0.30f, d => d.mouseSensitivity, (d, v) => d.mouseSensitivity = v);
            BindFloat(root, "GamepadLookSpeed", "settings.pad_look", 0.2f, 3.0f, d => d.gamepadLookSpeed, (d, v) => d.gamepadLookSpeed = v);
            BindBool(root, "InvertY", "settings.invert_y", d => d.invertY, (d, v) => d.invertY = v);
            BindInt(root, "FieldOfView", "settings.fov", 80, 110, d => (int)Math.Round(d.fieldOfView), (d, v) => d.fieldOfView = v);
            BindFloat(root, "CameraMotion", "settings.cam_motion", 0f, 1f, d => d.cameraMotion, (d, v) => d.cameraMotion = v);
            BindBool(root, "SprintToggle", "settings.sprint_toggle", d => d.sprintToggle, (d, v) => d.sprintToggle = v);
            BindBool(root, "AimToggle", "settings.aim_toggle", d => d.aimToggle, (d, v) => d.aimToggle = v);
            BindBool(root, "StreamerMode", "settings.streamer", d => d.streamerMode, (d, v) => d.streamerMode = v);
            BindInt(root, "UiScale", "settings.ui_scale", 80, 150, d => d.uiScalePercent, (d, v) => d.uiScalePercent = v);

            var back = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "SettingsBack");
            back.text = UiStrings.Get("settings.back");
            back.clicked += () => BackRequested?.Invoke();
        }

        public void Load()
        {
            foreach (var refresh in _refreshers) refresh();
        }

        public void FocusDefault() => _firstControl?.Focus();

        // Commits a typed but not yet committed display name into Current (no save; the caller saves).
        public void Commit()
        {
            var typed = _name.text ?? string.Empty;
            if (!string.Equals(typed, _settings.Current.displayName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                _settings.Current.displayName = typed;
                _settings.NotifyChanged();
            }
            _name.SetValueWithoutNotify(_settings.Current.displayName);
        }

        // Keeps the focused control visible while navigating with keyboard or gamepad (criterion 11).
        private void OnFocusIn(FocusInEvent evt)
        {
            if (evt.target is VisualElement element && element != _scroll && _scroll.contentContainer.Contains(element))
                _scroll.ScrollTo(element);
        }

        private void BindInt(VisualElement root, string name, string labelKey, int low, int high,
            Func<SettingsData, int> get, Action<SettingsData, int> set)
        {
            var slider = UiQuery.Req<SliderInt>(root, name);
            var label = UiStrings.Get(labelKey);
            slider.lowValue = low;
            slider.highValue = high;
            slider.RegisterValueChangedCallback(e =>
            {
                set(_settings.Current, e.newValue);
                _settings.NotifyChanged();
                slider.label = label + "  " + e.newValue.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            });
            _refreshers.Add(() =>
            {
                var value = get(_settings.Current);
                slider.SetValueWithoutNotify(value);
                slider.label = label + "  " + value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            });
            _firstControl ??= slider;
        }

        private void BindFloat(VisualElement root, string name, string labelKey, float low, float high,
            Func<SettingsData, float> get, Action<SettingsData, float> set)
        {
            var slider = UiQuery.Req<Slider>(root, name);
            var label = UiStrings.Get(labelKey);
            slider.lowValue = low;
            slider.highValue = high;
            slider.RegisterValueChangedCallback(e =>
            {
                set(_settings.Current, e.newValue);
                _settings.NotifyChanged();
                slider.label = label + "  " + e.newValue.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            });
            _refreshers.Add(() =>
            {
                var value = get(_settings.Current);
                slider.SetValueWithoutNotify(value);
                slider.label = label + "  " + value.ToString("0.00", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            });
            _firstControl ??= slider;
        }

        private void BindBool(VisualElement root, string name, string labelKey,
            Func<SettingsData, bool> get, Action<SettingsData, bool> set)
        {
            var toggle = UiQuery.Req<Toggle>(root, name);
            toggle.label = UiStrings.Get(labelKey);
            toggle.RegisterValueChangedCallback(e =>
            {
                set(_settings.Current, e.newValue);
                _settings.NotifyChanged();
            });
            _refreshers.Add(() => toggle.SetValueWithoutNotify(get(_settings.Current)));
            _firstControl ??= toggle;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.UI
{
    // Client-only. Interactive rebinding (spec 8.3 / 11.6) for M1 single-binding actions, one button per control scheme.
    // Overrides persist via IInputBindings.SaveBindingOverrides (settings.json). Move/Look composites and Pause are M2+.
    internal sealed class RebindPresenter
    {
        private const float TimeoutSeconds = 6f;
        private const long StartDelayMs = 150;
        private static readonly string[] ActionPaths = { InputActionNames.Jump, InputActionNames.Sprint, InputActionNames.Interact };
        private static readonly string[] ActionLabelKeys = { "settings.action_jump", "settings.action_sprint", "settings.action_interact" };
        private static readonly string[] KeyboardMousePaths = { "<Keyboard>", "<Mouse>" };
        private static readonly string[] GamepadPaths = { "<Gamepad>" };

        private readonly IInputBindings _bindings;
        private readonly Action _onClick;
        private readonly VisualElement _list;
        private InputActionRebindingExtensions.RebindingOperation _operation;
        private int _endedFrame = -10;

        public event Action BindingsChanged;

        // True while waiting for input and for one frame after, so the Escape that cancels is not also treated as Back.
        public bool IsRebinding => _operation != null || Time.frameCount <= _endedFrame + 1;

        public RebindPresenter(VisualElement root, IInputBindings bindings, Action onClick)
        {
            _bindings = bindings;
            _onClick = onClick;
            _list = UiQuery.Req<VisualElement>(root, "RebindList");
            var reset = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "RebindReset");
            reset.text = UiStrings.Get("settings.rebind_reset");
            reset.clicked += ResetAll;
        }

        public void Refresh()
        {
            _list.Clear();
            var asset = _bindings.Actions;
            if (asset == null) return;
            for (var i = 0; i < ActionPaths.Length; i++)
            {
                var action = asset.FindAction(ActionPaths[i], false);
                if (action == null) continue;
                AddButton(action, ActionLabelKeys[i], InputActionNames.KeyboardMouseScheme, "settings.scheme_kbm", KeyboardMousePaths);
                AddButton(action, ActionLabelKeys[i], InputActionNames.GamepadScheme, "settings.scheme_pad", GamepadPaths);
            }
        }

        // Cancels a running rebind (screen closed). Safe to call when none is running.
        public void CancelActive()
        {
            var op = _operation;
            if (op == null) return;
            if (op.started) op.Cancel();           // raises OnCancel -> Finish
            else if (_operation == op) Finish(null, false, false);
        }

        // Teardown without touching the UI.
        public void Dispose()
        {
            _operation?.Dispose();
            _operation = null;
        }

        private void AddButton(InputAction action, string labelKey, string scheme, string schemeKey, string[] devicePaths)
        {
            var index = action.GetBindingIndex(group: scheme);
            if (index < 0) return;
            var button = new Button();
            button.AddToClassList("menu-button");
            button.AddToClassList("rebind-button");
            button.text = UiStrings.Get(labelKey) + " (" + UiStrings.Get(schemeKey) + "): " + action.GetBindingDisplayString(index);
            button.SetEnabled(_operation == null);
            button.clicked += () =>
            {
                _onClick?.Invoke();
                BeginRebind(action, index, devicePaths, button);
            };
            _list.Add(button);
        }

        private void BeginRebind(InputAction action, int bindingIndex, string[] devicePaths, Button button)
        {
            if (_operation != null) return;
            var wasEnabled = action.enabled;
            if (wasEnabled) action.Disable();   // WithAction throws while the action is enabled (Player map is normally off in Menu).

            button.text = UiStrings.Get("settings.rebind_wait");
            foreach (var child in _list.Children()) child.SetEnabled(child == button);

            var op = action.PerformInteractiveRebinding(bindingIndex)
                .WithCancelingThrough("<Keyboard>/escape")
                .WithTimeout(TimeoutSeconds);
            foreach (var path in devicePaths) op.WithControlsHavingToMatchPath(path);
            op.OnComplete(_ => Finish(action, wasEnabled, true))
              .OnCancel(_ => Finish(action, wasEnabled, false));
            _operation = op;

            // Start slightly later so the Submit/click that opened the rebind is not captured as the new binding.
            _list.schedule.Execute(() =>
            {
                if (_operation == op) op.Start();
            }).StartingIn(StartDelayMs);
        }

        private void Finish(InputAction action, bool wasEnabled, bool completed)
        {
            var op = _operation;
            _operation = null;
            _endedFrame = Time.frameCount;
            op?.Dispose();
            if (action != null && wasEnabled) action.Enable();
            if (completed)
            {
                _bindings.SaveBindingOverrides();
                BindingsChanged?.Invoke();
            }
            Refresh();
        }

        private void ResetAll()
        {
            if (_operation != null) return;
            _bindings.ResetAllBindingOverrides();
            BindingsChanged?.Invoke();
            Refresh();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.UI
{
    // Client-only view logic for the Pause menu (spec 11.3). The join code row is shown online only. Streamer mode masks it;
    // a pointer hold reveals it, and a keyboard/gamepad submit on Reveal shows it for 5 s (UI Toolkit has no submit release).
    internal sealed class PausePresenter
    {
        private const float SubmitRevealSeconds = 5f;
        private readonly ISettings _settings;
        private readonly Button _resume;
        private readonly Button _leave;
        private readonly Button _joins;
        private readonly VisualElement _codeRow;
        private readonly Label _codeText;
        private string _code = string.Empty;
        private bool _showCode;
        private bool _holding;
        private float _revealUntil;

        public event Action ResumeRequested;
        public event Action SettingsRequested;
        public event Action LeaveRequested;
        public event Action JoinsToggleRequested;
        public event Action Copied;

        public PausePresenter(VisualElement root, ISettings settings)
        {
            _settings = settings;
            UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "PauseTitle").text = UiStrings.Get("pause.title");
            UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "CodeLabel").text = UiStrings.Get("pause.code_label");
            _codeRow = UiQuery.Req<VisualElement>(root, "CodeRow");
            _codeText = UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "CodeText");

            _resume = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "ResumeButton");
            _resume.text = UiStrings.Get("pause.resume");
            _resume.clicked += () => ResumeRequested?.Invoke();

            var settingsButton = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "PauseSettingsButton");
            settingsButton.text = UiStrings.Get("pause.settings");
            settingsButton.clicked += () => SettingsRequested?.Invoke();

            _leave = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "LeaveButton");
            _leave.text = UiStrings.Get("pause.leave");
            _leave.clicked += () => LeaveRequested?.Invoke();

            var copy = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "CopyButton");
            copy.text = UiStrings.Get("pause.copy");
            copy.clicked += () =>
            {
                if (_code.Length == 0) return;
                GUIUtility.systemCopyBuffer = _code;   // exactly as session.Code, never the mask
                Copied?.Invoke();
            };

            var reveal = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "RevealButton");
            reveal.text = UiStrings.Get("pause.reveal");
            reveal.RegisterCallback<PointerDownEvent>(_ => _holding = true, TrickleDown.TrickleDown);
            reveal.RegisterCallback<PointerUpEvent>(_ => _holding = false, TrickleDown.TrickleDown);
            reveal.RegisterCallback<PointerCaptureOutEvent>(_ => _holding = false);
            reveal.RegisterCallback<PointerLeaveEvent>(_ => _holding = false);
            reveal.RegisterCallback<NavigationSubmitEvent>(_ => _revealUntil = Time.unscaledTime + SubmitRevealSeconds, TrickleDown.TrickleDown);

            _joins = UiQuery.Req<Button>(root, "JoinsButton");
            _joins.clicked += () => JoinsToggleRequested?.Invoke();
        }

        public void Show(bool showCode, string code, bool showJoinsToggle, bool joinsOpen)
        {
            _showCode = showCode;
            _code = code ?? string.Empty;
            _holding = false;
            _revealUntil = 0f;
            UiQuery.Show(_codeRow, showCode);
            UiQuery.Show(_joins, showJoinsToggle);
            SetJoinsOpen(joinsOpen);
            Tick();
        }

        public void SetJoinsOpen(bool open) => _joins.text = UiStrings.Get(open ? "pause.joins_close" : "pause.joins_open");

        public void SetLeaveEnabled(bool enabled) => _leave.SetEnabled(enabled);

        public void Tick()
        {
            if (!_showCode) return;
            var reveal = !_settings.Current.streamerMode || _holding || Time.unscaledTime < _revealUntil;
            var text = reveal ? _code : UiStrings.Get("pause.masked");
            if (!string.Equals(_codeText.text, text, StringComparison.Ordinal)) _codeText.text = text;
        }

        public void FocusDefault() => _resume.Focus();
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using FishGame.Gameplay;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.UI
{
    // Client-only. HUD placeholder (spec 11.4): static crosshair (UXML), interact prompt "[key] text" at the centre,
    // and the bottom-left prompt strip. Key names come from IInputService for the last-used device.
    internal sealed class HudPresenter : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly Label _prompt;
        private readonly Label _strip;
        private readonly IInputService _input;
        private readonly IDisposable _subscription;
        private InputDeviceKind _device;
        private string _promptText;
        private bool _promptCanInteract = true;

        public HudPresenter(VisualElement root, EventBus bus, IInputService input)
        {
            _input = input;
            _prompt = UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "InteractPrompt");
            _strip = UiQuery.Req<Label>(root, "PromptStrip");
            _device = input.LastDevice;
            UiQuery.Show(_prompt, false);
            _subscription = bus.Subscribe<InteractPromptChanged>(OnPrompt);
        }

        public void Refresh()
        {
            _device = _input.LastDevice;
            _strip.text = UiStrings.Format("hud.strip_interact", KeyFor(InputActionNames.Interact))
                + "    " + UiStrings.Format("hud.strip_pause", KeyFor(InputActionNames.Pause));
            ApplyPrompt();
        }

        // Called every frame while the HUD is visible: re-labels prompts when the player switches device.
        public void Tick()
        {
            if (_input.LastDevice != _device) Refresh();
        }

        public void Dispose() => _subscription.Dispose();

        private void OnPrompt(InteractPromptChanged message)
        {
            _promptText = message.Prompt;
            _promptCanInteract = message.CanInteract;
            ApplyPrompt();
        }

        private void ApplyPrompt()
        {
            var show = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_promptText);
            _prompt.text = show ? UiStrings.Format("hud.key", KeyFor(InputActionNames.Interact)) + " " + _promptText : string.Empty;
            UiQuery.Show(_prompt, show);
            _prompt.EnableInClassList("dim", !_promptCanInteract);
        }

        private string KeyFor(string actionPath)
        {
            var text = _input.GetBindingDisplayString(actionPath);
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? "?" : text;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.UI
{
    // Client-only. Bottom-right toast queue (spec 11.4): at most 4 visible (oldest dropped), each removed after its Seconds.
    // The host join-code toast is masked in streamer mode (spec 11.3).
    internal sealed class ToastPresenter : IDisposable
    {
        private const int MaxVisible = 4;
        private const float DefaultSeconds = 4f;
        private const string JoinCodeKey = "toast.join_code";
        private readonly VisualElement _stack;
        private readonly ISettings _settings;
        private readonly IDisposable _subscription;

        public ToastPresenter(VisualElement root, EventBus bus, ISettings settings)
        {
            _stack = UiQuery.Req<VisualElement>(root, "ToastStack");
            _settings = settings;
            _subscription = bus.Subscribe<ToastRequested>(Show);
        }

        public void Dispose() => _subscription.Dispose();

        private void Show(ToastRequested toast)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(toast.Key)) return;
            var arg = toast.Arg;
            if (arg != null && toast.Key == JoinCodeKey && _settings.Current.streamerMode) arg = UiStrings.Get("pause.masked");
            var text = arg != null ? UiStrings.Format(toast.Key, arg) : UiStrings.Get(toast.Key);
            while (_stack.childCount >= MaxVisible) _stack[0].RemoveFromHierarchy();
            var label = new Label(text) { pickingMode = PickingMode.Ignore };
            label.AddToClassList("toast");
            _stack.Add(label);
            var seconds = toast.Seconds > 0f ? toast.Seconds : DefaultSeconds;
            label.schedule.Execute(() => label.RemoveFromHierarchy()).StartingIn((long)(seconds * 1000f));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Gameplay;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.UI
{
    // Client-only. Nameplates for remote players (PlayerNetState.Active minus Local), projected from each player's
    // NameplateAnchor with Camera.main, tinted with the slot colour, alpha fading from 15 m (opaque) to 25 m (hidden).
    internal sealed class NameplateOverlay
    {
        private const float FadeStartMeters = 15f;
        private const float FadeEndMeters = 25f;
        private const float FallbackHeight = 2.05f;

        private sealed class Entry
        {
            public Label Label;
            public Transform Anchor;
            public string Name;
            public int Slot = -1;
        }

        private readonly VisualElement _layer;
        private readonly Dictionary<PlayerNetState, Entry> _entries = new Dictionary<PlayerNetState, Entry>();
        private readonly List<PlayerNetState> _stale = new List<PlayerNetState>();
        private bool _active;

        public NameplateOverlay(VisualElement layer)
        {
            _layer = layer;
            SetActive(false);
        }

        public void SetActive(bool active)
        {
            _active = active;
            UiQuery.Show(_layer, active);
            if (!active) Clear();
        }

        public void Tick(Camera camera)
        {
            if (!_active || camera == null || _layer.panel == null) return;
            var players = PlayerNetState.Active;
            var local = PlayerNetState.Local;

            _stale.Clear();
            foreach (var pair in _entries)
            {
                if (pair.Key == null || pair.Key == local || !Contains(players, pair.Key)) _stale.Add(pair.Key);
            }
            foreach (var key in _stale)
            {
                _entries[key].Label.RemoveFromHierarchy();
                _entries.Remove(key);
            }

            var cameraTransform = camera.transform;
            for (var i = 0; i < players.Count; i++)
            {
                var player = players[i];
                if (player == null || player == local) continue;

                if (!_entries.TryGetValue(player, out var entry))
                {
                    entry = new Entry { Label = new Label(), Anchor = player.transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.NameplateAnchor) };
                    entry.Label.AddToClassList("nameplate");
                    entry.Label.pickingMode = PickingMode.Ignore;
                    _layer.Add(entry.Label);
                    _entries.Add(player, entry);
                }

                var displayName = player.DisplayName ?? string.Empty;
                if (!string.Equals(displayName, entry.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    entry.Name = displayName;
                    entry.Label.text = displayName;
                }

                int slot = player.Slot;
                if (slot != entry.Slot)
                {
                    entry.Slot = slot;
                    SlotPalette.GetRgb(slot < SlotPalette.Count ? slot : 0, out var r, out var g, out var b);
                    entry.Label.style.color = new Color(r, g, b, 1f);
                }

                var world = entry.Anchor != null ? entry.Anchor.position : player.transform.position + Vector3.up * FallbackHeight;
                var toPlayer = world - cameraTransform.position;
                var alpha = Mathf.Clamp01((FadeEndMeters - toPlayer.magnitude) / (FadeEndMeters - FadeStartMeters));
                var visible = alpha > 0f && Vector3.Dot(cameraTransform.forward, toPlayer) > 0f;
                entry.Label.style.display = visible ? DisplayStyle.Flex : DisplayStyle.None;
                if (!visible) continue;

                entry.Label.style.opacity = alpha;
                var panelPosition = RuntimePanelUtils.CameraTransformWorldToPanel(_layer.panel, world, camera);
                entry.Label.style.left = panelPosition.x;
                entry.Label.style.top = panelPosition.y;
            }
        }

        private void Clear()
        {
            foreach (var pair in _entries) pair.Value.Label.RemoveFromHierarchy();
            _entries.Clear();
        }

        private static bool Contains(IReadOnlyList<PlayerNetState> players, PlayerNetState player)
        {
            for (var i = 0; i < players.Count; i++)
            {
                if (players[i] == player) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Gameplay;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.UI
{
    // Authority: client-only (local UI). Owns the screen state and IInputService.MenuOpen, starts and cancels session
    // attempts, and drives Pause, Settings and the HUD. Services: INetworkSession, ISettings, IInputService, IInputBindings,
    // EventBus, AudioBus. AppBootstrap.Start calls Initialize (Awake would also work); the UIDocument tree is bound in Start (it may not exist yet).
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-500)]
    public sealed class UiFlowController : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private enum MenuFocus : byte { Default = 0, Solo = 1, JoinCode = 2 }

        private const int MinUiScalePercent = 80;
        private const int MaxUiScalePercent = 150;

        private ISettings _settings;
        private IInputService _input;
        private IInputBindings _bindings;
        private INetworkSession _session;
        private EventBus _bus;
        private AudioBus _audio;

        private UIDocument _document;
        private PanelSettings _panelCopy;
        private VisualElement _root;
        private VisualElement _mainMenu;
        private VisualElement _busy;
        private VisualElement _settingsScreen;
        private VisualElement _pause;
        private VisualElement _hud;

        private MainMenuPresenter _menu;
        private BusyPresenter _busyPresenter;
        private SettingsPresenter _settingsPresenter;
        private RebindPresenter _rebind;
        private PausePresenter _pausePresenter;
        private HudPresenter _hudPresenter;
        private ToastPresenter _toasts;
        private NameplateOverlay _nameplates;
        private IDisposable _toastSoundSubscription;

        private CancellationTokenSource _attempt;
        private UiScreen _screen = UiScreen.None;
        private UiScreen _settingsReturn = UiScreen.MainMenu;
        private UiScreen _pendingScreen = UiScreen.None;
        private bool _hasPendingScreen;
        private MenuFocus _menuFocus = MenuFocus.Default;
        private bool _initialized;
        private bool _started;
        private bool _bound;
        private bool _leaving;
        private bool _inGame;
        private int _screenChangedFrame = -1;

        public UiScreen CurrentScreen => _screen;

        public void Initialize(ServiceRegistry app)
        {
            if (_initialized) return;
            if (app == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(app));
            _settings = app.Get<ISettings>();
            _input = app.Get<IInputService>();
            _bindings = app.Get<IInputBindings>();
            _session = app.Get<INetworkSession>();
            _bus = app.Get<EventBus>();
            _audio = app.Get<AudioBus>();

            _settings.Changed += OnSettingsChanged;
            _session.StateChanged += OnSessionStateChanged;
            _session.Ended += OnSessionEnded;
            SceneManager.activeSceneChanged += OnActiveSceneChanged;
            _initialized = true;
            if (_started) Bind();
        }

        public void Show(UiScreen screen)
        {
            if (!_bound)
            {
                _pendingScreen = screen;
                _hasPendingScreen = true;
                return;
            }

            var previous = _screen;
            if (previous == UiScreen.Settings && screen != UiScreen.Settings) CloseSettings();

            _screen = screen;
            _screenChangedFrame = Time.frameCount;
            var settingsOverGame = screen == UiScreen.Settings && _settingsReturn == UiScreen.Pause;
            _inGame = screen == UiScreen.Hud || screen == UiScreen.Pause || settingsOverGame;

            UiQuery.Show(_mainMenu, screen == UiScreen.MainMenu);
            UiQuery.Show(_busy, screen == UiScreen.Busy);
            UiQuery.Show(_settingsScreen, screen == UiScreen.Settings);
            UiQuery.Show(_pause, screen == UiScreen.Pause);
            UiQuery.Show(_hud, _inGame);
            _nameplates.SetActive(_inGame);

            _input.MenuOpen = IsMenuScreen(screen);
            SetSoloPaused(screen == UiScreen.Pause || settingsOverGame);
            if (screen != UiScreen.Busy) _busyPresenter.Hide();

            switch (screen)
            {
                case UiScreen.MainMenu:
                    _menu.Refresh();
                    _menu.SetActionsEnabled(_session.State == ConnState.Offline && _attempt == null);
                    break;
                case UiScreen.Settings:
                    _settingsPresenter.Load();
                    _rebind.Refresh();
                    break;
                case UiScreen.Pause:
                    ShowPauseData();
                    break;
                case UiScreen.Hud:
                    _hudPresenter.Refresh();
                    break;
            }

            if (!IsMenuScreen(screen)) BlurFocus();
            var target = screen;
            _root.schedule.Execute(() => FocusScreen(target));
        }

        private void Start()
        {
            _started = true;
            if (_initialized) Bind();
        }

        private void Bind()
        {
            if (_bound) return;
            _document = GetComponent<UIDocument>();
            if (_document == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("UiFlowController needs a UIDocument on the same GameObject.");
                return;
            }

            var original = _document.panelSettings;
            if (original != null)
            {
                _panelCopy = Instantiate(original);           // D29: never modify the asset at runtime
                _panelCopy.name = original.name + " (Runtime)";
                _document.panelSettings = _panelCopy;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogError("UiFlowController: the UIDocument has no PanelSettings; UI scale is disabled.");
            }

            _root = _document.rootVisualElement;
            if (_root == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("UiFlowController: the UIDocument has no root visual element.");
                return;
            }

            BindScreens();
            _bound = true;
            ApplyUiScale();
            var first = _hasPendingScreen ? _pendingScreen : ScreenForScene(SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name);
            _hasPendingScreen = false;
            Show(first);
        }

        private void BindScreens()
        {
            _mainMenu = UiQuery.Req<VisualElement>(_root, "ScreenMainMenu");
            _busy = UiQuery.Req<VisualElement>(_root, "ScreenBusy");
            _settingsScreen = UiQuery.Req<VisualElement>(_root, "ScreenSettings");
            _pause = UiQuery.Req<VisualElement>(_root, "ScreenPause");
            _hud = UiQuery.Req<VisualElement>(_root, "ScreenHud");
            var nameplateLayer = UiQuery.Req<VisualElement>(_root, "NameplateLayer");

            _menu = new MainMenuPresenter(_mainMenu, _settings);
            _menu.HostRequested += () => StartAttempt("busy.creating", HostAsync);
            _menu.JoinRequested += OnJoinRequested;
            _menu.SoloRequested += () => StartAttempt("busy.loading", ct => _session.StartLocalAsync(false, ct));
            _menu.DevHostRequested += () => StartAttempt("busy.creating", ct => _session.StartLocalAsync(true, ct));
            _menu.DevJoinRequested += () => StartAttempt("busy.joining",
                ct => _session.JoinDirectAsync(NetworkConstants.LoopbackAddress, NetworkConstants.DefaultPort, ct));
            _menu.SettingsRequested += () => OpenSettings(UiScreen.MainMenu);
            _menu.QuitRequested += QuitApplication;

            _busyPresenter = new BusyPresenter(_busy);
            _busyPresenter.CancelRequested += CancelAttempt;

            _settingsPresenter = new SettingsPresenter(_settingsScreen, _settings);
            _settingsPresenter.BackRequested += () => Show(_settingsReturn);
            _rebind = new RebindPresenter(_settingsScreen, _bindings, PlayClick);

            _pausePresenter = new PausePresenter(_pause, _settings);
            _pausePresenter.ResumeRequested += () => Show(UiScreen.Hud);
            _pausePresenter.SettingsRequested += () => OpenSettings(UiScreen.Pause);
            _pausePresenter.LeaveRequested += LeaveSession;
            _pausePresenter.JoinsToggleRequested += ToggleJoins;
            _pausePresenter.Copied += () => _bus.Publish(new ToastRequested("pause.copied", null, 2f));

            _hudPresenter = new HudPresenter(_hud, _bus, _input);
            _toasts = new ToastPresenter(_root, _bus, _settings);
            _nameplates = new NameplateOverlay(nameplateLayer);

            // Every UXML button plays Ui_Click on press (pointer, keyboard submit and gamepad submit all raise clicked).
            _root.Query<Button>().ForEach(button => button.clicked += PlayClick);
            _toastSoundSubscription = _bus.Subscribe<ToastRequested>(OnToastSound);
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (!_bound) return;
            if (_input.Intent.PausePressed && Time.frameCount != _screenChangedFrame) HandleBack();
            if (_screen == UiScreen.Pause) _pausePresenter.Tick();
            if (_inGame)
            {
                _hudPresenter.Tick();
                _nameplates.Tick(Camera.main);
            }
            if (IsMenuScreen(_screen) && _input.LastDevice == InputDeviceKind.Gamepad && FocusedElement() == null)
                FocusScreen(_screen);
        }

        // Single handler for Escape / Start / UI Cancel (D27): no NavigationCancelEvent handlers exist.
        private void HandleBack()
        {
            switch (_screen)
            {
                case UiScreen.Hud: Show(UiScreen.Pause); break;
                case UiScreen.Pause: Show(UiScreen.Hud); break;
                case UiScreen.Settings:
                    if (!_rebind.IsRebinding) Show(_settingsReturn);
                    break;
                case UiScreen.Busy: CancelAttempt(); break;
            }
        }

        private void OpenSettings(UiScreen returnTo)
        {
            _settingsReturn = returnTo;
            Show(UiScreen.Settings);
        }

        // Spec 11.6: save when the panel closes, whichever way it closes.
        private void CloseSettings()
        {
            _rebind.CancelActive();
            _settingsPresenter.Commit();
            _settings.Save();
        }

        private void ShowPauseData()
        {
            var state = SessionState.Current;
            var code = _session.JoinCode;
            var showCode = _session.Mode == SessionMode.Online && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(code);
            var showJoins = UiQuery.IsDevBuild && _session.IsHost && _session.Mode != SessionMode.Solo && state != null;
            _pausePresenter.Show(showCode, code, showJoins, state == null || state.JoinsOpen);
            _pausePresenter.SetLeaveEnabled(!_leaving);
        }

        private async void StartAttempt(string messageKey, Func<CancellationToken, Task> operation)
        {
            if (_attempt != null || _session.State != ConnState.Offline) return;
            _menu.CommitName();                                  // the connect payload reads Current.displayName
            var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
            _attempt = cts;
            _busyPresenter.Show(UiStrings.Get(messageKey));
            Show(UiScreen.Busy);

            var succeeded = false;
            try
            {
                await operation(cts.Token);
                succeeded = true;
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                // Cancel ends the attempt with UserLeft: no toast.
            }
            catch (NetworkSessionException ex)
            {
                // Ended(reason) already fired; SceneFlow (T13) publishes the toast (D8). Raw text is logged only.
                Debug.Log("FishGame UI: session attempt ended: " + ex.Reason);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.LogException(ex);
                _bus.Publish(new ToastRequested("err.generic"));
            }
            finally
            {
                if (_attempt == cts) _attempt = null;
                cts.Dispose();
            }

            if (!_initialized || !_bound) return;
            if (!succeeded && _screen == UiScreen.Busy) Show(UiScreen.MainMenu);
            else _menu.SetActionsEnabled(_session.State == ConnState.Offline);
        }

        private async Task HostAsync(CancellationToken ct)
        {
            var code = await _session.HostOnlineAsync(ct);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(code)) _bus.Publish(new ToastRequested("toast.join_code", code, 10f));
        }

        private void OnJoinRequested(string code)
        {
            if (!JoinCode.IsPlausible(code))
            {
                _bus.Publish(new ToastRequested("err.code_not_found"));
                _menu.FocusJoinCode();                           // text is kept (spec 11.2)
                return;
            }
            StartAttempt("busy.joining", ct => _session.JoinOnlineAsync(code, ct));
        }

        private void CancelAttempt()
        {
            if (_attempt != null)
            {
                _attempt.Cancel();
                return;
            }
            // Already connected and waiting for the scene load: Cancel leaves instead.
            if (_session.State != ConnState.Offline) LeaveSession();
        }

        private async void LeaveSession()
        {
            if (_leaving) return;
            _leaving = true;
            if (_bound) _pausePresenter.SetLeaveEnabled(false);
            try
            {
                await _session.LeaveAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.LogException(ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                _leaving = false;
                if (_initialized && _bound) _pausePresenter.SetLeaveEnabled(true);
            }
        }

        // Dev-only host command (criterion 6): SessionState.NetJoinsOpen + Sessions lock.
        private async void ToggleJoins()
        {
            var state = SessionState.Current;
            if (state == null || !state.IsServer || !_session.IsHost) return;
            var open = !state.JoinsOpen;
            state.ServerSetJoinsOpen(open);
            _pausePresenter.SetJoinsOpen(open);
            try
            {
                await _session.SetJoinableAsync(open);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.LogException(ex);
            }
        }

        private void OnActiveSceneChanged(Scene previous, Scene next)
        {
            if (!_bound) return;
            Show(ScreenForScene(next.name));
        }

        private void OnSessionEnded(EndReason reason)
        {
            if (!_bound) return;
            if (reason == EndReason.ServicesUnavailable) _menuFocus = MenuFocus.Solo;        // "Play Solo instead"
            else if (reason == EndReason.InvalidCode) _menuFocus = MenuFocus.JoinCode;
            if (_screen == UiScreen.Busy) Show(UiScreen.MainMenu);
        }

        private void OnSessionStateChanged(ConnState previous, ConnState current)
        {
            if (!_bound) return;
            if (_screen == UiScreen.Busy && current == ConnState.Connected)
                _busyPresenter.SetMessage(UiStrings.Get("busy.loading"));
            _menu.SetActionsEnabled(current == ConnState.Offline && _attempt == null);
        }

        private void OnSettingsChanged(SettingsData data) => ApplyUiScale();

        private void ApplyUiScale()
        {
            if (_panelCopy == null || _settings == null) return;
            var percent = Mathf.Clamp(_settings.Current.uiScalePercent, MinUiScalePercent, MaxUiScalePercent);
            _panelCopy.scale = percent / 100f;
        }

        private void SetSoloPaused(bool paused)
        {
            if (_session.Mode != SessionMode.Solo) return;
            var game = ServiceRoots.Game;
            if (game != null && game.TryGet<IPauseState>(out var pause)) pause.SetPaused(paused);
        }

        private void FocusScreen(UiScreen screen)
        {
            if (!_bound || _screen != screen) return;
            switch (screen)
            {
                case UiScreen.MainMenu:
                    var focus = _menuFocus;
                    _menuFocus = MenuFocus.Default;
                    if (focus == MenuFocus.Solo) _menu.FocusSolo();
                    else if (focus == MenuFocus.JoinCode) _menu.FocusJoinCode();
                    else _menu.FocusDefault();
                    break;
                case UiScreen.Busy: _busyPresenter.FocusDefault(); break;
                case UiScreen.Settings: _settingsPresenter.FocusDefault(); break;
                case UiScreen.Pause: _pausePresenter.FocusDefault(); break;
            }
        }

        private Focusable FocusedElement() => _root?.panel?.focusController?.focusedElement;

        private void BlurFocus() => FocusedElement()?.Blur();

        private void PlayClick() => _audio.PlayUi(SfxIds.UiClick);

        private void OnToastSound(ToastRequested toast)
        {
            if (toast.Key == null) return;
            if (toast.Key.StartsWith("err.", StringComparison.Ordinal)) _audio.PlayUi(SfxIds.UiError);
            else if (toast.Key == "toast.join_code") _audio.PlayUi(SfxIds.UiConfirm);
        }

        private static bool IsMenuScreen(UiScreen screen) =>
            screen == UiScreen.MainMenu || screen == UiScreen.Busy || screen == UiScreen.Settings || screen == UiScreen.Pause;

        private static UiScreen ScreenForScene(string sceneName)
        {
            if (sceneName == SceneNames.Menu) return UiScreen.MainMenu;
            if (SceneNames.IsGameplay(sceneName)) return UiScreen.Hud;
            return UiScreen.None;   // Bootstrap
        }

        private static void QuitApplication()
        {
#if UNITY_EDITOR
            UnityEditor.EditorApplication.isPlaying = false;
#else
            Application.Quit();
#endif
        }

        private void OnApplicationQuit()
        {
            if (!_initialized) return;
            if (_bound && _screen == UiScreen.Settings) _settingsPresenter.Commit();
            _settings.Save();                                   // spec 11.6: saved on quit
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            if (!_initialized) return;
            _initialized = false;
            SceneManager.activeSceneChanged -= OnActiveSceneChanged;
            _settings.Changed -= OnSettingsChanged;
            _session.StateChanged -= OnSessionStateChanged;
            _session.Ended -= OnSessionEnded;
            _toastSoundSubscription?.Dispose();
            _toasts?.Dispose();
            _hudPresenter?.Dispose();
            _rebind?.Dispose();
            _attempt?.Cancel();
            _bound = false;
            if (_panelCopy != null) Destroy(_panelCopy);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task 15: Editor builders, validators, architecture test, start-scene hook, Auto Solo

Builds every generated asset in M1 from code, then checks the result. "Generated" means project settings, materials, data assets, the three network prefabs, the owned network prefab list, the Bootstrap, Menu and Spot_LakeDock scenes, and the build list. It covers spec 4.2 steps 2, 4 and 5, spec 4.6, spec 4.7 #1–#7, the 4.9 architecture test, and spec 17.1 items 2 and 9.

**NGO 2.13.3 / Unity 6000.6 facts this task relies on (checked in package source; no fallbacks needed)**

`NetworkManager` and `NetworkConfig`:
- `NetworkManager.NetworkConfig` is a public field. It can be **null** right after `AddComponent<NetworkManager>()` when `GenerateDefaultNetworkPrefabs` is off: the editor's reset hook only builds a config while that setting is on. So the builder creates one with `new NetworkConfig()`.
- `NetworkConfig` public fields:
  - `NetworkTransport`
  - `TickRate` (uint)
  - `ConnectionApproval`
  - `EnableSceneManagement`
  - `ProtocolVersion` (ushort)
  - `PlayerPrefab`
  - `ForceSamePrefabs`
  - `Prefabs` (a `NetworkPrefabs`, whose `NetworkPrefabsLists` is a `List<NetworkPrefabsList>`)

Network prefab types:
- `NetworkPrefabsList` (namespace `Unity.Netcode`) has `Add(NetworkPrefab)`, `Remove(NetworkPrefab)`, `Contains(GameObject)` and `PrefabList`.
- `NetworkPrefab` is a `[Serializable]` class with a public `GameObject Prefab` field and an implicit parameterless constructor.

`NetworkObject` and `NetworkTransform`:
- `NetworkObject.GlobalObjectIdHash` is a serialized internal field, set in `internal void OnValidate()`. The builder calls that by reflection after saving each prefab, so the hash is on disk.
- `NetworkTransform` (namespace `Unity.Netcode.Components`):
  - Enums `AuthorityModes { Server, Owner }` and `InterpolationTypes { LegacyLerp, Lerp, SmoothDampening }`.
  - Public fields `AuthorityMode`, `SyncPositionX/Y/Z`, `SyncRotAngleX/Y/Z`, `SyncScaleX/Y/Z`, `InLocalSpace`, `Interpolate`, `PositionInterpolationType`, `RotationInterpolationType`, `UseUnreliableDeltas`, `SwitchTransformSpaceWhenParented`.

NGO project settings:
- `NetcodeForGameObjectsProjectSettings` (namespace `Unity.Netcode.Editor.Configuration`) is a `ScriptableSingleton`. It is reached through `.instance`, has the public field `GenerateDefaultNetworkPrefabs`, and has `internal void SaveSettings()`, which is called by reflection.
- NGO's `NetworkPrefabProcessor` runs on **every** asset import or delete while that setting is on. It then recreates `Assets/DefaultNetworkPrefabs.asset`. So the setting is turned off first.

URP, input and UI:
- URP 17.6 `UniversalRenderPipelineAsset` has public setters for `msaaSampleCount`, `supportsCameraDepthTexture`, `supportsCameraOpaqueTexture`, `supportsHDR`, `shadowDistance` and `shadowCascadeCount`. `supportsSoftShadows` has an **internal** setter, so the builder uses `SerializedObject` on `m_SoftShadowsSupported`.
- Input System 1.20.0:
  - The `InputSystem.actions` setter returns early when the current value is already null.
  - The persisted entry is the `EditorBuildSettings` config object `com.unity.input.settings.actions`, so the builder also calls `EditorBuildSettings.RemoveConfigObject` for that key.
- UI Toolkit (6000.6): `UIDocument.visualTreeAsset` exists; `sourceAsset` does not. `PanelSettings` exposes `scaleMode`, `referenceResolution` (`Vector2Int`), `screenMatchMode`, `match` and `themeStyleSheet`.

Editor APIs and test framework:
- `EditorSettings.serializationMode` is **not** in the 6000.6 API docs. Force Text is therefore validated by reading the text of `ProjectSettings/EditorSettings.asset`.
- `UnityEditor.SessionState` exists. Any file with `using UnityEditor;` that names the gameplay `SessionState` must write `FishGame.Gameplay.SessionState`.
- Test Framework 1.8.0:
  - It has `static TestRunnerApi.RegisterTestCallback<T>(T callbacks, int priority = 0)`.
  - For PlayMode runs it raises `RunStarted` only **after** entering play mode, so the start-scene guard also hooks `ExitingEditMode`.

**Decisions made here**
1. `ProjectBuilder.RunAll` runs these steps in order, and runs every step even after one fails (it collects errors):
   1. ProjectSettings
   2. Content
   3. Prefabs
   4. NetworkPrefabs
   5. Scenes
   6. BuildSettings
   7. `AssetDatabase.SaveAssets()`
   8. Validate

   `SceneBuilder.BuildAll()` does not call `ApplyBuildSettings()`. `RunAll` is its only caller. Saving comes before validating because the validators read files on disk.
2. Logging, all through `Debug.Log`:
   - On success: `FG BUILDALL PASS`, then return normally (D40).
   - On failure: `FG BUILDALL FAIL errors=N`, then one `FG BUILDALL ERROR <text>` line per error, then `EditorApplication.Exit(1)`, but only when `Application.isBatchMode`.
3. Validators read only persisted state and never open a scene. The test-edit run is a separate Unity process, so a pass there also proves that `BuildAll` saved everything.
4. `ProjectSettingsBuilder` marks the TagManager, DynamicsManager, EditorSettings and ProjectSettings objects dirty, then calls `SaveAssets()`. Changes made through the API (`Physics.IgnoreLayerCollision`, `EditorSettings`, `PlayerSettings`) would otherwise not be written reliably.
5. Lake meshes are persisted as mesh assets under the new folder `Assets/_Project/Content/Meshes/`. On a rebuild they are refilled in place, so the GUID never changes and the bytes stay the same. The scene file stays small. They use unshared vertices, which gives a flat-shaded low-poly look.
6. The colours of the materials that the contract does not specify:

   | Material | Colour (RGB) |
   |---|---|
   | `M_Water` | (0.12, 0.36, 0.62) |
   | `M_Wood` | (0.55, 0.38, 0.22) |
   | `M_WoodDark` | (0.36, 0.24, 0.14) |
   | `M_Rock` | (0.46, 0.46, 0.48) |
   | `M_Grass` | (0.32, 0.56, 0.26) |
   | `M_Sand` | (0.84, 0.77, 0.56) |
   | `M_Foliage` | (0.18, 0.40, 0.20) |
   | `M_Brass` | (0.82, 0.66, 0.26) |
7. Lake-dock numbers (contract §6.5, D34, D36):
   - Shoreline R = 50.
   - Bed y = −6·clamp01((50 − r)/40). Check: at (12, −44), r = 45.61, so y ≈ −0.66 m, which matches the contract.
   - Ladders are boxes at x ±1.58, z −41.5, running from the lakebed up to the deck top at 0.6.
   - The RampDeck is a 3 × 0.1 box from (12, −0.9, −43) to (12, 0.4, −51). Its top surface sits about flush with the lakebed.
   - The shore has 14 seeded rocks (r 48–54) and 30 seeded trees (r 58–85). A placement is rejected if z ≤ −38 and it lies within 3 m (rocks) or 5 m (trees) of x 0 (the dock and the scene-camera sightline) or of x 12 (the ramp).
8. `PlayModeStartScene.Apply()` sets the start scene only outside batchmode. In batchmode it clears it.
9. The manifest validator checks all spec 4.4 version pins, including the template ones, plus the never-add list and a direct `com.unity.transport` entry.
10. The NetworkPrefabs validator asserts all of the following, so spec 4.7 #1 ("every reference resolves") and #2 are covered without opening scenes:
    - Every prefab with a root `NetworkObject` under `Assets/_Project` is in the owned list.
    - The three M1 prefabs have distinct, non-zero `GlobalObjectIdHash` values on disk.
    - No prefab has a missing script.
    - The Bootstrap scene text references the list and `SessionState.prefab`.
    - The Spot_LakeDock scene text references `PlayerFP.prefab` and `DockBell.prefab`.
11. `ProjectSettingsBuilder` repoints `PC_RPAsset`'s `m_VolumeProfile`, left dangling by T1's deletion of `SampleSceneProfile.asset`, to `Assets/Settings/DefaultVolumeProfile.asset` (GUID `ab09877e2e707104187f6f83e2f62510`); the ProjectSettings validator fails if the deleted GUID is still referenced. The Mobile assets are left alone (spec 4.2 #5).
12. `PrefabBuilder` sets `CharacterController.minMoveDistance = 0` on `PlayerFP`, so per-frame moves below 1 mm (high batchmode frame rates) are not dropped in T16.

**Known, accepted limits**
- `NewScene` gives scene objects fresh local file IDs, so `.unity` contents churn on every rebuild. Positions, names and order are deterministic. Scene GUIDs (`.meta`), prefabs, meshes, materials and data assets are byte-stable, and step 5.4 checks this.
- The Nose is a child of the Head sphere (scale 0.28), so it is drawn at about 0.28 of its table size. The contract table is implemented as written.
- PlayMode tests in batchmode (`unity.ps1 test-play`) never see the start scene, because `Apply()` does nothing in batchmode. The `ExitingEditMode` guard only matters for runs from the editor menu or the Test Runner window, and it is checked manually in T17.

```csharp
// Shared helpers for the T15 builders and validators (spec 4.6 overwrite rules). Owned by T15.
// Get-or-add keeps components, children and the root NetworkObject (and so its GlobalObjectIdHash) stable across rebuilds.
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    internal static class BuilderUtil
    {
        // Input System 1.20.0 stores the project-wide actions as this EditorBuildSettings config object.
        public const string ProjectWideActionsConfigKey = "com.unity.input.settings.actions";

        static readonly MethodInfo NetworkObjectOnValidate =
            typeof(NetworkObject).GetMethod("OnValidate", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);

        // Absolute path for a project-relative path ("Assets/...", "ProjectSettings/...", "Packages/...").
        public static string Abs(string projectRelativePath) =>
            Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(Application.dataPath), projectRelativePath));

        public static string Folder(string assetPath) => assetPath.Substring(0, assetPath.LastIndexOf('/'));

        // Creates every missing level of "Assets/A/B/C" through the AssetDatabase (folder .meta files included).
        public static void EnsureFolder(string folder)
        {
            string[] parts = folder.Split('/');
            string current = parts[0];
            for (int i = 1; i < parts.Length; i++)
            {
                string next = current + "/" + parts[i];
                if (!AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(next)) AssetDatabase.CreateFolder(current, parts[i]);
                current = next;
            }
        }

        public static T GetOrAdd<T>(GameObject go) where T : Component
        {
            T existing = go.GetComponent<T>();
            return existing != null ? existing : go.AddComponent<T>();
        }

        // Walks "A/B/C" below root, creating missing levels as empty GameObjects.
        public static Transform EnsurePath(Transform root, string path)
        {
            Transform current = root;
            foreach (string segment in path.Split('/'))
            {
                Transform next = current.Find(segment);
                if (next == null)
                {
                    var go = new GameObject(segment);
                    go.transform.SetParent(current, false);
                    next = go.transform;
                }
                current = next;
            }
            return current;
        }

        // Creates or reuses a primitive child. Its collider is removed unless keepCollider is true.
        public static GameObject EnsurePrimitive(Transform parent, string name, PrimitiveType type,
            Vector3 localPosition, Quaternion localRotation, Vector3 localScale, Material material, bool keepCollider)
        {
            Transform existing = parent.Find(name);
            GameObject go;
            if (existing != null)
            {
                go = existing.gameObject;
            }
            else
            {
                go = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(type);
                go.name = name;
                go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            }
            go.transform.localPosition = localPosition;
            go.transform.localRotation = localRotation;
            go.transform.localScale = localScale;
            if (!keepCollider)
            {
                Collider collider = go.GetComponent<Collider>();
                if (collider != null) Object.DestroyImmediate(collider);
            }
            MeshRenderer renderer = go.GetComponent<MeshRenderer>();
            if (renderer != null && material != null) renderer.sharedMaterial = material;
            return go;
        }

        public static void SetLayerRecursive(GameObject go, int layer)
        {
            go.layer = layer;
            foreach (Transform child in go.transform) SetLayerRecursive(child.gameObject, layer);
        }

        // Spec 4.6: an existing prefab is edited through LoadPrefabContents, so its GUID and its components survive.
        public static void WritePrefab(string assetPath, System.Action<GameObject> build)
        {
            EnsureFolder(Folder(assetPath));
            if (AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(assetPath) != null)
            {
                GameObject contents = PrefabUtility.LoadPrefabContents(assetPath);
                try
                {
                    build(contents);
                    PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(contents, assetPath, out bool saved);
                    if (!saved) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Could not save prefab " + assetPath);
                }
                finally
                {
                    PrefabUtility.UnloadPrefabContents(contents);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                var root = new GameObject(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(assetPath));
                try
                {
                    build(root);
                    PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(root, assetPath, out bool saved);
                    if (!saved) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Could not save prefab " + assetPath);
                }
                finally
                {
                    Object.DestroyImmediate(root);
                }
            }
        }

        // NGO computes GlobalObjectIdHash in NetworkObject.OnValidate (internal in 2.13.3) from the asset's GlobalObjectId.
        // A prefab saved from a temporary object can still hold 0, so run it on the saved asset and write the result to disk.
        public static void RefreshNetworkObjectHash(string prefabPath)
        {
            NetworkObject networkObject = LoadNetworkPrefab(prefabPath);
            if (NetworkObjectOnValidate == null)
                throw new System.MissingMethodException("NetworkObject.OnValidate not found (expected internal in NGO 2.13.3)");
            NetworkObjectOnValidate.Invoke(networkObject, null);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
        }

        public static NetworkObject LoadNetworkPrefab(string prefabPath)
        {
            GameObject go = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(prefabPath);
            if (go == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("Missing prefab " + prefabPath);
            NetworkObject networkObject = go.GetComponent<NetworkObject>();
            if (networkObject == null) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("No root NetworkObject on " + prefabPath);
            return networkObject;
        }

        // Spec 4.6: scenes are rebuilt from an empty scene and saved to the same path (same .meta, same GUID).
        public static void SaveScene(Scene scene, string assetPath)
        {
            EnsureFolder(Folder(assetPath));
            EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(scene);
            if (!EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(scene, assetPath))
                throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Could not save scene " + assetPath);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Text access to persisted files for the validators (YAML settings, manifest, scenes, prefabs). Owned by T15.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    internal static class ValidationText
    {
        public static string Read(string projectRelativePath)
        {
            string abs = BuilderUtil.Abs(projectRelativePath);
            return File.Exists(abs) ? File.ReadAllText(abs) : null;
        }

        // Each entry is "key: value". It must match a whole YAML line (leading spaces allowed).
        public static void ExpectLines(string projectRelativePath, List<string> errors, params string[] keyValues)
        {
            string text = Read(projectRelativePath);
            if (text == null) { errors.Add("missing " + projectRelativePath); return; }
            foreach (string keyValue in keyValues)
            {
                int colon = keyValue.IndexOf(':');
                string key = keyValue.Substring(0, colon);
                string value = keyValue.Substring(colon + 1).Trim();
                string pattern = "^\\s*" + Regex.Escape(key) + ":\\s*" + Regex.Escape(value) + "\\s*$";
                if (!Regex.IsMatch(text, pattern, RegexOptions.Multiline))
                    errors.Add(projectRelativePath + " must contain '" + keyValue + "'");
            }
        }

        // First capture group of pattern in the file, or null.
        public static string FirstGroup(string projectRelativePath, string pattern)
        {
            string text = Read(projectRelativePath);
            if (text == null) return null;
            Match match = Regex.Match(text, pattern, RegexOptions.Multiline);
            return match.Success ? match.Groups[1].Value : null;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Spec 4.7 invariants for M1 (#1-#7; #8 arrives in M3, and #9 has no FishGame shaders before M2). Owned by T15.
// Reads persisted state only (asset files, ProjectSettings text, Packages/manifest.json) and never opens a scene.
// The separate test-edit process therefore also proves that BuildAll saved everything.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Data;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    public static class Validators
    {
        static readonly string[] M1NetworkPrefabs = { AssetPaths.PlayerPrefab, AssetPaths.DockBellPrefab, AssetPaths.SessionStatePrefab };

        // GUID of Assets/Settings/SampleSceneProfile.asset, deleted by T1 (spec 4.2 #1).
        const string DeletedSampleSceneProfileGuid = "10fc4df2da32a41aaa32d77bc913491c";

        // Spec 4.4 pins ("name@version"). Rows marked "as in template" in the spec (timeline, ide.*) are not pinned here.
        static readonly string[] ManifestPins =
        {
            "com.unity.netcode.gameobjects@2.13.3", "com.unity.services.multiplayer@2.3.3",
            "com.unity.services.authentication@3.8.0", "com.unity.services.core@1.18.0",
            "com.unity.multiplayer.playmode@3.0.0", "com.unity.multiplayer.tools@2.2.12",
            "com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json@3.2.2", "com.unity.inputsystem@1.20.0",
            "com.unity.render-pipelines.universal@17.6.0", "com.unity.test-framework@1.8.0",
            "com.unity.ugui@2.6.0", "com.unity.ai.navigation@2.0.15", "com.unity.pipeline@0.8.0-exp.1",
        };

        // Spec 4.2 #3 removals, the 4.4 "never add" list, and com.unity.transport (transitive only, never listed).
        static readonly string[] ForbiddenPackages =
        {
            "com.unity.visualscripting", "com.unity.collab-proxy", "com.unity.services.relay", "com.unity.services.lobby",
            "com.unity.services.matchmaker", "com.unity.services.multiplay", "com.unity.multiplayer.widgets",
            "com.unity.textmeshpro", "com.unity.cinemachine", "com.unity.transport",
        };

        // 4.7 #1. Inside this class the method name shadows FishGame.Core.ContentIds, so the type is written with global::.
        public static List<string> ContentIds()
        {
            var errors = new List<string>();
            var registry = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<ContentRegistry>(AssetPaths.ContentRegistryAsset);
            if (registry == null) { errors.Add("ContentRegistry missing at " + AssetPaths.ContentRegistryAsset); return errors; }
            foreach (string error in registry.Validate()) errors.Add(error);

            var buildSceneNames = new HashSet<string>();
            foreach (EditorBuildSettingsScene scene in EditorBuildSettings.scenes)
                buildSceneNames.Add(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(scene.path));

            bool lakeDockListed = false;
            foreach (SpotDef spot in registry.Spots)
            {
                if (spot == null) continue; // reported by Validate()
                if (spot.Id == global::FishGame.Core.ContentIds.LakeDock)
                {
                    lakeDockListed = true;
                    if (spot.SceneName != SceneNames.SpotLakeDock)
                        errors.Add("lake_dock sceneName is '" + spot.SceneName + "', expected " + SceneNames.SpotLakeDock);
                }
                if (!buildSceneNames.Contains(spot.SceneName))
                    errors.Add("spot " + spot.Id + " references scene '" + spot.SceneName + "', which is not in the build list");
            }
            if (!lakeDockListed) errors.Add("lake_dock is not listed in ContentRegistry");
            return errors;
        }

        // 4.7 #2 (plus #1 for prefab and scene references).
        public static List<string> NetworkPrefabs()
        {
            var errors = new List<string>();
            var list = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<NetworkPrefabsList>(AssetPaths.NetworkPrefabsListAsset);
            if (list == null) { errors.Add("network prefab list missing at " + AssetPaths.NetworkPrefabsListAsset); return errors; }

            foreach (NetworkPrefab entry in list.PrefabList)
                if (entry == null || entry.Prefab == null) errors.Add("network prefab list has an empty entry");

            var seenHashes = new Dictionary<string, string>();
            foreach (string path in M1NetworkPrefabs)
            {
                GameObject go = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(path);
                if (go == null) { errors.Add("missing prefab " + path); continue; }
                if (go.GetComponent<NetworkObject>() == null) errors.Add(path + " has no root NetworkObject");
                string hash = ValidationText.FirstGroup(path, @"^\s*GlobalObjectIdHash:\s*(\d+)\s*$");
                if (hash == null || hash == "0") errors.Add(path + " has no GlobalObjectIdHash on disk");
                else if (seenHashes.ContainsKey(hash)) errors.Add(path + " shares GlobalObjectIdHash " + hash + " with " + seenHashes[hash]);
                else seenHashes.Add(hash, path);
            }

            foreach (string guid in AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:Prefab", new[] { AssetPaths.ProjectFolder }))
            {
                string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid);
                GameObject go = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(path);
                if (go == null) continue;
                foreach (Transform t in go.GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>(true))
                    if (GameObjectUtility.GetMonoBehavioursWithMissingScriptCount(t.gameObject) > 0)
                        errors.Add(path + " has a missing script on " + t.name);
                if (go.GetComponent<NetworkObject>() != null && !list.Contains(go))
                    errors.Add("networked prefab not in the network prefab list: " + path);
            }

            RequireReference(AssetPaths.BootstrapScene, AssetPaths.NetworkPrefabsListAsset, "Bootstrap NetworkManager does not reference FishGameNetworkPrefabs.asset", errors);
            RequireReference(AssetPaths.BootstrapScene, AssetPaths.SessionStatePrefab, "Bootstrap AppBootstrap does not reference SessionState.prefab", errors);
            RequireReference(AssetPaths.LakeDockScene, AssetPaths.PlayerPrefab, "Spot_LakeDock PlayerSpawner does not reference PlayerFP.prefab", errors);
            RequireReference(AssetPaths.LakeDockScene, AssetPaths.DockBellPrefab, "Spot_LakeDock has no NetSpawnAnchor referencing DockBell.prefab", errors);
            return errors;
        }

        // 4.7 #3
        public static List<string> BuildScenes()
        {
            var errors = new List<string>();
            EditorBuildSettingsScene[] scenes = EditorBuildSettings.scenes;
            string[] names = SceneNames.BuildOrder;
            if (scenes.Length != names.Length)
                errors.Add("expected " + names.Length + " build scenes, found " + scenes.Length);
            for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
            {
                string expected = AssetPaths.ScenesFolder + "/" + names[i] + ".unity";
                if (!File.Exists(BuilderUtil.Abs(expected))) errors.Add("missing scene file " + expected);
                if (i >= scenes.Length) continue;
                if (scenes[i].path != expected) errors.Add("build index " + i + " is '" + scenes[i].path + "', expected " + expected);
                else if (!scenes[i].enabled) errors.Add(expected + " is disabled in the build list");
            }
            return errors;
        }

        // 4.7 #4. Types are asserted for Player and Fishing only; UI by name (contract D17).
        public static List<string> InputActions()
        {
            var errors = new List<string>();
            string json = ValidationText.Read(InputActionNames.AssetPath);
            if (json == null) { errors.Add("missing " + InputActionNames.AssetPath); return errors; }
            InputActionAsset asset;
            try { asset = InputActionAsset.FromJson(json); }
            catch (System.Exception e) { errors.Add("inputactions parse failed: " + e.Message); return errors; }

            try
            {
                foreach (string map in new[] { InputActionNames.PlayerMap, InputActionNames.FishingMap, InputActionNames.UiMap })
                    if (asset.FindActionMap(map) == null) errors.Add("missing action map " + map);
                if (asset.FindActionMap("FishGameInput") != null) errors.Add("no action map may be named FishGameInput");
                foreach (string action in InputActionNames.PlayerActions) CheckType(asset, InputActionNames.PlayerMap + "/" + action, errors);
                foreach (string action in InputActionNames.FishingActions) CheckType(asset, InputActionNames.FishingMap + "/" + action, errors);
                foreach (string action in InputActionNames.UiActions)
                    if (asset.FindAction(InputActionNames.UiMap + "/" + action) == null) errors.Add("missing action " + InputActionNames.UiMap + "/" + action);
            }
            finally
            {
                Object.DestroyImmediate(asset);
            }
            return errors;
        }

        static void CheckType(InputActionAsset asset, string path, List<string> errors)
        {
            InputAction action = asset.FindAction(path);
            if (action == null) { errors.Add("missing action " + path); return; }
            bool ok;
            if (path == InputActionNames.Move || path == InputActionNames.Look)
                ok = action.type == InputActionType.Value && action.expectedControlType == "Vector2";
            else if (path == InputActionNames.Steer)
                ok = action.type == InputActionType.Value && action.expectedControlType == "Axis";
            else
                ok = action.type == InputActionType.Button;
            if (!ok) errors.Add("unexpected type for " + path + ": " + action.type + "/" + action.expectedControlType);
        }

        // 4.7 #5
        public static List<string> Manifest()
        {
            var errors = new List<string>();
            string text = ValidationText.Read(AssetPaths.ManifestFile);
            if (text == null) { errors.Add("missing " + AssetPaths.ManifestFile); return errors; }
            if (text.Length > 0 && text[0] == '\uFEFF') errors.Add("manifest.json starts with a BOM");
            foreach (string pin in ManifestPins)
            {
                int at = pin.IndexOf('@');
                string name = pin.Substring(0, at), version = pin.Substring(at + 1);
                string pattern = "\"" + Regex.Escape(name) + "\"\\s*:\\s*\"" + Regex.Escape(version) + "\"";
                if (!Regex.IsMatch(text, pattern)) errors.Add("pin missing or wrong: " + name + " " + version);
            }
            foreach (string name in ForbiddenPackages)
                if (Regex.IsMatch(text, "\"" + Regex.Escape(name) + "\"\\s*:")) errors.Add("forbidden package listed: " + name);
            return errors;
        }

        // 4.7 #6 plus the spec 4.2 steps 2, 4, 5 outputs of ProjectSettingsBuilder.
        public static List<string> ProjectSettingsInvariants()
        {
            var errors = new List<string>();
            ValidationText.ExpectLines(AssetPaths.EditorSettingsFile, errors, "m_SerializationMode: 2", "m_EnterPlayModeOptionsEnabled: 0");
            ValidationText.ExpectLines(AssetPaths.ProjectSettingsFile, errors, "activeInputHandler: 1", "runInBackground: 1");
            ValidationText.ExpectLines(AssetPaths.PcRenderPipelineAsset, errors,
                "m_MSAA: 4", "m_RequireDepthTexture: 1", "m_SupportsHDR: 1", "m_RequireOpaqueTexture: 0",
                "m_SoftShadowsSupported: 1", "m_ShadowCascadeCount: 2", "m_ShadowDistance: 70");
            ValidationText.ExpectLines(AssetPaths.PcRenderer, errors, "m_RenderingMode: 2", "m_CopyDepthMode: 0");
            string pcRp = ValidationText.Read(AssetPaths.PcRenderPipelineAsset);
            if (pcRp != null && pcRp.Contains(DeletedSampleSceneProfileGuid))
                errors.Add(AssetPaths.PcRenderPipelineAsset + " still references the deleted SampleSceneProfile (m_VolumeProfile)");
            ValidationText.ExpectLines(AssetPaths.NetcodeSettingsFile, errors, "GenerateDefaultNetworkPrefabs: 0");

            string buildSettings = ValidationText.Read(AssetPaths.EditorBuildSettingsFile);
            if (buildSettings != null && buildSettings.Contains(BuilderUtil.ProjectWideActionsConfigKey))
                errors.Add("project-wide input actions entry (" + BuilderUtil.ProjectWideActionsConfigKey + ") is still configured");
            if (UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputSystem.actions != null)
                errors.Add("InputSystem.actions must be null (project-wide actions cleared)");

            CheckIgnored(Layers.Fish, Layers.Player, errors);
            CheckIgnored(Layers.Fish, Layers.RemotePlayer, errors);
            CheckIgnored(Layers.Ragdoll, Layers.Player, errors);
            CheckIgnored(Layers.Ragdoll, Layers.RemotePlayer, errors);
            CheckIgnored(Layers.Ragdoll, Layers.Fish, errors);

            if (LayerMask.LayerToName(Layers.Water) != "Water") errors.Add("layer " + Layers.Water + " must be Water");
            for (int i = 0; i < Layers.UserLayerIndices.Length; i++)
            {
                int index = Layers.UserLayerIndices[i];
                if (LayerMask.LayerToName(index) != Layers.UserLayerNames[i])
                    errors.Add("layer " + index + " must be " + Layers.UserLayerNames[i] + ", found '" + LayerMask.LayerToName(index) + "'");
            }
            return errors;
        }

        // 4.7 #7: nothing under Assets/ except _Project and Settings (and their two folder metas).
        public static List<string> AssetsLayout()
        {
            var errors = new List<string>();
            string assets = Application.dataPath;
            foreach (string dir in Directory.GetDirectories(assets))
            {
                string name = Path.GetFileName(dir);
                if (name != "_Project" && name != "Settings") errors.Add("unexpected folder Assets/" + name);
            }
            foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(assets))
            {
                string name = Path.GetFileName(file);
                if (name == "_Project.meta" || name == "Settings.meta") continue;
                errors.Add("unexpected file Assets/" + name);
            }
            return errors;
        }

        static void CheckIgnored(int a, int b, List<string> errors)
        {
            if (!Physics.GetIgnoreLayerCollision(a, b))
                errors.Add("physics matrix: layers " + LayerMask.LayerToName(a) + " and " + LayerMask.LayerToName(b) + " must not collide");
        }

        static void RequireReference(string fileAssetPath, string referencedAssetPath, string message, List<string> errors)
        {
            string guid = AssetDatabase.AssetPathToGUID(referencedAssetPath);
            string text = ValidationText.Read(fileAssetPath);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(guid) || text == null || !text.Contains("guid: " + guid)) errors.Add(message);
        }
    }
}
```
