```csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    internal static class LakeDockLayout
    {
        public const ulong Seed = 0xF15ED0C4UL; // contract 5.6 lake-dock layout seed
        public const string RockStream = "lake_dock.rocks";
        public const string TreeStream = "lake_dock.trees";

        // Bowl: 0 m at the shoreline (r 50), -6 m at 40 m inward, flat -6 m inside r 10.
        public const float ShoreRadius = 50f, BowlRun = 40f, BowlDepth = 6f;
        public static readonly float[] LakebedRadii = { 0f, 4f, 8f, 10f, 14f, 18f, 22f, 26f, 30f, 34f, 38f, 42f, 46f, 50f };

        // Shore ring: y -0.2 at r 49 rising to y 1.0 at r 56, flat to r 90.
        public const float ShoreInnerRadius = 49f, ShoreInnerY = -0.2f, ShoreTopRadius = 56f, ShoreTopY = 1f;
        public static readonly float[] ShoreRadii = { 49f, 50f, 51f, 52f, 53f, 54f, 55f, 56f, 60f, 65f, 70f, 80f, 90f };

        // Dock: deck x in [-1.5, 1.5], z in [-52, -40], top y 0.6, thickness 0.1; posts every 2 m at x +-1.4.
        public const float DeckWidth = 3f, DeckNearZ = -52f, DeckFarZ = -40f, DeckTopY = 0.6f, DeckThickness = 0.1f;
        public const float PostX = 1.4f, PostSpacing = 2f, PostSize = 0.12f;
        public const float LadderZ = -41.5f, LadderX = 1.58f, LadderThickness = 0.06f, LadderWidth = 0.5f;

        // Ramp at x 12, from the lakebed to the shore.
        public const float RampX = 12f;
        public static readonly Vector3 RampLow = new Vector3(12f, -0.9f, -43f);
        public static readonly Vector3 RampHigh = new Vector3(12f, 0.4f, -51f);
        public const float RampWidth = 3f, RampThickness = 0.1f;

        // Spawns 1.5 m apart on the deck, facing +z.
        public const int SpawnCount = 4;
        public const float SpawnY = 0.65f, FirstSpawnZ = -50.5f, SpawnSpacing = 1.5f;

        // Seeded props. Placements near the dock/camera line (x 0) and the ramp (x 12) at z <= -38 are rejected.
        public const int RockCount = 14, TreeCount = 30, MaxAttempts = 500;
        public const float RockMinRadius = 48f, RockMaxRadius = 54f, TreeMinRadius = 58f, TreeMaxRadius = 85f;
        public const float RockClearance = 3f, TreeClearance = 5f, ClearanceMaxZ = -38f;

        public static float BedY(float r) =>
            r >= ShoreRadius ? 0f : -BowlDepth * Mathf.Clamp01((ShoreRadius - r) / BowlRun);

        public static float BedYAt(float x, float z) => BedY(Mathf.Sqrt(x * x + z * z));

        public static float ShoreY(float r) =>
            Mathf.Lerp(ShoreInnerY, ShoreTopY, Mathf.Clamp01((r - ShoreInnerRadius) / (ShoreTopRadius - ShoreInnerRadius)));

        public static bool Blocked(float x, float z, float clearance) =>
            z <= ClearanceMaxZ && (Mathf.Abs(x) <= clearance || Mathf.Abs(x - RampX) <= clearance);
    }
```

- [ ] **3.2 Create `Assets/_Project/Editor/Builders/LakeDockMeshes.cs`**

```csharp
// Radial height-field meshes for the lakebed and shore, saved as mesh assets and refilled in place (stable GUID, byte-identical rebuilds). Owned by T15.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    internal static class LakeDockMeshes
    {
        public const int Sectors = 48;

        // radii must be ascending; radii[0] == 0 makes a centre fan (disk), otherwise the mesh is a ring.
        public static Mesh BuildAsset(string assetPath, float[] radii, System.Func<float, float> heightAtRadius)
        {
            BuilderUtil.EnsureFolder(BuilderUtil.Folder(assetPath));
            Mesh mesh = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Mesh>(assetPath);
            bool created = mesh == null;
            if (created) mesh = new Mesh();
            mesh.name = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(assetPath);
            Fill(mesh, radii, heightAtRadius);
            if (created) AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(mesh, assetPath);
            else EditorUtility.SetDirty(mesh);
            return mesh;
        }

        static void Fill(Mesh mesh, float[] radii, System.Func<float, float> heightAtRadius)
        {
            var vertices = new List<Vector3>();
            var triangles = new List<int>();
            for (int ring = 0; ring + 1 < radii.Length; ring++)
            {
                float r0 = radii[ring], r1 = radii[ring + 1];
                float y0 = heightAtRadius(r0), y1 = heightAtRadius(r1);
                for (int s = 0; s < Sectors; s++)
                {
                    Vector3 a0 = Point(r0, y0, s), b0 = Point(r0, y0, s + 1);
                    Vector3 a1 = Point(r1, y1, s), b1 = Point(r1, y1, s + 1);
                    AddTriangle(vertices, triangles, a0, a1, b1);
                    if (r0 > 0f) AddTriangle(vertices, triangles, a0, b1, b0);
                }
            }
            mesh.Clear();
            mesh.SetVertices(vertices);
            mesh.SetTriangles(triangles, 0);
            mesh.RecalculateNormals();
            mesh.RecalculateBounds();
        }

        static Vector3 Point(float r, float y, int sector)
        {
            float angle = (sector % Sectors) * (Mathf.PI * 2f / Sectors);
            return new Vector3(Mathf.Cos(angle) * r, y, Mathf.Sin(angle) * r);
        }

        // Unshared vertices give flat facets. The winding is flipped when needed so every face normal points up (+y).
        static void AddTriangle(List<Vector3> vertices, List<int> triangles, Vector3 a, Vector3 b, Vector3 c)
        {
            if (Vector3.Cross(b - a, c - a).y < 0f) { Vector3 swap = b; b = c; c = swap; }
            int start = vertices.Count;
            vertices.Add(a); vertices.Add(b); vertices.Add(c);
            triangles.Add(start); triangles.Add(start + 1); triangles.Add(start + 2);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Project-wide settings (spec 4.2 steps 2, 4, 5; spec 4.6 step 1; contract 7.15). Idempotent. Owned by T15.
using System.Reflection;
using FishGame.Core;
using Unity.Netcode.Editor.Configuration;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Rendering.Universal;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    public static class ProjectSettingsBuilder
    {
        public static void Apply()
        {
            // Netcode first. Every later asset import or delete runs NGO's NetworkPrefabProcessor, which recreates
            // Assets/DefaultNetworkPrefabs.asset while GenerateDefaultNetworkPrefabs is still on.
            ApplyNetcode();
            ApplyLayers();
            ApplyPhysicsMatrix();
            EditorSettings.enterPlayModeOptionsEnabled = false; // domain reload stays ON (spec 4.2 #4)
            PlayerSettings.runInBackground = true;
            ApplyUrp();

            // Spec 4.2 #2: clear the project-wide actions entry, then delete the template asset.
            UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputSystem.actions = null;
            EditorBuildSettings.RemoveConfigObject(BuilderUtil.ProjectWideActionsConfigKey); // the setter skips this when already null
            DeleteIfPresent(AssetPaths.TemplateInputActions);
            DeleteIfPresent(AssetPaths.DefaultNetworkPrefabs);

            // API setters do not always mark these settings objects dirty; make sure SaveAssets writes them.
            MarkDirty(AssetPaths.TagManagerFile);
            MarkDirty(AssetPaths.DynamicsManagerFile);
            MarkDirty(AssetPaths.EditorSettingsFile);
            MarkDirty(AssetPaths.ProjectSettingsFile);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
        }

        static void ApplyNetcode()
        {
            NetcodeForGameObjectsProjectSettings settings = NetcodeForGameObjectsProjectSettings.instance;
            settings.GenerateDefaultNetworkPrefabs = false;
            MethodInfo save = typeof(NetcodeForGameObjectsProjectSettings)
                .GetMethod("SaveSettings", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            if (save == null) throw new System.MissingMethodException("NetcodeForGameObjectsProjectSettings.SaveSettings not found (internal in NGO 2.13.3)");
            save.Invoke(settings, null); // writes ProjectSettings/NetcodeForGameObjects.asset
        }

        static void ApplyLayers()
        {
            Object[] objects = AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath(AssetPaths.TagManagerFile);
            if (objects.Length == 0) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot load " + AssetPaths.TagManagerFile);
            var tagManager = new SerializedObject(objects[0]);
            SerializedProperty layers = tagManager.FindProperty("layers");
            for (int i = 0; i < Layers.UserLayerIndices.Length; i++)
                layers.GetArrayElementAtIndex(Layers.UserLayerIndices[i]).stringValue = Layers.UserLayerNames[i];
            tagManager.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
        }

        // Contract 5.3: Fish ignores Player and RemotePlayer; Ragdoll ignores Player, RemotePlayer and Fish. Everything else collides.
        static void ApplyPhysicsMatrix()
        {
            Physics.IgnoreLayerCollision(Layers.Fish, Layers.Player, true);
            Physics.IgnoreLayerCollision(Layers.Fish, Layers.RemotePlayer, true);
            Physics.IgnoreLayerCollision(Layers.Ragdoll, Layers.Player, true);
            Physics.IgnoreLayerCollision(Layers.Ragdoll, Layers.RemotePlayer, true);
            Physics.IgnoreLayerCollision(Layers.Ragdoll, Layers.Fish, true);
        }

        // Spec 4.2 #5: MSAA 4x, depth texture on, HDR on, soft shadows, 2 cascades, shadow distance 70 m, opaque texture off.
        static void ApplyUrp()
        {
            var asset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UniversalRenderPipelineAsset>(AssetPaths.PcRenderPipelineAsset);
            if (asset == null) throw new System.IO.FileNotFoundException("Missing " + AssetPaths.PcRenderPipelineAsset);
            asset.msaaSampleCount = 4;
            asset.supportsCameraDepthTexture = true;
            asset.supportsHDR = true;
            asset.supportsCameraOpaqueTexture = false;
            asset.shadowCascadeCount = 2;
            asset.shadowDistance = 70f;
            var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset); // supportsSoftShadows has an internal setter in URP 17.6
            SerializedProperty soft = serialized.FindProperty("m_SoftShadowsSupported");
            if (soft == null) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("m_SoftShadowsSupported not found on " + AssetPaths.PcRenderPipelineAsset);
            soft.boolValue = true;
            serialized.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(asset);
            RepointVolumeProfile(asset);
        }

        // T1 deleted Assets/Settings/SampleSceneProfile.asset, which PC_RPAsset still referenced (a missing reference).
        // Point it at the template's DefaultVolumeProfile, the same profile the URP global settings use. Mobile assets stay as they are (spec 4.2 #5).
        static void RepointVolumeProfile(UniversalRenderPipelineAsset asset)
        {
            var profile = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.Rendering.VolumeProfile>(AssetPaths.DefaultVolumeProfile);
            if (profile == null) throw new System.IO.FileNotFoundException("Missing " + AssetPaths.DefaultVolumeProfile);
            var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset);
            SerializedProperty volume = serialized.FindProperty("m_VolumeProfile");
            if (volume == null) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("m_VolumeProfile not found on " + AssetPaths.PcRenderPipelineAsset);
            if (volume.objectReferenceValue == profile) return;
            volume.objectReferenceValue = profile;
            serialized.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(asset);
        }

        static void DeleteIfPresent(string assetPath)
        {
            bool known = AssetDatabase.LoadMainAssetAtPath(assetPath) != null;
            if (!known && !System.IO.File.Exists(BuilderUtil.Abs(assetPath))) return;
            if (!AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(assetPath)) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Could not delete " + assetPath);
        }

        static void MarkDirty(string settingsPath)
        {
            Object[] objects = AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath(settingsPath);
            if (objects.Length == 0) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot load " + settingsPath);
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(objects[0]);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Flat URP Lit placeholder materials (contract 6.2, spec 10.1). Updated in place, so GUIDs never change. Owned by T15.
using FishGame.Core;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    public static class MaterialLibrary
    {
        const string LitShaderName = "Universal Render Pipeline/Lit";
        static readonly int BaseColorId = Shader.PropertyToID("_BaseColor");

        public static void BuildAll()
        {
            BuilderUtil.EnsureFolder(AssetPaths.MaterialsFolder);
            Shader lit = Shader.Find(LitShaderName);
            if (lit == null) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Shader not found: " + LitShaderName);

            for (int i = 0; i < SlotPalette.Count; i++)
            {
                SlotPalette.GetRgb(i, out float r, out float g, out float b);
                Ensure(lit, "M_Body_Slot" + i, new Color(r, g, b));
            }
            SlotPalette.GetSkinRgb(out float sr, out float sg, out float sb);
            Ensure(lit, "M_Skin", new Color(sr, sg, sb));
            Ensure(lit, "M_Water", new Color(0.12f, 0.36f, 0.62f));
            Ensure(lit, "M_Wood", new Color(0.55f, 0.38f, 0.22f));
            Ensure(lit, "M_WoodDark", new Color(0.36f, 0.24f, 0.14f));
            Ensure(lit, "M_Rock", new Color(0.46f, 0.46f, 0.48f));
            Ensure(lit, "M_Grass", new Color(0.32f, 0.56f, 0.26f));
            Ensure(lit, "M_Sand", new Color(0.84f, 0.77f, 0.56f));
            Ensure(lit, "M_Foliage", new Color(0.18f, 0.40f, 0.20f));
            Ensure(lit, "M_Brass", new Color(0.82f, 0.66f, 0.26f));
        }

        // name without extension, e.g. "M_Body_Slot0".
        public static Material Get(string name)
        {
            Material material = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Material>(AssetPaths.MaterialsFolder + "/" + name + ".mat");
            if (material == null) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Material not built: " + name + " (run MaterialLibrary.BuildAll first)");
            return material;
        }

        static void Ensure(Shader lit, string name, Color color)
        {
            string path = AssetPaths.MaterialsFolder + "/" + name + ".mat";
            Material material = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Material>(path);
            bool changed = false;
            if (material == null)
            {
                material = new Material(lit);
                AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(material, path);
                changed = true;
            }
            if (material.shader != lit) { material.shader = lit; changed = true; }
            if (material.GetColor(BaseColorId) != color) { material.SetColor(BaseColorId, color); changed = true; }
            if (changed) EditorUtility.SetDirty(material);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Data assets (spec 4.6 step 2). Create-if-missing only: the user tunes these in the Inspector, so existing values are never overwritten.
// The only edit to an existing asset is adding lake_dock to the registry list and filling an empty PanelSettings theme. Owned by T15.
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Data;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    public static class ContentBuilder
    {
        public static void Build()
        {
            BuilderUtil.EnsureFolder(BuilderUtil.Folder(AssetPaths.LakeDockSpotAsset));
            BuilderUtil.EnsureFolder(BuilderUtil.Folder(AssetPaths.PanelSettingsAsset));
            BuilderUtil.EnsureFolder(BuilderUtil.Folder(AssetPaths.NetworkPrefabsListAsset));
            MaterialLibrary.BuildAll();
            SpotDef lakeDock = EnsureLakeDockSpot();
            EnsureRegistry(lakeDock);
            EnsurePanelSettings();
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
        }

        static SpotDef EnsureLakeDockSpot()
        {
            var spot = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<SpotDef>(AssetPaths.LakeDockSpotAsset);
            if (spot != null) return spot;
            spot = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<SpotDef>();
            spot.Configure(global::FishGame.Core.ContentIds.LakeDock, "Lake Dock", SceneNames.SpotLakeDock);
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(spot, AssetPaths.LakeDockSpotAsset);
            return spot;
        }

        static void EnsureRegistry(SpotDef lakeDock)
        {
            var registry = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<ContentRegistry>(AssetPaths.ContentRegistryAsset);
            if (registry == null)
            {
                registry = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<ContentRegistry>();
                registry.Configure(1, new[] { lakeDock });
                AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(registry, AssetPaths.ContentRegistryAsset);
                return;
            }
            var serialized = new SerializedObject(registry);
            SerializedProperty spots = serialized.FindProperty("spots");
            if (spots == null) throw new System.InvalidOperationException("ContentRegistry has no serialized field 'spots'");
            for (int i = 0; i < spots.arraySize; i++)
                if (spots.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i).objectReferenceValue == lakeDock) return;
            spots.InsertArrayElementAtIndex(spots.arraySize);
            spots.GetArrayElementAtIndex(spots.arraySize - 1).objectReferenceValue = lakeDock;
            serialized.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
        }

        // Contract 6.2: Scale With Screen Size, 1920x1080, MatchWidthOrHeight 0.5, theme = FishGameTheme.tss.
        static void EnsurePanelSettings()
        {
            var panel = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<PanelSettings>(AssetPaths.PanelSettingsAsset);
            if (panel == null)
            {
                panel = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<PanelSettings>();
                panel.scaleMode = PanelScaleMode.ScaleWithScreenSize;
                panel.referenceResolution = new Vector2Int(1920, 1080);
                panel.screenMatchMode = PanelScreenMatchMode.MatchWidthOrHeight;
                panel.match = 0.5f;
                AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(panel, AssetPaths.PanelSettingsAsset);
            }
            if (panel.themeStyleSheet == null)
            {
                var theme = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<ThemeStyleSheet>(AssetPaths.ThemeStyleSheet);
                if (theme == null) throw new System.IO.FileNotFoundException("Missing UI theme " + AssetPaths.ThemeStyleSheet + " (T14)");
                panel.themeStyleSheet = theme;
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(panel);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// PlayerFP, DockBell and SessionState network prefabs (contract 6.3, 6.4, 6.2). Owned by T15.
// Rebuilt in place with get-or-add (never destroy/re-add the root NetworkObject), then GlobalObjectIdHash is refreshed on the saved asset.
// This file deliberately has no "using UnityEditor;": UnityEditor.SessionState would clash with FishGame.Gameplay.SessionState.
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Gameplay;
using Unity.Netcode;
using Unity.Netcode.Components;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    public static class PrefabBuilder
    {
        public static void Build()
        {
            BuildPlayer();
            BuildDockBell();
            BuildSessionState();
        }

        public static void BuildPlayer()
        {
            BuilderUtil.WritePrefab(AssetPaths.PlayerPrefab, BuildPlayerRoot);
            BuilderUtil.RefreshNetworkObjectHash(AssetPaths.PlayerPrefab);
        }

        public static void BuildDockBell()
        {
            BuilderUtil.WritePrefab(AssetPaths.DockBellPrefab, BuildDockBellRoot);
            BuilderUtil.RefreshNetworkObjectHash(AssetPaths.DockBellPrefab);
        }

        // Contract 6.2: root NetworkObject + SessionState only.
        public static void BuildSessionState()
        {
            BuilderUtil.WritePrefab(AssetPaths.SessionStatePrefab, root =>
            {
                BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<NetworkObject>(root);
                BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<FishGame.Gameplay.SessionState>(root);
            });
            BuilderUtil.RefreshNetworkObjectHash(AssetPaths.SessionStatePrefab);
        }

        static void BuildPlayerRoot(GameObject root)
        {
            var slotMaterials = new Material[SlotPalette.Count];
            for (int i = 0; i < slotMaterials.Length; i++) slotMaterials[i] = MaterialLibrary.Get("M_Body_Slot" + i);
            Material skin = MaterialLibrary.Get("M_Skin");
            Material body = slotMaterials[0];

            // Components in contract 6.3 order.
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<NetworkObject>(root);

            NetworkTransform nt = BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<NetworkTransform>(root);
            nt.AuthorityMode = NetworkTransform.AuthorityModes.Owner;
            nt.SyncPositionX = true; nt.SyncPositionY = true; nt.SyncPositionZ = true;
            nt.SyncRotAngleX = false; nt.SyncRotAngleY = true; nt.SyncRotAngleZ = false;
            nt.SyncScaleX = false; nt.SyncScaleY = false; nt.SyncScaleZ = false;
            nt.InLocalSpace = false;
            nt.Interpolate = true;
            nt.PositionInterpolationType = NetworkTransform.InterpolationTypes.Lerp;
            nt.RotationInterpolationType = NetworkTransform.InterpolationTypes.Lerp;
            nt.UseUnreliableDeltas = false;
            nt.SwitchTransformSpaceWhenParented = true;
            nt.enabled = true;

            CharacterController controller = BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<CharacterController>(root);
            controller.height = MovementMath.CapsuleHeight;
            controller.radius = MovementMath.CapsuleRadius;
            controller.center = new Vector3(0f, MovementMath.CapsuleCenterY, 0f);
            controller.stepOffset = MovementMath.StepOffset;
            controller.slopeLimit = MovementMath.SlopeLimit;
            controller.skinWidth = MovementMath.SkinWidth;
            controller.minMoveDistance = 0f; // batchmode frame rates move < 1 mm per frame; the default 0.001 would drop those moves (T16)
            controller.enabled = false;

            CapsuleCollider capsule = BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<CapsuleCollider>(root);
            capsule.height = MovementMath.CapsuleHeight;
            capsule.radius = MovementMath.CapsuleRadius;
            capsule.center = new Vector3(0f, MovementMath.CapsuleCenterY, 0f);
            capsule.direction = 1; // Y axis
            capsule.enabled = false;

            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<PlayerNetState>(root).enabled = true;
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<PlayerActions>(root).enabled = true;
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<PlayerLocomotion>(root).enabled = false;
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<PlayerCamera>(root).enabled = false;
            PlayerBody playerBody = BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<PlayerBody>(root);
            playerBody.Configure(slotMaterials, skin);
            playerBody.enabled = true;
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<PlayerInteractor>(root).enabled = false;

            // Children (contract 6.3). Visual primitives have their colliders removed.
            Transform t = root.transform;
            Empty(t, PlayerRigPaths.HeadPivot, new Vector3(0f, MovementMath.EyeHeight, 0f));
            Empty(t, PlayerRigPaths.Shake, Vector3.zero);
            Transform cameraTransform = Empty(t, PlayerRigPaths.Camera, Vector3.zero);
            cameraTransform.gameObject.tag = "MainCamera";
            Camera camera = BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<Camera>(cameraTransform.gameObject);
            camera.nearClipPlane = MovementMath.NearClip;
            camera.farClipPlane = MovementMath.FarClip;
            camera.enabled = false;
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<AudioListener>(cameraTransform.gameObject).enabled = false;

            Prim(t, PlayerRigPaths.Head, PrimitiveType.Sphere, Vector3.zero, new Vector3(0.28f, 0.28f, 0.28f), skin);
            Prim(t, PlayerRigPaths.Nose, PrimitiveType.Cube, new Vector3(0f, 0f, 0.5f), new Vector3(0.18f, 0.18f, 0.3f), skin);

            Empty(t, PlayerRigPaths.Body, Vector3.zero);
            Prim(t, PlayerRigPaths.Torso, PrimitiveType.Cube, new Vector3(0f, 1.2f, 0f), new Vector3(0.42f, 0.55f, 0.24f), body);
            Empty(t, PlayerRigPaths.ArmL, new Vector3(-0.27f, 1.42f, 0f));
            Empty(t, PlayerRigPaths.ArmR, new Vector3(0.27f, 1.42f, 0f));
            Prim(t, PlayerRigPaths.ArmLMesh, PrimitiveType.Capsule, new Vector3(0f, -0.25f, 0f), new Vector3(0.12f, 0.25f, 0.12f), body);
            Prim(t, PlayerRigPaths.ArmRMesh, PrimitiveType.Capsule, new Vector3(0f, -0.25f, 0f), new Vector3(0.12f, 0.25f, 0.12f), body);
            Empty(t, PlayerRigPaths.LegL, new Vector3(-0.11f, 0.8f, 0f));
            Empty(t, PlayerRigPaths.LegR, new Vector3(0.11f, 0.8f, 0f));
            Prim(t, PlayerRigPaths.LegLMesh, PrimitiveType.Capsule, new Vector3(0f, -0.4f, 0f), new Vector3(0.16f, 0.4f, 0.16f), body);
            Prim(t, PlayerRigPaths.LegRMesh, PrimitiveType.Capsule, new Vector3(0f, -0.4f, 0f), new Vector3(0.16f, 0.4f, 0.16f), body);
            Empty(t, PlayerRigPaths.NameplateAnchor, new Vector3(0f, 2.05f, 0f));
        }

        // Contract 6.4.
        static void BuildDockBellRoot(GameObject root)
        {
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<NetworkObject>(root);
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<DockBell>(root);
            BoxCollider box = BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<BoxCollider>(root);
            box.isTrigger = false;
            box.size = new Vector3(0.6f, 1.6f, 0.6f);
            box.center = new Vector3(0f, 0.8f, 0f);

            BuilderUtil.EnsurePrimitive(root.transform, "Post", PrimitiveType.Cylinder, new Vector3(0f, 0.8f, 0f),
                Quaternion.identity, new Vector3(0.12f, 0.8f, 0.12f), MaterialLibrary.Get("M_Wood"), false);
            BuilderUtil.EnsurePrimitive(root.transform, "Bell", PrimitiveType.Sphere, new Vector3(0f, 1.45f, 0f),
                Quaternion.identity, new Vector3(0.35f, 0.4f, 0.35f), MaterialLibrary.Get("M_Brass"), false);
            BuilderUtil.SetLayerRecursive(root, Layers.Interactable);
        }

        static Transform Empty(Transform root, string path, Vector3 localPosition)
        {
            Transform t = BuilderUtil.EnsurePath(root, path);
            t.localPosition = localPosition;
            t.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
            t.localScale = Vector3.one;
            return t;
        }

        static GameObject Prim(Transform root, string path, PrimitiveType type, Vector3 localPosition, Vector3 localScale, Material material)
        {
            int cut = path.LastIndexOf('/');
            Transform parent = cut < 0 ? root : BuilderUtil.EnsurePath(root, path.Substring(0, cut));
            string name = cut < 0 ? path : path.Substring(cut + 1);
            return BuilderUtil.EnsurePrimitive(parent, name, type, localPosition, Quaternion.identity, localScale, material, false);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// The owned network prefab list (spec 4.6 step 4). Updated in place (stable GUID); NGO's default list is off (ProjectSettingsBuilder). Owned by T15.
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    public static class NetworkPrefabsBuilder
    {
        static readonly string[] Prefabs = { AssetPaths.PlayerPrefab, AssetPaths.DockBellPrefab, AssetPaths.SessionStatePrefab };

        public static void Build()
        {
            BuilderUtil.EnsureFolder(BuilderUtil.Folder(AssetPaths.NetworkPrefabsListAsset));
            var list = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<NetworkPrefabsList>(AssetPaths.NetworkPrefabsListAsset);
            if (list == null)
            {
                list = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<NetworkPrefabsList>();
                AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(list, AssetPaths.NetworkPrefabsListAsset);
            }

            var wanted = new List<GameObject>();
            foreach (string path in Prefabs) wanted.Add(BuilderUtil.LoadNetworkPrefab(path).gameObject);

            bool changed = false;
            foreach (NetworkPrefab entry in new List<NetworkPrefab>(list.PrefabList))
            {
                if (entry == null || entry.Prefab == null || !wanted.Contains(entry.Prefab))
                {
                    list.Remove(entry);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
            foreach (GameObject prefab in wanted)
            {
                if (list.Contains(prefab)) continue;
                list.Add(new NetworkPrefab { Prefab = prefab });
                changed = true;
            }
            if (changed)
            {
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(list);
                AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Bootstrap and Menu scenes and the build list (contract 6.5; spec 4.6 steps 5 and 6). Owned by T15.
// Each scene starts from NewScene(EmptyScene, Single) and is saved to the same path, so its GUID stays stable.
using FishGame.App;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Data;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using FishGame.UI;
using Unity.Netcode;
using Unity.Netcode.Transports.UTP;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    public static class SceneBuilder
    {
        // ProjectBuilder.RunAll calls ApplyBuildSettings once, after this.
        public static void BuildAll()
        {
            BuildBootstrap();
            BuildMenu();
            LakeDockBuilder.Build();
        }

        public static void BuildBootstrap()
        {
            NetworkObject sessionStatePrefab = BuilderUtil.LoadNetworkPrefab(AssetPaths.SessionStatePrefab);
            var inputActions = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<InputActionAsset>(InputActionNames.AssetPath);
            if (inputActions == null) throw new System.IO.FileNotFoundException("Missing " + InputActionNames.AssetPath);
            var registry = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<ContentRegistry>(AssetPaths.ContentRegistryAsset);
            if (registry == null) throw new System.IO.FileNotFoundException("Missing " + AssetPaths.ContentRegistryAsset);
            var prefabList = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<NetworkPrefabsList>(AssetPaths.NetworkPrefabsListAsset);
            if (prefabList == null) throw new System.IO.FileNotFoundException("Missing " + AssetPaths.NetworkPrefabsListAsset);
            var panelSettings = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<PanelSettings>(AssetPaths.PanelSettingsAsset);
            if (panelSettings == null) throw new System.IO.FileNotFoundException("Missing " + AssetPaths.PanelSettingsAsset);
            var appRoot = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<VisualTreeAsset>(AssetPaths.AppRootUxml);
            if (appRoot == null) throw new System.IO.FileNotFoundException("Missing " + AssetPaths.AppRootUxml + " (T14)");

            Scene scene = EditorSceneManager.NewScene(NewSceneSetup.EmptyScene, NewSceneMode.Single);

            // App: AppBootstrap, NetworkManager, UnityTransport, PlayerInputAdapter, AudioBus (contract 6.5 order).
            var app = new GameObject("App");
            AppBootstrap bootstrap = BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<AppBootstrap>(app);
            NetworkManager networkManager = BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<NetworkManager>(app);
            UnityTransport transport = BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<UnityTransport>(app);
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<PlayerInputAdapter>(app);
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<AudioBus>(app);
            ConfigureNetworkManager(networkManager, transport, prefabList);
            bootstrap.Configure(sessionStatePrefab, inputActions, registry);

            var ui = new GameObject("UI");
            ui.transform.SetParent(app.transform, false);
            UIDocument document = BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<UIDocument>(ui);
            document.panelSettings = panelSettings;
            document.visualTreeAsset = appRoot; // contract 6.5 calls this "sourceAsset"; the 6000.6 property is visualTreeAsset
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<UiFlowController>(ui);

            var eventSystem = new GameObject("EventSystem");
            eventSystem.transform.SetParent(app.transform, false);
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<UnityEngine.EventSystems.EventSystem>(eventSystem);
            BuilderUtil.GetOrAdd<UnityEngine.InputSystem.UI.InputSystemUIInputModule>(eventSystem); // default actions

            BuilderUtil.SaveScene(scene, AssetPaths.BootstrapScene);
        }

        public static void BuildMenu()
        {
            Scene scene = EditorSceneManager.NewScene(NewSceneSetup.EmptyScene, NewSceneMode.Single);

            var cameraObject = new GameObject("MenuCamera");
            cameraObject.tag = "MainCamera";
            Camera camera = cameraObject.AddComponent<Camera>();
            camera.clearFlags = CameraClearFlags.SolidColor;
            camera.backgroundColor = new Color(0.07f, 0.10f, 0.14f);
            cameraObject.AddComponent<AudioListener>();

            var sun = new GameObject("Sun");
            sun.AddComponent<Light>().type = LightType.Directional;
            sun.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(50f, -30f, 0f);

            BuilderUtil.SaveScene(scene, AssetPaths.MenuScene);
        }

        // Spec 4.6 step 6: build list in SceneNames.BuildOrder order (Bootstrap at index 0).
        public static void ApplyBuildSettings()
        {
            string[] names = SceneNames.BuildOrder;
            var entries = new EditorBuildSettingsScene[names.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
            {
                string path = AssetPaths.ScenesFolder + "/" + names[i] + ".unity";
                if (AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<SceneAsset>(path) == null) throw new System.IO.FileNotFoundException("Missing scene " + path);
                entries[i] = new EditorBuildSettingsScene(path, true);
            }
            EditorBuildSettings.scenes = entries;
        }

        // Contract 6.5 NetworkManager configuration.
        static void ConfigureNetworkManager(NetworkManager networkManager, UnityTransport transport, NetworkPrefabsList prefabList)
        {
            // Null right after AddComponent when GenerateDefaultNetworkPrefabs is off (NGO's reset hook only builds it when on).
            if (networkManager.NetworkConfig == null) networkManager.NetworkConfig = new NetworkConfig();
            NetworkConfig config = networkManager.NetworkConfig;
            config.NetworkTransport = transport;
            config.TickRate = NetworkConstants.TickRate;
            config.ConnectionApproval = true;
            config.EnableSceneManagement = true;
            config.PlayerPrefab = null;
            config.ProtocolVersion = NetworkConstants.NgoProtocolVersion;
            config.ForceSamePrefabs = true;
            if (config.Prefabs == null) config.Prefabs = new NetworkPrefabs();
            config.Prefabs.NetworkPrefabsLists.Clear();
            config.Prefabs.NetworkPrefabsLists.Add(prefabList);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Builds Spot_LakeDock.unity (contract 6.5, spec 17.1 item 9, D34, D36). Owned by T15.
// Deterministic: fixed build order, fixed names, seeded Pcg32 streams (Rng.Stream); the meshes are refilled in place.
// Never name SessionState in this file: with "using UnityEditor;" it would be ambiguous (CS0104).
using FishGame.App;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Gameplay;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using Unity.Netcode;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    public static class LakeDockBuilder
    {
        public static void Build()
        {
            NetworkObject playerPrefab = BuilderUtil.LoadNetworkPrefab(AssetPaths.PlayerPrefab);
            NetworkObject bellPrefab = BuilderUtil.LoadNetworkPrefab(AssetPaths.DockBellPrefab);
            Mesh lakebedMesh = LakeDockMeshes.BuildAsset(AssetPaths.LakebedMesh, LakeDockLayout.LakebedRadii, LakeDockLayout.BedY);
            Mesh shoreMesh = LakeDockMeshes.BuildAsset(AssetPaths.ShoreMesh, LakeDockLayout.ShoreRadii, LakeDockLayout.ShoreY);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets(); // meshes are on disk before the scene references them

            Scene scene = EditorSceneManager.NewScene(NewSceneSetup.EmptyScene, NewSceneMode.Single);

            Root("GameScope", Layers.Default).AddComponent<GameScope>();
            AddSpawner(playerPrefab);
            AddSceneCamera();
            AddSun();
            Root("Ambience", Layers.Default).AddComponent<AmbienceBed>();
            AddWater();
            AddSurface("Lakebed", Layers.Ground, lakebedMesh, "M_Sand");
            GameObject shore = AddSurface("Shore", Layers.Shore, shoreMesh, "M_Grass");
            PlaceRocks(shore.transform);
            PlaceTrees(shore.transform);
            AddDock();
            AddExits();
            AddBellAnchor(bellPrefab);

            BuilderUtil.SaveScene(scene, AssetPaths.LakeDockScene);
        }

        static GameObject Root(string name, int layer)
        {
            var go = new GameObject(name);
            go.layer = layer;
            return go;
        }

        // Spawn0..Spawn3 at (0, 0.65, -50.5 + 1.5 i), facing +z.
        static void AddSpawner(NetworkObject playerPrefab)
        {
            GameObject root = Root("PlayerSpawner", Layers.Default);
            var points = new Transform[LakeDockLayout.SpawnCount];
            for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
            {
                var point = new GameObject("Spawn" + i);
                point.transform.SetParent(root.transform, false);
                point.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0f, LakeDockLayout.SpawnY, LakeDockLayout.FirstSpawnZ + LakeDockLayout.SpawnSpacing * i);
                point.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
                points[i] = point.transform;
            }
            root.AddComponent<PlayerSpawner>().Configure(playerPrefab, points);
        }

        static void AddSceneCamera()
        {
            GameObject go = Root("SceneCamera", Layers.Default);
            go.tag = "MainCamera";
            go.transform.position = new Vector3(0f, 4f, -60f);
            go.transform.LookAt(new Vector3(0f, 0.6f, -46f));
            Camera camera = go.AddComponent<Camera>();
            camera.nearClipPlane = MovementMath.NearClip;
            camera.farClipPlane = MovementMath.FarClip;
            go.AddComponent<AudioListener>();
            go.AddComponent<SceneCameraSwitch>();
        }

        static void AddSun()
        {
            GameObject go = Root("Sun", Layers.Default);
            Light light = go.AddComponent<Light>();
            light.type = LightType.Directional;
            light.shadows = LightShadows.Soft;
            go.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(50f, -30f, 0f);
        }

        // Spec 10.4 M1 water: a flat 120 x 120 m visual plane plus a separate trigger box whose top face is y 0.
        static void AddWater()
        {
            GameObject visual = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Plane);
            visual.name = "WaterVisual";
            visual.layer = Layers.Water;
            Object.DestroyImmediate(visual.GetComponent<Collider>());
            visual.transform.position = Vector3.zero;
            visual.transform.localScale = new Vector3(12f, 1f, 12f); // the built-in plane is 10 x 10 m
            visual.GetComponent<MeshRenderer>().sharedMaterial = MaterialLibrary.Get("M_Water");

            GameObject volume = Root("WaterVolume", Layers.Water);
            BoxCollider box = volume.AddComponent<BoxCollider>();
            box.isTrigger = true;
            box.size = new Vector3(120f, 8f, 120f);
            box.center = new Vector3(0f, -4f, 0f);
            volume.AddComponent<WaterVolume>();
        }

        static GameObject AddSurface(string name, int layer, Mesh mesh, string material)
        {
            GameObject go = Root(name, layer);
            go.AddComponent<MeshFilter>().sharedMesh = mesh;
            go.AddComponent<MeshRenderer>().sharedMaterial = MaterialLibrary.Get(material);
            go.AddComponent<MeshCollider>().sharedMesh = mesh;
            return go;
        }

        static void PlaceRocks(Transform parent)
        {
            Material rockMaterial = MaterialLibrary.Get("M_Rock");
            Pcg32 rng = Rng.Stream(LakeDockLayout.Seed, LakeDockLayout.RockStream, 0UL);
            int placed = 0;
            for (int attempt = 0; attempt < LakeDockLayout.MaxAttempts && placed < LakeDockLayout.RockCount; attempt++)
            {
                float angle = rng.Range(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
                float r = rng.Range(LakeDockLayout.RockMinRadius, LakeDockLayout.RockMaxRadius);
                float size = rng.Range(0.6f, 1.6f);
                float x = Mathf.Cos(angle) * r, z = Mathf.Sin(angle) * r;
                if (LakeDockLayout.Blocked(x, z, LakeDockLayout.RockClearance)) continue;
                GameObject rock = BuilderUtil.EnsurePrimitive(parent, "Rock_" + placed.ToString("00"), PrimitiveType.Sphere,
                    new Vector3(x, LakeDockLayout.ShoreY(r) + size * 0.25f, z), Quaternion.Euler(0f, angle * Mathf.Rad2Deg, 0f),
                    new Vector3(size, size * 0.7f, size), rockMaterial, true);
                BuilderUtil.SetLayerRecursive(rock, Layers.Shore);
                placed++;
            }
            if (placed < LakeDockLayout.RockCount)
                throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Placed only " + placed + " of " + LakeDockLayout.RockCount + " rocks");
        }

        static void PlaceTrees(Transform parent)
        {
            Material trunkMaterial = MaterialLibrary.Get("M_WoodDark");
            Material canopyMaterial = MaterialLibrary.Get("M_Foliage");
            Pcg32 rng = Rng.Stream(LakeDockLayout.Seed, LakeDockLayout.TreeStream, 0UL);
            int placed = 0;
            for (int attempt = 0; attempt < LakeDockLayout.MaxAttempts && placed < LakeDockLayout.TreeCount; attempt++)
            {
                float angle = rng.Range(0f, Mathf.PI * 2f);
                float r = rng.Range(LakeDockLayout.TreeMinRadius, LakeDockLayout.TreeMaxRadius);
                float height = rng.Range(0.8f, 1.3f);
                float x = Mathf.Cos(angle) * r, z = Mathf.Sin(angle) * r;
                if (LakeDockLayout.Blocked(x, z, LakeDockLayout.TreeClearance)) continue;
                var tree = new GameObject("Tree_" + placed.ToString("00"));
                tree.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
                tree.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(x, LakeDockLayout.ShoreY(r), z);
                tree.transform.localScale = new Vector3(height, height, height);
                BuilderUtil.EnsurePrimitive(tree.transform, "Trunk", PrimitiveType.Cylinder, new Vector3(0f, 1f, 0f),
                    Quaternion.identity, new Vector3(0.4f, 1f, 0.4f), trunkMaterial, true);
                BuilderUtil.EnsurePrimitive(tree.transform, "Canopy", PrimitiveType.Sphere, new Vector3(0f, 2.6f, 0f),
                    Quaternion.identity, new Vector3(2.4f, 2.4f, 2.4f), canopyMaterial, true);
                BuilderUtil.SetLayerRecursive(tree, Layers.Shore);
                placed++;
            }
            if (placed < LakeDockLayout.TreeCount)
                throw new System.InvalidOperationException("Placed only " + placed + " of " + LakeDockLayout.TreeCount + " trees");
        }

        // Deck 3 x 12 m (x -1.5..1.5, z -52..-40), top y 0.6; posts every 2 m at x +-1.4 down to the bed; ladders at z -41.5; ramp at x 12.
        static void AddDock()
        {
            GameObject dock = Root("Dock", Layers.Structure);
            Transform t = dock.transform;
            Material wood = MaterialLibrary.Get("M_Wood");
            Material woodDark = MaterialLibrary.Get("M_WoodDark");

            float deckLength = LakeDockLayout.DeckFarZ - LakeDockLayout.DeckNearZ;
            float deckUnderside = LakeDockLayout.DeckTopY - LakeDockLayout.DeckThickness;
            BuilderUtil.EnsurePrimitive(t, "Deck", PrimitiveType.Cube,
                new Vector3(0f, LakeDockLayout.DeckTopY - LakeDockLayout.DeckThickness * 0.5f, (LakeDockLayout.DeckNearZ + LakeDockLayout.DeckFarZ) * 0.5f),
                Quaternion.identity, new Vector3(LakeDockLayout.DeckWidth, LakeDockLayout.DeckThickness, deckLength), wood, true);

            int postRows = Mathf.RoundToInt(deckLength / LakeDockLayout.PostSpacing) + 1; // 7 rows: z -52, -50, ..., -40
            for (int i = 0; i < postRows; i++)
            {
                float z = LakeDockLayout.DeckNearZ + LakeDockLayout.PostSpacing * i;
                for (int side = -1; side <= 1; side += 2)
                {
                    float x = LakeDockLayout.PostX * side;
                    float bed = LakeDockLayout.BedYAt(x, z);
                    BuilderUtil.EnsurePrimitive(t, "Post_" + (side < 0 ? "L" : "R") + i, PrimitiveType.Cube,
                        new Vector3(x, (deckUnderside + bed) * 0.5f, z), Quaternion.identity,
                        new Vector3(LakeDockLayout.PostSize, deckUnderside - bed, LakeDockLayout.PostSize), woodDark, true);
                }
            }

            AddLadder(t, "Ladder_L", -LakeDockLayout.LadderX, woodDark);
            AddLadder(t, "Ladder_R", LakeDockLayout.LadderX, woodDark);

            Vector3 low = LakeDockLayout.RampLow, high = LakeDockLayout.RampHigh;
            Vector3 along = high - low;
            BuilderUtil.EnsurePrimitive(t, "RampDeck", PrimitiveType.Cube, (low + high) * 0.5f,
                Quaternion.LookRotation(along.normalized, Vector3.up),
                new Vector3(LakeDockLayout.RampWidth, LakeDockLayout.RampThickness, along.magnitude), wood, true);

            BuilderUtil.SetLayerRecursive(dock, Layers.Structure);
        }

        static void AddLadder(Transform parent, string name, float x, Material material)
        {
            float bed = LakeDockLayout.BedYAt(x, LakeDockLayout.LadderZ);
            float top = LakeDockLayout.DeckTopY;
            BuilderUtil.EnsurePrimitive(parent, name, PrimitiveType.Cube, new Vector3(x, (top + bed) * 0.5f, LakeDockLayout.LadderZ),
                Quaternion.identity, new Vector3(LakeDockLayout.LadderThickness, top - bed, LakeDockLayout.LadderWidth), material, true);
        }

        // Contract 6.5 exits: trigger boxes plus a child "Top" at the climb-out point.
        static void AddExits()
        {
            GameObject exits = Root("Exits", Layers.Water);
            AddExit(exits.transform, "LadderL", new Vector3(-2.1f, -0.8f, -41.5f), new Vector3(1.2f, 2.6f, 1.2f), new Vector3(-0.9f, 0.65f, -41.5f));
            AddExit(exits.transform, "LadderR", new Vector3(2.1f, -0.8f, -41.5f), new Vector3(1.2f, 2.6f, 1.2f), new Vector3(0.9f, 0.65f, -41.5f));
            AddExit(exits.transform, "Ramp", new Vector3(12f, -0.9f, -44f), new Vector3(3f, 2.4f, 4f), new Vector3(12f, 0.45f, -50.5f));
            BuilderUtil.SetLayerRecursive(exits, Layers.Water);
        }

        static void AddExit(Transform parent, string name, Vector3 center, Vector3 size, Vector3 topWorld)
        {
            var go = new GameObject(name);
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            go.transform.position = center;
            BoxCollider box = go.AddComponent<BoxCollider>();
            box.isTrigger = true;
            box.size = size;
            var top = new GameObject(WaterExit.TopChildName);
            top.transform.SetParent(go.transform, false);
            top.transform.position = topWorld;
            go.AddComponent<WaterExit>();
        }

        static void AddBellAnchor(NetworkObject bellPrefab)
        {
            GameObject go = Root("BellAnchor", Layers.Default);
            go.transform.position = new Vector3(1.1f, 0.6f, -40.6f);
            go.AddComponent<NetSpawnAnchor>().Configure(bellPrefab);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// The single build entry point (spec 4.6; contract 7.15, D40) and FishGame/Build All. Owned by T15.
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    public static class ProjectBuilder
    {
        [MenuItem("FishGame/Build All")]
        public static void BuildAllMenu()
        {
            // NewScene(Single) discards the open scene, so offer to save it first. Cancel aborts the build.
            if (!EditorSceneManager.SaveCurrentModifiedScenesIfUserWantsTo())
            {
                Debug.Log("FG BUILDALL CANCELLED");
                return;
            }
            Execute();
            PlayModeStartScene.Apply(); // a first build in the editor arms the play-from-any-scene hook
        }

        // Batchmode entry: -executeMethod FishGame.EditorTools.ProjectBuilder.BuildAll, always together with -quit.
        // Success returns normally, so -quit prints "Exiting batchmode successfully" (D40). Failure exits 1 in batchmode only.
        public static void BuildAll()
        {
            bool ok = Execute();
            if (!ok && Application.isBatchMode) EditorApplication.Exit(1);
        }

        // Runs every step even after a failure and collects the errors. Saves before validating (the validators read disk).
        public static bool RunAll(List<string> errors)
        {
            if (errors == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(errors));
            Step(errors, "ProjectSettings", ProjectSettingsBuilder.Apply);
            Step(errors, "Content", ContentBuilder.Build);
            Step(errors, "Prefabs", PrefabBuilder.Build);
            Step(errors, "NetworkPrefabs", NetworkPrefabsBuilder.Build);
            Step(errors, "Scenes", SceneBuilder.BuildAll);
            Step(errors, "BuildSettings", SceneBuilder.ApplyBuildSettings);
            Step(errors, "Save", AssetDatabase.SaveAssets);
            Step(errors, "Validate", () => errors.AddRange(ValidationRunner.Run()));
            return errors.Count == 0;
        }

        static bool Execute()
        {
            var errors = new List<string>();
            if (RunAll(errors))
            {
                Debug.Log("FG BUILDALL PASS");
                return true;
            }
            Debug.Log("FG BUILDALL FAIL errors=" + errors.Count);
            foreach (string error in errors) Debug.Log("FG BUILDALL ERROR " + error);
            return false;
        }

        static void Step(List<string> errors, string label, Action action)
        {
            try
            {
                action();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                errors.Add(label + ": " + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message);
                Debug.LogException(e);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Play from any scene: the play-mode start scene is Bootstrap (spec 4.6). Never set in batchmode. Owned by T15.
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    [InitializeOnLoad]
    public static class PlayModeStartScene
    {
        static PlayModeStartScene()
        {
            // The AssetDatabase is not ready inside an InitializeOnLoad constructor; wait one editor tick.
            EditorApplication.delayCall += Apply;
        }

        public static void Apply()
        {
            if (Application.isBatchMode) { Clear(); return; }
            var bootstrap = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<SceneAsset>(AssetPaths.BootstrapScene);
            if (bootstrap != null && EditorSceneManager.playModeStartScene != bootstrap)
                EditorSceneManager.playModeStartScene = bootstrap;
        }

        public static void Clear()
        {
            if (EditorSceneManager.playModeStartScene != null) EditorSceneManager.playModeStartScene = null;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Keeps Test Runner runs out of Bootstrap (D30). Owned by T15.
// PlayMode runs: test-framework 1.8.0 raises RunStarted only after entering play mode (PlayModeRunTask follows EnterPlayModeTask),
// which is too late. So ExitingEditMode clears the start scene when the runner's init scene (its controller object) is open.
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.TestTools.TestRunner.Api;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FishGame.EditorTools
{
    [InitializeOnLoad]
    public static class TestRunStartSceneGuard
    {
        // PlaymodeTestsController.kPlaymodeTestControllerName (internal in test-framework 1.8.0).
        const string TestControllerObjectName = "Code-based tests runner";

        static TestRunStartSceneGuard()
        {
            // Callbacks are not serialized, so they are re-registered after every domain reload.
            TestRunnerApi.RegisterTestCallback(new Callbacks());
            EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged -= OnPlayModeStateChanged;
            EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged += OnPlayModeStateChanged;
        }

        static void OnPlayModeStateChanged(PlayModeStateChange change)
        {
            if (change == PlayModeStateChange.ExitingEditMode && GameObject.Find(TestControllerObjectName) != null)
                PlayModeStartScene.Clear();
        }

        sealed class Callbacks : ICallbacks
        {
            public void RunStarted(ITestAdaptor testsToRun) => PlayModeStartScene.Clear();
            public void RunFinished(ITestResultAdaptor result) => PlayModeStartScene.Apply();
            public void TestStarted(ITestAdaptor test) { }
            public void TestFinished(ITestResultAdaptor result) { }
        }
    }
}
```

#### Notes for the implementer
- Run order matters. `RunAll` order is fixed: ProjectSettings first, because NGO's prefab postprocessor must be off before any other asset import. Content before Prefabs, because materials come first. Prefabs before NetworkPrefabs and Scenes.
- Never call `AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset` on a generated asset to "start clean". It changes GUIDs and breaks the 5.4 check. The only deletions are the two template files.
- Never add `using UnityEditor;` to `PrefabBuilder.cs`. Wherever `UnityEditor` is imported, write the gameplay class as `FishGame.Gameplay.SessionState`.
- `FishGame/Build All` in an open editor first asks to save the open scene, and arms the Bootstrap start scene once it finishes. `FishGame/Validate` prints `FG VALIDATE PASS` or `FG VALIDATE ERROR ...` lines.
- The architecture test is a regression guard. Passing in the red run is expected and does not mean the test is weak.
- The Nose is drawn at about 0.28 of its table size, because it is a child of the scaled Head. Keep the contract values.

**Verified NGO 2.13.3 behaviour this task relies on:**
- **Local RPC delivery.** When the host calls a `SendTo.Owner` RPC on an object it owns, `OwnerRpcTarget` hands it to `LocalSendRpcTarget`. With `DeferLocal` false (the default), that target runs the RPC body **synchronously, inside the call**. So `TeleportRpc` has been applied by the time it returns.
- **Teleport.** `NetworkTransform.Teleport` calls `SetStateInternal`, which calls `transform.SetPositionAndRotation` immediately.
- **Active scene.** `NetworkSceneManager` calls `SceneManager.SetActiveScene` for `LoadSceneMode.Single` loads.
- **Transport.** `UnityTransport.SetConnectionData(...)` sets `ServerListenAddress = listenAddress ?? ipv4Address` and switches to `ProtocolType.UnityTransport`.
- **Test Framework 1.8.0.** `TestEnumerator` runs nested `IEnumerator`s (`yield return Harness.X()`) and records exceptions thrown inside them (including `Assert.Fail`) as test failures. It also fails a test on any unexpected `Debug.LogError` or `LogException` ("Unhandled log message").

```csharp
// Authority: test-only (no networked state). Bootstrap composes the App services and lands on Menu with the menu open.
using System.Collections;

        public IEnumerator Bootstrap_Loads_Menu()
        {
            yield return PlayModeHarness.LoadBootstrapAndWaitForMenu();

            Assert.That(SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name, Is.EqualTo(SceneNames.Menu), "Active scene must be Menu");

            var app = AppBootstrap.Current;

            Assert.That(app.Services.Contains<IInputService>(), Is.True, "IInputService not registered");
            Assert.That(app.Services.Contains<ISettings>(), Is.True, "ISettings not registered");
```

```csharp
// Authority: test-only. Solo start/leave/restart on the real stack: host-authoritative solo session on 127.0.0.1, port 7790 (plain UnityTransport).
using System.Collections;
using FishGame.App;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Gameplay;
using FishGame.Networking;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Unity.Netcode.Transports.UTP;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;

namespace FishGame.Tests.PlayMode
{
    public class SoloSessionTests
    {
        [UnityTearDown]
        public IEnumerator TearDown()
        {
            yield return PlayModeHarness.TearDownApp();
        }

        [UnityTest]
        public IEnumerator Solo_Start_SpawnsOneOwnedPlayerWithCamera()
        {
            yield return PlayModeHarness.LoadBootstrapAndWaitForMenu();
            yield return PlayModeHarness.StartSoloAndWaitForPlayer();

            // Give a duplicate spawn (OnLoadEventCompleted plus OnSynchronizeComplete) time to show up before counting.
            yield return new WaitForSecondsRealtime(0.5f);

            var app = AppBootstrap.Current;
            var session = app.Services.Get<INetworkSession>();
            Assert.That(session.State, Is.EqualTo(ConnState.Connected), "Solo session must be Connected");
            Assert.That(session.Mode, Is.EqualTo(SessionMode.Solo), "Session mode must be Solo");
            Assert.That(app.NetworkManager.IsHost, Is.True, "Solo runs as host");
            Assert.That(SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name, Is.EqualTo(SceneNames.SpotLakeDock), "Solo must load Spot_LakeDock");
            Assert.That(ServiceRoots.Game, Is.Not.Null, "GameScope must register ServiceRoots.Game in the gameplay scene");

            Assert.That(PlayerNetState.Active.Count, Is.EqualTo(1), "Exactly one PlayerNetState expected");
            var player = PlayerNetState.Local;
            Assert.That(player, Is.Not.Null, "No local player");
            Assert.That(PlayerNetState.Active[0], Is.SameAs(player), "The only active player must be the local one");
            Assert.That(player.IsOwner, Is.True, "Local player must be owned by this peer");
            Assert.That(player.gameObject.layer, Is.EqualTo(Layers.Player), "Owner root must be on layer Player");

            var cameraTransform = player.transform.Find(PlayerRigPaths.Camera);
            Assert.That(cameraTransform, Is.Not.Null, "Player rig is missing " + PlayerRigPaths.Camera);
            var playerCamera = cameraTransform.GetComponent<Camera>();
            var listener = cameraTransform.GetComponent<AudioListener>();
            Assert.That(playerCamera, Is.Not.Null, "Player camera component missing");
            Assert.That(listener, Is.Not.Null, "Player AudioListener component missing");
            Assert.That(playerCamera.enabled, Is.True, "Owner Camera must be enabled");
            Assert.That(listener.enabled, Is.True, "Owner AudioListener must be enabled");

            var capsule = player.GetComponent<CapsuleCollider>();
            var controller = player.GetComponent<CharacterController>();
            Assert.That(capsule, Is.Not.Null, "PlayerFP root must have a CapsuleCollider");
            Assert.That(controller, Is.Not.Null, "PlayerFP root must have a CharacterController");
            Assert.That(capsule.enabled, Is.False, "Remote-only CapsuleCollider must be disabled on the owner");
            Assert.That(controller.enabled, Is.True, "Owner CharacterController must be enabled");

            var sceneCameraObject = GameObject.Find("SceneCamera");
            Assert.That(sceneCameraObject, Is.Not.Null, "SceneCamera missing in Spot_LakeDock");
            var sceneCamera = sceneCameraObject.GetComponent<Camera>();
            var sceneListener = sceneCameraObject.GetComponent<AudioListener>();
            Assert.That(sceneCamera, Is.Not.Null, "SceneCamera has no Camera");
            Assert.That(sceneListener, Is.Not.Null, "SceneCamera has no AudioListener");
            Assert.That(sceneCamera.enabled, Is.False, "SceneCamera Camera must be off while a local player exists");
            Assert.That(sceneListener.enabled, Is.False, "SceneCamera AudioListener must be off while a local player exists");
        }

        [UnityTest]
        public IEnumerator Solo_LeaveThenRestart_Works()
        {
            yield return PlayModeHarness.LoadBootstrapAndWaitForMenu();

            var app = AppBootstrap.Current;
            var nm = app.NetworkManager;
            var session = app.Services.Get<INetworkSession>();
            var local = app.Services.Get<LocalNetworkSession>();

            AssertNgoIdle(nm, "before the first start");
            yield return PlayModeHarness.StartSoloAndWaitForPlayer();
            Assert.That(PlayerNetState.Local, Is.Not.Null, "First solo start did not spawn a local player");
            AssertSoloTransport(nm, local, "first start");

            yield return PlayModeHarness.LeaveAndWaitForMenu();
            Assert.That(session.State, Is.EqualTo(ConnState.Offline), "Session must be Offline after leave");
            Assert.That(PlayerNetState.Local, Is.Null, "Local player must be gone after leave");
            Assert.That(PlayerNetState.Active.Count, Is.EqualTo(0), "No players may remain after leave");
            Assert.That(SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name, Is.EqualTo(SceneNames.Menu), "Leave must return to Menu");

            AssertNgoIdle(nm, "before the restart");
            yield return PlayModeHarness.StartSoloAndWaitForPlayer();
            Assert.That(session.State, Is.EqualTo(ConnState.Connected), "Restart must reach Connected");
            Assert.That(PlayerNetState.Local, Is.Not.Null, "Restart after leave did not spawn a local player");
            Assert.That(PlayerNetState.Active.Count, Is.EqualTo(1), "Exactly one player after restart");
            AssertSoloTransport(nm, local, "restart");
        }

        private static void AssertNgoIdle(Unity.Netcode.NetworkManager nm, string when)
        {
            Assert.That(nm, Is.Not.Null, "NetworkManager missing " + when);
            Assert.That(nm.ShutdownInProgress, Is.False, "NGO ShutdownInProgress must be false " + when);
            Assert.That(nm.IsListening, Is.False, "NGO must not be listening " + when);
        }

        private static void AssertSoloTransport(Unity.Netcode.NetworkManager nm, LocalNetworkSession local, string when)
        {
            UnityTransport transport = TransportSetup.Get(nm);
            Assert.That(transport, Is.Not.Null, "No UnityTransport (" + when + ")");
            Assert.That(transport.Protocol, Is.EqualTo(UnityTransport.ProtocolType.UnityTransport),
                "Solo must use the plain UnityTransport protocol, not Relay (" + when + ")");
            Assert.That(transport.ConnectionData.Address, Is.EqualTo(NetworkConstants.LoopbackAddress),
                "Solo must connect to 127.0.0.1 (" + when + ")");
            Assert.That(transport.ConnectionData.ServerListenAddress, Is.EqualTo(NetworkConstants.LoopbackAddress),
                "Solo must listen on 127.0.0.1 (" + when + ")");

            int first = NetworkConstants.TestPort;
            int last = NetworkConstants.TestPort + NetworkConstants.SoloPortRetryCount - 1;
            Assert.That((int)local.ActivePort, Is.InRange(first, last),
                "ActivePort must be TestPort..TestPort+9 (" + when + ")");
            Assert.That((int)transport.ConnectionData.Port, Is.EqualTo((int)local.ActivePort),
                "Transport port must equal LocalNetworkSession.ActivePort (" + when + ")");
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Authority: test-only. Fake input drives the owner's real PlayerLocomotion; TeleportRpc (host -> owner) is invoked by the host on its own player.
using System.Collections;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Gameplay;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;

namespace FishGame.Tests.PlayMode
{
    public class PlayerMovementTests
    {
        [UnityTearDown]
        public IEnumerator TearDown()
        {
            yield return PlayModeHarness.TearDownApp();
        }

        [UnityTest]
        public IEnumerator FakeInput_MoveForward_MovesPlayerMoreThanOneMeterInOneSecond()
        {
            yield return PlayModeHarness.LoadBootstrapAndWaitForMenu();
            var fake = InstallFakeInput();
            yield return PlayModeHarness.StartSoloAndWaitForPlayer();

            var player = PlayerNetState.Local;
            var locomotion = player.GetComponent<PlayerLocomotion>();
            Assert.That(locomotion, Is.Not.Null, "PlayerLocomotion missing on PlayerFP");
            Assert.That(locomotion.enabled, Is.True, "PlayerLocomotion must be enabled on the owner");
            yield return PlayModeHarness.WaitUntil(() => locomotion.IsGrounded, PlayModeHarness.DefaultTimeoutSeconds,
                "Player never became grounded on the dock");

            Vector3 start = player.transform.position;
            fake.Frame = new PlayerInputFrame { MoveY = 1f };
            float elapsed = 0f;
            int frames = 0;
            while (elapsed < 1f)
            {
                yield return null;
                elapsed += Time.deltaTime;
                frames++;
            }
            fake.Frame = default;

            Vector3 delta = player.transform.position - start;
            float flat = new Vector2(delta.x, delta.z).magnitude;
            string detail = $"moved {flat:F3} m (dz {delta.z:F3}) over {elapsed:F3} s of game time in {frames} frames";
            Assert.That(flat, Is.GreaterThan(1f), "Forward input must move the player more than 1 m in 1 s; " + detail);
            Assert.That(delta.z, Is.GreaterThan(1f), "Spawn faces +z (yaw 0), so forward input must move toward +z; " + detail);
        }

        [UnityTest]
        public IEnumerator TeleportRpc_OnDeck_LandsWithinFiveCentimetersWithZeroVelocity()
        {
            yield return PlayModeHarness.LoadBootstrapAndWaitForMenu();
            var fake = InstallFakeInput();
            yield return PlayModeHarness.StartSoloAndWaitForPlayer();

            var player = PlayerNetState.Local;
            var locomotion = player.GetComponent<PlayerLocomotion>();
            var actions = player.GetComponent<PlayerActions>();
            Assert.That(locomotion, Is.Not.Null, "PlayerLocomotion missing on PlayerFP");
            Assert.That(actions, Is.Not.Null, "PlayerActions missing on PlayerFP");
            yield return PlayModeHarness.WaitUntil(() => locomotion.IsGrounded, PlayModeHarness.DefaultTimeoutSeconds,
                "Player never became grounded on the dock");

            // Walk first, so that "zero velocity after teleport" is not trivially true.
            fake.Frame = new PlayerInputFrame { MoveY = 1f };
            yield return new WaitForSeconds(0.4f);
            float walkSpeed = new Vector2(locomotion.Velocity.x, locomotion.Velocity.z).magnitude;
            Assert.That(walkSpeed, Is.GreaterThan(1f), $"Precondition: the player must be walking before the teleport (speed {walkSpeed:F3})");
            fake.Frame = default;

            // Deck: x in [-1.5, 1.5], z in [-52, -40], top at y 0.6. Root y 0.65 matches the spawn points.
            var target = new Vector3(0f, 0.65f, -44f);
            const float yaw = 90f;

            // Host calling a SendTo.Owner RPC on its own player: NGO runs it locally and synchronously (DeferLocal is false).
            actions.TeleportRpc(target, yaw);

            float landed = Vector3.Distance(player.transform.position, target);
            Assert.That(landed, Is.LessThanOrEqualTo(0.05f), $"Teleport must land within 0.05 m of the target (was {landed:F4} m)");
            Assert.That(locomotion.Velocity.magnitude, Is.LessThan(1e-4f),
                $"ApplyTeleport must zero velocity (was {locomotion.Velocity})");
            Assert.That(Mathf.Abs(Mathf.DeltaAngle(player.transform.eulerAngles.y, yaw)), Is.LessThan(1f),
                $"Yaw must match the teleport yaw (was {player.transform.eulerAngles.y:F2})");

            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
            {
                yield return null;
            }

            Vector3 after = player.transform.position;
            float drift = new Vector2(after.x - target.x, after.z - target.z).magnitude;
            Assert.That(drift, Is.LessThanOrEqualTo(0.05f),
                $"Player must stay within 0.05 m (XZ) of the teleport target a few frames later (drifted {drift:F4} m)");
            Assert.That(Mathf.Abs(after.y - target.y), Is.LessThan(0.3f), $"Player must stay on the deck after teleport (y {after.y:F3})");
            float residual = new Vector2(locomotion.Velocity.x, locomotion.Velocity.z).magnitude;
            Assert.That(residual, Is.LessThan(0.05f), $"No horizontal momentum may survive the teleport (speed {residual:F4})");
            Assert.That(Mathf.Abs(Mathf.DeltaAngle(player.transform.eulerAngles.y, yaw)), Is.LessThan(1f),
                "Yaw must stay at the teleport yaw with no look input");
        }

        // Must run before StartSoloAndWaitForPlayer: PlayerLocomotion/PlayerCamera/PlayerInteractor read IInputService in OnEnable.
        private static FakeInputService InstallFakeInput()
        {
            Assert.That(ServiceRoots.App, Is.Not.Null, "ServiceRoots.App missing; load Bootstrap first");
            var fake = new FakeInputService();
            fake.MenuOpen = false;
            fake.GameplayContext = InputContext.Free;
            fake.Frame = default;
            ServiceRoots.App.Replace<IInputService>(fake);
            return fake;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Authority: test-only (no networked state). Drives the real App through Bootstrap -> Menu -> solo host -> leave for PlayMode tests.
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FishGame.App;
using FishGame.Core;
using FishGame.Gameplay;
using FishGame.Networking;
using FishGame.Runtime;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;

namespace FishGame.Tests.PlayMode
{
    public static class PlayModeHarness
    {
        public const float DefaultTimeoutSeconds = 10f;
        private const float SessionTimeoutSeconds = 20f;
        private const float TeardownTimeoutSeconds = 20f;

        public static IEnumerator LoadBootstrapAndWaitForMenu()
        {
            // AppBootstrap's duplicate guard would destroy the NEW App if a stale one survived, so refuse to continue on a leak.
            Assert.That(AppBootstrap.Current, Is.Null,
                "A previous test leaked the App (AppBootstrap.Current is not null); fix the first failing test's teardown first");
            Assert.That(Unity.Netcode.NetworkManager.Singleton, Is.Null,
                "A previous test leaked a NetworkManager (NetworkManager.Singleton is not null)");

            AppBootstrap.SuppressDevAutoStart = true;
            SceneManager.LoadScene(SceneNames.Bootstrap, LoadSceneMode.Single);
            yield return WaitUntil(
                () => AppBootstrap.Current != null && SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name == SceneNames.Menu,
                SessionTimeoutSeconds,
                "Bootstrap did not reach the Menu scene");
            yield return null; // let Menu objects and UiFlowController's activeSceneChanged handling settle
        }

        public static IEnumerator StartSoloAndWaitForPlayer()
        {
            var app = AppBootstrap.Current;
            Assert.That(app, Is.Not.Null, "StartSoloAndWaitForPlayer: no App; call LoadBootstrapAndWaitForMenu first");

            var local = app.Services.Get<LocalNetworkSession>();
            local.Port = NetworkConstants.TestPort;
            var session = app.Services.Get<INetworkSession>();
            Assert.That(session.State, Is.EqualTo(ConnState.Offline), "Solo start requested while the session is not Offline");

            yield return Await(session.StartLocalAsync(false, CancellationToken.None), SessionTimeoutSeconds);
            yield return WaitUntil(
                () => PlayerNetState.Local != null && SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name == SceneNames.SpotLakeDock,
                SessionTimeoutSeconds,
                "Local player never spawned in Spot_LakeDock after solo start");
            yield return null; // one frame for owner-side OnEnable work (locomotion, camera, SceneCameraSwitch)
        }

        public static IEnumerator LeaveAndWaitForMenu()
        {
            var app = AppBootstrap.Current;
            Assert.That(app, Is.Not.Null, "LeaveAndWaitForMenu: no App");
            var session = app.Services.Get<INetworkSession>();
            var nm = app.NetworkManager;

            yield return Await(session.LeaveAsync(), SessionTimeoutSeconds);
            yield return WaitUntil(
                () => session.State == ConnState.Offline
                      && !nm.ShutdownInProgress
                      && !nm.IsListening
                      && PlayerNetState.Local == null
                      && SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name == SceneNames.Menu,
                SessionTimeoutSeconds,
                "Did not return to an idle Menu after leave");
            yield return null;
        }

        // Never asserts before DestroyForTests: a failing teardown must still remove the App, or every later test is poisoned.
        public static IEnumerator TearDownApp()
        {
            string problem = null;
            var app = AppBootstrap.Current;
            if (app != null)
            {
                INetworkSession session = null;
                if (app.Services != null && app.Services.TryGet<INetworkSession>(out var found))
                {
                    session = found;
                }

                if (session != null && session.State != ConnState.Offline)
                {
                    Task leave = null;
                    try
                    {
                        leave = session.LeaveAsync();
                    }
                    catch (Exception e)
                    {
                        problem = "LeaveAsync threw: " + e.GetBaseException().Message;
                    }

                    if (leave != null)
                    {
                        double leaveDeadline = Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble + TeardownTimeoutSeconds;
                        while (!leave.IsCompleted && Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble < leaveDeadline)
                        {
                            yield return null;
                        }

                        if (!leave.IsCompleted)
                        {
                            problem = $"LeaveAsync did not complete within {TeardownTimeoutSeconds} s";
                        }
                        else if (leave.IsFaulted)
                        {
                            problem = "LeaveAsync faulted: " + leave.Exception.GetBaseException().Message;
                        }
                    }
                }

                app.DestroyForTests();
            }

            double deadline = Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble + TeardownTimeoutSeconds;
            while ((AppBootstrap.Current != null || Unity.Netcode.NetworkManager.Singleton != null || PlayerNetState.Active.Count > 0)
                   && Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble < deadline)
            {
                yield return null;
            }
            yield return null;
            yield return null;

            if (problem == null && AppBootstrap.Current != null)
            {
                problem = "AppBootstrap.Current is still set after DestroyForTests";
            }
            if (problem == null && Unity.Netcode.NetworkManager.Singleton != null)
            {
                problem = "NetworkManager.Singleton is still set after DestroyForTests";
            }
            if (problem == null && PlayerNetState.Active.Count > 0)
            {
                problem = $"{PlayerNetState.Active.Count} PlayerNetState(s) still registered after DestroyForTests";
            }
            if (problem != null)
            {
                Assert.Fail("TearDownApp: " + problem);
            }
        }

        public static IEnumerator WaitUntil(Func<bool> condition, float timeoutSeconds, string failMessage)
        {
            double deadline = Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble + timeoutSeconds;
            while (!condition())
            {
                if (Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble >= deadline)
                {
                    Assert.Fail($"{failMessage} (timed out after {timeoutSeconds} s)");
                }
                yield return null;
            }
        }

        public static IEnumerator Await(Task task, float timeoutSeconds)
        {
            Assert.That(task, Is.Not.Null, "Await: task is null");
            double deadline = Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble + timeoutSeconds;
            while (!task.IsCompleted)
            {
                if (Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble >= deadline)
                {
                    Assert.Fail($"Task did not complete within {timeoutSeconds} s");
                }
                yield return null;
            }

            if (task.IsFaulted)
            {
                Assert.Fail("Task faulted: " + task.Exception.GetBaseException());
            }
            if (task.IsCanceled)
            {
                Assert.Fail("Task was cancelled");
            }
        }
    }
}
```
